and he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. and he said, "o my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. my lord has made it reality. and he was certainly good to me when he took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. indeed, my lord is subtle in what he wills. indeed, it is he who is the knowing, the wise.



My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."
Rabbi qad ātaitanī minal-mulki wa ‘allamtanī min ta'wīlil-aḥādīṡ(i), fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), anta waliyyī fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), tawaffanī muslimaw wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
رب قد ءاتيتني من الملك وعلمتني من تاويل الاحاديث  فاطر السموت والارض انت ولي في الدنيا والاخره  توفني مسلما والحقني بالصلحين

my lord, you have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. creator of the heavens and earth, you are my protector in this world and the hereafter. cause me to die a muslim and join me with the righteous."


That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.
Żālika min ambā'il-gaibi nūḥīhi ilaik(a), wa mā kunta ladaihim iż ajma‘ū amrahum wa hum yamkurūn(a).
ذلك من انباء الغيب نوحيه اليك  وما كنت لديهم اذ اجمعوا امرهم وهم يمكرون
that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal, [o muhammad], to you. and you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.
zalikaminambailgaibinuhihiilaikawamakuntaladaihimizajmauamrahumwahumyamkurunathalikaminanbaialghaybinooheehiilaykawamakuntaladayhimithajmaaaooamrahumwahumyamkuroon
And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
Wa mā akṡarun-nāsi wa lau ḥaraṣta bimu'minīn(a).
وما اكثر الناس ولو حرصت بمؤمنين
and most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
wamaaksarunnasiwalauharastabimumininawamaaktharuannasiwalawharastabimumineen
And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.
Wa mā tas'aluhum ‘alaihi min ajr(in), in huwa illā żikrul lil-‘ālamīn(a).
وما تسلهم عليه من اجر  ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
and you do not ask of them for it any payment. it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
wamatasaluhumalaihiminajrininhuwaillazikrullilalaminawamatasaluhumaaalayhiminajrininhuwaillathikrunlilaaalameen
And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
Wa ka'ayyim min āyatin fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi yamurrūna ‘alaihā wa hum ‘anhā mu‘rḍūn(a).
وكاين من ءايه في السموت والارض يمرون عليها وهم عنها معرضون
and how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
wakaayyimminayatinfissamawatiwalardiyamurrunaalaihawahumanhamurdunawakaayyinminayatinfeeassamawatiwalardiyamurroonaaaalayhawahumaaanhamuaaridoon
And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.
Wa mā yu'minu akṡaruhum billāhi illā wa hum musyrikūn(a).
وما يؤمن اكثرهم بالله الا وهم مشركون
and most of them believe not in allah except while they associate others with him.
wamayuminuaksaruhumbillahiillawahummusyrikunawamayuminuaktharuhumbillahiillawahummushrikoon
Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
Afa aminū an ta'tiyahum gāsyiyatum min ‘ażābillāhi au ta'tiyahumus-sā‘atu bagtataw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
افامنوا ان تاتيهم غشيه من عذاب الله او تاتيهم الساعه بغته وهم لا يشعرون
then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of allah or that the hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
afaaminuantatiyahumgasyiyatumminazabillahiautatiyahumussaatubagtatawwahumlayasyurunaafaaminooantatiyahumghashiyatunminaaathabiallahiawtatiyahumuassaaaatubaghtatanwahumlayashaauroon
Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."
Qul hāżihī sabīlī ad‘ū ilallāh(i), ‘alā baṣīratin ana wa manittaba‘anī, wa subḥānallāhi wa mā ana minal-musyrikīn(a).
قل هذه سبيلي ادعوا الي الله  علي بصيره انا ومن اتبعني  وسبحن الله وما انا من المشركين
say, "this is my way; i invite to allah with insight, i and those who follow me. and exalted is allah; and i am not of those who associate others with him."
qulhazihisabiliaduilallahialabasiratinanawamanittabaaniwasubhanallahiwamaanaminalmusyrikinaqulhathihisabeeleeadaaooilaallahiaaalabaseeratinanawamaniittabaaaaneewasubhanaallahiwamaanaminaalmushrikeen

And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?

Wa mā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilaihim min ahlil-qurā, afalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fa yanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qablihim, wa ladārul-ākhirati khairul lil-lażīnattaqau, afalā ta‘qilūn(a).
وما ارسلنا من قبلك الا رجالا نوحي اليهم من اهل القري  افلم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبلهم  ولدار الاخره خير للذين اتقوا  افلا تعقلون

and we sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom we revealed from among the people of cities. so have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? and the home of the hereafter is best for those who fear allah; then will you not reason?



[They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.
Ḥattā iżastai'asar-rusulu wa ẓannū annahum qad kużibū jā'ahum naṣrunā, fa nujjiya man nasyā'(u), wa lā yuraddu ba'sunā ‘anil-qaumil-mujrimīn(a).
حتي اذا استيس الرسل وظنوا انهم قد كذبوا جاءهم نصرنا فنجي من نشاء  ولا يرد باسنا عن القوم المجرمين

[they continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them our victory, and whoever we willed was saved. and our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.

hattaizastaiasarrusuluwazannuannahumqadkuzibujaahumnasrunafanujjiyamannasyauwalayuraddubasunaanilqaumilmujriminahattaithaistayasaarrusuluwathannooannahumqadkuthiboojaahumnasrunafanujjiyamannashaowalayuraddubasunaaaanialqawmialmujrimeen

There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
Laqad kāna fī qaṣaṣihim ‘ibratul li'ulil-albāb(i), mā kāna ḥadīṡay yuftarā wa lākin taṣdīqal-lażī baina yadaihi wa tafṣīla kulli syai'iw wa hudaw wa raḥmatal liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
لقد كان في قصصهم عبره لاولي الالبب  ما كان حديثا يفتري ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه وتفصيل كل شيء وهدي ورحمه لقوم يؤمنون

there was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. never was it [i.e., the qur’an] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

laqadkanafiqasasihimibratulliulilalbabimakanahadisayyuftarawalakintasdiqallazibainayadaihiwatafsilakullisyaiiwwahudawwarahmatalliqaumiyyuminunalaqadkanafeeqasasihimaaibratunlioleealalbabimakanahadeethanyuftarawalakintasdeeqaallatheebaynayadayhiwatafseelakullishayinwahudanwarahmatanliqawminyuminoon
Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
Alif lām mīm rā, tilka āyātul-kitāb(i), wal-lażī unzila ilaika mir rabbikal-ḥaqqu wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā yu'minūn(a).
المر  تلك ءايت الكتب  والذي انزل اليك من ربك الحق ولكن اكثر الناس لا يؤمنون
alif, lam, meem, ra. these are the verses of the book; and what has been revealed to you from your lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
aliflammimratilkaayatulkitabiwallaziunzilailaikamirrabbikalhaqquwalakinnaaksarannasilayuminunaaliflammeemratilkaayatualkitabiwallatheeonzilailaykaminrabbikaalhaqquwalakinnaaktharaannasilayuminoon

It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.

Allāhul-lażī rafa‘as-samāwāti bigairi ‘amadin taraunahā ṡummastawā ‘alal-‘arsyi wa sakhkharasy-syamsa  wal-qamar(a), kulluy yajrī li'ajalim musammā(n), yudabbirul-amra yufaṣṣilul-āyāti la‘allakum biliqā'i rabbikum tūqinūn(a).
الله الذي رفع السموت بغير عمد ترونها  ثم استوي علي العرش  وسخر الشمس والقمر  كل يجري لاجل مسمي  يدبر الامر يفصل الايت لعلكم بلقاء ربكم توقنون

it is allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then he established himself above the throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. he arranges [each] matter; he details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your lord, be certain.



And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
Wa huwal-lażī maddal-arḍa wa ja‘ala fīhā rawāsiya wa anhārā(n), wa min kulliṡ-ṡamarāti ja‘ala fīhā zaujainiṡnaini yugsyil-lailan-nahār(a), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
وهو الذي مد الارض وجعل فيها روسي وانهرا  ومن كل الثمرت جعل فيها زوجين اثنين  يغشي اليل النهار  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون

and it is he who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits he made therein two mates; he causes the night to cover the day. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.



And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

Wa fil-arḍi qiṭa‘um mutajāwirātuw wa jannātum min a‘nābiw wa zar‘uw wa nakhīlun ṣinwānuw wa gairu ṣinwāniy yusqā bimā'iw wāḥid(in), wa nufaḍḍilu ba‘ḍahā ‘alā ba‘ḍin fil-ukul(i), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
وفي الارض قطع متجورت وجنت من اعنب وزرع ونخيل صنوان وغير صنوان يسقي بماء وحد ونفضل بعضها علي بعض في الاكل  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون

and within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but we make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.



And if you are astonished, [O Muḥammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

Wa in ta‘jab fa ‘ajabun qauluhum a'iżā kunnā turāban a'innā lafī khalqin jadīd(in), ulā'ikal-lażīna kafarū birabbihim, wa ulā'ikal-aglālu fī a‘nāqihim, wa ulā'ika aṣḥābun-nār(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
وان تعجب فعجب قولهم اءذا كنا تربا اءنا لفي خلق جديد  اولئك الذين كفروا بربهم  واولئك الاغلل في اعناقهم  واولئك اصحب النار  هم فيها خلدون

and if you are astonished, [o muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "when we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" those are the ones who have disbelieved in their lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally.



They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
Wa yasta‘jilūnaka bis-sayyi'ati qablal-ḥasanati wa qad khalat min qablihimul-maṡulāt(u), wa inna rabbaka lażū magfiratil lin-nāsi ‘alā ẓulmihim, wa inna rabbaka lasyadīdul-‘iqāb(i).
ويستعجلونك بالسيئه قبل الحسنه وقد خلت من قبلهم المثلت  وان ربك لذو مغفره للناس علي ظلمهم  وان ربك لشديد العقاب

they impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. and indeed, your lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your lord is severe in penalty.


And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.
Wa yaqūlul-lażīna kafarū lau lā unzila ‘alaihi āyatum mir rabbih(ī), innamā anta munżiruw wa likulli qaumin hād(in).
ويقول الذين كفروا لولا انزل عليه ءايه من ربه  انما انت منذر  ولكل قوم هاد
and those who disbelieved say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" you are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.
wayaqulullazinakafarulaulaunzilaalaihiayatummirrabbihiinnamaantamunziruwwalikulliqauminhadinwayaqooluallatheenakafaroolawlaonzilaaaalayhiayatunminrabbihiinnamaantamunthirunwalikulliqawminhad
Allāh knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.
Allāhu ya‘lamu mā taḥmilu kullu unṡā wa mā tagīḍul-arḥāmu wa mā tazdād(u), wa kullu syai'in ‘indahū bimiqdār(in).
الله يعلم ما تحمل كل انثي وما تغيض الارحام وما تزداد  وكل شيء عنده بمقدار
allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. and everything with him is by due measure.
allahuyalamumatahmilukulluunsawamatagidularhamuwamatazdaduwakullusyaiinindahubimiqdarinallahuyaaalamumatahmilukulluonthawamatagheedualarhamuwamatazdaduwakullushayinaaindahubimiqdar
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
‘Alimul-gaibi wasy-syahādatil-kabīrul-muta‘āl(i).
علم الغيب والشهده الكبير المتعال
[he is] knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the grand, the exalted.
alimulgaibiwasysyahadatilkabirulmutaaliaaalimualghaybiwashshahadatialkabeerualmutaaaal
It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.
Sawā'um minkum man asarral-qaula wa man jahara bihī wa man huwa mustakhfim bil-laili wa sāribum bin-nahār(i).
سواء منكم من اسر القول ومن جهر به ومن هو مستخف باليل وسارب بالنهار
it is the same [to him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.
sawaumminkummanasarralqaulawamanjaharabihiwamanhuwamustakhfimbillailiwasaribumbinnaharisawaonminkummanasarraalqawlawamanjaharabihiwamanhuwamustakhfinbillayliwasaribunbinnahar

For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

Lahū mu‘aqqibātum mim baini yadaihi wa min khalfihī yaḥfaẓūnahū min amrillāh(i), innallāha lā yugayyiru mā biqaumin ḥattā yugayyirū mā bi'anfusihim, wa iżā arādallāhu biqaumin sū'an falā maradda lah(ū), wa mā lahum min dūnihī miw wāl(in).
له معقبت من بين يديه ومن خلفه يحفظونه من امر الله  ان الله لا يغير ما بقوم حتي يغيروا ما بانفسهم  واذا اراد الله بقوم سوءا فلا مرد له  وما لهم من دونه من وال

for him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of allah. indeed, allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. and when allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. and there is not for them besides him any patron.


It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.
Huwal-lażī  yurīkumul -barqa khaufaw  wa  ṭama‘aw  wa  yunsyi'us -saḥābaṡ-ṡiqāl(a).
هو الذي يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينشئ السحاب الثقال
it is he who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.
huwallaziyurikumulbarqakhaufawwatamaawwayunsyiussahabassiqalahuwaallatheeyureekumualbarqakhawfanwatamaaaanwayunshioassahabaaththiqal

And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.
Wa yusabbiḥur-ra‘du biḥamdihī wal-malā'ikatu min khīfatih(ī), wa yursiluṣ-ṣawā‘iqa fa yuṣību bihā may yasyā'u wa hum yujālidilūna fillāh(i), wa huwa syadīdul-miḥāl(i).
ويسبح الرعد بحمده والملئكه من خيفته ويرسل الصوعق فيصيب بها من يشاء وهم يجدلون في الله وهو شديد المحال

and the thunder exalts [allah] with praise of him - and the angels [as well] from fear of him - and he sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom he wills while they dispute about allah; and he is severe in assault.

wayusabbihurradubihamdihiwalmalaikatuminkhifatihiwayursilussawaiqafayusibubihamayyasyauwahumyujalidilunafillahiwahuwasyadidulmihaliwayusabbihuarraaadubihamdihiwalmalaikatuminkheefatihiwayursiluassawaaaiqafayuseebubihamanyashaowahumyujadiloonafeeallahiwahuwashadeedualmihal

To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].
Lahū da‘watul-ḥaqq(i), wal-lażīna yad‘ūna min dūnihī lā yastajībūna lahum bisyai'in illā kabāsiṭi kaffaihi ilal-mā'i liyabluga fāhu wa mā huwa bibāligih(ī), wa mā du‘ā'ul-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl(in).
له دعوه الحق  والذين يدعون من دونه لا يستجيبون لهم بشيء الا كبسط كفيه الي الماء ليبلغ فاه وما هو ببلغه  وما دعاء الكفرين الا في ضلل

to him [alone] is the supplication of truth. and those they call upon besides him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. and the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].


And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
Wa lillāhi yasjudu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭau‘aw wa karhaw wa ẓilāluhum bil-guduwwi wal-āṣāl(i).
ولله يسجد من في السموت والارض طوعا وكرها وظللهم بالغدو والاصال
and to allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
walillahiyasjudumanfissamawatiwalarditauawwakarhawwazilaluhumbilguduwwiwalasaliwalillahiyasjudumanfeeassamawatiwalarditawaaanwakarhanwathilaluhumbilghuduwwiwalasal

Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."

Qul mar rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), qulillāh(u), qul afattakhażtum  min dūnihī auliyā'a lā yamlikūna li'anfusihim naf‘aw wa lā ḍarrā(n), qul hal yastawil-a‘mā wal-baṣīr(u),  am hal tastawiẓ-ẓulumātu wan-nūr(u), am ja‘alū lillāhi syurakā'a khalaqū kakhalqihī fa tasyābahal-khalqu  ‘alaihim, qulillāhu khāliqu kulli syai'iw wa huwal-wāḥidul-qahhār(u).

قل من رب السموت والارض قل الله  قل افاتخذتم من دونه اولياء لا يملكون لانفسهم نفعا ولا ضرا  قل هل يستوي الاعمي والبصير ام هل تستوي الظلمت والنور  ام جعلوا لله شركاء خلقوا كخلقه فتشبه الخلق عليهم  قل الله خلق كل شيء وهو الوحد القهر

say, "who is lord of the heavens and earth?" say, "allah." say, "have you then taken besides him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" say, "is the blind equivalent to the seeing? or is darkness equivalent to light? or have they attributed to allah partners who created like his creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" say, "allah is the creator of all things, and he is the one, the prevailing."



He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.

Anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa sālat audiyatum biqadarihā faḥtamalas-sailu zabadar rābiyā(n), wa mimmā yūqidūna ‘alaihi fin-nāribtigā'a ḥilyatin au matā‘in zabadum miṡluh(ū), każālika yaḍribullāhul-ḥaqqa wal-bāṭil(a), fa ammaz-zabadu fa yażhabu jufā'ā(n), wa ammā mā yanfa‘un-nāsa fa yamkuṡu fil-arḍ(i), każālika yaḍribullāhul-amṡāl(a).

انزل من السماء ماء فسالت اوديه بقدرها فاحتمل السيل زبدا رابيا  ومما يوقدون عليه في النار ابتغاء حليه او متع زبد مثله  كذلك يضرب الله الحق والبطل  فاما الزبد فيذهب جفاء  واما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الارض  كذلك يضرب الله الامثال

he sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. and from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. thus allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. as for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. thus does allah present examples.



For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

Lil-lażīnastajābū lirabbihimul-ḥusnā, wal-lażīna lam yastajībū lahū lau anna lahum mā fil-arḍi jamī‘aw wa miṡlahū ma‘ahū laftadau bih(ī), ulā'ika lahum sū'ul-ḥisāb(i), wa ma'wāhum jahannam(u), wa bi'sal-mihād(u).
للذين استجابوا لربهم الحسني  والذين لم يستجيبوا له لو ان لهم ما في الارض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به  اولئك لهم سوء الحساب وماويهم جهنم  وبئس المهاد

for those who have responded to their lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. those will have the worst account, and their refuge is hell, and wretched is the resting place.


Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -
Afamay ya‘lamu annamā unzila ilaika mir rabbikal-ḥaqqu kaman huwa a‘mā, innamā yatażakkaru ulul-albāb(i).
افمن يعلم انما انزل اليك من ربك الحق كمن هو اعمي  انما يتذكر اولوا الالبب
then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your lord is the truth like one who is blind? they will only be reminded who are people of understanding -
afamayyalamuannamaunzilailaikamirrabbikalhaqqukamanhuwaamainnamayatazakkaruululalbabiafamanyaaalamuannamaonzilailaykaminrabbikaalhaqqukamanhuwaaaamainnamayatathakkaruolooalalbab
Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,
Al-lażīna yūfūna bi‘ahdillāhi wa lā yanquḍūnal-mīṡāq(a).
الذين يوفون بعهد الله ولا ينقضون الميثق
those who fulfill the covenant of allah and do not break the contract,
allazinayufunabiahdillahiwalayanqudunalmisaqaallatheenayoofoonabiaaahdiallahiwalayanqudoonaalmeethaq
And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,
Wal-lażīna yaṣilūna mā amarallāhu bihī ay yūṣala wa yakhsyauna rabbahum wa yakhāfūna sū'al-ḥisāb(i).
والذين يصلون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويخشون ربهم ويخافون سوء الحساب
and those who join that which allah has ordered to be joined and fear their lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,
wallazinayasilunamaamarallahubihiayyusalawayakhsyaunarabbahumwayakhafunasualhisabiwallatheenayasiloonamaamaraallahubihianyoosalawayakhshawnarabbahumwayakhafoonasooaalhisab

And those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home -
Wal-lażīna ṣabarubtigā'a wajhi rabbihim wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta wa anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirraw wa ‘alāniyataw wa yadra'ūna bil-ḥasanatis-sayyi'ata  ulā'ika lahum ‘uqbad-dār(i).
والذين صبروا ابتغاء وجه ربهم واقاموا الصلوه وانفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانيه ويدرءون بالحسنه السيئه اولئك لهم عقبي الدار

and those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their lord, and establish prayer and spend from what we have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home -

wallazinasabarubtigaawajhirabbihimwaaqamussalatawaanfaqumimmarazaqnahumsirrawwaalaniyatawwayadraunabilhasanatissayyiataulaikalahumuqbaddariwallatheenasabarooibtighaawajhirabbihimwaaqamooassalatawaanfaqoomimmarazaqnahumsirranwaaaalaniyatanwayadraoonabilhasanatiassayyiataolaikalahumaauqbaaddar

Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],
Jannātu ‘adniy yadkhulūnahā wa man ṣalaḥa min ābā'ihim wa azwājihim  wa żurriyyātihim wal-malā'ikatu yadkhulūna ‘alaihim min kulli bāb(in).
جنت عدن يدخلونها ومن صلح من ءابائهم وازوجهم وذريتهم  والملئكه يدخلون عليهم من كل باب

gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. and the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],

jannatuadniyyadkhulunahawamansalahaminabaihimwaazwajihimwazurriyyatihimwalmalaikatuyadkhulunaalaihimminkullibabinjannatuaaadninyadkhuloonahawamansalahaminabaihimwaazwajihimwathurriyyatihimwalmalaikatuyadkhuloonaaaalayhimminkullibab
"Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
Salāmun ‘alaikum bimā ṣabartum fa ni‘ma ‘uqbad-dār(i).
سلم عليكم بما صبرتم  فنعم عقبي الدار
"peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. and excellent is the final home."
salamunalaikumbimasabartumfanimauqbaddarisalamunaaalaykumbimasabartumfaniaamaaauqbaaddar

But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.
Wal-lażīna yanquḍūna ‘ahdallāhi mim ba‘di mīṡāqihī wa yaqṭa‘ūna mā amarallāhu bihī ay yūṣala wa yufsidūna fil-arḍ(i), ulā'ika lahumul-la‘natu wa lahum sū'ud-dār(i).
والذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثقه ويقطعون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويفسدون في الارض  اولئك لهم اللعنه ولهم سوء الدار

but those who break the covenant of allah after contracting it and sever that which allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.

wallazinayanqudunaahdallahimimbadimisaqihiwayaqtaunamaamarallahubihiayyusalawayufsidunafilardiulaikalahumullanatuwalahumsuuddariwallatheenayanqudoonaaaahdaallahiminbaaadimeethaqihiwayaqtaaaoonamaamaraallahubihianyoosalawayufsidoonafeealardiolaikalahumuallaaanatuwalahumsoooaddar
Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.
Allāhu yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), wa fariḥū bil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa mal-ḥayātud-dun-yā fil-ākhirati illā matā‘(un).
الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر  وفرحوا بالحيوه الدنيا وما الحيوه الدنيا في الاخره الا متع
allah extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]. and they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.

allahuyabsuturrizqalimayyasyauwayaqdiruwafarihubilhayatiddunyawamalhayatuddunyafilakhiratiillamataunallahuyabsutuarrizqalimanyashaowayaqdiruwafarihoobilhayatiaddunyawamaalhayatuaddunyafeealakhiratiillamataaa

And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -
Wa yaqūlul-lażīna kafarū lau lā unzila ‘alaihi āyatum mir rabbih(ī), qul innallāha yuḍillu may yasyā'u wa yahdī ilaihi man anāb(a).
ويقول الذين كفروا لولا انزل عليه ءايه من ربه  قل ان الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي اليه من اناب

and those who disbelieved say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" say, [o muhammad], "indeed, allah leaves astray whom he wills and guides to himself whoever turns back [to him] -

wayaqulullazinakafarulaulaunzilaalaihiayatummirrabbihiqulinnallahayudillumayyasyauwayahdiilaihimananabawayaqooluallatheenakafaroolawlaonzilaaaalayhiayatunminrabbihiqulinnaallahayudillumanyashaowayahdeeilayhimananab
Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."
Al-lażīna āmanū wa taṭma'innu qulūbuhum biżikrillāh(i), alā biżikrillāhi taṭma'innul-qulūb(u).
الذين ءامنوا وتطمئن قلوبهم بذكر الله  الا بذكر الله تطمئن القلوب
those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of allah. unquestionably, by the remembrance of allah hearts are assured."
allazinaamanuwatatmainnuqulubuhumbizikrillahialabizikrillahitatmainnulqulubuallatheenaamanoowatatmainnuquloobuhumbithikriallahialabithikriallahitatmainnualquloob
Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
Allażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti ṭūbā lahum wa ḥusnu ma'āb(in).
الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت طوبي لهم وحسن ماب
those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
allazinaamanuwaamilussalihatitubalahumwahusnumaabinallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatitoobalahumwahusnumaab

Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."

Każālika arsalnāka fī ummatin qad khalat min qablihā umamul litatluwa ‘alaihimul-lażī auḥainā ilaika wa hum yakfurūna bir-raḥmān(i), qul huwa rabbī lā ilāha illā huw(a), ‘alaihi tawakkaltu wa ilaihi matāb(i).
كذلك ارسلنك في امه قد خلت من قبلها امم لتتلوا عليهم الذي اوحينا اليك وهم يكفرون بالرحمن  قل هو ربي لا اله الا هو عليه توكلت واليه متاب

thus have we sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which we revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the most merciful. say, "he is my lord; there is no deity except him. upon him i rely, and to him is my return."



And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.

Wa lau anna qur'ānan suyyirat bihil-jibālu au quṭṭi‘at bihil-arḍu au kullima bihil-mautā, bal lillāhil-amru jamī‘ā(n), afalam yai'asil-lażīna  āmanū allau yasyā'ullāhu lahadan-nāsa jamī‘ā(n), wa lā yazālul-lażīna kafarū tuṣībuhum bimā ṣana‘ū qāri‘atun au taḥullu qarībam min dārihim ḥattā ya'tiya wa‘dullāh(i), innallāha lā yukhliful-mī‘ād(a).

ولو ان قرءانا سيرت به الجبال او قطعت به الارض او كلم به الموتي  بل لله الامر جميعا  افلم يايس الذين ءامنوا ان لو يشاء الله لهدي الناس جميعا  ولا يزال الذين كفروا تصيبهم بما صنعوا قارعه او تحل قريبا من دارهم حتي ياتي وعد الله  ان الله لا يخلف الميعاد

and if there was any qur’an [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this qur’an], but to allah belongs the affair entirely. then have those who believed not accepted that had allah willed, he would have guided the people, all of them? and those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of allah. indeed, allah does not fail in [his] promise.


And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
Wa laqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fa amlaitu lil-lażīna kafarū ṡumma akhażtuhum fa kaifa kāna ‘iqāb(i).
ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فامليت للذين كفروا ثم اخذتهم  فكيف كان عقاب
and already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and i extended the time of those who disbelieved; then i seized them, and how [terrible] was my penalty.
walaqadistuhziabirusulimminqablikafaamlaitulillazinakafarusummaakhaztuhumfakaifakanaiqabiwalaqadiistuhziabirusulinminqablikafaamlaytulillatheenakafaroothummaakhathtuhumfakayfakanaaaiqab

Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.

Afaman huwa qā'imun ‘alā kulli nafsim bimā kasabat, wa ja‘alū lillāhi syurakā'(a), qul sammūhum, am tunabbi'ūnahū bimā lā ya‘lamu fil-arḍi am biẓāhirim minal-qaul(i), bal zuyyina lil-lażīna kafarū makruhum wa ṣuddū ‘anis-sabīl(i), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
افمن هو قائم علي كل نفس بما كسبت  وجعلوا لله شركاء قل سموهم  ام تنبونه بما لا يعلم في الارض ام بظهر من القول  بل زين للذين كفروا مكرهم وصدوا عن السبيل  ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد

then is he who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? but to allah they have attributed partners. say, "name them. or do you inform him of that which he knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. and whomever allah sends astray - there will be for him no guide.


For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.
Lahum ‘ażābun fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa la‘ażābul-ākhirati asyaqq(u), wa mā lahum minallāhi miw wāq(in).
لهم عذاب في الحيوه الدنيا  ولعذاب الاخره اشق  وما لهم من الله من واق
for them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the hereafter is more severe. and they will not have from allah any protector.
lahumazabunfilhayatiddunyawalaazabulakhiratiasyaqquwamalahumminallahimiwwaqinlahumaaathabunfeealhayatiaddunyawalaaaathabualakhiratiashaqquwamalahumminaallahiminwaq

The example [i.e., description] of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.
Maṡalul-jannatil-latī wu‘idal-muttaqūn(a), tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār(u), ukuluhā dā'imuw wa ẓilluhā, tilka ‘uqbal-lażīnattaqau, wa ‘uqbal-kāfirīnan-nār(u).
مثل الجنه التي وعد المتقون  تجري من تحتها الانهر  اكلها دائم وظلها  تلك عقبي الذين اتقوا  وعقبي الكفرين النار

the example [i.e., description] of paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. its fruit is lasting, and its shade. that is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the fire.

masaluljannatillatiwuidalmuttaqunatajrimintahtihalanharuukuluhadaimuwwazilluhatilkauqballazinattaqauwauqbalkafirinannarumathalualjannatiallateewuaaidaalmuttaqoonatajreemintahtihaalanharuokuluhadaimunwathilluhatilkaaauqbaallatheenaittaqawwaaauqbaalkafireenaannar

And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allāh and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."
Wal-lażīna ātaināhumul-kitāba yafraḥūna bimā unzila ilaika wa minal-aḥzābi may yunkiru ba‘ḍah(ū), qul innamā umirtu an a‘budallāha wa lā usyrika bih(ī), ilaihi ad‘ū wa ilaihi ma'āb(i).
والذين ءاتينهم الكتب يفرحون بما انزل اليك  ومن الاحزاب من ينكر بعضه  قل انما امرت ان اعبد الله ولا اشرك به  اليه ادعوا واليه ماب

and [the believers among] those to whom we have given the [previous] scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [o muhammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the qur’an]. say, "i have only been commanded to worship allah and not associate [anything] with him. to him i invite, and to him is my return."


And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allāh any ally or any protector.
Wa każālika anzalnāhu ḥukman ‘arabiyyā(n), wa la'inittaba‘ta ahwā'ahum ba‘da mā jā'aka minal-‘ilm(i), mā laka minallāhi miw waliyyiw wa lā wāq(in).
وكذلك انزلنه حكما عربيا  ولئن اتبعت اهواءهم بعد ما جاءك من العلم ما لك من الله من ولي ولا واق
and thus we have revealed it as an arabic legislation. and if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against allah any ally or any protector.

wakazalikaanzalnahuhukmanarabiyyanwalainittabataahwaahumbadamajaakaminalilmimalakaminallahimiwwaliyyiwwalawaqinwakathalikaanzalnahuhukmanaaarabiyyanwalainiittabaaataahwaahumbaaadamajaakaminaalaailmimalakaminaallahiminwaliyyinwalawaq

And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allāh. For every term is a decree.
Wa laqad arsalnā rusulam min qablika wa ja‘alnā lahum azwājaw wa żurriyyah(tan), wa mā kāna lirasūlin ay ya'tiya bi'āyatin illā bi'iżnillāh(i), likulli ajalin kitāb(un).
ولقد ارسلنا رسلا من قبلك وجعلنا لهم ازوجا وذريه  وما كان لرسول ان ياتي بايه الا باذن الله  لكل اجل كتاب

and we have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. and it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of allah. for every term is a decree.

walaqadarsalnarusulamminqablikawajaalnalahumazwajawwazurriyyahtanwamakanalirasulinayyatiyabiayatinillabiiznillahilikulliajalinkitabunwalaqadarsalnarusulanminqablikawajaaaalnalahumazwajanwathurriyyatanwamakanalirasoolinanyatiyabiayatinillabiithniallahilikulliajalinkitab
Allāh eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
Yamḥullāhu mā yasyā'u wa yuṡbit(u), wa ‘indahū ummul-kitāb(i).

But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

Wa qālasy-syaiṭānu lammā quḍiyal-amru innallāha wa‘adakum wa‘dal-ḥaqqi wa wa‘attukum fa akhlaftukum, wa mā kāna liya ‘alaikum min sulṭānin illā an da‘autukum fastajabtum lī, falā talūmūnī wa lūmū anfusakum, wa mā ana bimuṣrikhikum wa mā antum bimuṣrikhiyy(a), innī kafartu bimā asyraktumūni min qabl(u), innaẓ-ẓālimīna lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).

وقال الشيطن لما قضي الامر ان الله وعدكم وعد الحق ووعدتكم فاخلفتكم  وما كان لي عليكم من سلطن الا ان دعوتكم فاستجبتم لي  فلا تلوموني ولوموا انفسكم  ما انا بمصرخكم وما انتم بمصرخي  اني كفرت بما اشركتمون من قبل  ان الظلمين لهم عذاب اليم

and satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "indeed, allah had promised you the promise of truth. and i promised you, but i betrayed you. but i had no authority over you except that i invited you, and you responded to me. so do not blame me; but blame yourselves. i cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. indeed, i deny your association of me [with allah] before. indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."



And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"
Wa udkhilal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā bi'iżni rabbihim, taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salām(un).
وادخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها باذن ربهم  تحيتهم فيها سلم

and those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their lord; and their greeting therein will be, "peace!"

waudkhilallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatijannatintajrimintahtihalanharukhalidinafihabiiznirabbihimtahiyyatuhumfihasalamunwaodkhilaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatijannatintajreemintahtihaalanharukhalideenafeehabiithnirabbihimtahiyyatuhumfeehasalam
Have you not considered how Allāh presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
Alam tara kaifa ḍaraballāhu maṡalan kalimatan ṭayyibatan kasyajaratin ṭayyibatin aṣluhā ṡābituw wa far‘uhā fis-samā'(i).
الم تر كيف ضرب الله مثلا كلمه طيبه كشجره طيبه اصلها ثابت وفرعها في السماء
have you not considered how allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

alamtarakaifadaraballahumasalankalimatantayyibatankasyajaratintayyibatinasluhasabituwwafaruhafissamaialamtarakayfadarabaallahumathalankalimatantayyibatankashajaratintayyibatinasluhathabitunwafaraauhafeeassama
It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
Tu'tī ukulahā kulla ḥīnim bi'iżni rabbihā, wa yaḍribullāhul-amṡāla lin-nāsi la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
تؤتي اكلها كل حين باذن ربها  ويضرب الله الامثال للناس لعلهم يتذكرون
it produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its lord. and allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
tutiukulahakullahinimbiiznirabbihawayadribullahulamsalalinnasilaallahumyatazakkarunatuteeokulahakullaheeninbiithnirabbihawayadribuallahualamthalalinnasilaaaallahumyatathakkaroon
And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
Wa maṡalu kalimatin khabīṡatin kasyajaratin khabīṡatinijtuṡṡat  min fauqil-arḍi mā lahā min qarār(in).
ومثل كلمه خبيثه كشجره خبيثه اجتثت من فوق الارض ما لها من قرار
and the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
wamasalukalimatinkhabisatinkasyajaratinkhabisatinijtussatminfauqilardimalahaminqararinwamathalukalimatinkhabeethatinkashajaratinkhabeethatinijtuththatminfawqialardimalahaminqarar
Allāh keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allāh does what He wills.
Yuṡabbitullāhul-lażīna āmanū bil-qauliṣ-ṣābiti fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa fil-ākhirah(ti), wa yuḍillullāhuẓ-ẓālimīn(a), wa yaf‘alullāhu mā yasyā'(u).
يثبت الله الذين ءامنوا بالقول الثابت في الحيوه الدنيا وفي الاخره  ويضل الله الظلمين  ويفعل الله ما يشاء
allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the hereafter. and allah sends astray the wrongdoers. and allah does what he wills.

yusabbitullahullazinaamanubilqaulissabitifilhayatiddunyawafilakhirahtiwayudillullahuzzaliminawayafalullahumayasyauyuthabbituallahuallatheenaamanoobilqawliaththabitifeealhayatiaddunyawafeealakhiratiwayudilluallahuaththalimeenawayafaaaluallahumayasha
Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
Alam tara ilal-lażīna baddalū ni‘matallāhi kufraw wa aḥallū qaumahum dāral-bawār(i).
الم تر الي الذين بدلوا نعمت الله كفرا واحلوا قومهم دار البوار
have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
alamtarailallazinabaddalunimatallahikufrawwaahalluqaumahumdaralbawarialamtarailaallatheenabaddalooniaamataallahikufranwaahallooqawmahumdaraalbawar
[It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
Jahannama yaṣlaunahā, wa bi'sal-qarār(u).
جهنم يصلونها  وبئس القرار
[it is] hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
jahannamayaslaunahawabisalqararujahannamayaslawnahawabisaalqarar
And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
Wa ja‘alū lillāhi andādal liyuḍillū ‘an sabīlih(ī), qul tamatta‘ū fa inna maṣīrakum ilan-nār(i).
وجعلوا لله اندادا ليضلوا عن سبيله  قل تمتعوا فان مصيركم الي النار
and they have attributed to allah equals to mislead [people] from his way. say, "enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the fire."
wajaalulillahiandadalliyudilluansabilihiqultamattaufainnamasirakumilannariwajaaaaloolillahiandadanliyudillooaaansabeelihiqultamattaaaoofainnamaseerakumilaannar

[O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.
Qul li‘ibādiyal-lażīna āmanū yuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa yunfiqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirraw wa ‘alāniyatam min qabli ay ya'tiya yaumul lā bai‘un fīhi wa lā khilāl(un).
قل لعبادي الذين ءامنوا يقيموا الصلوه وينفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانيه من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا بيع فيه ولا خلل

[o muhammad], tell my servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what we have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.

qulliibadiyallazinaamanuyuqimussalatawayunfiqumimmarazaqnahumsirrawwaalaniyatamminqabliayyatiyayaumullabaiunfihiwalakhilalunqulliaaibadiyaallatheenaamanooyuqeemooassalatawayunfiqoomimmarazaqnahumsirranwaaaalaniyatanminqablianyatiyayawmunlabayaaunfeehiwalakhilal

It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.

Allāhul-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa akhraja bihī minaṡ-ṡamarāti rizqal lakum, wa sakhkhara lakumul-fulka litajriya fil-baḥri bi'amrih(ī), wa sakhkhara lakumul-anhār(a).
الله الذي خلق السموت والارض وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرج به من الثمرت رزقا لكم  وسخر لكم الفلك لتجري في البحر بامره  وسخر لكم الانهر

it is allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by his command and subjected for you the rivers.


And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
Wa sakhkhara lakumusy-syamsa wal-qamara dā'ibaīn(i), wa sakhkhara lakumul-laila wan-nahār(a).
وسخر لكم الشمس والقمر دائبين  وسخر لكم اليل والنهار
and he subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
wasakhkharalakumusysyamsawalqamaradaibainiwasakhkharalakumullailawannaharawasakhkharalakumuashshamsawalqamaradaibayniwasakhkharalakumuallaylawannahar
And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
Wa ātākum min kulli mā sa'altumūh(u), wa in ta‘uddū ni‘matallāhi lā tuḥṣūhā, innal-insāna laẓalūmun kaffār(un).
وءاتيكم من كل ما سالتموه  وان تعدوا نعمت الله لا تحصوها  ان الانسن لظلوم كفار
and he gave you from all you asked of him. and if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of allah, you could not enumerate them. indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
waatakumminkullimasaaltumuhuwaintauddunimatallahilatuhsuhainnalinsanalazalumunkaffarunwaatakumminkullimasaaltumoohuwaintaaauddooniaamataallahilatuhsoohainnaalinsanalathaloomunkaffar
And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [i.e., Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
Wa iż qāla ibrāhīmu rabbij‘al hāżal-balada āminaw wajnubnī wa baniyya an na‘budal-aṣnām(a).
واذ قال ابرهيم رب اجعل هذا البلد ءامنا واجنبني وبني ان نعبد الاصنام
and [mention, o muhammad], when abraham said, "my lord, make this city [i.e., makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
waizqalaibrahimurabbijalhazalbaladaaminawwajnubniwabaniyyaannabudalasnamawaithqalaibraheemurabbiijaaalhathaalbaladaaminanwajnubneewabaniyyaannaaabudaalasnam
My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
Rabbi innahunna  aḍlalna kaṡīram minan-nās(i), faman tabi‘anī fa innahū minnī, wa man ‘aṣānī fa innaka gafūrur raḥīm(un).
رب انهن اضللن كثيرا من الناس  فمن تبعني فانه مني  ومن عصاني فانك غفور رحيم
my lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. so whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, you are [yet] forgiving and merciful.
rabbiinnahunnaadlalnakasiramminannasifamantabianifainnahuminniwamanasanifainnakagafururrahimunrabbiinnahunnaadlalnakatheeranminaannasifamantabiaaaneefainnahuminneewamanaaasaneefainnakaghafoorunraheem

Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

Rabbanā innī askantu min żurriyyatī biwādin gairi żī zar‘in ‘inda baitikal-muḥarram(i), rabbanā liyuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta faj‘al af'idatam minan-nāsi tahwī ilaihim warzuqhum minaṡ-ṡamarāti la‘allahum yasykurūn(a).
ربنا اني اسكنت من ذريتي بواد غير ذي زرع عند بيتك المحرم ربنا ليقيموا الصلوه فاجعل افده من الناس تهوي اليهم وارزقهم من الثمرت لعلهم يشكرون

our lord, i have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near your sacred house, our lord, that they may establish prayer. so make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.


Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allāh on the earth or in the heaven.
Rabbanā innaka ta‘lamu mā nukhfī wa mā nu‘lin(u), wa mā yakhfā ‘alallāhi min syai'in fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'(i).
ربنا انك تعلم ما نخفي وما نعلن  وما يخفي علي الله من شيء في الارض ولا في السماء
our lord, indeed you know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from allah on the earth or in the heaven.
rabbanainnakatalamumanukhfiwamanulinuwamayakhfaalallahiminsyaiinfilardiwalafissamairabbanainnakataaalamumanukhfeewamanuaalinuwamayakhfaaaalaallahiminshayinfeealardiwalafeeassama
Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī wahaba lī ‘alal-kibari ismā‘īla wa isḥāq(a), inna rabbī lasamī‘ud-du‘ā'(i).
الحمد لله الذي وهب لي علي الكبر اسمعيل واسحق  ان ربي لسميع الدعاء
praise to allah, who has granted to me in old age ishmael and isaac. indeed, my lord is the hearer of supplication.
alhamdulillahillaziwahabalialalkibariismailawaishaqainnarabbilasamiudduaialhamdulillahiallatheewahabaleeaaalaalkibariismaaaeelawaishaqainnarabbeelasameeaauadduaaa
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Rabbij‘alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min żurriyyatī, rabbanā wa taqabbal du‘ā'(i).
رب اجعلني مقيم الصلوه ومن ذريتي  ربنا وتقبل دعاء
my lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. our lord, and accept my supplication.
rabbijalnimuqimassalatiwaminzurriyyatirabbanawataqabbalduairabbiijaaalneemuqeemaassalatiwaminthurriyyateerabbanawtaqabbalduaaa
Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
Rabbanagfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yauma yaqūmul-ḥisāb(u).
ربنا اغفر لي ولولدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب
our lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the day the account is established."
rabbanagfirliwaliwalidayyawalilmumininayaumayaqumulhisaburabbanaighfirleewaliwalidayyawalilmumineenayawmayaqoomualhisab
And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
Wa lā taḥsabannallāha gāfilan ‘ammā ya‘maluẓ-ẓālimūn(a), innamā yu'akhkhiruhum liyaumin tasykhaṣu fīhil-abṣār(u).
ولا تحسبن الله غفلا عما يعمل الظلمون  انما يؤخرهم ليوم تشخص فيه الابصر
and never think that allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. he only delays them [i.e., their account] for a day when eyes will stare [in horror].
walatahsabannallahagafilanammayamaluzzalimunainnamayuakhkhiruhumliyaumintasykhasufihilabsaruwalatahsabannaallahaghafilanaaammayaaamaluaththalimoonainnamayuakhkhiruhumliyawmintashkhasufeehialabsar
Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
Muhṭi‘īna muqni‘ī ru'ūsihim lā yartaddu ilaihim ṭarfuhum, wa af'idatuhum hawā'(un).
مهطعين مقنعي رءوسهم لا يرتد اليهم طرفهم  وافدتهم هواء
racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
muhtiinamuqniiruusihimlayartadduilaihimtarfuhumwaafidatuhumhawaunmuhtiaaeenamuqniaaeeruoosihimlayartadduilayhimtarfuhumwaafidatuhumhawa

And, [O Muḥammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?

Wa anżirin-nāsa yauma ya'tīhimul-‘ażāb(u), fa yaqūlul-lażīna ẓalamū rabbanā akhkhirnā ilā ajalin qarīb(in), nujib da‘wataka wa nattabi‘ir-rusul(a), awalam takūnū aqsamtum min qablu mā lakum min zawāl(in).
وانذر الناس يوم ياتيهم العذاب فيقول الذين ظلموا ربنا اخرنا الي اجل قريب نجب دعوتك ونتبع الرسل  اولم تكونوا اقسمتم من قبل ما لكم من زوال

and, [o muhammad], warn the people of a day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "our lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer your call and follow the messengers." [but it will be said], "had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?


And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
Wa sakantum fī masākinil-lażīna ẓalamū anfusahum wa tabayyana lakum kaifa fa‘alnā bihim wa ḍarabnā lakumul-amṡāl(a).
وسكنتم في مسكن الذين ظلموا انفسهم وتبين لكم كيف فعلنا بهم وضربنا لكم الامثال
and you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how we dealt with them. and we presented for you [many] examples."

wasakantumfimasakinillazinazalamuanfusahumwatabayyanalakumkaifafaalnabihimwadarabnalakumulamsalawasakantumfeemasakiniallatheenathalamooanfusahumwatabayyanalakumkayfafaaaalnabihimwadarabnalakumualamthal
And they had planned their plan, but with Allāh is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
Wa qad makarū makrahum wa ‘indallāhi makruhum, wa in kāna makruhum litazūla minhul-jibāl(u).
وقد مكروا مكرهم وعند الله مكرهم وان كان مكرهم لتزول منه الجبال
and they had planned their plan, but with allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
waqadmakarumakrahumwaindallahimakruhumwainkanamakruhumlitazulaminhuljibaluwaqadmakaroomakrahumwaaaindaallahimakruhumwainkanamakruhumlitazoolaminhualjibal
So never think that Allāh will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
Falā taḥsabannallāha mukhlifa wa‘dihī rusulah(ū), innallāha ‘azīzun żun tiqām(in).
فلا تحسبن الله مخلف وعده رسله  ان الله عزيز ذو انتقام
so never think that allah will fail in his promise to his messengers. indeed, allah is exalted in might and owner of retribution.
falatahsabannallahamukhlifawadihirusulahuinnallahaazizunzuntiqaminfalatahsabannaallahamukhlifawaaadihirusulahuinnaallahaaaazeezunthoointiqam
[It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
Yauma tubaddalul-arḍu gairal-arḍi was-samāwātu wa barazū lillāhil-wāḥidil-qahhār(i).
يوم تبدل الارض غير الارض والسموت  وبرزوا لله الوحد القهار
[it will be] on the day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before allah, the one, the prevailing,
yaumatubaddalulardugairalardiwassamawatuwabarazulillahilwahidilqahhariyawmatubaddalualardughayraalardiwassamawatuwabarazoolillahialwahidialqahhar
And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in irons,
Wa taral-mujrimīna yauma'iżim muqarranīna fil-aṣfād(i).
وتري المجرمين يومئذ مقرنين في الاصفاد
and you will see the criminals that day bound together in irons,
wataralmujriminayaumaizimmuqarraninafilasfadiwataraalmujrimeenayawmaithinmuqarraneenafeealasfad
Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire
Sarābīluhum min qaṭirāniw wa tagsyā wujūhahumun-nār(u).
سرابيلهم من قطران وتغشي وجوههم النار
their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the fire
sarabiluhumminqatiraniwwatagsyawujuhahumunnarusarabeeluhumminqatraninwataghshawujoohahumuannar
So that Allāh will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
Liyajziyallāhu kulla nafsim mā kasabat, innallāha sarī‘ul-ḥisāb(i).
ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت  ان الله سريع الحساب
so that allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. indeed, allah is swift in account.
liyajziyallahukullanafsimmakasabatinnallahasariulhisabiliyajziyaallahukullanafsinmakasabatinnaallahasareeaaualhisab
This [Qur’ān] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
Hāżā balāgul lin-nāsi wa liyunżarū bihī wa liya‘lamū annamā huwa ilāhuw wāḥiduw wa liyażżakkara ulul-albāb(i).
هذا بلغ للناس ولينذروا به وليعلموا انما هو اله وحد وليذكر اولوا الالبب
this [qur’an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that he is but one god and that those of understanding will be reminded.

qalulataujalinnanubasysyirukabigulaminaliminqaloolatawjalinnanubashshirukabighulaminaaaleem
He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
Qāla abasysyartumūnī ‘alā am massaniyal-kibaru fa bima tubasysyirūn(a).
قال ابشرتموني علي ان مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون
he said, "have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
qalaabasysyartumunialaammassaniyalkibarufabimatubasysyirunaqalaabashshartumooneeaaalaanmassaniyaalkibarufabimatubashshiroon
They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
Qālū basysyarnāka bil-ḥaqqi falā takum minal-qāniṭīn(a).
قالوا بشرنك بالحق فلا تكن من القنطين
they said, "we have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
qalubasysyarnakabilhaqqifalatakumminalqanitinaqaloobashsharnakabilhaqqifalatakunminaalqaniteen
He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
Qāla wa may yaqnaṭu mir raḥmati rabbihī illaḍ-ḍāllūn(a).
قال ومن يقنط من رحمه ربه الا الضالون
he said, "and who despairs of the mercy of his lord except for those astray?"
qalawamayyaqnatumirrahmatirabbihiilladdallunaqalawamanyaqnatuminrahmatirabbihiillaaddalloon
[Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhal-mursalūn(a).
قال فما خطبكم ايها المرسلون
[abraham] said, "then what is your business [here], o messengers?"
qalafamakhatbukumayyuhalmursalunaqalafamakhatbukumayyuhaalmursaloon
They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
Qālū innā ursilnā ilā qaumim mujrimīn(a).
قالوا انا ارسلنا الي قوم مجرمين
they said, "indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
qaluinnaursilnailaqaumimmujriminaqalooinnaorsilnailaqawminmujrimeen
Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
Illā āla lūṭ(in), innā lamunajjūhum ajma‘īn(a).
الا ءال لوط انا لمنجوهم اجمعين
except the family of lot; indeed, we will save them all
illaalalutininnalamunajjuhumajmainaillaalalootininnalamunajjoohumajmaaaeen
Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
Illamra'atahū qaddarnā innahā laminal-gābirīn(a).
الا امراته قدرنا  انها لمن الغبرين
except his wife." we [i.e., allah] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
illamraatahuqaddarnainnahalaminalgabirinaillaimraatahuqaddarnainnahalaminaalghabireen
And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
Falammā jā'a āla lūṭinil-mursalūn(a).
فلما جاء ءال لوط المرسلون
and when the messengers came to the family of lot,
falammajaaalalutinilmursalunafalammajaaalalootinalmursaloon
He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
Qāla innakum qaumum munkarūn(a).
قال انكم قوم منكرون
he said, "indeed, you are people unknown."
qalainnakumqaumummunkarunaqalainnakumqawmunmunkaroon
They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
Qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūn(a).
قالوا بل جئنك بما كانوا فيه يمترون
they said, "but we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
qalubaljinakabimakanufihiyamtarunaqaloobaljinakabimakanoofeehiyamtaroon
And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
Wa ataināka bil-ḥaqqi wa innā laṣādiqūn(a).
واتينك بالحق وانا لصدقون
and we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
waatainakabilhaqqiwainnalasadiqunawaataynakabilhaqqiwainnalasadiqoon
So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
Fa asri bi'ahlika biqiṭ‘im minal-laili wattabi‘ adbārahum wa lā yaltafit minkum aḥaduw wamḍū ḥaiṡu tu'marūn(a).
فاسر باهلك بقطع من اليل واتبع ادبرهم ولا يلتفت منكم احد وامضوا حيث تؤمرون
so set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
faasribiahlikabiqitimminallailiwattabiadbarahumwalayaltafitminkumahaduwwamduhaisutumarunafaasribiahlikabiqitaainminaallayliwattabiaaadbarahumwalayaltafitminkumahadunwamdoohaythutumaroon
And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
Wa qaḍainā ilaihi żālikal-amra anna dābira hā'ulā'i maqṭū‘um muṣbiḥīn(a).
وقضينا اليه ذلك الامر ان دابر هؤلاء مقطوع مصبحين
and we conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
waqadainailaihizalikalamraannadabirahaulaimaqtuummusbihinawaqadaynailayhithalikaalamraannadabirahaolaimaqtooaaunmusbiheen
And the people of the city came rejoicing.
Wa jā'a ahlul-madīnati yastabsyirūn(a).
وجاء اهل المدينه يستبشرون
and the people of the city came rejoicing.
wajaaahlulmadinatiyastabsyirunawajaaahlualmadeenatiyastabshiroon
[Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
Qāla inna hā'ulā'i ḍaifī falā tafḍaḥūn(i).
قال ان هؤلاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون
[lot] said, "indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
qalainnahaulaidaififalatafdahuniqalainnahaolaidayfeefalatafdahoon
And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
Wattaqullāha wa lā tukhzūn(i).
واتقوا الله ولا تخزون
and fear allah and do not disgrace me."
wattaqullahawalatukhzuniwattaqooallahawalatukhzoon
They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
Qālū awalam nanhaka ‘anil-‘ālamīn(a).
قالوا اولم ننهك عن العلمين
they said, "have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
qaluawalamnanhakaanilalaminaqalooawalamnanhakaaaanialaaalameen
[Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
Qāla hā'ulā'i banātī in kuntum fā‘ilīn(a).
قال هؤلاء بناتي ان كنتم فعلين
[lot] said, "these are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
qalahaulaibanatiinkuntumfailinaqalahaolaibanateeinkuntumfaaaileen
By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
La‘amruka innahum lafī sakratihim ya‘mahūn(a).
لعمرك انهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون
by your life, [o muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
laamrukainnahumlafisakratihimyamahunalaaaamrukainnahumlafeesakratihimyaaamahoona
So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
Fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣaiḥatu musyriqīn(a).
فاخذتهم الصيحه مشرقين
so the shriek seized them at sunrise.
faakhazathumussaihatumusyriqinafaakhathathumuassayhatumushriqeen
And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
Fa ja‘alnā ‘āliyahā sāfilahā wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim ḥijāratam min sijjīl(in).
فجعلنا عليها سافلها وامطرنا عليهم حجاره من سجيل
and we made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
fajaalnaaliyahasafilahawaamtarnaalaihimhijaratamminsijjilinfajaaaalnaaaaliyahasafilahawaamtarnaaaalayhimhijaratanminsijjeel
Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
Inna fī żālika la'āyātil lil-mutawassimīn(a).
ان في ذلك لايت للمتوسمين
indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
innafizalikalaayatillilmutawassiminainnafeethalikalaayatinlilmutawassimeen
And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
Wa innahā labisabīlim muqīm(in).
وانها لبسبيل مقيم
and indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
wainnahalabisabilimmuqiminwainnahalabisabeelinmuqeem
Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
Inna fī żālika la'āyatal lil-mu'minīn(a).
ان في ذلك لايه للمؤمنين
indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
innafizalikalaayatallilmumininainnafeethalikalaayatanlilmumineen
And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
Wa in kāna aṣḥābul-aikati laẓālimīn(a).
وان كان اصحب الايكه لظلمين
and the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
wainkanaashabulaikatilazaliminawainkanaashabualaykatilathalimeen
So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
Fantaqamnā minhum, wa innahumā labi'imāmim mubīn(in).
فانتقمنا منهم وانهما لبامام مبين
so we took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
fantaqamnaminhumwainnahumalabiimamimmubininfantaqamnaminhumwainnahumalabiimaminmubeen
And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
Wa laqad każżaba aṣḥābul-ḥijril-mursalīn(a).
ولقد كذب اصحب الحجر المرسلين
and certainly did the companions of al-hijr [i.e., the thamud] deny the messengers.
walaqadkazzabaashabulhijrilmursalinawalaqadkaththabaashabualhijrialmursaleen
And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
Wa ātaināhum āyātinā fa kānū ‘anhā mu‘riḍīn(a).
وءاتينهم ءايتنا فكانوا عنها معرضين
and we gave them our signs, but from them they were turning away.
waatainahumayatinafakanuanhamuridinawaataynahumayatinafakanooaaanhamuaarideen
And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
Wa kānū yanḥitūna minal-jibāli buyūtan āminīn(a).
وكانوا ينحتون من الجبال بيوتا ءامنين
and they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
wakanuyanhitunaminaljibalibuyutanamininawakanooyanhitoonaminaaljibalibuyootanamineen
But the shriek seized them at early morning,
Fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣaiḥatu muṣbiḥīn(a).
فاخذتهم الصيحه مصبحين
but the shriek seized them at early morning,
faakhazathumussaihatumusbihinafaakhathathumuassayhatumusbiheen
So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
Famā agnā ‘anhum mā kānū yaksibūn(a).
فما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
so nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
famaagnaanhummakanuyaksibunafamaaghnaaaanhummakanooyaksiboon
And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
Wa mā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa  wa mā bainahumā illā bil-ḥaqq(i), wa innas-sā‘ata la'ātiyatun faṣfaḥiṣ-ṣafḥal-jamīl(a).
وما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق  وان الساعه لاتيه  فاصفح الصفح الجميل
and we have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. and indeed, the hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
wamakhalaqnassamawatiwalardawamabainahumaillabilhaqqiwainnassaatalaatiyatunfasfahissafhaljamilawamakhalaqnaassamawatiwalardawamabaynahumaillabilhaqqiwainnaassaaaatalaatiyatunfasfahiassafhaaljameel
Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
Inna rabbaka huwal-khallāqul-‘alīm(u).
ان ربك هو الخلق العليم
indeed, your lord - he is the knowing creator.
innarabbakahuwalkhallaqulalimuinnarabbakahuwaalkhallaqualaaaleem
And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
Wa laqad ātaināka sab‘am minal-maṡānī wal-qur'ānal-‘aẓīm(a).
ولقد ءاتينك سبعا من المثاني والقرءان العظيم
and we have certainly given you, [o muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great qur’an.
walaqadatainakasabamminalmasaniwalquranalazimawalaqadataynakasabaaanminaalmathaneewalquranaalaaatheem

Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
Lā tamuddanna ‘ainaika ilā mā matta‘nā bihī azwājam minhum wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wakhfiḍ janāḥaka lil-mu'minīn(a).
لا تمدن عينيك الي ما متعنا به ازوجا منهم ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمؤمنين

do not extend your eyes toward that by which we have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. and lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
latamuddannaainaikailamamattanabihiazwajamminhumwalatahzanalaihimwakhfidjanahakalilmumininalatamuddannaaaaynaykailamamattaaanabihiazwajanminhumwalatahzanaaalayhimwakhfidjanahakalilmumineen
And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
Wa qul innī anan-nażīrul-mubīn(u).
وقل اني انا النذير المبين
and say, "indeed, i am the clear warner" -
waqulinnianannazirulmubinuwaqulinneeanaannatheerualmubeen
Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
Kamā anzalnā ‘alal-muqtasimīn(a).
كما انزلنا علي المقتسمين
just as we had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
kamaanzalnaalalmuqtasiminakamaanzalnaaaalaalmuqtasimeen
Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
Allażīna ja‘alul-qur'āna ‘iḍīn(a).
الذين جعلوا القرءان عضين
who have made the qur’an into portions.
allazinajaalulquranaidinaallatheenajaaaalooalquranaaaideen
So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
Fa wa rabbika lanas'alannahum ajma‘īn(a).
فوربك لنسلنهم اجمعين
so by your lord, we will surely question them all
fawarabbikalanasalannahumajmainafawarabbikalanasalannahumajmaaaeen
About what they used to do.
‘Ammā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
عما كانوا يعملون
about what they used to do.
ammakanuyamalunaaaammakanooyaaamaloon
Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
Faṣda‘ bimā tu'maru wa a‘riḍ ‘anil-musyrikīn(a).
فاصدع بما تؤمر واعرض عن المشركين
then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
fasdabimatumaruwaaridanilmusyrikinafasdaaabimatumaruwaaaaridaaanialmushrikeen
Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
Innā kafainākal-mustahzi'īn(a).
انا كفينك المستهزءين
indeed, we are sufficient for you against the mockers
innakafainakalmustahziinainnakafaynakaalmustahzieen
Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
Allażīna yaj‘alūna ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhar(a), fa saufa ya‘lamūn(a).
الذين يجعلون مع الله الها ءاخر  فسوف يعلمون
who make [equal] with allah another deity. but they are going to know.
allazinayajalunamaallahiilahanakharafasaufayalamunaallatheenayajaaaloonamaaaaallahiilahanakharafasawfayaaalamoon
And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
Wa laqad na‘lamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn(a).
ولقد نعلم انك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون
and we already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
walaqadnalamuannakayadiqusadrukabimayaqulunawalaqadnaaalamuannakayadeequsadrukabimayaqooloon
So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
Fa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa kum minas-sājidīn(a).
فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من السجدين
so exalt [allah] with praise of your lord and be of those who prostrate [to him].
fasabbihbihamdirabbikawakumminassajidinafasabbihbihamdirabbikawakunminaassajideen
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
Wa‘bud rabbaka ḥattā ya'tiyakal-yaqīn(u).
واعبد ربك حتي ياتيك اليقين
and worship your lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
wabudrabbakahattayatiyakalyaqinuwaaabudrabbakahattayatiyakaalyaqeen
The command of Allāh is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
Atā amrullāhi falā tasta‘jilūh(u), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
اتي امر الله فلا تستعجلوه  سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
the command of allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. exalted is he and high above what they associate with him.
ataamrullahifalatastajiluhusubhanahuwataalaammayusyrikunaataamruallahifalatastaaajiloohusubhanahuwataaaalaaaammayushrikoon
He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
Yunazzilul-malā'ikata bir-rūḥi min amrihī ‘alā may yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī an anżirū annahū lā ilāha illā ana fattaqūn(i).
ينزل الملئكه بالروح من امره علي من يشاء من عباده ان انذروا انه لا اله الا انا فاتقون
he sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of his command, upon whom he wills of his servants, [telling them], "warn that there is no deity except me; so fear me."
yunazzilulmalaikatabirruhiminamrihialamayyasyauminibadihiananziruannahulailahaillaanafattaquniyunazzilualmalaikatabirroohiminamrihiaaalamanyashaominaaibadihiananthirooannahulailahaillaanafattaqoon
He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
Khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
خلق السموت والارض بالحق  تعلي عما يشركون
he created the heavens and earth in truth. high is he above what they associate with him.
khalaqassamawatiwalardabilhaqqitaalaammayusyrikunakhalaqaassamawatiwalardabilhaqqitaaaalaaaammayushrikoon
He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once he is a clear adversary.
Khalaqal-insāna min nuṭfatin fa iżā huwa khaṣīmum mubīn(un).
خلق الانسن من نطفه فاذا هو خصيم مبين
he created man from a sperm-drop; then at once he is a clear adversary.
khalaqalinsanaminnutfatinfaizahuwakhasimummubinunkhalaqaalinsanaminnutfatinfaithahuwakhaseemunmubeen
And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
Wal-an‘āma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'uw wa manāfi‘u wa minhā ta'kulūn(a).
والانعم خلقها  لكم فيها دفء ومنفع ومنها تاكلون
and the grazing livestock he has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
walanamakhalaqahalakumfihadifuwwamanafiuwaminhatakulunawalanaaamakhalaqahalakumfeehadifonwamanafiaauwaminhatakuloon
And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
Wa lakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna wa ḥīna tasraḥūn(a).
ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون
and for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
walakumfihajamalunhinaturihunawahinatasrahunawalakumfeehajamalunheenatureehoonawaheenatasrahoon
And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
Wa taḥmilu aṡqālakum ilā baladil lam takūnū bāligīhi illā bisyiqqil-anfus(i), inna rabbakum lara'ūfur raḥīm(un).
وتحمل اثقالكم الي بلد لم تكونوا بلغيه الا بشق الانفس  ان ربكم لرءوف رحيم
and they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. indeed, your lord is kind and merciful.
watahmiluasqalakumilabaladillamtakunubaligihiillabisyiqqilanfusiinnarabbakumlaraufurrahimunwatahmiluathqalakumilabaladinlamtakoonoobaligheehiillabishiqqialanfusiinnarabbakumlaraoofunraheem
And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
Wal-khaila wal-bigāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wa zīnah(tan), wa yakhluqu mā lā ta‘lamūn(a).
والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينه  ويخلق ما لا تعلمون
and [he created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. and he creates that which you do not know.
walkhailawalbigalawalhamiralitarkabuhawazinahtanwayakhluqumalatalamunawalkhaylawalbighalawalhameeralitarkaboohawazeenatanwayakhluqumalataaalamoon
And upon Allāh is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
Wa ‘alallāhi qaṣdus-sabīli wa minhā jā'ir(un), wa lau syā'a lahadākum ajma‘īn(a).
وعلي الله قصد السبيل ومنها جائر  ولو شاء لهديكم اجمعين
and upon allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. and if he willed, he could have guided you all.
waalallahiqasdussabiliwaminhajairunwalausyaalahadakumajmainawaaaalaallahiqasduassabeeliwaminhajairunwalawshaalahadakumajmaaaeen
It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
Huwal-lażī anzala minas-samā'i mā'al lakum minhu syarābuw wa minhu syajarun fīhi tusīmūn(a).
