Wa in ‘āqabtum fa ‘āqibū bimiṡli mā ‘ūqibtum bih(ī), wa la'in ṣabartum lahuwa khairul liṣ-ṣābirīn(a).
وان عاقبتم فعاقبوا بمثل ما عوقبتم به  ولئن صبرتم لهو خير للصبرين
and if you punish [an enemy, o believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. but if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
wainaqabtumfaaqibubimislimauqibtumbihiwalainsabartumlahuwakhairullissabirinawainaaaqabtumfaaaaqiboobimithlimaaaooqibtumbihiwalainsabartumlahuwakhayrunlissabireen
And be patient, [O Muḥammad], and your patience is not but through Allāh. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
Waṣbir wa mā ṣabruka illā billāhi wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wa lā taku fī ḍaiqim mimmā yamkurūn(a).
واصبر وما صبرك الا بالله  ولا تحزن عليهم ولا تك في ضيق مما يمكرون
and be patient, [o muhammad], and your patience is not but through allah. and do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
wasbirwamasabrukaillabillahiwalatahzanalaihimwalatakufidaiqimmimmayamkurunawasbirwamasabrukaillabillahiwalatahzanaaalayhimwalatakufeedayqinmimmayamkuroon
Indeed, Allāh is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
Innallāha ma‘al-lażīnattaqau wal-lażīna hum muḥsinūn(a).
ان الله مع الذين اتقوا والذين هم محسنون
indeed, allah is with those who fear him and those who are doers of good.
innallahamaallazinattaqauwallazinahummuhsinunainnaallahamaaaaallatheenaittaqawwallatheenahummuhsinoon

Exalted is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] by night from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām to al-Masjid al-Aqṣā, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
Subḥānal-lażī asrā bi‘abdihī lailam minal-masjidil ḥarāmi ilal-masjidil-aqṣal-lażī bāraknā ḥaulahū linuriyahū min āyātinā, innahū huwas-samī‘ul-baṣīr(u).
سبحن الذي اسري بعبده ليلا من المسجد الحرام الي المسجد الاقصا الذي بركنا حوله لنريه من ءايتنا  انه هو السميع البصير

exalted is he who took his servant [i.e., prophet muhammad (ﷺ)] by night from al-masjid al-haram to al-masjid al-aqsa, whose surroundings we have blessed, to show him of our signs. indeed, he is the hearing, the seeing.

subhanallaziasrabiabdihilailamminalmasjidilharamiilalmasjidilaqsallazibaraknahaulahulinuriyahuminayatinainnahuhuwassamiulbasirusubhanaallatheeasrabiaaabdihilaylanminaalmasjidialharamiilaalmasjidialaqsaallatheebaraknahawlahulinuriyahuminayatinainnahuhuwaassameeaaualbaseer
And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
Wa ātainā mūsal-kitāba wa ja‘alnāhu hudal libanī isrā'īla allā tattakhiżū min dūnī wakīlā(n).
وءاتينا موسي الكتب وجعلنه هدي لبني اسرءيل الا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا
and we gave moses the scripture and made it a guidance for the children of israel that you not take other than me as disposer of affairs,
waatainamusalkitabawajaalnahuhudallibaniisrailaallatattakhizuminduniwakilanwaataynamoosaalkitabawajaaaalnahuhudanlibaneeisraeelaallatattakhithoomindooneewakeela
O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
Żurriyyata man ḥamalnā ma‘a nūḥ(in), innahū kāna ‘abdan syakūrā(n).
ذريه من حملنا مع نوح  انه كان عبدا شكورا
o descendants of those we carried [in the ship] with noah. indeed, he was a grateful servant.
zurriyyatamanhamalnamaanuhininnahukanaabdansyakuranthurriyyatamanhamalnamaaaanoohininnahukanaaaabdanshakoora
And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness."
Wa qaḍainā ilā banī isrā'īla fil-kitābi latufsidunna fil-arḍi marrataini wa lata‘lunna ‘uluwwan kabīrā(n).
وقضينا الي بني اسرءيل في الكتب لتفسدن في الارض مرتين ولتعلن علوا كبيرا
and we conveyed to the children of israel in the scripture that, "you will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness."
waqadainailabaniisrailafilkitabilatufsidunnafilardimarratainiwalatalunnauluwwankabiranwaqadaynailabaneeisraeelafeealkitabilatufsidunnafeealardimarratayniwalataaalunnaaauluwwankabeera
So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.
Fa iżā jā'a wa‘du ūlāhumā ba‘aṡnā ‘alaikum ‘ibādal lanā ulī ba'sin syadīdin fa jāsū khilālad-diyār(i), wa kāna wa‘dam maf‘ūlā(n).
فاذا جاء وعد اوليهما بعثنا عليكم عبادا لنا اولي باس شديد فجاسوا خلل الديار  وكان وعدا مفعولا
so when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, we sent against you servants of ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.

faizajaawaduulahumabaasnaalaikumibadallanaulibasinsyadidinfajasukhilaladdiyariwakanawadammafulanfaithajaawaaaduoolahumabaaaathnaaaalaykumaaibadanlanaoleebasinshadeedinfajasookhilalaaddiyariwakanawaaadanmafaaoola
Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower.
Ṡumma radadnā lakumul-karrata ‘alaihim wa amdadnākum bi'amwāliw wa banīna wa ja‘alnākum akṡara nafīrā(n).
ثم رددنا لكم الكره عليهم وامددنكم بامول وبنين وجعلنكم اكثر نفيرا
then we gave back to you a return victory over them. and we reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower.
summaradadnalakumulkarrataalaihimwaamdadnakumbiamwaliwwabaninawajaalnakumaksaranafiranthummaradadnalakumualkarrataaaalayhimwaamdadnakumbiamwalinwabaneenawajaaaalnakumaktharanafeera

[And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves]." Then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in Jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
In aḥsantum aḥsantum li'anfusikum, wa in asa'tum fa lahā, fa iżā jā'a wa‘dul-ākhirati liyasū'ū wujūhakum wa liyadkhulal-masjida kamā dakhalūhu awwala marratiw wa liyutabbirū mā ‘alau tatbīrā(n).
ان احسنتم احسنتم لانفسكم  وان اساتم فلها  فاذا جاء وعد الاخره ليسوا وجوهكم وليدخلوا المسجد كما دخلوه اول مره وليتبروا ما علوا تتبيرا

[and said], "if you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves]." then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [we sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.



[Then Allāh said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
‘Asā rabbukum ay yarḥamakum, wa in ‘uttum ‘udnā, wa ja‘alnā jahannama lil-kāfirīna ḥaṣīrā(n).
عسي ربكم ان يرحمكم  وان عدتم عدنا  وجعلنا جهنم للكفرين حصيرا

[then allah said], "it is expected, [if you repent], that your lord will have mercy upon you. but if you return [to sin], we will return [to punishment]. and we have made hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
asarabbukumayyarhamakumwainuttumudnawajaalnajahannamalilkafirinahasiranaaasarabbukumanyarhamakumwainaaudtumaaudnawajaaaalnajahannamalilkafireenahaseera
Indeed, this Qur’ān guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward
Inna hāżal-qur'āna yahdī lil-latī hiya aqwamu wa yubasysyirul-mu'minīnal-lażīna ya‘malūnaṣ-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum ajran kabīrā(n).
ان هذا القرءان يهدي للتي هي اقوم ويبشر المؤمنين الذين يعملون الصلحت ان لهم اجرا كبيرا
indeed, this qur’an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward

innahazalquranayahdilillatihiyaaqwamuwayubasysyirulmumininallazinayamalunassalihatiannalahumajrankabiraninnahathaalquranayahdeelillateehiyaaqwamuwayubashshirualmumineenaallatheenayaaamaloonaassalihatiannalahumajrankabeera
And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
Wa annal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati a‘tadnā lahum ‘ażāban alīmā(n).
وان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخره اعتدنا لهم عذابا اليما
and that those who do not believe in the hereafter - we have prepared for them a painful punishment.
waannallazinalayuminunabilakhiratiatadnalahumazabanalimanwaannaallatheenalayuminoonabilakhiratiaaatadnalahumaaathabanaleema
And man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
Wa yad‘ul-insānu bisy-syarri du‘ā'ahū bil-khair(i), wa kānal-insānu ‘ajūlā(n).
ويدع الانسن بالشر دعاءه بالخير  وكان الانسن عجولا
and man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
wayadulinsanubisysyarriduaahubilkhairiwakanalinsanuajulanwayadaaualinsanubishsharriduaaaahubilkhayriwakanaalinsanuaaajoola

And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.

Wa ja‘alnal-laila wan-nahāra āyataini fa maḥaunā āyatal-laili wa ja‘alnā āyatan-nahāri mubṣiratal litabtagū faḍlam mir rabbikum wa lita‘lamū ‘adadas-sinīna wal-ḥisāb(a), wa kulla syai'in faṣṣalnāhu tafṣīlā(n).
وجعلنا اليل والنهار ءايتين  فمحونا ءايه اليل وجعلنا ءايه النهار مبصره لتبتغوا فضلا من ربكم ولتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب  وكل شيء فصلنه تفصيلا

and we have made the night and day two signs, and we erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. and everything we have set out in detail.


And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
Wa kulla insānin alzamnāhu ṭā'irahū fī ‘unuqih(ī), wa nukhriju lahū yaumal-qiyāmati kitābay yalqāhu mansyūrā(n).
وكل انسن الزمنه طئره في عنقه  ونخرج له يوم القيمه كتبا يلقيه منشورا
and [for] every person we have imposed his fate upon his neck, and we will produce for him on the day of resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
wakullainsaninalzamnahutairahufiunuqihiwanukhrijulahuyaumalqiyamatikitabayyalqahumansyuranwakullainsaninalzamnahutairahufeeaaunuqihiwanukhrijulahuyawmaalqiyamatikitabanyalqahumanshoora
[It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
Iqra' kitābak(a), kafā binafsikal-yauma ‘alaika ḥasībā(n).
اقرا كتبك كفي بنفسك اليوم عليك حسيبا
[it will be said], "read your record. sufficient is yourself against you this day as accountant."
iqrakitabakakafabinafsikalyaumaalaikahasibaniqrakitabakakafabinafsikaalyawmaaaalaykahaseeba

Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.
Manihtadā fa innamā yahtadī linafsih(ī), wa man ḍalla fa innamā yaḍillu ‘alaihā, wa lā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, wa mā kunnā mu‘ażżibīna ḥattā nab‘aṡa rasūlā(n).
من اهتدي فانما يهتدي لنفسه  ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها  ولا تزر وازره وزر اخري  وما كنا معذبين حتي نبعث رسولا

whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. and whoever errs only errs against it. and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. and never would we punish until we sent a messenger.

manihtadafainnamayahtadilinafsihiwamandallafainnamayadillualaihawalataziruwaziratuwwizraukhrawamakunnamuazzibinahattanabasarasulanmaniihtadafainnamayahtadeelinafsihiwamandallafainnamayadilluaaalayhawalataziruwaziratunwizraokhrawamakunnamuaaaththibeenahattanabaaatharasoola

And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
Wa iżā aradnā an nuhlika qaryatan amarnā mutrafīhā fa fasaqū fīhā fa ḥaqqa ‘alaihal-qaulu fa dammarnāhā tadmīrā(n).
واذا اردنا ان نهلك قريه امرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرنها تدميرا

and when we intend to destroy a city, we command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and we destroy it with [complete] destruction.
waizaaradnaannuhlikaqaryatanamarnamutrafihafafasaqufihafahaqqaalaihalqaulufadammarnahatadmiranwaithaaradnaannuhlikaqaryatanamarnamutrafeehafafasaqoofeehafahaqqaaaalayhaalqawlufadammarnahatadmeera
And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Aware and Seeing.
Wa kam ahlaknā minal-qurūni mim ba‘di nūḥ(in), wa kafā birabbika biżunūbi ‘ibādihī khabīram baṣīrā(n).
وكم اهلكنا من القرون من بعد نوح  وكفي بربك بذنوب عباده خبيرا بصيرا
and how many have we destroyed from the generations after noah. and sufficient is your lord, concerning the sins of his servants, as aware and seeing.
wakamahlaknaminalqurunimimbadinuhinwakafabirabbikabizunubiibadihikhabirambasiranwakamahlaknaminaalqurooniminbaaadinoohinwakafabirabbikabithunoobiaaibadihikhabeeranbaseera
Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.
Man kāna yurīdul-‘ājilata ‘ajjalnā lahū fīhā mā nasyā'u liman nurīdu ṡumma ja‘alnā lahū jahannam(a), yaṣlāhā mażmūmam madḥūrā(n).
من كان يريد العاجله عجلنا له فيها ما نشاء لمن نريد ثم جعلنا له جهنم يصليها مذموما مدحورا
whoever should desire the immediate - we hasten for him from it what we will to whom we intend. then we have made for him hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.

mankanayuridulajilataajjalnalahufihamanasyaulimannuridusummajaalnalahujahannamayaslahamazmumammadhuranmankanayureedualaaajilataaaajjalnalahufeehamanashaolimannureeduthummajaaaalnalahujahannamayaslahamathmoomanmadhoora
But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allāh].
Wa man arādal-ākhirata wa sa‘ā lahā sa‘yahā wa huwa mu'minun fa ulā'ika kāna sa‘yuhum masykūrā(n).
ومن اراد الاخره وسعي لها سعيها وهو مؤمن فاولئك كان سعيهم مشكورا
but whoever desires the hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by allah].
wamanaradalakhiratawasaalahasayahawahuwamuminunfaulaikakanasayuhummasykuranwamanaradaalakhiratawasaaaalahasaaayahawahuwamuminunfaolaikakanasaaayuhummashkoora
To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
Kullan numiddu hā'ulā'i wa hā'ulā'i min ‘aṭā'i rabbik(a), wa mā kāna ‘aṭā'u rabbika maḥẓūrā(n).
كلا نمد هؤلاء وهؤلاء من عطاء ربك  وما كان عطاء ربك محظورا
to each [category] we extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your lord. and never has the gift of your lord been restricted.
kullannumidduhaulaiwahaulaiminatairabbikawamakanaataurabbikamahzurankullannumidduhaolaiwahaolaiminaaatairabbikawamakanaaaataorabbikamahthoora
Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
Unẓur kaifa faḍḍalnā ba‘ḍahum ‘alā ba‘ḍ(in), wa lal-ākhiratu akbaru darajātiw wa akbaru tafḍīlā(n).
انظر كيف فضلنا بعضهم علي بعض  وللاخره اكبر درجت واكبر تفضيلا
look how we have favored [in provision] some of them over others. but the hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
unzurkaifafaddalnabadahumalabadinwalalakhiratuakbarudarajatiwwaakbarutafdilanonthurkayfafaddalnabaaadahumaaalabaaadinwalalakhiratuakbarudarajatinwaakbarutafdeela
Do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
Lā taj‘al ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara fa taq‘uda mażmūmam makhżūlā(n).
لا تجعل مع الله الها ءاخر فتقعد مذموما مخذولا
do not make [as equal] with allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
latajalmaallahiilahanakharafataqudamazmumammakhzulanlatajaaalmaaaaallahiilahanakharafataqaaudamathmoomanmakhthoola

And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.
Wa qaḍā rabbuka allā ta‘budū illā iyyāhu wa bil-wālidaini iḥsānā(n), immā yabluganna ‘indakal-kibara aḥaduhumā au kilāhumā falā taqul lahumā uffiw wa lā tanhar humā wa qul lahumā qaulan karīmā(n).
وقضي ربك الا تعبدوا الا اياه وبالولدين احسنا  اما يبلغن عندك الكبر احدهما او كلاهما فلا تقل لهما اف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما

and your lord has decreed that you worship not except him, and to parents, good treatment. whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.


And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
Wakhfiḍ lahumā janāḥaż-żulli minar-raḥmati wa qur rabbirḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣagīrā(n).
واخفض لهما جناح الذل من الرحمه وقل رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
and lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "my lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when i was] small."
wakhfidlahumajanahazzulliminarrahmatiwaqurrabbirhamhumakamarabbayanisagiranwakhfidlahumajanahaaththulliminaarrahmatiwaqulrabbiirhamhumakamarabbayaneesagheera
Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.
Rabbukum a‘lamu bimā fī nufūsikum, in takūnū ṣāliḥīna fa innahū kāna lil-awwābīna gafūrā(n).
ربكم اعلم بما في نفوسكم  ان تكونوا صلحين فانه كان للاوبين غفورا
your lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. if you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed he is ever, to the often returning [to him], forgiving.
rabbukumalamubimafinufusikumintakunusalihinafainnahukanalilawwabinagafuranrabbukumaaalamubimafeenufoosikumintakoonoosaliheenafainnahukanalilawwabeenaghafoora
And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.
Wa āti żal-qurbā ḥaqqahū wal-miskīna wabnas-sabīli wa lā tubażżir tabżīrā(n).
وءات ذا القربي حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ولا تبذر تبذيرا
and give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.
waatizalqurbahaqqahuwalmiskinawabnassabiliwalatubazzirtabziranwaatithaalqurbahaqqahuwalmiskeenawabnaassabeeliwalatubaththirtabtheera
Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.
Innal-mubażżirīna kānū ikhwānasy-syayāṭīn(i), wa kānasy-syaiṭānu lirabbihī kafūrā(n).
ان المبذرين كانوا اخون الشيطين  وكان الشيطن لربه كفورا
indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has satan been to his lord ungrateful.
innalmubazzirinakanuikhwanasysyayatiniwakanasysyaitanulirabbihikafuraninnaalmubaththireenakanooikhwanaashshayateeniwakanaashshaytanulirabbihikafoora
And if you [must] turn away from them [i.e., the needy] awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.
Wa immā tu‘riḍanna ‘anhumubtigā'a raḥmatim mir rabbika tarjūhā faqul lahum qaulam maisūrā(n).
واما تعرضن عنهم ابتغاء رحمه من ربك ترجوها فقل لهم قولا ميسورا
and if you [must] turn away from them [i.e., the needy] awaiting mercy from your lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.
waimmaturidannaanhumubtigaarahmatimmirrabbikatarjuhafaqullahumqaulammaisuranwaimmatuaaridannaaaanhumuibtighaarahmatinminrabbikatarjoohafaqullahumqawlanmaysoora
And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
Wa lā taj‘al yadaka maglūlatan ilā ‘unuqika wa lā tabsuṭhā kullal-basṭi fa taq‘uda malūmam maḥsūrā(n).
ولا تجعل يدك مغلوله الي عنقك ولا تبسطها كل البسط فتقعد ملوما محسورا
and do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
walatajalyadakamaglulatanilaunuqikawalatabsuthakullalbastifataqudamalumammahsuranwalatajaaalyadakamaghloolatanilaaaunuqikawalatabsuthakullaalbastifataqaaudamaloomanmahsoora
Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing.
Inna rabbaka yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), innahū kāna bi‘ibādihī khabīram baṣīrā(n).
ان ربك يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر  انه كان بعباده خبيرا بصيرا
indeed, your lord extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]. indeed he is ever, concerning his servants, aware and seeing.
innarabbakayabsuturrizqalimayyasyauwayaqdiruinnahukanabiibadihikhabirambasiraninnarabbakayabsutuarrizqalimanyashaowayaqdiruinnahukanabiaaibadihikhabeeranbaseera
And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
Wa lā taqtulū aulādakum khasy-yata imlāq(in), naḥnu narzuquhum wa iyyākum, inna qatlahum kāna khiṭ'an kabīrā(n).
ولا تقتلوا اولدكم خشيه املق  نحن نرزقهم واياكم  ان قتلهم كان خطا كبيرا
and do not kill your children for fear of poverty. we provide for them and for you. indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
walataqtuluauladakumkhasyyataimlaqinnahnunarzuquhumwaiyyakuminnaqatlahumkanakhitankabiranwalataqtulooawladakumkhashyataimlaqinnahnunarzuquhumwaiyyakuminnaqatlahumkanakhitankabeera
And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
Wa lā taqrabuz-zinā innahū kāna fāḥisyah(tan), wa sā'a sabīlā(n).
ولا تقربوا الزني  انه كان فحشه وساء سبيلا
and do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
walataqrabuzzinainnahukanafahisyahtanwasaasabilanwalataqrabooazzinainnahukanafahishatanwasaasabeela

And do not kill the soul [i.e., person] which Allāh has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
Wa lā taqtulun-nafsal-latī ḥarramallāhu illā bil-ḥaqq(i), wa man qutila maẓlūman faqad ja‘alnā liwaliyyihī sulṭānan falā yusrif fil-qatl(i), innahū kāna manṣūrā(n).
ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله الا بالحق  ومن قتل مظلوما فقد جعلنا لوليه سلطنا فلا يسرف في القتل  انه كان منصورا

and do not kill the soul [i.e., person] which allah has forbidden, except by right. and whoever is killed unjustly - we have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. indeed, he has been supported [by the law].

walataqtulunnafsallatiharramallahuillabilhaqqiwamanqutilamazlumanfaqadjaalnaliwaliyyihisultananfalayusriffilqatliinnahukanamansuranwalataqtulooannafsaallateeharramaallahuillabilhaqqiwamanqutilamathloomanfaqadjaaaalnaliwaliyyihisultananfalayusriffeealqatliinnahukanamansoora

And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
Wa lā taqrabū mālal-yatīmi illā bil-latī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yabluga asyuddah(ū), wa aufū bil-‘ahd(i), innal-‘ahda kāna mas'ūlā(n).
ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم الا بالتي هي احسن حتي يبلغ اشده  واوفوا بالعهد  ان العهد كان مسولا

and do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. and fulfill [every] commitment. indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.

walataqrabumalalyatimiillabillatihiyaahsanuhattayablugaasyuddahuwaaufubilahdiinnalahdakanamasulanwalataqraboomalaalyateemiillabillateehiyaahsanuhattayablughaashuddahuwaawfoobilaaahdiinnaalaaahdakanamasoola
And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
Wa auful-kaila iżā kiltum wa zinū bil-qisṭāsil-mustaqīm(i), żālika khairuw wa aḥsanu ta'wīlā(n).
واوفوا الكيل اذا كلتم وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم  ذلك خير واحسن تاويلا
and give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. that is the best [way] and best in result.
waaufulkailaizakiltumwazinubilqistasilmustaqimizalikakhairuwwaahsanutawilanwaawfooalkaylaithakiltumwazinoobilqistasialmustaqeemithalikakhayrunwaahsanutaweela
And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
Wa lā taqfu mā laisa laka bihī ‘ilm(un), innas-sam‘a wal-baṣara wal-fu'āda kullu ulā'ika kāna ‘anhu mas'ūlā(n).
ولا تقف ما ليس لك به علم  ان السمع والبصر والفؤاد كل اولئك كان عنه مسولا
and do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
walataqfumalaisalakabihiilmuninnassamawalbasarawalfuadakulluulaikakanaanhumasulanwalataqfumalaysalakabihiaailmuninnaassamaaawalbasarawalfuadakulluolaikakanaaaanhumasoola
And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
Wa lā tamsyi fil-arḍi marahā(n), innaka lan takhriqal-arḍa wa lan tablugal-jibāla ṭūlā(n).
ولا تمش في الارض مرحا  انك لن تخرق الارض ولن تبلغ الجبال طولا
and do not walk upon the earth exultantly. indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
walatamsyifilardimarahaninnakalantakhriqalardawalantablugaljibalatulanwalatamshifeealardimarahaninnakalantakhriqaalardawalantablughaaljibalatoola
All that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
Kullu żālika kāna sayyi'uhū ‘inda rabbika makrūhā(n).
كل ذلك كان سيئه عند ربك مكروها
all that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your lord, detested.
kulluzalikakanasayyiuhuindarabbikamakruhankulluthalikakanasayyiohuaaindarabbikamakrooha
That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
Żālika mimmā auḥā ilaika rabbuka minal-ḥikmah(ti), wa lā taj‘al ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara fa tulqā fī jahannama malūmam madḥūrā(n).
ذلك مما اوحي اليك ربك من الحكمه  ولا تجعل مع الله الها ءاخر فتلقي في جهنم ملوما مدحورا
that is from what your lord has revealed to you, [o muhammad], of wisdom. and, [o mankind], do not make [as equal] with allah another deity, lest you be thrown into hell, blamed and banished.

zalikamimmaauhailaikarabbukaminalhikmahtiwalatajalmaallahiilahanakharafatulqafijahannamamalumammadhuranthalikamimmaawhailaykarabbukaminaalhikmatiwalatajaaalmaaaaallahiilahanakharafatulqafeejahannamamaloomanmadhoora
Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
Afa aṣfākum rabbukum bil-banīna wattakhaża minal-malā'ikati ināṡā(n), innakum lataqūlūna qaulan ‘aẓīmā(n).
افاصفيكم ربكم بالبنين واتخذ من الملئكه انثا  انكم لتقولون قولا عظيما
then, has your lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? indeed, you say a grave saying.
afaasfakumrabbukumbilbaninawattakhazaminalmalaikatiinasaninnakumlataqulunaqaulanazimanafaasfakumrabbukumbilbaneenawattakhathaminaalmalaikatiinathaninnakumlataqooloonaqawlanaaatheema
And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur’ān that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
Wa laqad ṣarrafnā fī hāżal-qur'āni liyażżakkarū, wa mā yazīduhum illā nufūrā(n).
ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرءان ليذكروا وما يزيدهم الا نفورا
and we have certainly diversified [the contents] in this qur’an that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
walaqadsarrafnafihazalquraniliyazzakkaruwamayaziduhumillanufuranwalaqadsarrafnafeehathaalquraniliyaththakkaroowamayazeeduhumillanufoora
Say, [O Muḥammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
Qul lau kāna ma‘ahū ālihatun kamā yaqūlūna iżal labtagau ilā żil-‘arsyi sabīlā(n).
قل لو كان معه ءالهه كما يقولون اذا لابتغوا الي ذي العرش سبيلا
say, [o muhammad], "if there had been with him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the owner of the throne a way."
qullaukanamaahualihatunkamayaqulunaizallabtagauilazilarsyisabilanqullawkanamaaaahualihatunkamayaqooloonaithanlabtaghawilatheealaaarshisabeela
Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
Subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yaqūlūna ‘uluwwan kabīrā(n).
سبحنه وتعلي عما يقولون علوا كبيرا
exalted is he and high above what they say by great sublimity.
subhanahuwataalaammayaqulunauluwwankabiransubhanahuwataaaalaaaammayaqooloonaaauluwwankabeera

The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allāh] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
Tusabbiḥu lahus-samāwātus-sab‘u wal-arḍu wa man fīhinn(a), wa im min syai'in illā yusabbiḥu biḥamdihī wa lākil lā tafqahūna tasbīḥahum, innahū kāna ḥalīman gafūrā(n).
تسبح له السموت السبع والارض ومن فيهن  وان من شيء الا يسبح بحمده ولكن لا تفقهون تسبيحهم  انه كان حليما غفورا

the seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt him. and there is not a thing except that it exalts [allah] by his praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. indeed, he is ever forbearing and forgiving.

tusabbihulahussamawatussabuwalarduwamanfihinnawaimminsyaiinillayusabbihubihamdihiwalakillatafqahunatasbihahuminnahukanahalimangafurantusabbihulahuassamawatuassabaauwalarduwamanfeehinnawainminshayinillayusabbihubihamdihiwalakinlatafqahoonatasbeehahuminnahukanahaleemanghafoora
And when you recite the Qur’ān, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
Wa iżā qara'tal-qur'āna ja‘alnā bainaka wa bainal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ḥijābam mastūrā(n).
واذا قرات القرءان جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخره حجابا مستورا
and when you recite the qur’an, we put between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter a concealed partition.
waizaqaratalquranajaalnabainakawabainallazinalayuminunabilakhiratihijabammasturanwaithaqarataalquranajaaaalnabaynakawabaynaallatheenalayuminoonabilakhiratihijabanmastoora
And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.
Wa ja‘alnā ‘alā qulūbihim akinnatan ay yafqahūhu wa fī āżānihim waqrā(n), wa iżā żakarta rabbaka fil-qur'āni waḥdahū wallau ‘alā adbārihim nufūrā(n).
وجعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنه ان يفقهوه وفي ءاذانهم وقرا  واذا ذكرت ربك في القرءان وحده ولوا علي ادبرهم نفورا
and we have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. and when you mention your lord alone in the qur’an, they turn back in aversion.

wajaalnaalaqulubihimakinnatanayyafqahuhuwafiazanihimwaqranwaizazakartarabbakafilquraniwahdahuwallaualaadbarihimnufuranwajaaaalnaaaalaquloobihimakinnatananyafqahoohuwafeeathanihimwaqranwaithathakartarabbakafeealquraniwahdahuwallawaaalaadbarihimnufoora
We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
Naḥnu a‘lamu bimā yastami‘ūna bihī iż yastami‘ūna ilaika wa iż hum najwā iż yaqūluẓ-ẓālimūna in tattabi‘ūna illā rajulam masḥūrā(n).
نحن اعلم بما يستمعون به اذ يستمعون اليك واذ هم نجوي اذ يقول الظلمون ان تتبعون الا رجلا مسحورا
we are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "you follow not but a man affected by magic."

nahnualamubimayastamiunabihiizyastamiunailaikawaizhumnajwaizyaquluzzalimunaintattabiunaillarajulammashurannahnuaaalamubimayastamiaaoonabihiithyastamiaaoonailaykawaithhumnajwaithyaqooluaththalimoonaintattabiaaoonaillarajulanmashoora
Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
Unẓur kaifa ḍarabū lakal-amṡāla fa ḍallū falā yastaṭī‘ūna sabīlā(n).
انظر كيف ضربوا لك الامثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
unzurkaifadarabulakalamsalafadallufalayastatiunasabilanonthurkayfadaraboolakaalamthalafadalloofalayastateeaaoonasabeela
And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
Wa qālū a'iżā kunnā ‘iẓāmaw wa rufātan a'innā lamab‘ūṡūna khalqan jadīdā(n).
وقالوا اءذا كنا عظما ورفتا اءنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا
and they say, "when we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
waqaluaizakunnaizamawwarufatanainnalamabusunakhalqanjadidanwaqalooaithakunnaaaithamanwarufatanainnalamabaaoothoonakhalqanjadeeda
Say, "Be you stones or iron
Qul kūnū ḥijāratan au ḥadīdā(n).
قل كونوا حجاره او حديدا
say, "be you stones or iron
qulkunuhijaratanauhadidanqulkoonoohijaratanawhadeeda

Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
Au khalqam mimmā yakburu fī ṣudūrikum, fa sayaqūlūna may yu‘īdunā, qulil-lażī faṭarakum awwala marrah(tin), fa sayun-giḍūna ilaika ru'ūsahum wa yaqūlūna matā huw(a), qul ‘asā ay yakūna qarībā(n).
او خلقا مما يكبر في صدوركم  فسيقولون من يعيدنا  قل الذي فطركم اول مره  فسينغضون اليك رءوسهم ويقولون متي هو  قل عسي ان يكون قريبا

or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." and they will say, "who will restore us?" say, "he who brought you forth the first time." then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "when is that?" say, "perhaps it will be soon -


On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
Yauma yad‘ūkum fa tastajībūna biḥamdihī wa taẓunnūna il labiṡtum illā qalīlā(n).
يوم يدعوكم فتستجيبون بحمده وتظنون ان لبثتم الا قليلا
on the day he will call you and you will respond with praise of him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
yaumayadukumfatastajibunabihamdihiwatazunnunaillabistumillaqalilanyawmayadaaookumfatastajeeboonabihamdihiwatathunnoonainlabithtumillaqaleela
And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
Wa qul li‘ibādī yaqūlul-latī hiya aḥsan(u), innasy-syaiṭāna yanzagu bainahum, innasy-syaiṭāna kāna lil-insāni ‘aduwwam mubīnā(n).
وقل لعبادي يقولوا التي هي احسن  ان الشيطن ينزغ بينهم  ان الشيطن كان للانسن عدوا مبينا
and tell my servants to say that which is best. indeed, satan induces [dissension] among them. indeed satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.

waqulliibadiyaqulullatihiyaahsanuinnasysyaitanayanzagubainahuminnasysyaitanakanalilinsaniaduwwammubinanwaqulliaaibadeeyaqoolooallateehiyaahsanuinnaashshaytanayanzaghubaynahuminnaashshaytanakanalilinsaniaaaduwwanmubeena
Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a manager.
Rabbukum a‘lamu bikum, iy yasya' yarḥamkum au iy yasya' yu‘ażżibkum, wa mā arsalnāka ‘alaihim wakīlā(n).
ربكم اعلم بكم  ان يشا يرحمكم او ان يشا يعذبكم  وما ارسلنك عليهم وكيلا
your lord is most knowing of you. if he wills, he will have mercy upon you; or if he wills, he will punish you. and we have not sent you, [o muhammad], over them as a manager.
rabbukumalamubikumiyyasyayarhamkumauiyyasyayuazzibkumwamaarsalnakaalaihimwakilanrabbukumaaalamubikuminyashayarhamkumawinyashayuaaaththibkumwamaarsalnakaaaalayhimwakeela
And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
Wa rabbuka a‘lamu biman fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa laqad faḍḍalnā ba‘ḍan nabiyyīna ‘alā ba‘ḍiw wa ātainā dāwūda zabūrā(n).
وربك اعلم بمن في السموت والارض  ولقد فضلنا بعض النبين علي بعض  وءاتينا داود زبورا
and your lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. and we have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to david we gave the book [of psalms].

warabbukaalamubimanfissamawatiwalardiwalaqadfaddalnabadannabiyyinaalabadiwwaatainadawudazaburanwarabbukaaaalamubimanfeeassamawatiwalardiwalaqadfaddalnabaaadaannabiyyeenaaaalabaaadinwaataynadawoodazaboora
Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
Qulid‘ul-lażīna za‘amtum min dūnihī falā yamlikūna kasyfaḍ-ḍurri ‘ankum wa lā taḥwīlā(n).
قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دونه فلا يملكون كشف الضر عنكم ولا تحويلا
say, "invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
qulidullazinazaamtummindunihifalayamlikunakasyfaddurriankumwalatahwilanquliodaauallatheenazaaaamtummindoonihifalayamlikoonakashfaaddurriaaankumwalatahweela

Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
Ulā'ikal-lażīna yad‘ūna yabtagūna ilā rabbihimul-wasīlata ayyuhum aqrabu wa yarjūna raḥmatahū wa yakhāfūna ‘ażābah(ū), inna ‘ażāba rabbika kāna maḥżūrā(n).
اولئك الذين يدعون يبتغون الي ربهم الوسيله ايهم اقرب ويرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه  ان عذاب ربك كان محذورا

those whom they invoke seek means of access to their lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for his mercy and fear his punishment. indeed, the punishment of your lord is ever feared.

ulaikallazinayadunayabtagunailarabbihimulwasilataayyuhumaqrabuwayarjunarahmatahuwayakhafunaazabahuinnaazabarabbikakanamahzuranolaikaallatheenayadaaoonayabtaghoonailarabbihimualwaseelataayyuhumaqrabuwayarjoonarahmatahuwayakhafoonaaaathabahuinnaaaathabarabbikakanamahthoora
And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
Wa im min qaryatin illā naḥnu muhlikūhā qabla yaumil-qiyāmati au mu‘ażżibūhā ‘ażāban syadīdā(n), kāna żālika fil-kitābi masṭūrā(n).
وان من قريه الا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيمه او معذبوها عذابا شديدا  كان ذلك في الكتب مسطورا
and there is no city but that we will destroy it before the day of resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. that has ever been in the register inscribed.

waimminqaryatinillanahnumuhlikuhaqablayaumilqiyamatiaumuazzibuhaazabansyadidankanazalikafilkitabimasturanwainminqaryatinillanahnumuhlikoohaqablayawmialqiyamatiawmuaaaththiboohaaaathabanshadeedankanathalikafeealkitabimastoora

And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
Wa mā mana‘anā an nursila bil-āyāti  illā an każżaba bihal-awwalūn(a), wa ātainā ṡamūdan-nāqata mubṣiratan fa ẓalamū bihā, wa mā nursilu bil-āyāti illā takhwīfā(n).
وما منعنا ان نرسل بالايت الا ان كذب بها الاولون  وءاتينا ثمود الناقه مبصره فظلموا بها  وما نرسل بالايت الا تخويفا

and nothing has prevented us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. and we gave thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. and we send not the signs except as a warning.

wamamanaanaannursilabilayatiillaankazzababihalawwalunawaatainasamudannaqatamubsiratanfazalamubihawamanursilubilayatiillatakhwifanwamamanaaaanaannursilabilayatiillaankaththababihaalawwaloonawaataynathamoodaannaqatamubsiratanfathalamoobihawamanursilubilayatiillatakhweefa

And [remember, O Muḥammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.

Wa iż qulnā laka inna rabbaka aḥāṭa bin-nās(i), wa mā ja‘alnar-ru'yal-latī araināka illā fitnatal lin-nāsi wasy-syajaratal mal‘ūnata fil-qur'ān(i), wa nukhawwifuhum, famā yazīduhum illā ṭugyānan kabīrā(n).
واذ قلنا لك ان ربك احاط بالناس  وما جعلنا الرءيا التي ارينك الا فتنه للناس والشجره الملعونه في القرءان  ونخوفهم فما يزيدهم الا طغينا كبيرا

and [remember, o muhammad], when we told you, "indeed, your lord has encompassed the people." and we did not make the sight which we showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the qur’an. and we threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.


And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
Wa iż qulnā lil-malā'ikatisjudū li'ādama fa sajadū illā iblīs(a), qāla a'asjudu liman khalaqta ṭīnā(n).
واذ قلنا للملئكه اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس قال ءاسجد لمن خلقت طينا
and [mention] when we said to the angels, "prostrate to adam," and they prostrated, except for iblees. he said, "should i prostrate to one you created from clay?"
waizqulnalilmalaikatisjuduliadamafasajaduillaiblisaqalaaasjudulimankhalaqtatinanwaithqulnalilmalaikatiosjudooliadamafasajadooillaibleesaqalaaasjudulimankhalaqtateena
[Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
Qāla ara'aitaka  hāżal-lażī karramta ‘alayya la'in akhkhartani ilā yaumil-qiyāmati la'aḥtanikanna żurriyyatahū illā qalīlā(n).
قال ارءيتك هذا الذي كرمت علي لئن اخرتن الي يوم القيمه لاحتنكن ذريته الا قليلا
[iblees] said, "do you see this one whom you have honored above me? if you delay me [i.e., my death] until the day of resurrection, i will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."

qalaaraaitakahazallazikarramtaalayyalainakhkhartaniilayaumilqiyamatilaahtanikannazurriyyatahuillaqalilanqalaaraaytakahathaallatheekarramtaaaalayyalainakhkhartaniilayawmialqiyamatilaahtanikannathurriyyatahuillaqaleela
[Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
Qālażhab faman tabi‘aka minhum fa inna jahannama jazā'ukum jazā'am maufūrā(n).
قال اذهب فمن تبعك منهم فان جهنم جزاؤكم جزاء موفورا
[allah] said, "go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
qalazhabfamantabiakaminhumfainnajahannamajazaukumjazaammaufuranqalaithhabfamantabiaaakaminhumfainnajahannamajazaokumjazaanmawfoora

And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
Wastafziz manistaṭa‘ta minhum biṣautika wa ajlib ‘alaihim bikhailika wa rajilika wa syārikūhum fil-amwāli wal-aulādi wa ‘idhum, wa mā ya‘iduhumusy-syaiṭānu illā gurūrā(n).
واستفزز من استطعت منهم بصوتك واجلب عليهم بخيلك ورجلك وشاركهم في الامول والاولد وعدهم  وما يعدهم الشيطن الا غرورا

and incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." but satan does not promise them except delusion.

wastafzizmanistatataminhumbisautikawaajlibalaihimbikhailikawarajilikawasyarikuhumfilamwaliwalauladiwaidhumwamayaiduhumusysyaitanuillagururanwastafzizmaniistataaataminhumbisawtikawaajlibaaalayhimbikhaylikawarajlikawasharikhumfeealamwaliwalawladiwaaaidhumwamayaaaiduhumuashshaytanuillaghuroora
Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
Inna ‘ibādī laisa laka ‘alaihim sulṭān(un), wa kafā birabbika wakīlā(n).
ان عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطن  وكفي بربك وكيلا
indeed, over my [believing] servants there is for you no authority. and sufficient is your lord as disposer of affairs.
innaibadilaisalakaalaihimsultanunwakafabirabbikawakilaninnaaaibadeelaysalakaaaalayhimsultanunwakafabirabbikawakeela
It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
Rabbukumul-lażī yuzjī lakumul-fulka fil-baḥri litabtagū min faḍlih(ī), innahū kāna bikum raḥīmā(n).
ربكم الذي يزجي لكم الفلك في البحر لتبتغوا من فضله  انه كان بكم رحيما
it is your lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of his bounty. indeed, he is ever, to you, merciful.
rabbukumullaziyuzjilakumulfulkafilbahrilitabtaguminfadlihiinnahukanabikumrahimanrabbukumuallatheeyuzjeelakumualfulkafeealbahrilitabtaghoominfadlihiinnahukanabikumraheema
And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
Wa iżā massakumuḍ-ḍurru fil-baḥri ḍalla man tad‘ūna illā iyyāh(u), falammā najjākum ilal-barri a‘raḍtum, wa kānal-insānu kafūrā(n).
واذا مسكم الضر في البحر ضل من تدعون الا اياه  فلما نجيكم الي البر اعرضتم  وكان الانسن كفورا
and when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for him. but when he delivers you to the land, you turn away [from him]. and ever is man ungrateful.

waizamassakumuddurrufilbahridallamantadunaillaiyyahufalammanajjakumilalbarriaradtumwakanalinsanukafuranwaithamassakumuaddurrufeealbahridallamantadaaoonaillaiyyahufalammanajjakumilaalbarriaaaradtumwakanaalinsanukafoora
Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
Afa amintum ay yakhsifa bikum jānibal-barri au yursila ‘alaikum ḥaṣiban ṡumma lā tajidū lakum wakīlā(n).
افامنتم ان يخسف بكم جانب البر او يرسل عليكم حاصبا ثم لا تجدوا لكم وكيلا
then do you feel secure that [instead] he will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
afaamintumayyakhsifabikumjanibalbarriauyursilaalaikumhasibansummalatajidulakumwakilanafaamintumanyakhsifabikumjanibaalbarriawyursilaaaalaykumhasibanthummalatajidoolakumwakeela

Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
Am amintum ay yu‘īdakum fīhi tāratan ukhrā fa yursila ‘alaikum qāṣifam minar-rīḥi fa yugriqakum bimā kafartum, ṡumma lā tajidū lakum ‘alainā bihī tabī‘ā(n).
ام امنتم ان يعيدكم فيه تاره اخري فيرسل عليكم قاصفا من الريح فيغرقكم بما كفرتم  ثم لا تجدوا لكم علينا به تبيعا

or do you feel secure that he will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? then you would not find for yourselves against us an avenger.

amamintumayyuidakumfihitaratanukhrafayursilaalaikumqasifamminarrihifayugriqakumbimakafartumsummalatajidulakumalainabihitabianamamintumanyuaaeedakumfeehitaratanokhrafayursilaaaalaykumqasifanminaarreehifayughriqakumbimakafartumthummalatajidoolakumaaalaynabihitabeeaaa

And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
Wa laqad karramnā banī ādama wa ḥamalnāhum fil-barri wal-baḥri wa razaqnāhum minaṭ-ṭayyibāti wa faḍḍalnāhum ‘alā kaṡīrim mimman khalaqnā tafḍīlā(n).
ولقد كرمنا بني ءادم وحملنهم في البر والبحر ورزقنهم من الطيبت وفضلنهم علي كثير ممن خلقنا تفضيلا

and we have certainly honored the children of adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what we have created, with [definite] preference.

walaqadkarramnabaniadamawahamalnahumfilbarriwalbahriwarazaqnahumminattayyibatiwafaddalnahumalakasirimmimmankhalaqnatafdilanwalaqadkarramnabaneeadamawahamalnahumfeealbarriwalbahriwarazaqnahumminaattayyibatiwafaddalnahumaaalakatheerinmimmankhalaqnatafdeela

[Mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
Yauma nad‘ū kulla unāsim bi'imāmihim, faman ūtiya katābahū biyamīnihī fa ulā'ika yaqra'ūna kitābahum wa lā yuẓlamūna fatīlā(n).
يوم ندعوا كل اناس باممهم  فمن اوتي كتبه بيمينه فاولئك يقرءون كتبهم ولا يظلمون فتيلا

[mention, o muhammad], the day we will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].

yaumanadukullaunasimbiimamihimfamanutiyakatabahubiyaminihifaulaikayaqraunakitabahumwalayuzlamunafatilanyawmanadaaookullaonasinbiimamihimfamanootiyakitabahubiyameenihifaolaikayaqraoonakitabahumwalayuthlamoonafateela
And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
Wa man kāna fī hāżihī a‘mā fa huwa fil-ākhirati a‘mā wa aḍallu sabīlā(n).
ومن كان في هذه اعمي فهو في الاخره اعمي واضل سبيلا
and whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the hereafter and more astray in way.
wamankanafihazihiamafahuwafilakhiratiamawaadallusabilanwamankanafeehathihiaaamafahuwafeealakhiratiaaamawaadallusabeela
And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
Wa in kādū layaftinūnaka ‘anil-lażī auḥainā ilaika litaftariya ‘alainā gairah(ū), wa iżal lattakhażūka khalīlā(n).
وان كادوا ليفتنونك عن الذي اوحينا اليك لتفتري علينا غيره  واذا لاتخذوك خليلا
and indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which we revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
wainkadulayaftinunakaanillaziauhainailaikalitaftariyaalainagairahuwaizallattakhazukakhalilanwainkadoolayaftinoonakaaaaniallatheeawhaynailaykalitaftariyaaaalaynaghayrahuwaithanlattakhathookakhaleela
And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
Wa lau lā an ṡabbatnāka laqad kitta tarkanu ilaihim syai'an qalīlā(n).
ولولا ان ثبتنك لقد كدت تركن اليهم شيا قليلا
and if we had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
walaulaansabbatnakalaqadkittatarkanuilaihimsyaianqalilanwalawlaanthabbatnakalaqadkidtatarkanuilayhimshayanqaleela
Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
Iżal-la'ażaqnāka ḍi‘fal-ḥayāti wa ḍi‘fal-mamāti ṡumma lā tajidu laka ‘alainā naṣīrā(n).
اذا لاذقنك ضعف الحيوه وضعف الممات ثم لا تجد لك علينا نصيرا
then [if you had], we would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. then you would not find for yourself against us a helper.
izallaazaqnakadifalhayatiwadifalmamatisummalatajidulakaalainanasiranithanlaathaqnakadiaafaalhayatiwadiaafaalmamatithummalatajidulakaaaalaynanaseera
And indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., Makkah] to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
Wa in kādū layastafizzūnaka minal-arḍi liyukhrijūka minhā wa iżal lā yalbaṡūna khilāfaka illā qalīlā(n).
وان كادوا ليستفزونك من الارض ليخرجوك منها  واذا لا يلبثون خلفك الا قليلا
and indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., makkah] to evict you therefrom. and then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
wainkadulayastafizzunakaminalardiliyukhrijukaminhawaizallayalbasunakhilafakaillaqalilanwainkadoolayastafizzoonakaminaalardiliyukhrijookaminhawaithanlayalbathoonakhilafakaillaqaleela
[That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
Sunnata man qad arsalnā qablaka mir rusulinā wa lā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlā(n).
سنه من قد ارسلنا قبلك من رسلنا  ولا تجد لسنتنا تحويلا
[that is our] established way for those we had sent before you of our messengers; and you will not find in our way any alteration.
sunnatamanqadarsalnaqablakamirrusulinawalatajidulisunnatinatahwilansunnatamanqadarsalnaqablakaminrusulinawalatajidulisunnatinatahweela
Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
Aqimiṣ-ṣalāta lidulūkisy-syamsi ilā gasaqil-laili wa qur'ānal-fajr(i), inna qur'ānal-fajri kāna masyhūdā(n).
اقم الصلوه لدلوك الشمس الي غسق اليل وقرءان الفجر  ان قرءان الفجر كان مشهودا
establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the qur’an [i.e., recitation] of dawn. indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
aqimissalatalidulukisysyamsiilagasaqillailiwaquranalfajriinnaquranalfajrikanamasyhudanaqimiassalatalidulookiashshamsiilaghasaqiallayliwaquranaalfajriinnaquranaalfajrikanamashhooda
And from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
Wa minal-laili fa tahajjad bihī nāfilatal lak(a), ‘asā ay yab‘aṡaka rabbuka maqāmam maḥmūdā(n).
ومن اليل فتهجد به نافله لك عسي ان يبعثك ربك مقاما محمودا
and from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the qur’an] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
waminallailifatahajjadbihinafilatallakaasaayyabasakarabbukamaqamammahmudanwaminaallaylifatahajjadbihinafilatanlakaaaasaanyabaaathakarabbukamaqamanmahmooda
And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
Wa qur rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqiw wa akhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqiw waj‘al lī mil ladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā(n).
وقل رب ادخلني مدخل صدق واخرجني مخرج صدق واجعل لي من لدنك سلطنا نصيرا
and say, "my lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from yourself a supporting authority."
waqurrabbiadkhilnimudkhalasidqiwwaakhrijnimukhrajasidqiwwajallimilladunkasultanannasiranwaqulrabbiadkhilneemudkhalasidqinwaakhrijneemukhrajasidqinwajaaalleeminladunkasultanannaseera
And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
Wa qul jā'al-ḥaqqu wa zahaqal-bāṭil(u), innal-bāṭila kāna zahūqā(n).
وقل جاء الحق وزهق البطل  ان البطل كان زهوقا
and say, "truth has come, and falsehood has departed. indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
waquljaalhaqquwazahaqalbatiluinnalbatilakanazahuqanwaquljaaalhaqquwazahaqaalbatiluinnaalbatilakanazahooqa
And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
Wa nunazzilu minal-qur'āni mā huwa syifā'uw wa raḥmatul lil-mu'minīn(a), wa lā yazīduẓ-ẓālimīna illā khasārā(n).
وننزل من القرءان ما هو شفاء ورحمه للمؤمنين  ولا يزيد الظلمين الا خسارا
and we send down of the qur’an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
wanunazziluminalquranimahuwasyifauwwarahmatullilmumininawalayaziduzzaliminaillakhasaranwanunazziluminaalquranimahuwashifaonwarahmatunlilmumineenawalayazeeduaththalimeenaillakhasara
And when We bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
Wa iżā an‘amnā ‘alal-insāni a‘raḍa wa na'ā bijānibih(ī), wa iżā massahusy-syarru kāna ya'ūsā(n).
واذا انعمنا علي الانسن اعرض ونا بجانبه  واذا مسه الشر كان يوسا
and when we bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
waizaanamnaalalinsaniaradawanaabijanibihiwaizamassahusysyarrukanayausanwaithaanaaamnaaaalaalinsaniaaaradawanaabijanibihiwaithamassahuashsharrukanayaoosa
Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
Qul kulluy ya‘malu ‘alā syākilatih(ī), fa rabbukum a‘lamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlā(n).
قل كل يعمل علي شاكلته فربكم اعلم بمن هو اهدي سبيلا
say, "each works according to his manner, but your lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
qulkulluyyamalualasyakilatihifarabbukumalamubimanhuwaahdasabilanqulkullunyaaamaluaaalashakilatihifarabbukumaaalamubimanhuwaahdasabeela
And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."
Wa yas'alūnaka ‘anir-rūḥ(i), qulir-rūḥu min amri rabbī wa mā ūtītum minal-‘ilmi illā qalīlā(n).
ويسلونك عن الروح  قل الروح من امر ربي وما اوتيتم من العلم الا قليلا
and they ask you, [o muhammad], about the soul. say, "the soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my lord. and you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."
wayasalunakaanirruhiqulirruhuminamrirabbiwamautitumminalilmiillaqalilanwayasaloonakaaaaniarroohiquliarroohuminamrirabbeewamaooteetumminaalaailmiillaqaleela
And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
Wa la'in syi'nā lanażhabanna bil-lażī auḥainā ilaika ṡumma lā tajidu laka bihī ‘alainā wakīlā(n).
ولئن شئنا لنذهبن بالذي اوحينا اليك ثم لا تجد لك به علينا وكيلا
and if we willed, we could surely do away with that which we revealed to you. then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against us.
walainsyinalanazhabannabillaziauhainailaikasummalatajidulakabihialainawakilanwalainshinalanathhabannabillatheeawhaynailaykathummalatajidulakabihiaaalaynawakeela
Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
Illā raḥmatam mir rabbik(a), inna faḍalahū kāna ‘alaika kabīrā(n).
الا رحمه من ربك  ان فضله كان عليك كبيرا
except [we have left it with you] as a mercy from your lord. indeed, his favor upon you has ever been great.
illarahmatammirrabbikainnafadalahukanaalaikakabiranillarahmatanminrabbikainnafadlahukanaaaalaykakabeera
Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
Qul la'inijtama‘atil-insu wal-jinnu ‘alā ay ya'tū bimiṡli hāżal-qur'āni lā ya'tūna bimiṡlihī wa lau kāna ba‘ḍuhum liba‘ḍin ẓahīrā(n).
قل لئن اجتمعت الانس والجن علي ان ياتوا بمثل هذا القرءان لا ياتون بمثله ولو كان بعضهم لبعض ظهيرا
say, "if mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this qur’an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."

qullainijtamaatilinsuwaljinnualaayyatubimislihazalquranilayatunabimislihiwalaukanabaduhumlibadinzahiranqullainiijtamaaaatialinsuwaljinnuaaalaanyatoobimithlihathaalquranilayatoonabimithlihiwalawkanabaaaduhumlibaaadinthaheera
And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.
Wa laqad ṣarrafnā lin-nāsi fī hāżal-qur'āni min kulli maṡal(in), fa abā akṡarun-nāsi illā kufūrā(n).
ولقد صرفنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل فابي اكثر الناس الا كفورا
and we have certainly diversified for the people in this qur’an from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.
walaqadsarrafnalinnasifihazalquraniminkullimasalinfaabaaksarunnasiillakufuranwalaqadsarrafnalinnasifeehathaalquraniminkullimathalinfaabaaktharuannasiillakufoora
And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
Wa qālū lan nu'mina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā minal-arḍi yambū‘ā(n).
وقالوا لن نؤمن لك حتي تفجر لنا من الارض ينبوعا
and they say, "we will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
waqalulannuminalakahattatafjuralanaminalardiyambuanwaqaloolannuminalakahattatafjuralanaminaalardiyanbooaaa
Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
Au takūna laka jannatum min nakhīliw wa ‘inabin fa tufajjiral-anhāra khilālahā tafjīrā(n).
او تكون لك جنه من نخيل وعنب فتفجر الانهر خللها تفجيرا
or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
autakunalakajannatumminnakhiliwwainabinfatufajjiralanharakhilalahatafjiranawtakoonalakajannatunminnakheelinwaaainabinfatufajjiraalanharakhilalahatafjeera
Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allāh and the angels before [us]
Au tusqiṭas-samā'a kamā za‘amta ‘alainā kisafan au ta'tiya billāhi wal-malā'ikati qabīlā(n).
او تسقط السماء كما زعمت علينا كسفا او تاتي بالله والملئكه قبيلا
or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring allah and the angels before [us]
autusqitassamaakamazaamtaalainakisafanautatiyabillahiwalmalaikatiqabilanawtusqitaassamaakamazaaaamtaaaalaynakisafanawtatiyabillahiwalmalaikatiqabeela

Or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
Au yakūna laka baitum min zukhrufin au tarqā fis-samā'(i), wa lan nu'mina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ‘alainā kitāban naqra'uh(ū), qul subḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basyarar rasūlā(n).
او يكون لك بيت من زخرف او ترقي في السماء ولن نؤمن لرقيك حتي تنزل علينا كتبا نقرؤه  قل سبحان ربي هل كنت الا بشرا رسولا

or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. and [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." say, "exalted is my lord! was i ever but a human messenger?"

auyakunalakabaitumminzukhrufinautarqafissamaiwalannuminaliruqiyyikahattatunazzilaalainakitabannaqrauhuqulsubhanarabbihalkuntuillabasyararrasulanawyakoonalakabaytunminzukhrufinawtarqafeeassamaiwalannuminaliruqiyyikahattatunazzilaaaalaynakitabannaqraohuqulsubhanarabbeehalkuntuillabasharanrasoola
And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allāh sent a human messenger?"
Wa mā mana‘an-nāsa ay yu'minū iż jā'ahumul-hudā illā an qālū aba‘aṡallāhu basyarar rasūlā(n).
وما منع الناس ان يؤمنوا اذ جاءهم الهدي الا ان قالوا ابعث الله بشرا رسولا
and what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "has allah sent a human messenger?"
wamamanaannasaayyuminuizjaahumulhudaillaanqaluabaasallahubasyararrasulanwamamanaaaaannasaanyuminooithjaahumualhudaillaanqalooabaaaathaallahubasharanrasoola
Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
Qul lau kāna fil-arḍi malā'ikatuy yamsyūna muṭma'innīna lanazzalnā ‘alaihim minas-samā'i malakar rasūlā(n).
قل لو كان في الارض ملئكه يمشون مطمئنين لنزلنا عليهم من السماء ملكا رسولا
say, "if there were upon the earth angels walking securely, we would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
qullaukanafilardimalaikatuyyamsyunamutmainninalanazzalnaalaihimminassamaimalakarrasulanqullawkanafeealardimalaikatunyamshoonamutmainneenalanazzalnaaaalayhimminaassamaimalakanrasoola
Say, "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing."
Qul kafā billāhi syahīdam bainī wa bainakum, innahū kāna bi‘ibādihī khabīram baṣīrā(n).
قل كفي بالله شهيدا بيني وبينكم  انه كان بعباده خبيرا بصيرا
say, "sufficient is allah as witness between me and you. indeed he is ever, concerning his servants, aware and seeing."
qulkafabillahisyahidambainiwabainakuminnahukanabiibadihikhabirambasiranqulkafabillahishaheedanbayneewabaynakuminnahukanabiaaibadihikhabeeranbaseera

And whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides, We increase [for] them blazing fire.

Wa may yahdillāhu fa huwal-muhtad(i), wa may yuḍlil falan tajida lahum auliyā'a min dūnih(ī), wa naḥsyuruhum yaumal-qiyāmati ‘alā wujūhihim ‘umyaw wa bukmaw wa ṣummā(n), ma'wāhum jahannam(u), kullamā khabat zidnāhum sa‘īrā(n).
ومن يهد الله فهو المهتد  ومن يضلل فلن تجد لهم اولياء من دونه  ونحشرهم يوم القيمه علي وجوههم عميا وبكما وصما  ماويهم جهنم  كلما خبت زدنهم سعيرا

and whoever allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever he sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides him, and we will gather them on the day of resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. their refuge is hell; every time it subsides, we increase [for] them blazing fire.


That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
Żālika jazā'uhum bi'annahum kafarū bi'āyātinā wa qālū a'iżā kunnā ‘iẓāmaw wa rufātan a'innā lamab‘ūṡūna khalqan jadīdā(n).
ذلك جزاؤهم بانهم كفروا بايتنا وقالوا اءذا كنا عظما ورفتا اءنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا
that is their recompense because they disbelieved in our verses and said, "when we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"

zalikajazauhumbiannahumkafarubiayatinawaqaluaizakunnaizamawwarufatanainnalamabusunakhalqanjadidanthalikajazaohumbiannahumkafaroobiayatinawaqalooaithakunnaaaithamanwarufatanainnalamabaaoothoonakhalqanjadeeda

Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief.
Awalam yarau annallāhal-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ‘alā ay yakhluqa miṡlahum wa ja‘ala lahum ajalal lā raiba fīh(i), fa abaẓ-ẓālimūna illā kufūrā(n).
اولم يروا ان الله الذي خلق السموت والارض قادر علي ان يخلق مثلهم وجعل لهم اجلا لا ريب فيه فابي الظلمون الا كفورا

do they not see that allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] able to create the likes of them? and he has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. but the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief.

awalamyarauannallahallazikhalaqassamawatiwalardaqadirunalaayyakhluqamislahumwajaalalahumajalallaraibafihifaabazzalimunaillakufuranawalamyarawannaallahaallatheekhalaqaassamawatiwalardaqadirunaaalaanyakhluqamithlahumwajaaaalalahumajalanlaraybafeehifaabaaththalimoonaillakufoora
Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
Qul lau antum tamlikūna khazā'ina raḥmati rabbī iżal la'amsaktum khasy-yatal-infāq(i), wa kānal-insānu qatūrā(n).
قل لو انتم تملكون خزائن رحمه ربي اذا لامسكتم خشيه الانفاق  وكان الانسن قتورا
say [to them], "if you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." and ever has man been stingy.
qullauantumtamlikunakhazainarahmatirabbiizallaamsaktumkhasyyatalinfaqiwakanalinsanuqaturanqullawantumtamlikoonakhazainarahmatirabbeeithanlaamsaktumkhashyataalinfaqiwakanaalinsanuqatoora
And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
Wa laqad ātainā mūsā tis‘a āyātim bayyinātin fas'al banī isrā'īla iż jā'ahum fa qāla lahū fir‘aunu innī la'aẓunnuka yā mūsā masḥūrā(n).
ولقد ءاتينا موسي تسع ءايت بينت  فسل بني اسرءيل اذ جاءهم فقال له فرعون اني لاظنك يموسي مسحورا
and we had certainly given moses nine evident signs, so ask the children of israel [about] when he came to them and pharaoh said to him, "indeed i think, o moses, that you are affected by magic."

walaqadatainamusatisaayatimbayyinatinfasalbaniisrailaizjaahumfaqalalahufiraunuinnilaazunnukayamusamashuranwalaqadataynamoosatisaaaayatinbayyinatinfasalbaneeisraeelaithjaahumfaqalalahufiraaawnuinneelaathunnukayamoosamashoora
[Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
Qāla laqad ‘alimta mā anzala hā'ulā'i illā rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣā'ir(a), wa innī la'aẓunnuka yā fir‘aunu maṡbūrā(n).
قال لقد علمت ما انزل هؤلاء الا رب السموت والارض بصائر واني لاظنك يفرعون مثبورا
[moses] said, "you have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed i think, o pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
qalalaqadalimtamaanzalahaulaiillarabbussamawatiwalardibasairawainnilaazunnukayafiraunumasburanqalalaqadaaalimtamaanzalahaolaiillarabbuassamawatiwalardibasairawainneelaathunnukayafiraaawnumathboora
So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
Fa arāda ay yastafizzahum minal arḍi fa agraqnāhu wa mam ma‘ahū jamī‘ā(n).
فاراد ان يستفزهم من الارض فاغرقنه ومن معه جميعا
so he intended to drive them from the land, but we drowned him and those with him all together.
faaradaayyastafizzahumminalardifaagraqnahuwamammaahujamianfaaradaanyastafizzahumminaalardifaaghraqnahuwamanmaaaahujameeaaa

And We said after him [i.e., Pharaoh] to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
Wa qulnā mim ba‘dihī libanī isrā'īlaskunul-arḍa fa iżā jā'a wa‘dul-ākhirati ji'nā bikum lafīfā(n).
وقلنا من بعده لبني اسرءيل اسكنوا الارض فاذا جاء وعد الاخره جئنا بكم لفيفا

and we said after him [i.e., pharaoh] to the children of israel, "dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the hereafter, we will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
waqulnamimbadihilibaniisrailaskunulardafaizajaawadulakhiratijinabikumlafifanwaqulnaminbaaadihilibaneeisraeelaoskunooalardafaithajaawaaadualakhiratijinabikumlafeefa
And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
Wa bil-ḥaqqi anzalnāhu wa bil-ḥaqqi nazal(a), wa mā arsalnāka illā mubasysyiraw wa nażīrā(n).
وبالحق انزلنه وبالحق نزل  وما ارسلنك الا مبشرا ونذيرا
and with the truth we have sent it [i.e., the qur’an] down, and with the truth it has descended. and we have not sent you, [o muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
wabilhaqqianzalnahuwabilhaqqinazalawamaarsalnakaillamubasysyirawwanaziranwabilhaqqianzalnahuwabilhaqqinazalawamaarsalnakaillamubashshiranwanatheera
And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
Wa qur'ānan faraqnāhu litaqra'ahū ‘alan-nāsi ‘alā mukṡiw wa nazzalnāhu tanzīlā(n).
وقرءانا فرقنه لتقراه علي الناس علي مكث ونزلنه تنزيلا
and [it is] a qur’an which we have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. and we have sent it down progressively.
waqurananfaraqnahulitaqraahualannasialamuksiwwanazzalnahutanzilanwaqurananfaraqnahulitaqraahuaaalaannasiaaalamukthinwanazzalnahutanzeela
Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
Qul āminū bihī au lā tu'minū, innal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma min qablihī iżā yutlā ‘alaihim yakhirrūna lil-ażqāni sujjadā(n).
قل ءامنوا به او لا تؤمنوا  ان الذين اوتوا العلم من قبله اذا يتلي عليهم يخرون للاذقان سجدا
say, "believe in it or do not believe." indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,

qulaminubihiaulatuminuinnallazinautulilmaminqablihiizayutlaalaihimyakhirrunalilazqanisujjadanqulaminoobihiawlatuminooinnaallatheenaootooalaailmaminqablihiithayutlaaaalayhimyakhirroonalilathqanisujjada
And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
Wa yaqūlūna subḥāna rabbinā in kāna wa‘du rabbinā lamaf‘ūlā(n).
ويقولون سبحن ربنا ان كان وعد ربنا لمفعولا
and they say, "exalted is our lord! indeed, the promise of our lord has been fulfilled."
wayaqulunasubhanarabbinainkanawadurabbinalamafulanwayaqooloonasubhanarabbinainkanawaaadurabbinalamafaaoola
And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
Wa yakhirrūna lil-ażqāni yabkūna wa yazīduhum khusyū‘ā(n).
ويخرون للاذقان يبكون ويزيدهم خشوعا
and they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the qur’an] increases them in humble submission.
wayakhirrunalilazqaniyabkunawayaziduhumkhusyuanwayakhirroonalilathqaniyabkoonawayazeeduhumkhushooaaa

Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
Qulid‘ullāha awid‘ur-raḥmān(a), ayyam mā tad‘ū fa lahul-asmā'ul-ḥusnā, wa lā tajhar biṣalātika wa lā tukhāfit bihā wabtagi baina żālika sabīlā(n).
قل ادعوا الله او ادعوا الرحمن  ايا ما تدعوا فله الاسماء الحسني  ولا تجهر بصلاتك ولا تخافت بها وابتغ بين ذلك سبيلا

say, "call upon allah or call upon the most merciful [ar-rahman]. whichever [name] you call - to him belong the best names." and do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.

qulidullahaawidurrahmanaayyammatadufalahulasmaulhusnawalatajharbisalatikawalatukhafitbihawabtagibainazalikasabilanquliodaaooallahaawiodaaooarrahmanaayyanmatadaaoofalahualasmaoalhusnawalatajharbisalatikawalatukhafitbihawabtaghibaynathalikasabeela
And say, "Praise to Allāh, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
Wa qulil-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī lam yattakhiż waladaw wa lam yakul lahū syarīkun fil-mulki wa lam yakul lahū waliyyum minaż-żulli wa kabbirhu takbīrā(n).
وقل الحمد لله الذي لم يتخذ ولدا ولم يكن له شريك في الملك ولم يكن له ولي من الذل  وكبره تكبيرا
and say, "praise to allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [his] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify him with [great] glorification."

waqulilhamdulillahillazilamyattakhizwaladawwalamyakullahusyarikunfilmulkiwalamyakullahuwaliyyumminazzulliwakabbirhutakbiranwaqulialhamdulillahiallatheelamyattakhithwaladanwalamyakunlahushareekunfeealmulkiwalamyakunlahuwaliyyunminaaththulliwakabbirhutakbeera
[All] praise is [due] to Allāh, who has sent down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī anzala ‘alā ‘abdihil-kitāba wa lam yaj‘al lahū ‘iwajā(n).
الحمد لله الذي انزل علي عبده الكتب ولم يجعل له عوجا
[all] praise is [due] to allah, who has sent down upon his servant [muhammad (ﷺ)] the book and has not made therein any deviance.
alhamdulillahillazianzalaalaabdihilkitabawalamyajallahuiwajanalhamdulillahiallatheeanzalaaaalaaaabdihialkitabawalamyajaaallahuaaiwaja
[He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward [i.e., Paradise].
Qayyimal liyunżira ba'san syadīdam mil ladunhu wa yubasysyiral-mu'minīnal-lażīna ya‘malūnaṣ-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum ajran ḥasanā(n).
قيما لينذر باسا شديدا من لدنه ويبشر المؤمنين الذين يعملون الصلحت ان لهم اجرا حسنا
[he has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward [i.e., paradise].

qayyimalliyunzirabasansyadidammilladunhuwayubasysyiralmumininallazinayamalunassalihatiannalahumajranhasananqayyimanliyunthirabasanshadeedanminladunhuwayubashshiraalmumineenaallatheenayaaamaloonaassalihatiannalahumajranhasana
In which they will remain forever
Mākiṡīna fīhi abadā(n).
مكثين فيه ابدا
in which they will remain forever
makisinafihiabadanmakitheenafeehiabada
And to warn those who say, "Allāh has taken a son".
Wa yunżiral-lażīna qāluttakhażallāhu waladā(n).
وينذر الذين قالوا اتخذ الله ولدا
and to warn those who say, "allah has taken a son".
wayunzirallazinaqaluttakhazallahuwaladanwayunthiraallatheenaqalooittakhathaallahuwalada
They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.
Mā lahum bihī min ‘ilmiw wa lā li'ābā'ihim, kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwāhihim, iy yaqūlūna illā każibā(n).
ما لهم به من علم ولا لابائهم  كبرت كلمه تخرج من افوههم  ان يقولون الا كذبا
they have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.
malahumbihiminilmiwwalaliabaihimkaburatkalimatantakhrujuminafwahihimiyyaqulunaillakazibanmalahumbihiminaailminwalaliabaihimkaburatkalimatantakhrujuminafwahihiminyaqooloonaillakathiba
Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muḥammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
Fa la‘allaka bākhi‘un nafsaka ‘alā āṡārihim illam yu'minū bihāżal-ḥadīṡi asafā(n).
فلعلك بخع نفسك علي ءاثرهم ان لم يؤمنوا بهذا الحديث اسفا
then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [o muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
falaallakabakhiunnafsakaalaasarihimillamyuminubihazalhadisiasafanfalaaaallakabakhiaaunnafsakaaaalaatharihiminlamyuminoobihathaalhadeethiasafa
Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
Innā ja‘alnā mā ‘alal-arḍi zīnatal lahā linabluwahum ayyuhum aḥsanu ‘amalā(n).
انا جعلنا ما علي الارض زينه لها لنبلوهم ايهم احسن عملا
indeed, we have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that we may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
innajaalnamaalalardizinatallahalinabluwahumayyuhumahsanuamalaninnajaaaalnamaaaalaalardizeenatanlahalinabluwahumayyuhumahsanuaaamala
And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
Wa innā lajā‘ilūna mā ‘alaihā ṣa‘īdan juruzā(n).
وانا لجعلون ما عليها صعيدا جرزا
and indeed, we will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
