they said, "o dhul-qarnayn, indeed gog and magog are [great] corrupters in the land. so may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"

qaluyazalqarnainiinnayajujawamajujamufsidunafilardifahalnajalulakakharjanalaantajalabainanawabainahumsaddanqalooyathaalqarnayniinnayajoojawamajoojamufsidoonafeealardifahalnajaaalulakakharjanaaalaantajaaalabaynanawabaynahumsadda
He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
Qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī fa a‘īnūnī biquwwatin aj‘al bainakum wa bainahum radmā(n).
قال ما مكني فيه ربي خير فاعينوني بقوه اجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما
he said, "that in which my lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; i will make between you and them a dam.
qalamamakkannifihirabbifaainunibiquwwatinajalbainakumwabainahumradmanqalamamakkanneefeehirabbeekhayrunfaaaaeenooneebiquwwatinajaaalbaynakumwabaynahumradma

Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
Ātūnī zubaral-ḥadīd(i), ḥattā iżā sāwā bainaṣ-ṣadafaini qālanfukhū, ḥattā iżā ja‘alahū nārā(n), qāla ātūnī ufrig ‘alaihi qiṭrā(n).
ءاتوني زبر الحديد  حتي اذا ساوي بين الصدفين قال انفخوا  حتي اذا جعله نارا قال ءاتوني افرغ عليه قطرا

bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "bring me, that i may pour over it molten copper."

atunizubaralhadidihattaizasawabainassadafainiqalanfukhuhattaizajaalahunaranqalaatuniufrigalaihiqitranatooneezubaraalhadeedihattaithasawabaynaasadafayniqalaonfukhoohattaithajaaaalahunaranqalaatooneeofrighaaalayhiqitra
So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
Famasṭā‘ū ay yaẓharūhu wa mastaṭā‘ū lahū naqbā(n).
فما اسطعوا ان يظهروه وما استطعوا له نقبا
so they [i.e., gog and magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
famastauayyazharuhuwamastataulahunaqbanfamaistaaaooanyathharoohuwamaistataaaoolahunaqba
[Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
Qāla hāżā raḥmatum mir rabbī, fa iżā jā'a wa‘du rabbī ja‘alahū dakkā'(a), wa kāna wa‘du rabbī ḥaqqā(n).
قال هذا رحمه من ربي  فاذا جاء وعد ربي جعله دكاء  وكان وعد ربي حقا
[dhul-qarnayn] said, "this is a mercy from my lord; but when the promise of my lord comes [i.e., approaches], he will make it level, and ever is the promise of my lord true."
qalahazarahmatummirrabbifaizajaawadurabbijaalahudakkaawakanawadurabbihaqqanqalahatharahmatunminrabbeefaithajaawaaadurabbeejaaaalahudakkaawakanawaaadurabbeehaqqa
And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
Wa taraknā ba‘ḍahum yauma'iżiy yamūju fī ba‘ḍiw wa nufikha fiṣ-ṣūri fa jama‘nāhum jam‘ā(n).
وتركنا بعضهم يومئذ يموج في بعض  ونفخ في الصور فجمعنهم جمعا
and we will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the horn will be blown, and we will assemble them in [one] assembly.
wataraknabadahumyaumaiziyyamujufibadiwwanufikhafissurifajamanahumjamanwataraknabaaadahumyawmaithinyamoojufeebaaadinwanufikhafeeassoorifajamaaanahumjamaaa
And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -
Wa ‘araḍnā jahannama yauma'iżil lil-kāfirīna ‘arḍā(n).
وعرضنا جهنم يومئذ للكفرين عرضا
and we will present hell that day to the disbelievers, on display -
waaradnajahannamayaumaizillilkafirinaardanwaaaaradnajahannamayawmaithinlilkafireenaaaarda
Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
Allażīna kānat a‘yunuhum fī giṭā'in ‘an żikrī wa kānū lā yastaṭī‘ūna sam‘ā(n).
الذين كانت اعينهم في غطاء عن ذكري وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا
those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from my remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
allazinakanatayunuhumfigitainanzikriwakanulayastatiunasamanallatheenakanataaayunuhumfeeghitainaaanthikreewakanoolayastateeaaoonasamaaa
Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
Afaḥasibal-lażīna kafarū ay yattakhiżū ‘ibādī min dūnī auliyā'(a), innā a‘tadnā jahannama lil-kāfirīna nuzulā(n).
افحسب الذين كفروا ان يتخذوا عبادي من دوني اولياء  انا اعتدنا جهنم للكفرين نزلا
then do those who disbelieve think that they can take my servants instead of me as allies? indeed, we have prepared hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
afahasiballazinakafaruayyattakhizuibadiminduniauliyaainnaatadnajahannamalilkafirinanuzulanafahasibaallatheenakafarooanyattakhithooaaibadeemindooneeawliyaainnaaaatadnajahannamalilkafireenanuzula
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
Qul hal nunabbi'ukum bil-akhsarīna a‘mālā(n).
قل هل ننبئكم بالاخسرين اعملا
say, [o muhammad], "shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
qulhalnunabbiukumbilakhsarinaamalanqulhalnunabbiokumbilakhsareenaaaamala
[They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
Al-lażīna ḍalla sa‘yuhum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa hum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥsinūna ṣun‘ā(n).
الذين ضل سعيهم في الحيوه الدنيا وهم يحسبون انهم يحسنون صنعا
[they are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
allazinadallasayuhumfilhayatiddunyawahumyahsabunaannahumyuhsinunasunanallatheenadallasaaayuhumfeealhayatiaddunyawahumyahsaboonaannahumyuhsinoonasunaaa

Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
Ulā'ikal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyāti rabbihim wa liqā'ihī fa ḥabiṭat a‘māluhum falā nuqīma lahum yaumal-qiyāmati waznā(n).
اولئك الذين كفروا بايت ربهم ولقائه فحبطت اعملهم فلا نقيم لهم يوم القيمه وزنا

those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their lord and in [their] meeting him, so their deeds have become worthless; and we will not assign to them on the day of resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
ulaikallazinakafarubiayatirabbihimwaliqaihifahabitatamaluhumfalanuqimalahumyaumalqiyamatiwaznanolaikaallatheenakafaroobiayatirabbihimwaliqaihifahabitataaamaluhumfalanuqeemulahumyawmaalqiyamatiwazna
That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
Żālika jazā'uhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wattakhażū āyātī wa rusulī huzuwā(n).
ذلك جزاؤهم جهنم بما كفروا واتخذوا ءايتي ورسلي هزوا
that is their recompense - hell - for what they denied and [because] they took my signs and my messengers in ridicule.
zalikajazauhumjahannamubimakafaruwattakhazuayatiwarusulihuzuwanthalikajazaohumjahannamubimakafaroowattakhathooayateewarusuleehuzuwa
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
Innal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātul-firdausi nuzulā(n).
ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كانت لهم جنت الفردوس نزلا
indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the gardens of paradise as a lodging,
innallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatikanatlahumjannatulfirdausinuzulaninnaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatikanatlahumjannatualfirdawsinuzula
Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
Khālidīna fīhā lā yabgūna ‘anhā ḥiwalā(n).
خلدين فيها لا يبغون عنها حولا
wherein they abide eternally. they will not desire from it any transfer.
khalidinafihalayabgunaanhahiwalankhalideenafeehalayabghoonaaaanhahiwala
Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
Qul lau kānal-baḥru midādal likalimāti rabbī lanafidal-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimāṭu rabbī wa lau ji'nā bimiṡlihī madadā(n).
قل لو كان البحر مدادا لكلمت ربي لنفد البحر قبل ان تنفد كلمت ربي ولو جئنا بمثله مددا
say, "if the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my lord were exhausted, even if we brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."

qullaukanalbahrumidadallikalimatirabbilanafidalbahruqablaantanfadakalimaturabbiwalaujinabimislihimadadanqullawkanaalbahrumidadanlikalimatirabbeelanafidaalbahruqablaantanfadakalimaturabbeewalawjinabimithlihimadada

Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
Qul innamā ana basyarum miṡlukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥid(un), faman kāna yarjū liqā'a rabbihī falya‘mal ‘amalan ṣāliḥaw wa lā yusyrik bi‘ibādati rabbihī aḥadā(n).
قل انما انا بشر مثلكم يوحي الي انما الهكم اله وحد  فمن كان يرجوا لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صلحا ولا يشرك بعباده ربه احدا

say, "i am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one god. so whoever would hope for the meeting with his lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his lord anyone."

qulinnamaanabasyarummislukumyuhailayyaannamailahukumilahuwwahidunfamankanayarjuliqaarabbihifalyamalamalansalihawwalayusyrikbiibadatirabbihiahadanqulinnamaanabasharunmithlukumyoohailayyaannamailahukumilahunwahidunfamankanayarjooliqaarabbihifalyaaamalaaamalansalihanwalayushrikbiaaibadatirabbihiahada
Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.
Kāf hā yā ‘aīn ṣād.
كهيعص
kaf, ha, ya, ʿayn, sad.
kafhayaainsadkafhayaaaaynsad
[This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
Żikru raḥmati rabbika ‘abdahū zakariyyā.
ذكر رحمت ربك عبده زكريا
[this is] a mention of the mercy of your lord to his servant zechariah
zikrurahmatirabbikaabdahuzakariyyathikrurahmatirabbikaaaabdahuzakariyya
When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
Iż nādā rabbahū nidā'an khafiyyā(n).
اذ نادي ربه نداء خفيا
when he called to his lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
iznadarabbahunidaankhafiyyanithnadarabbahunidaankhafiyya
He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
Qāla rabbi innī wahanal-‘aẓmu minnī wasyta‘alar-ra'su syaibaw wa lam akum bidu‘ā'ika rabbi syaqiyyā(n).
قال رب اني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الراس شيبا ولم اكن بدعائك رب شقيا
he said, "my lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have i been in my supplication to you, my lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
qalarabbiinniwahanalazmuminniwasytaalarrasusyaibawwalamakumbiduaikarabbisyaqiyyanqalarabbiinneewahanaalaaathmuminneewashtaaaalaarrasushaybanwalamakunbiduaaaikarabbishaqiyya
And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
Wa innī khiftul-mawāliya miw warā'ī wa kānatimra'atī ‘āqiran fahab lī mil ladunka waliyyā(n).
واني خفت المولي من وراءي وكانت امراتي عاقرا فهب لي من لدنك وليا
and indeed, i fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from yourself an heir
wainnikhiftulmawaliyamiwwaraiwakanatimraatiaqiranfahablimilladunkawaliyyanwainneekhiftualmawaliyaminwaraeewakanatiimraateeaaaqiranfahableeminladunkawaliyya
Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
Yariṡunī wa yariṡu min āli ya‘qūba waj‘alhu rabbi raḍiyyā(n).
يرثني ويرث من ءال يعقوب  واجعله رب رضيا
who will inherit me and inherit from the family of jacob. and make him, my lord, pleasing [to you]."
yarisuniwayarisuminaliyaqubawajalhurabbiradiyyanyarithuneewayarithuminaliyaaaqoobawajaaalhurabbiradiyya
[He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
Yā zakariyyā innā nubasysyiruka bigulāminismuhū yaḥyā, lam naj‘al lahū min qablu samiyyā(n).
يزكريا انا نبشرك بغلم اسمه يحيي لم نجعل له من قبل سميا
[he was told], "o zechariah, indeed we give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be john. we have not assigned to any before [this] name."
yazakariyyainnanubasysyirukabigulaminismuhuyahyalamnajallahuminqablusamiyyanyazakariyyainnanubashshirukabighulaminismuhuyahyalamnajaaallahuminqablusamiyya
He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa kānatimra'atī ‘āqiraw wa qad balagtu minal-kibari ‘itiyyā(n).
قال رب اني يكون لي غلم وكانت امراتي عاقرا وقد بلغت من الكبر عتيا
he said, "my lord, how will i have a boy when my wife has been barren and i have reached extreme old age?"
qalarabbiannayakunuligulamuwwakanatimraatiaqirawwaqadbalagtuminalkibariitiyyanqalarabbiannayakoonuleeghulamunwakanatiimraateeaaaqiranwaqadbalaghtuminaalkibariaaitiyya
[An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"
Qāla każālik(a), qāla rabbuka huwa ‘alayya hayyinuw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku syai'ā(n).
قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين وقد خلقتك من قبل ولم تك شيا
[an angel] said, "thus [it will be]; your lord says, 'it is easy for me, for i created you before, while you were nothing.'"
qalakazalikaqalarabbukahuwaalayyahayyinuwwaqadkhalaqtukaminqabluwalamtakusyaianqalakathalikaqalarabbukahuwaaaalayyahayyinunwaqadkhalaqtukaminqabluwalamtakushaya
[Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
Qāla rabbij‘al lī āyah(tan), qāla āyatuka allā tukalliman-nāsa  ṡalāṡa layālin sawiyyā(n).
قال رب اجعل لي ءايه  قال ءايتك الا تكلم الناس ثلث ليال سويا
[zechariah] said, "my lord, make for me a sign." he said, "your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
qalarabbijalliayahtanqalaayatukaallatukallimannasasalasalayalinsawiyyanqalarabbiijaaalleeayatanqalaayatukaallatukallimaannasathalathalayalinsawiyya
So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
Fa kharaja ‘alā qaumihī minal-miḥrābi fa auḥā ilaihim an sabbiḥū bukrataw wa ‘asyiyyā(n).
فخرج علي قومه من المحراب فاوحي اليهم ان سبحوا بكره وعشيا
so he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [allah] in the morning and afternoon.
fakharajaalaqaumihiminalmihrabifaauhailaihimansabbihubukratawwaasyiyyanfakharajaaaalaqawmihiminaalmihrabifaawhailayhimansabbihoobukratanwaaaashiyya
[Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
Yā yaḥyā khużil-kitāba biquwwah(tin), wa ātaināhul-ḥukma ṣabiyyā(n).
ييحيي خذ الكتب بقوه  وءاتينه الحكم صبيا
[allah said], "o john, take the scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." and we gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
yayahyakhuzilkitababiquwwahtinwaatainahulhukmasabiyyanyayahyakhuthialkitababiquwwatinwaataynahualhukmasabiyya
And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
Wa ḥanānam mil ladunnā wa zakāh(tan), wa kāna taqiyyā(n).
وحنانا من لدنا وزكوه  وكان تقيا
and affection from us and purity, and he was fearing of allah
wahananammilladunnawazakahtanwakanataqiyyanwahanananminladunnawazakatanwakanataqiyya
And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
Wa barram biwālidaihi wa lam yakun jabbāran ‘aṣiyyā(n).
وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا
and dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
wabarrambiwalidaihiwalamyakunjabbaranasiyyanwabarranbiwalidayhiwalamyakunjabbaranaaasiyya
And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
Wa salāmun ‘alaihi yauma wulida wa yauma yamūtu wa yauma yub‘aṡu ḥayyā(n).
وسلم عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا
and peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
wasalamunalaihiyaumawulidawayaumayamutuwayaumayubasuhayyanwasalamunaaalayhiyawmawulidawayawmayamootuwayawmayubaaathuhayya
And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
Ważkur fil-kitābi maryam(a), iżintabażat min ahlihā makānan syarqiyyā(n).
واذكر في الكتب مريم اذ انتبذت من اهلها مكانا شرقيا
and mention, [o muhammad], in the book [the story of] mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
wazkurfilkitabimaryamaizintabazatminahlihamakanansyarqiyyanwathkurfeealkitabimaryamaithiintabathatminahlihamakanansharqiyya
And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
Fattakhażat min dūnihim ḥijābā(n), fa arsalnā ilaihā rūḥanā fa tamaṡṡala lahā basyaran sawiyyā(n).
فاتخذت من دونهم حجابا فارسلنا اليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا
and she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. then we sent to her our angel [i.e., gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
fattakhazatmindunihimhijabanfaarsalnailaiharuhanafatamassalalahabasyaransawiyyanfattakhathatmindoonihimhijabanfaarsalnailayharoohanafatamaththalalahabasharansawiyya
She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
Qālat innī a‘ūżu bir-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyā(n).
قالت اني اعوذ بالرحمن منك ان كنت تقيا
she said, "indeed, i seek refuge in the most merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of allah."
qalatinniauzubirrahmaniminkainkuntataqiyyanqalatinneeaaaoothubirrahmaniminkainkuntataqiyya
He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
Qāla innamā ana rasūlu rabbik(a), li'ahaba laki gulāman zakiyyā(n).
قال انما انا رسول ربك لاهب لك غلما زكيا
he said, "i am only the messenger of your lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
qalainnamaanarasulurabbikaliahabalakigulamanzakiyyanqalainnamaanarasoolurabbikiliahabalakighulamanzakiyya
She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
Qālat annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa lam yamsasnī basyaruw wa lam aku bagiyyā(n).
قالت اني يكون لي غلم ولم يمسسني بشر ولم اك بغيا
she said, "how can i have a boy while no man has touched me and i have not been unchaste?"
qalatannayakunuligulamuwwalamyamsasnibasyaruwwalamakubagiyyanqalatannayakoonuleeghulamunwalamyamsasneebasharunwalamakubaghiyya
He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
Qāla każālik(a), qāla rabbuka huwa ‘alayya hayyin(un), wa linaj‘alahū āyatal lin-nāsi wa raḥmatam minnā, wa kāna amram maqḍiyyā(n).
قال كذلك قال ربك هو علي هين  ولنجعله ءايه للناس ورحمه منا  وكان امرا مقضيا
he said, "thus [it will be]; your lord says, 'it is easy for me, and we will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from us. and it is a matter [already] decreed.'"

qalakazalikaqalarabbukahuwaalayyahayyinunwalinajalahuayatallinnasiwarahmatamminnawakanaamrammaqdiyyanqalakathalikiqalarabbukihuwaaaalayyahayyinunwalinajaaalahuayatanlinnasiwarahmatanminnawakanaamranmaqdiyya
So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
Fa ḥamalathu fantabażat bihī makānan qaṣiyyā(n).
فحملته فانتبذت به مكانا قصيا
so she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
fahamalathufantabazatbihimakananqasiyyanfahamalathufantabathatbihimakananqasiyya
And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
Fa ajā'ahal-makhāḍu ilā jiz‘in nakhlah(ti), qālat yā laitanī mittu qabla hāżā wa kuntu nas-yam mansiyyā(n).
فاجاءها المخاض الي جذع النخله قالت يليتني مت قبل هذا وكنت نسيا منسيا
and the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. she said, "oh, i wish i had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
faajaahalmakhaduilajizinnakhlahtiqalatyalaitanimittuqablahazawakuntunasyammansiyyanfaajaahaalmakhaduilajithaaiannakhlatiqalatyalaytaneemittuqablahathawakuntunasyanmansiyya
But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
Fa nādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad ja‘ala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyā(n).
فناديها من تحتها الا تحزني قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا
but he called her from below her, "do not grieve; your lord has provided beneath you a stream.
fanadahamintahtihaallatahzaniqadjaalarabbukitahtakisariyyanfanadahamintahtihaallatahzaneeqadjaaaalarabbukitahtakisariyya
And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
Wa huzzī ilaiki bijiz‘in-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ‘alaiki ruṭaban janiyyā(n).
وهزي اليك بجذع النخله تسقط عليك رطبا جنيا
and shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
wahuzziilaikibijizinnakhlatitusaqitalaikirutabanjaniyyanwahuzzeeilaykibijithaaiannakhlatitusaqitaaalaykirutabanjaniyya
So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
Fa kulī wasyrabī wa qarrī ‘ainā(n), fa immā tarayinna minal-basyari aḥadā(n), fa qūlī innī nażartu lir-raḥmāni ṣauman falan ukallimal-yauma insiyyā(n).
فكلي واشربي وقري عينا  فاما ترين من البشر احدا فقولي اني نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن اكلم اليوم انسيا
so eat and drink and be contented. and if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'indeed, i have vowed to the most merciful abstention, so i will not speak today to [any] man.'"

fakuliwasyrabiwaqarriainanfaimmatarayinnaminalbasyariahadanfaquliinninazartulirrahmanisaumanfalanukallimalyaumainsiyyanfakuleewashrabeewaqarreeaaaynanfaimmatarayinnaminaalbashariahadanfaqooleeinneenathartulirrahmanisawmanfalanokallimaalyawmainsiyya
Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
Fa atat bihī qaumahā taḥmiluh(ū), qālū yā maryamu laqad ji'ti syai'an fariyyā(n).
فاتت به قومها تحمله  قالوا يمريم لقد جئت شيا فريا
then she brought him to her people, carrying him. they said, "o mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
faatatbihiqaumahatahmiluhuqaluyamaryamulaqadjitisyaianfariyyanfaatatbihiqawmahatahmiluhuqalooyamaryamulaqadjitishayanfariyya
O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
Yā ukhta hārūna kāna abūkimra'a sau'iw wa mā kānat ummuki bagiyyā(n).
ياخت هرون ما كان ابوك امرا سوء وما كانت امك بغيا
o sister [i.e., descendant] of aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
yaukhtaharunakanaabukimraasauiwwamakanatummukibagiyyanyaokhtaharoonamakanaabookiimraasawinwamakanatommukibaghiyya
So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
Fa asyārat ilaīh(i), qālū kaifa nukallimu man kāna fil-mahdi ṣabiyyā(n).
فاشارت اليه  قالوا كيف نكلم من كان في المهد صبيا
so she pointed to him. they said, "how can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
faasyaratilaihiqalukaifanukallimumankanafilmahdisabiyyanfaasharatilayhiqalookayfanukallimumankanafeealmahdisabiyya
[Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
Qāla innī ‘abdullāh(i), ātāniyal-kitāba wa ja‘alanī nabiyyā(n).
قال اني عبد الله ءاتيني الكتب وجعلني نبيا
[jesus] said, "indeed, i am the servant of allah. he has given me the scripture and made me a prophet.
qalainniabdullahiataniyalkitabawajaalaninabiyyanqalainneeaaabduallahiataniyaalkitabawajaaaalaneenabiyya
And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
Wa ja‘alanī mubārakan aina mā kunt(u), wa auṣānī biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāti mā dumtu ḥayyā(n).
وجعلني مباركا اين ما كنت واوصني بالصلوه والزكوه ما دمت حيا
and he has made me blessed wherever i am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as i remain alive
wajaalanimubarakanainamakuntuwaausanibissalatiwazzakatimadumtuhayyanwajaaaalaneemubarakanaynamakuntuwaawsaneebissalatiwazzakatimadumtuhayya
And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
Wa barram biwālidatī wa lam yaj‘alnī jabbāran syaqiyyā(n).
وبرا بولدتي ولم يجعلني جبارا شقيا
and [made me] dutiful to my mother, and he has not made me a wretched tyrant.
wabarrambiwalidatiwalamyajalnijabbaransyaqiyyanwabarranbiwalidateewalamyajaaalneejabbaranshaqiyya
And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
Was-salāmu ‘alayya yauma wulittu wa yauma amūtu wa yauma ub‘aṡu ḥayyā(n).
والسلم علي يوم ولدت ويوم اموت ويوم ابعث حيا
and peace is on me the day i was born and the day i will die and the day i am raised alive."
wassalamualayyayaumawulittuwayaumaamutuwayaumaubasuhayyanwassalamuaaalayyayawmawulidtuwayawmaamootuwayawmaobaaathuhayya
That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
Żālika ‘īsabnu maryam(a), qaulal-ḥaqqil-lażī fīhi yamtarūn(a).
ذلك عيسي ابن مريم  قول الحق الذي فيه يمترون
that is jesus, the son of mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
zalikaisabnumaryamaqaulalhaqqillazifihiyamtarunathalikaaaeesaibnumaryamaqawlaalhaqqiallatheefeehiyamtaroon
It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
Mā kāna lillāhi ay yattakhiża miw waladin subḥānah(ū), iżā qaḍā amran fa innamā yaqūlu lahū kun fa yakūn(u).
ما كان لله ان يتخذ من ولد  سبحنه  اذا قضي امرا فانما يقول له كن فيكون
it is not [befitting] for allah to take a son; exalted is he! when he decrees an affair, he only says to it, "be," and it is.
makanalillahiayyattakhizamiwwaladinsubhanahuizaqadaamranfainnamayaqululahukunfayakunumakanalillahianyattakhithaminwaladinsubhanahuithaqadaamranfainnamayaqoolulahukunfayakoon
[Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
Wa innallāha rabbī wa rabbukum fa‘budūh(u), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
وان الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه  هذا صرط مستقيم
[jesus said], "and indeed, allah is my lord and your lord, so worship him. that is a straight path."
wainnallaharabbiwarabbukumfabuduhuhazasiratummustaqimunwainnaallaharabbeewarabbukumfaaabudoohuhathasiratunmustaqeem
Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
Fakhtalafal-aḥzābu mim bainihim, fa wailul lil-lażīna kafarū mim masyhadi yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
فاختلف الاحزاب من بينهم  فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
then the factions differed [concerning jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous day.
fakhtalafalahzabumimbainihimfawailullillazinakafarumimmasyhadiyauminaziminfakhtalafaalahzabuminbaynihimfawaylunlillatheenakafaroominmashhadiyawminaaatheem
How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
Asmi‘ bihim wa abṣir, yauma ya'tūnanā lākiniẓ-ẓālimūnal-yauma fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
اسمع بهم وابصر يوم ياتوننا  لكن الظلمون اليوم في ضلل مبين
how [clearly] they will hear and see the day they come to us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
asmibihimwaabsiryaumayatunanalakinizzalimunalyaumafidalalimmubininasmiaabihimwaabsiryawmayatoonanalakiniaththalimoonaalyawmafeedalalinmubeen
And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
Wa anżirhum yaumal-ḥasrati  iż quḍiyal-amr(u), wa hum fī gaflatiw wa hum lā yu'minūn(a).
وانذرهم يوم الحسره اذ قضي الامر وهم في غفله وهم لا يؤمنون
and warn them, [o muhammad], of the day of regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
waanzirhumyaumalhasratiizqudiyalamruwahumfigaflatiwwahumlayuminunawaanthirhumyawmaalhasratiithqudiyaalamruwahumfeeghaflatinwahumlayuminoon
Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
Innā naḥnu nariṡul-arḍa wa man ‘alaihā wa ilainā yurja‘ūn(a).
انا نحن نرث الارض ومن عليها والينا يرجعون
indeed, it is we who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to us they will be returned.
innanahnunarisulardawamanalaihawailainayurjaunainnanahnunarithualardawamanaaalayhawailaynayurjaaaoon
And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
Ważkur fil-kitābi ibrāhīm(a), innahū kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā(n).
واذكر في الكتب ابرهيم  انه كان صديقا نبيا
and mention in the book [the story of] abraham. indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
wazkurfilkitabiibrahimainnahukanasiddiqannabiyyanwathkurfeealkitabiibraheemainnahukanasiddeeqannabiyya
[Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
Iż qāla li'abīhi yā abati lima ta‘budu mā lā yasma‘u wa lā yubṣiru wa lā yugnī ‘anka syai'ā(n).
اذ قال لابيه يابت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغني عنك شيا
[mention] when he said to his father, "o my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
izqalaliabihiyaabatilimatabudumalayasmauwalayubsiruwalayugniankasyaianithqalaliabeehiyaabatilimataaabudumalayasmaaauwalayubsiruwalayughneeaaankashaya
O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
Yā abati innī qad jā'anī minal-‘ilmi mā lam ya'tika fattabi‘nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyā(n).
يابت اني قد جاءني من العلم ما لم ياتك فاتبعني اهدك صرطا سويا
o my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; i will guide you to an even path.
yaabatiinniqadjaaniminalilmimalamyatikafattabiniahdikasiratansawiyyanyaabatiinneeqadjaaneeminaalaailmimalamyatikafattabiaaneeahdikasiratansawiyya
O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
Yā abati lā ta‘budisy-syaiṭān(a), innasy-syaiṭāna kāna lir-raḥmāni ‘aṣiyyā(n).
يابت لا تعبد الشيطن  ان الشيطن كان للرحمن عصيا
o my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] satan. indeed satan has ever been, to the most merciful, disobedient.
yaabatilatabudisysyaitanainnasysyaitanakanalirrahmaniasiyyanyaabatilataaabudiashshaytanainnaashshaytanakanalirrahmaniaaasiyya
O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
Yā abati innī akhāfu ay yamassaka ‘ażābum minar-raḥmāni fa takūna lisy-syaiṭāni waliyyā(n).
يابت اني اخاف ان يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطن وليا
o my father, indeed i fear that there will touch you a punishment from the most merciful so you would be to satan a companion [in hellfire]."
yaabatiinniakhafuayyamassakaazabumminarrahmanifatakunalisysyaitaniwaliyyanyaabatiinneeakhafuanyamassakaaaathabunminaarrahmanifatakoonalishshyataniwaliyya
[His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
Qāla arāgibun anta ‘an ālihatī yā ibrāhīm(u), la'illam tantahi la'arjumannaka wahjurnī maliyyā(n).
قال اراغب انت عن ءالهتي يابرهيم  لئن لم تنته لارجمنك  واهجرني مليا
[his father] said, "have you no desire for my gods, o abraham? if you do not desist, i will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
qalaaragibunantaanalihatiyaibrahimulaillamtantahilaarjumannakawahjurnimaliyyanqalaaraghibunantaaaanalihateeyaibraheemulainlamtantahilaarjumannakawahjurneemaliyya
[Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
Qāla salāmun ‘alaik(a), sa'astagfiru laka rabbī, innahū kāna bī ḥafiyyā(n).
قال سلم عليك  ساستغفر لك ربي  انه كان بي حفيا
[abraham] said, "peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. i will ask forgiveness for you of my lord. indeed, he is ever gracious to me.
qalasalamunalaikasaastagfirulakarabbiinnahukanabihafiyyanqalasalamunaaalaykasaastaghfirulakarabbeeinnahukanabeehafiyya
And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
Wa a‘tazilukum wa mā tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi wa ad‘ū rabbī, ‘asā allā akūna bidu‘ā'i rabbī syaqiyyā(n).
واعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون الله وادعوا ربي عسي الا اكون بدعاء ربي شقيا
and i will leave you and those you invoke other than allah and will invoke my lord. i expect that i will not be in invocation to my lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
waatazilukumwamatadunamindunillahiwaadurabbiasaallaakunabiduairabbisyaqiyyanwaaaatazilukumwamatadaaoonamindooniallahiwaadaaoorabbeeaaasaallaakoonabiduaaairabbeeshaqiyya
So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
Falamma‘tazalahum wa mā ya‘budūna min dūnillāh(i), wahabnā lahū isḥāqa wa ya‘qūb(a),  wa kullan ja‘alnā nabiyyā(n).
فلما اعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون الله وهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب  وكلا جعلنا نبيا
so when he had left them and those they worshipped other than allah, we gave him isaac and jacob, and each [of them] we made a prophet.
falammatazalahumwamayabudunamindunillahiwahabnalahuishaqawayaqubawakullanjaalnanabiyyanfalammaiaatazalahumwamayaaabudoonamindooniallahiwahabnalahuishaqawayaaaqoobawakullanjaaaalnanabiyya
And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
Wa wahabnā lahum mir raḥmatinā wa ja‘alnā lahum lisāna ṣidqin ‘aliyyā(n).
ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا
and we gave them of our mercy, and we made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
wawahabnalahummirrahmatinawajaalnalahumlisanasidqinaliyyanwawahabnalahumminrahmatinawajaaaalnalahumlisanasidqinaaaliyya
And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
Ważkur  fil-kitābi mūsā, innahū kāna mukhlaṣaw wa kāna rasūlan nabiyyā(n).
واذكر في الكتب موسي  انه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا
and mention in the book, moses. indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
wazkurfilkitabimusainnahukanamukhlasawwakanarasulannabiyyanwathkurfeealkitabimoosainnahukanamukhlasanwakanarasoolannabiyya
And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
Wa nādaināhu min jānibiṭ-ṭūril-aimani wa qarrabnāhu najiyyā(n).
وندينه من جانب الطور الايمن وقربنه نجيا
and we called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
wanadainahuminjanibitturilaimaniwaqarrabnahunajiyyanwanadaynahuminjanibiattoorialaymaniwaqarrabnahunajiyya
And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
Wa wahabnā lahū mir raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyā(n).
ووهبنا له من رحمتنا اخاه هرون نبيا
and we gave him out of our mercy his brother aaron as a prophet.
wawahabnalahumirrahmatinaakhahuharunanabiyyanwawahabnalahuminrahmatinaakhahuharoonanabiyya
And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
Ważkur  fil-kitābi ismā‘īl(a), innahū kāna ṣādiqal-wa‘di wa kāna rasūlan nabiyyā(n).
واذكر في الكتب اسمعيل  انه كان صادق الوعد وكان رسولا نبيا
and mention in the book, ishmael. indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
wazkurfilkitabiismailainnahukanasadiqalwadiwakanarasulannabiyyanwathkurfeealkitabiismaaaeelainnahukanasadiqaalwaaadiwakanarasoolannabiyya
And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
Wa kāna ya'muru ahlahū biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāh(ti), wa kāna ‘inda rabbihī marḍiyyā(n).
وكان يامر اهله بالصلوه والزكوه وكان عند ربه مرضيا
and he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by him].
wakanayamuruahlahubissalatiwazzakahtiwakanaindarabbihimardiyyanwakanayamuruahlahubissalatiwazzakatiwakanaaaindarabbihimardiyya
And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
Ważkur  fil-kitābi idrīs(a), innahū kāna ṣādiqan nabiyyā(n).
واذكر في الكتب ادريس  انه كان صديقا نبيا
and mention in the book, idrees. indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
wazkurfilkitabiidrisainnahukanasadiqannabiyyanwathkurfeealkitabiidreesainnahukanasiddeeqannabiyya
And We raised him to a high station.
Wa rafa‘nāhu makānan ‘aliyyā(n).
ورفعنه مكانا عليا
and we raised him to a high station.
warafanahumakananaliyyanwarafaaanahumakananaaaliyya

Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

Ulā'ikal-lażīna an‘amallāhu ‘alaihim minan-nabiyyīna min żurriyyati ādama wa mimman ḥamalnā ma‘a nūḥ(in), wa min żurriyyati ibrāhīma wa isrā'īl(a), wa mimman hadainā wajtabainā, iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātur-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadaw wa bukiyyā(n).
اولئك الذين انعم الله عليهم من النبين من ذريه ءادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذريه ابرهيم واسرءيل وممن هدينا واجتبينا  اذا تتلي عليهم ءايت الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا

those were the ones upon whom allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of adam and of those we carried [in the ship] with noah, and of the descendants of abraham and israel [i.e., jacob], and of those whom we guided and chose. when the verses of the most merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.


But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
Fa khalafa mim ba‘dihim khalfun aḍā‘uṣ-ṣalāta wattaba‘usy-syahawāti fa saufa yalqauna gayyā(n).
فخلف من بعدهم خلف اضاعوا الصلوه واتبعوا الشهوت  فسوف يلقون غيا
but there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
fakhalafamimbadihimkhalfunadaussalatawattabausysyahawatifasaufayalqaunagayyanfakhalafaminbaaadihimkhalfunadaaaooassalatawattabaaaooashshahawatifasawfayalqawnaghayya
Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
Illā man tāba wa āmana wa ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa ulā'ika yadkhulūnal-jannata wa lā yuẓlamūna syai'ā(n).
الا من تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا فاولئك يدخلون الجنه ولا يظلمون شيا
except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter paradise and will not be wronged at all.
illamantabawaamanawaamilasalihanfaulaikayadkhulunaljannatawalayuzlamunasyaianillamantabawaamanawaaaamilasalihanfaolaikayadkhuloonaaljannatawalayuthlamoonashaya
[Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.
Jannāti ‘adninil-latī wa‘adar-raḥmānu ‘ibādahū bil-gaib(i), innahū kāna wa‘duhū ma'tiyyā(n).
جنت عدن التي وعد الرحمن عباده بالغيب  انه كان وعده ماتيا
[therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the most merciful has promised his servants in the unseen. indeed, his promise has ever been eminent.
jannatiadninillatiwaadarrahmanuibadahubilgaibiinnahukanawaduhumatiyyanjannatiaaadninallateewaaaadaarrahmanuaaibadahubighaybiinnahukanawaaaduhumatiyya
They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
Lā yasma‘ūna fīhā lagwan illā salāmā(n), wa lahum rizquhum fīhā bukrataw wa ‘asyiyyā(n).
لا يسمعون فيها لغوا الا سلما  ولهم رزقهم فيها بكره وعشيا
they will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
layasmaunafihalagwanillasalamanwalahumrizquhumfihabukratawwaasyiyyanlayasmaaaoonafeehalaghwanillasalamanwalahumrizquhumfeehabukratanwaaaashiyya
That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
Tilkal-jannatul-latī nūriṡu min ‘ibādinā man kāna taqiyyā(n).
تلك الجنه التي نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا
that is paradise, which we give as inheritance to those of our servants who were fearing of allah.
tilkaljannatullatinurisuminibadinamankanataqiyyantilkaaljannatuallateenoorithuminaaibadinamankanataqiyya
[Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
Wa mā natanazzalu illā bi'amri rabbik(a), lahū mā baina aidīnā wa mā khalfanā wa mā baina żālika wa mā kāna rabbuka nasiyyā(n).
وما نتنزل الا بامر ربك  له ما بين ايدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك  وما كان ربك نسيا
[gabriel said], "and we [angels] descend not except by the order of your lord. to him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. and never is your lord forgetful -
wamanatanazzaluillabiamrirabbikalahumabainaaidinawamakhalfanawamabainazalikawamakanarabbukanasiyyanwamanatanazzaluillabiamrirabbikalahumabaynaaydeenawamakhalfanawamabaynathalikawamakanarabbukanasiyya
Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā fa‘budhu waṣṭabir li‘ibādatih(ī), hal ta‘lamu lahū samiyyā(n).
رب السموت والارض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبدته  هل تعلم له سميا
lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship him and have patience for his worship. do you know of any similarity to him?"
rabbussamawatiwalardiwamabainahumafabudhuwastabirliibadatihihaltalamulahusamiyyanrabbuassamawatiwalardiwamabaynahumafaaabudhuwastabirliaaibadatihihaltaaalamulahusamiyya
And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
Wa yaqūlul-insānu a'iżā mā mittu lasaufa ukhraju ḥayyā(n).
ويقول الانسن اءذا ما مت لسوف اخرج حيا
and man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "when i have died, am i going to be brought forth alive?"
wayaqululinsanuaizamamittulasaufaukhrajuhayyanwayaqoolualinsanuaithamamittulasawfaokhrajuhayya
Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
Awalā yażkurul-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu wa lam yaku syai'ā(n).
اولا يذكر الانسن انا خلقنه من قبل ولم يك شيا
does man not remember that we created him before, while he was nothing?
awalayazkurulinsanuannakhalaqnahuminqabluwalamyakusyaianawalayathkurualinsanuannakhalaqnahuminqabluwalamyakushaya
So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
Fa wa rabbika lanaḥsyurannahum wasy-syayāṭīna ṡumma lanuḥḍirannahum ḥaula jahannama jiṡiyyā(n).
فوربك لنحشرنهم والشيطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا
so by your lord, we will surely gather them and the devils; then we will bring them to be present around hell upon their knees.
fawarabbikalanahsyurannahumwasysyayatinasummalanuhdirannahumhaulajahannamajisiyyanfawarabbikalanahshurannahumwashshayateenathummalanuhdirannahumhawlajahannamajithiyya
Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
Ṡumma lananzi‘anna min kulli syī‘atin ayyuhum asyaddu ‘alar-raḥmāni ‘itiyyā(n).
ثم لننزعن من كل شيعه ايهم اشد علي الرحمن عتيا
then we will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the most merciful in insolence.
summalananziannaminkullisyiatinayyuhumasyaddualarrahmaniitiyyanthummalananziaaannaminkullisheeaaatinayyuhumashadduaaalaarrahmaniaaitiyya
Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
Ṡumma lanaḥnu a‘lamu bil-lażīna  hum aulā bihā ṣiliyyā(n).
ثم لنحن اعلم بالذين هم اولي بها صليا
then, surely it is we who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
summalanahnualamubillazinahumaulabihasiliyyanthummalanahnuaaalamubillatheenahumawlabihasiliyya
And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
Wa im minkum illā wāriduhā, kāna ‘alā rabbika ḥatmam maqḍiyyā(n).
وان منكم الا واردها  كان علي ربك حتما مقضيا
and there is none of you except he will come to it. this is upon your lord an inevitability decreed.
waimminkumillawariduhakanaalarabbikahatmammaqdiyyanwainminkumillawariduhakanaaaalarabbikahatmanmaqdiyya
Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
Ṡumma nunajjil-lażīnattaqau wa nażaruẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jiṡiyyā(n).
ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا ونذر الظلمين فيها جثيا
then we will save those who feared allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
summanunajjillazinattaqauwanazaruzzaliminafihajisiyyanthummanunajjeeallatheenaittaqawwanatharuaththalimeenafeehajithiyya
And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātin qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-lażīna āmanū, ayyul-farīqaini khairum maqāmaw wa aḥsanu nadiyyā(n).
واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا اي الفريقين خير مقاما واحسن نديا
and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

waizatutlaalaihimayatunabayyinatinqalallazinakafarulillazinaamanuayyulfariqainikhairummaqamawwaahsanunadiyyanwaithatutlaaaalayhimayatunabayyinatinqalaallatheenakafaroolillatheenaamanooayyualfareeqaynikhayrunmaqamanwaahsanunadiyya
And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
Wa kam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu aṡāṡaw wa ri'yā(n).
وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم احسن اثثا ورءيا
and how many a generation have we destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
wakamahlaknaqablahumminqarninhumahsanuasasawwariyanwakamahlaknaqablahumminqarninhumahsanuathathanwariya

Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
Qul man kāna fiḍ-ḍalālati falyamdud lahur-raḥmānu maddā(n), ḥattā iżā ra'au mā yū‘adūna immal-‘ażāba wa immas-sā‘ata fa saya‘lamūna man huwa syarrum makānaw wa aḍ‘afu jundā(n).
قل من كان في الضلله فليمدد له الرحمن مدا  حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون اما العذاب واما الساعه فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا واضعف جندا

say, "whoever is in error - let the most merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

qulmankanafiddalalatifalyamdudlahurrahmanumaddanhattaizaraaumayuadunaimmalazabawaimmassaatafasayalamunamanhuwasyarrummakanawwaadafujundanqulmankanafeeaddalalatifalyamdudlahuarrahmanumaddanhattaitharaawmayooaaadoonaimmaalaaathabawaimmaassaaaatafasayaaalamoonamanhuwasharrunmakananwaadaaafujunda
And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
Wa yazīdullāhul-lażīnahtadau hudā(n), wal-bāqiyātuṣ-ṣāliḥātu khairun ‘inda rabbika ṡawābaw wa khairum maraddā(n).
ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدي  والبقيت الصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
and allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your lord for reward and better for recourse.
wayazidullahullazinahtadauhudanwalbaqiyatussalihatukhairunindarabbikasawabawwakhairummaraddanwayazeeduallahuallatheenaihtadawhudanwalbaqiyatuassalihatukhayrunaaindarabbikathawabanwakhayrunmaradda
Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
Afa ra'aital-lażī kafara bi'āyātinā wa qāla la'ūtayanna mālaw wa waladā(n).
افرءيت الذي كفر بايتنا وقال لاوتين مالا وولدا
then, have you seen he who disbelieved in our verses and said, "i will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
afaraaitallazikafarabiayatinawaqalalautayannamalawwawaladanafaraaytaallatheekafarabiayatinawaqalalaootayannamalanwawalada
Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
Aṭṭala‘al-gaiba amittakhaża ‘indar-raḥmāni ‘ahdā(n).
اطلع الغيب ام اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the most merciful a promise?
attalaalgaibaamittakhazaindarrahmaniahdanattalaaaaalghaybaamiittakhathaaaindaarrahmaniaaahda
No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
Kallā, sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wa namuddu lahū minal-‘ażābi maddā(n).
كلا  سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من العذاب مدا
no! we will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
kallasanaktubumayaquluwanamuddulahuminalazabimaddankallasanaktubumayaqooluwanamuddulahuminaalaaathabimadda
And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
Wa nariṡuhū mā yaqūlu wa ya'tīnā fardā(n).
ونرثه ما يقول وياتينا فردا
and we will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to us alone.
wanarisuhumayaquluwayatinafardanwanarithuhumayaqooluwayateenafarda
And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
Wattakhażū min dūnillāhi ālihatal liyakūnū lahum ‘izzā(n).
واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهه ليكونوا لهم عزا
and they have taken besides allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
wattakhazumindunillahialihatalliyakunulahumizzanwattakhathoomindooniallahialihatanliyakoonoolahumaaizza
No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
Kallā, sayakfurūna bi‘ibādatihim wa yakūnūna ‘alaihim ḍiddā(n).
كلا  سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا
no! they [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the day of judgement].
kallasayakfurunabiibadatihimwayakununaalaihimdiddankallasayakfuroonabiaaibadatihimwayakoonoonaaaalayhimdidda
Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
Alam tara annā arsalnasy-syayāṭīna ‘alal-kāfirīna ta'uzzuhum azzā(n).
الم تر انا ارسلنا الشيطين علي الكفرين تؤزهم ازا
do you not see that we have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
alamtaraannaarsalnasysyayatinaalalkafirinatauzzuhumazzanalamtaraannaarsalnaashshayateenaaaalaalkafireenataozzuhumazza
So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
Falā ta‘jal ‘alaihim, innamā na‘uddu lahum ‘addā(n).
فلا تعجل عليهم  انما نعد لهم عدا
so be not impatient over them. we only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
falatajalalaihiminnamanauddulahumaddanfalataaajalaaalayhiminnamanaaauddulahumaaadda
On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
Yauma naḥsyurul-muttaqīna ilar-raḥmāni wafdā(n).
يوم نحشر المتقين الي الرحمن وفدا
on the day we will gather the righteous to the most merciful as a delegation
yaumanahsyurulmuttaqinailarrahmaniwafdanyawmanahshurualmuttaqeenailaarrahmaniwafda
And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
Wa nasūqul-mujrimīna ilā jahannama wirdā(n).
ونسوق المجرمين الي جهنم وردا
and will drive the criminals to hell in thirst
wanasuqulmujriminailajahannamawirdanwanasooqualmujrimeenailajahannamawirda
None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
Lā yamlikūnasy-syafā‘ata illā manittakhaża ‘indar-raḥmāni ‘ahdā(n).
لا يملكون الشفعه الا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
none will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the most merciful a covenant.
layamlikunasysyafaataillamanittakhazaindarrahmaniahdanlayamlikoonaashshafaaaataillamaniittakhathaaaindaarrahmaniaaahda
And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
Wa qāluttakhażar-raḥmānu waladā(n).
وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا
and they say, "the most merciful has taken [for himself] a son."
waqaluttakhazarrahmanuwaladanwaqalooittakhathaarrahmanuwalada
You have done an atrocious thing.
Laqad ji'tum syai'an iddā(n).
لقد جئتم شيا ادا
you have done an atrocious thing.
laqadjitumsyaianiddanlaqadjitumshayanidda
The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
Takādus-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna  minhu wa tansyaqqul-arḍu wa takhirrul-jibālu haddā(n).
تكاد السموت يتفطرن منه وتنشق الارض وتخر الجبال هدا
the heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
takadussamawatuyatafattarnaminhuwatansyaqqularduwatakhirruljibaluhaddantakaduassamawatuyatafattarnaminhuwatanshaqqualarduwatakhirrualjibaluhadda
That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
An da‘au lir-raḥmāni waladā(n).
ان دعوا للرحمن ولدا
that they attribute to the most merciful a son.
andaaulirrahmaniwaladanandaaaawlirrahmaniwalada
And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
Wa mā yambagī lir-raḥmāni ay yattakhiża waladā(n).
وما ينبغي للرحمن ان يتخذ ولدا
and it is not appropriate for the most merciful that he should take a son.
wamayambagilirrahmaniayyattakhizawaladanwamayanbagheelirrahmanianyattakhithawalada
There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
In kullu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātir-raḥmāni ‘abdā(n).
ان كل من في السموت والارض الا ءاتي الرحمن عبدا
there is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the most merciful as a servant.
inkullumanfissamawatiwalardiillaatirrahmaniabdaninkullumanfeeassamawatiwalardiillaateearrahmaniaaabda
He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
Laqad aḥṣāhum wa ‘addahum ‘addā(n).
لقد احصيهم وعدهم عدا
he has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
laqadahsahumwaaddahumaddanlaqadahsahumwaaaaddahumaaadda
And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
Wa kulluhum ātīhi yaumal-qiyāmati fardā(n).
وكلهم ءاتيه يوم القيمه فردا
and all of them are coming to him on the day of resurrection alone.
wakulluhumatihiyaumalqiyamatifardanwakulluhumateehiyawmaalqiyamatifarda
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
Innal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayaj‘alu lahumur-raḥmānu wuddā(n).
ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا
indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the most merciful will appoint for them affection.
innallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatisayajalulahumurrahmanuwuddaninnaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatisayajaaalulahumuarrahmanuwudda
So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
Fa innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubasysyira bihil-muttaqīna wa tunżira bihī qaumal luddā(n).
فانما يسرنه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا
so, [o muhammad], we have only made it [i.e., the qur’an] easy in your tongue [i.e., the arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
fainnamayassarnahubilisanikalitubasysyirabihilmuttaqinawatunzirabihiqaumalluddanfainnamayassarnahubilisanikalitubashshirabihialmuttaqeenawatunthirabihiqawmanludda
And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
Wa kam ahlaknā qablahum min qarn(in), hal tuḥissu minhum min aḥadin au tasma‘u lahum rikzā(n).
وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من احد او تسمع لهم ركزا
and how many have we destroyed before them of generations? do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
wakamahlaknaqablahumminqarninhaltuhissuminhumminahadinautasmaulahumrikzanwakamahlaknaqablahumminqarninhaltuhissuminhumminahadinawtasmaaaulahumrikza
Ṭā, Hā.
Ṭāhā.
طه
ta, ha.
tahataha
We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed
Mā anzalnā ‘alaikal-qur'āna litasyqā.
ما انزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقي
we have not sent down to you the qur’an that you be distressed
maanzalnaalaikalquranalitasyqamaanzalnaaaalaykaalquranalitashqa
But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -
Illā tażkiratal limay yakhsyā.
الا تذكره لمن يخشي
but only as a reminder for those who fear [allah] -
illatazkiratallimayyakhsyaillatathkiratanlimanyakhsha
A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
Tanzīlam mimman khalaqal-arḍa was-samāwātil-‘ulā.
تنزيلا ممن خلق الارض والسموت العلي
a revelation from he who created the earth and highest heavens,
tanzilammimmankhalaqalardawassamawatilulatanzeelanmimmankhalaqaalardawassamawatialaaula
The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
Ar- raḥmānu ‘alal-‘arsyistawā.
الرحمن علي العرش استوي
the most merciful [who is] above the throne established.
arrahmanualalarsyistawaarrahmanuaaalaalaaarshiistawa
To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍi wa mā bainahumā wa mā taḥtaṡ-ṡarā.
له ما في السموت وما في الارض وما بينهما وما تحت الثري
to him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
lahumafissamawatiwamafilardiwamabainahumawamatahtassaralahumafeeassamawatiwamafeealardiwamabaynahumawamatahtaaththara
And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
Wa in tajhar bil-qauli fa innahū ya‘lamus-sirra wa akhfā.

so high [above all] is allah, the sovereign, the truth. and, [o muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the qur’an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "my lord, increase me in knowledge."

and [mention] when we said to the angels, "prostrate to adam," and they prostrated, except iblees; he refused.

so we said, "o adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. then let him not remove you from paradise so you would suffer.

indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

and do not extend your eyes toward that by which we have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which we test them. and the provision of your lord is better and more enduring.

And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
Wa'mur ahlaka biṣ-ṣalāti waṣṭabir ‘alaihā, lā nas'aluka rizqā(n), naḥnu narzuquk(a), wal-‘āqibatu lit-taqwā.
وامر اهلك بالصلوه واصطبر عليها  لا نسلك رزقا  نحن نرزقك  والعقبه للتقوي
and enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. we ask you not for provision; we provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
wamurahlakabissalatiwastabiralaihalanasalukarizqannahnunarzuqukawalaqibatulittaqwawamurahlakabissalatiwastabiraaalayhalanasalukarizqannahnunarzuqukawalaaaqibatulittaqwa
And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
Wa qālū lau lā ya'tīnā bi'āyatim mir rabbih(ī), awalam ta'tihim bayyinatu mā fiṣ-ṣuḥufil-ūlā.
وقالوا لولا ياتينا بايه من ربه  اولم تاتهم بينه ما في الصحف الاولي
and they say, "why does he not bring us a sign from his lord?" has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
waqalulaulayatinabiayatimmirrabbihiawalamtatihimbayyinatumafissuhufilulawaqaloolawlayateenabiayatinminrabbihiawalamtatihimbayyinatumafeeassuhufialoola

And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
Wa lau annā ahlaknāhum bi‘ażābim min qablihī laqālū rabbanā lau lā arsalta ilainā rasūlan fa nattabi‘a āyātika min qabli an nażilla wa nakhzā.
ولو انا اهلكنهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا ارسلت الينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك من قبل ان نذل ونخزي

and if we had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "our lord, why did you not send to us a messenger so we could have followed your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"

walauannaahlaknahumbiazabimminqablihilaqalurabbanalaulaarsaltailainarasulanfanattabiaayatikaminqabliannazillawanakhzawalawannaahlaknahumbiaaathabinminqablihilaqaloorabbanalawlaarsaltailaynarasoolanfanattabiaaaayatikaminqabliannathillawanakhza
Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
Qul kullum mutarabbiṣun fa tarabbaṣū, fa sata‘lamūna man aṣḥābuṣ-ṣirāṭis-sawiyyi wa manihtadā.
قل كل متربص فتربصوا  فستعلمون من اصحب الصرط السوي ومن اهتدي
say, "each [of us] is waiting; so wait. for you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
qulkullummutarabbisunfatarabbasufasatalamunamanashabussiratissawiyyiwamanihtadaqulkullunmutarabbisunfatarabbasoofasataaalamoonamanashabuassiratiassawiyyiwamaniihtada
[The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
Iqtaraba lin-nāsi ḥisābuhum wa hum fī gaflatim mu‘riḍūn(a).
اقترب للناس حسابهم وهم في غفله معرضون
[the time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
iqtarabalinnasihisabuhumwahumfigaflatimmuridunaiqtarabalinnasihisabuhumwahumfeeghaflatinmuaaridoon
No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
Mā ya'tīhim min żikrim mir rabbihim muḥdaṡin illastama‘ūhu wa hum yal‘abūn(a).
ما ياتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث الا استمعوه وهم يلعبون
no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
mayatihimminzikrimmirrabbihimmuhdasinillastamauhuwahumyalabunamayateehimminthikrinminrabbihimmuhdathinillaistamaaaoohuwahumyalaaaboon

With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
Lāhiyatan qulūbuhum, wa asarrun-najwal-lażīna ẓalamū, hal hāżā illā basyarum miṡlukum, afa ta'tūnas-siḥra wa antum tubṣirūn(a).
لاهيه قلوبهم  واسروا النجوي الذين ظلموا هل هذا الا بشر مثلكم  افتاتون السحر وانتم تبصرون

with their hearts distracted. and those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "is this [prophet] except a human being like you? so would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

lahiyatanqulubuhumwaasarrunnajwallazinazalamuhalhazaillabasyarummislukumafatatunassihrawaantumtubsirunalahiyatanquloobuhumwaasarrooannajwaallatheenathalamoohalhathaillabasharunmithlukumafatatoonaassihrawaantumtubsiroon
He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
Qāla rabbī ya‘lamul-qaula fis-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), wa huwas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).
قال ربي يعلم القول في السماء والارض  وهو السميع العليم
he [the prophet (ﷺ)] said, "my lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and he is the hearing, the knowing."
qalarabbiyalamulqaulafissamaiwalardiwahuwassamiulalimuqalarabbeeyaaalamualqawlafeeassamaiwalardiwahuwaassameeaaualaaaleem

But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
Bal qālū aḍgāṡu aḥlāmim baliftarāhu bal huwa syā‘ir(un), falya'tinā bi'āyatin kamā ursilal-awwalūn(a).
بل قالوا اضغث احلم بل افتريه بل هو شاعر فلياتنا بايه كما ارسل الاولون

but they say, "[the revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. so let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
balqaluadgasuahlamimbaliftarahubalhuwasyairunfalyatinabiayatinkamaursilalawwalunabalqalooadghathuahlaminbaliiftarahubalhuwashaaairunfalyatinabiayatinkamaorsilaalawwaloon
Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
Mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā, afahum yu'minūn(a).
ما ءامنت قبلهم من قريه اهلكنها  افهم يؤمنون
not a [single] city which we destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
maamanatqablahumminqaryatinahlaknahaafahumyuminunamaamanatqablahumminqaryatinahlaknahaafahumyuminoon
And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
Wa mā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilaihim fas'alū ahlaż-żikri in kuntum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
وما ارسلنا قبلك الا رجالا نوحي اليهم  فسلوا اهل الذكر ان كنتم لا تعلمون
and we sent not before you, [o muhammad], except men to whom we revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
wamaarsalnaqablakaillarijalannuhiilaihimfasaluahlazzikriinkuntumlatalamunawamaarsalnaqablakaillarijalannooheeilayhimfasalooahlaaththikriinkuntumlataaalamoon
And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
Wa mā ja‘alnāhum jasadal lā ya'kulūnaṭ-ṭa‘āma wa mā kānū khālidīn(a).
وما جعلنهم جسدا لا ياكلون الطعام وما كانوا خلدين
and we did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
wamajaalnahumjasadallayakulunattaamawamakanukhalidinawamajaaaalnahumjasadanlayakuloonaattaaaamawamakanookhalideen
Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
Ṡumma ṣadaqnāhumul-wa‘da fa anjaināhum wa man nasyā'u wa ahlaknal-musrifīn(a).
ثم صدقنهم الوعد فانجينهم ومن نشاء واهلكنا المسرفين
then we fulfilled for them the promise, and we saved them and whom we willed and destroyed the transgressors.
summasadaqnahumulwadafaanjainahumwamannasyauwaahlaknalmusrifinathummasadaqnahumualwaaadafaanjaynahumwamannashaowaahlaknaalmusrifeen
We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
Laqad anzalnā ilaikum kitāban fīhi żikrukum, afalā ta‘qilūn(a).
لقد انزلنا اليكم كتبا فيه ذكركم  افلا تعقلون
we have certainly sent down to you a book [i.e., the qur’an] in which is your mention. then will you not reason?
laqadanzalnailaikumkitabanfihizikrukumafalataqilunalaqadanzalnailaykumkitabanfeehithikrukumafalataaaqiloon
And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
Wa kam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimataw wa ansya'nā ba‘dahā qauman ākharīn(a).
وكم قصمنا من قريه كانت ظالمه وانشانا بعدها قوما ءاخرين
and how many a city which was unjust have we shattered and produced after it another people.
wakamqasamnaminqaryatinkanatzalimatawwaansyanabadahaqaumanakharinawakamqasamnaminqaryatinkanatthalimatanwaanshanabaaadahaqawmanakhareen
And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
Falammā aḥassū ba'sanā iżā hum minhā yarkuḍūn(a).
فلما احسوا باسنا اذا هم منها يركضون
and when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived our punishment, at once they fled from it.
falammaahassubasanaizahumminhayarkudunafalammaahassoobasanaithahumminhayarkudoon
[Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
Lā tarkuḍū warji‘ū ilā mā utriftum fīhi wa masākinikum la‘allakum tus'alūn(a).
لا تركضوا وارجعوا الي ما اترفتم فيه ومسكنكم لعلكم تسلون
[some angels said], "do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
latarkuduwarjiuilamautriftumfihiwamasakinikumlaallakumtusalunalatarkudoowarjiaaooilamaotriftumfeehiwamasakinikumlaaaallakumtusaloon
They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
Qālū yā wailanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn(a).
قالوا يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
they said, "o woe to us! indeed, we were wrongdoers."
qaluyawailanainnakunnazaliminaqalooyawaylanainnakunnathalimeen
And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
Famā zālat tilka da‘wāhum ḥattā ja‘alnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīn(a).
فما زالت تلك دعويهم حتي جعلنهم حصيدا خمدين
and that declaration of theirs did not cease until we made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
famazalattilkadawahumhattajaalnahumhasidankhamidinafamazalattilkadaaawahumhattajaaaalnahumhaseedankhamideen
And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
Wa mā khalaqnas-samā'a wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā lā‘ibīn(a).
وما خلقنا السماء والارض وما بينهما لعبين
and we did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
wamakhalaqnassamaawalardawamabainahumalaibinawamakhalaqnaassamaawalardawamabaynahumalaaaibeen
Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
Lau aradnā an nattakhiża lahwal lattakhażnāhum mil ladunnā, in kunnā fā‘ilīn(a).
لو اردنا ان نتخذ لهوا لاتخذنه من لدنا ان كنا فعلين
had we intended to take a diversion, we could have taken it from [what is] with us - if [indeed] we were to do so.
lauaradnaannattakhizalahwallattakhaznahummilladunnainkunnafailinalawaradnaannattakhithalahwanlattakhathnahuminladunnainkunnafaaaileen
Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
Bal naqżifu bil-ḥaqqi ‘alal-bāṭili fa yadmaguhū fa iżā huwa zāhiq(un), wa lakumul-wailu mimmā taṣifūn(a).
بل نقذف بالحق علي البطل فيدمغه فاذا هو زاهق  ولكم الويل مما تصفون
rather, we dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. and for you is destruction from that which you describe.
balnaqzifubilhaqqialalbatilifayadmaguhufaizahuwazahiqunwalakumulwailumimmatasifunabalnaqthifubilhaqqiaaalaalbatilifayadmaghuhufaithahuwazahiqunwalakumualwaylumimmatasifoon
To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
Wa lahū man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa man ‘indahū lā yastakbirūna ‘an ‘ibādatihī wa lā yastaḥsirūn(a).
وله من في السموت والارض  ومن عنده لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ولا يستحسرون
to him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. and those near him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from his worship, nor do they tire.
walahumanfissamawatiwalardiwamanindahulayastakbirunaanibadatihiwalayastahsirunawalahumanfeeassamawatiwalardiwamanaaindahulayastakbiroonaaaanaaibadatihiwalayastahsiroon
They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
Yusabbiḥūnal-laila wan-nahāra wa lā yafturūn(a).
يسبحون اليل والنهار لا يفترون
they exalt [him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
yusabbihunallailawannaharawalayafturunayusabbihoonaallaylawannaharalayafturoon
Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
Amittakhażū ālihatam minal-arḍi  hum yunsyirūn(a).
ام اتخذوا ءالهه من الارض هم ينشرون
or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
amittakhazualihatamminalardihumyunsyirunaamiittakhathooalihatanminaalardihumyunshiroon
Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
Lau kāna fīhimā ālihatun illallāhu lafasadatā, fa subḥānallāhi rabbil-‘arsyi ‘ammā yaṣifūn(a).
لو كان فيهما ءالهه الا الله لفسدتا  فسبحن الله رب العرش عما يصفون
had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides allah, they both would have been ruined. so exalted is allah, lord of the throne, above what they describe.
laukanafihimaalihatunillallahulafasadatafasubhanallahirabbilarsyiammayasifunalawkanafeehimaalihatunillaallahulafasadatafasubhanaallahirabbialaaarshiaaammayasifoon
He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
Lā yus'alu ‘ammā yaf‘alu wa hum yus'alūn(a).
لا يسل عما يفعل وهم يسلون
he is not questioned about what he does, but they will be questioned.
layusaluammayafaluwahumyusalunalayusaluaaammayafaaaluwahumyusaloon

Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
Amittakhażū min dūnihī ālihah(tan), qul hātū burhānakum, hāżā żikru mam ma‘iya wa żikru man qablī, bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūnal-ḥaqqa fahum mu‘riḍūn(a).
ام اتخذوا من دونه ءالهه  قل هاتوا برهنكم  هذا ذكر من معي وذكر من قبلي  بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون الحق  فهم معرضون

or have they taken gods besides him? say, [o muhammad], "produce your proof. this [qur’an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." but most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.

amittakhazumindunihialihahtanqulhatuburhanakumhazazikrumammaiyawazikrumanqablibalaksaruhumlayalamunalhaqqafahummuridunaamiittakhathoomindoonihialihatanqulhatooburhanakumhathathikrumanmaaaiyawathikrumanqableebalaktharuhumlayaaalamoonaalhaqqafahummuaaridoon
And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
Wa mā arsalnā min qablika mir rasūlin illā nūḥī ilaihi annahū lā ilāha illā ana fa‘budūn(i).
وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول الا نوحي اليه انه لا اله الا انا فاعبدون
and we sent not before you any messenger except we revealed to him that, "there is no deity except me, so worship me."
wamaarsalnaminqablikamirrasulinillanuhiilaihiannahulailahaillaanafabuduniwamaarsalnaminqablikaminrasoolinillanooheeilayhiannahulailahaillaanafaaabudoon
And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
Wa qāluttakhażar-raḥmānu waladan subḥānah(ū), bal ‘ibādum mukramūn(a).
وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا  سبحنه  بل عباد مكرمون
and they say, "the most merciful has taken a son." exalted is he! rather, they are [but] honored servants.
waqaluttakhazarrahmanuwaladansubhanahubalibadummukramunawaqalooittakhathaarrahmanuwaladansubhanahubalaaibadunmukramoon
They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
Lā yasbiqūnahū bil-qauli wa hum bi'amrihī ya‘malūn(a).
لا يسبقونه بالقول وهم بامره يعملون
they cannot precede him in word, and they act by his command.
layasbiqunahubilqauliwahumbiamrihiyamalunalayasbiqoonahubilqawliwahumbiamrihiyaaamaloon
He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
Ya‘lamū mā baina aidīhim wa mā khalfahum wa lā yasyfa‘ūna illā limanirtaḍā wa hum min khasy-yatihī musyfiqūn(a).
يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون الا لمن ارتضي وهم من خشيته مشفقون
he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom he approves. and they, from fear of him, are apprehensive.
yalamumabainaaidihimwamakhalfahumwalayasyfaunaillalimanirtadawahumminkhasyyatihimusyfiqunayaaalamumabaynaaydeehimwamakhalfahumwalayashfaaaoonaillalimaniirtadawahumminkhashyatihimushfiqoon
And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
Wa may yaqul minhum innī ilāhun min dūnihī fa żālika najzīhi jahannam(a), każālika najziẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ومن يقل منهم اني اله من دونه فذلك نجزيه جهنم  كذلك نجزي الظلمين
and whoever of them should say, "indeed, i am a god besides him" - that one we would recompense with hell. thus do we recompense the wrongdoers.
wamayyaqulminhuminniilahunmindunihifazalikanajzihijahannamakazalikanajzizzaliminawamanyaqulminhuminneeilahunmindoonihifathalikanajzeehijahannamakathalikanajzeeaththalimeen
Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
Awalam yaral-lażīna kafarū annas-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fa fataqnāhumā, wa ja‘alnā minal-mā'i kulla syai'in ḥayy(in),  afalā yu'minūn(a).
اولم ير الذين كفروا ان السموت والارض كانتا رتقا ففتقنهما  وجعلنا من الماء كل شيء حي  افلا يؤمنون
have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then we separated them and made from water every living thing? then will they not believe?

awalamyarallazinakafaruannassamawatiwalardakanataratqanfafataqnahumawajaalnaminalmaikullasyaiinhayyinafalayuminunaawalamyaraallatheenakafarooannaassamawatiwalardakanataratqanfafataqnahumawajaaaalnaminaalmaikullashayinhayyinafalayuminoon
And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
Wa ja‘alnā fil-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim, wa ja‘anā fīhā fijājan subulal la‘allahum yahtadūn(a).
وجعلنا في الارض روسي ان تميد بهم وجعلنا فيها فجاجا سبلا لعلهم يهتدون
and we placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and we made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
wajaalnafilardirawasiyaantamidabihimwajaanafihafijajansubulallaallahumyahtadunawajaaaalnafeealardirawasiyaantameedabihimwajaaaalnafeehafijajansubulanlaaaallahumyahtadoon
And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
Wa ja‘alnas-samā'a saqfam maḥfūẓā(n), wa hum ‘an āyātihā mu‘riḍūn(a).
وجعلنا السماء سقفا محفوظا  وهم عن ءايتها معرضون
and we made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
wajaalnassamaasaqfammahfuzanwahumanayatihamuridunawajaaaalnaassamaasaqfanmahfoothanwahumaaanayatihamuaaridoon
And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
Wa huwal-lażī khalaqal-laila wan-nahāra wasy-syamsa wal-qamar(a), kullun fī falakiy yasbaḥūn(a).
وهو الذي خلق اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر  كل في فلك يسبحون
and it is he who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
wahuwallazikhalaqallailawannaharawasysyamsawalqamarakullunfifalakiyyasbahunawahuwaallatheekhalaqaallaylawannaharawashshamsawalqamarakullunfeefalakinyasbahoon
And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
Wa mā ja‘alnā libasyarim min qablikal-khuld(a), afa'im mitta fahumul-khālidūn(a).
وما جعلنا لبشر من قبلك الخلد  افاين مت فهم الخلدون
and we did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
wamajaalnalibasyarimminqablikalkhuldaafaimmittafahumulkhalidunawamajaaaalnalibasharinminqablikaalkhuldaafainmittafahumualkhalidoon
Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
Kullu nafsin żā'iqatul-maut(i), wa nablūkum bisy-syarri wal-khairi fitnah(tan), wa ilainā turja‘ūn(a).
كل نفس ذائقه الموت  ونبلوكم بالشر والخير فتنه  والينا ترجعون
every soul will taste death. and we test you with evil and with good as trial; and to us you will be returned.
