kullunafsinzaiqatulmautiwanablukumbisysyarriwalkhairifitnahtanwailainaturjaunakullunafsinthaiqatualmawtiwanablookumbishsharriwalkhayrifitnatanwailaynaturjaaaoon

And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
Wa iżā ra'ākal-lażīna kafarū iy yattakhiżūnaka illā huzuwā(n), ahāżal-lażī yażkuru ālihatakum, wa hum biżikrir-raḥmāni hum kāfirūn(a).
واذا رءاك الذين كفروا ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي يذكر ءالهتكم وهم بذكر الرحمن هم كفرون

and when those who disbelieve see you, [o muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" and they are, at the mention of the most merciful, disbelievers.

waizaraakallazinakafaruiyyattakhizunakaillahuzuwanahazallaziyazkurualihatakumwahumbizikrirrahmanihumkafirunawaitharaakaallatheenakafarooinyattakhithoonakaillahuzuwanahathaallatheeyathkurualihatakumwahumbithikriarrahmanihumkafiroon
Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
Khuliqal-insānu min ‘ajal(in), sa'urīkum āyātī falā tasta‘jilūn(i).
خلق الانسن من عجل  ساوريكم ءايتي فلا تستعجلون
man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. i will show you my signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge me.
khuliqalinsanuminajalinsaurikumayatifalatastajilunikhuliqaalinsanuminaaajalinsaoreekumayateefalatastaaajiloon
And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
wayaqulunamatahazalwaduinkuntumsadiqinawayaqooloonamatahathaalwaaaduinkuntumsadiqeen
If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
Lau ya‘lamul-lażīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ‘aw wujūhihimun nāra wa lā ‘an ẓuhūrihim wa lā hum yunṣarūn(a).
لو يعلم الذين كفروا حين لا يكفون عن وجوههم النار ولا عن ظهورهم ولا هم ينصرون
if those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
lauyalamullazinakafaruhinalayakuffunaawwujuhihimunnarawalaanzuhurihimwalahumyunsarunalawyaaalamuallatheenakafarooheenalayakuffoonaaaanwujoohihimuannarawalaaaanthuhoorihimwalahumyunsaroon
Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
Bal ta'tīhim bagtatan fa tabhatuhum falā yastaṭī‘ūna raddahā wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).
بل تاتيهم بغته فتبهتهم فلا يستطيعون ردها ولا هم ينظرون
rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
baltatihimbagtatanfatabhatuhumfalayastatiunaraddahawalahumyunzarunabaltateehimbaghtatanfatabhatuhumfalayastateeaaoonaraddahawalahumyuntharoon
And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
Wa laqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fa ḥāqa bil-lażīna sakhirū minhum mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
and already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
walaqadistuhziabirusulimminqablikafahaqabillazinasakhiruminhummakanubihiyastahziunawalaqadiistuhziabirusulinminqablikafahaqabillatheenasakhiroominhummakanoobihiyastahzioon
Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
Qul may yakla'ukum bil-laili wan-nahāri minar-raḥmān(i), bal hum ‘an żikrihim mu‘riḍūn(a).
قل من يكلؤكم باليل والنهار من الرحمن  بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون
say, "who can protect you at night or by day from the most merciful?" but they are, from the remembrance of their lord, turning away.
qulmayyaklaukumbillailiwannahariminarrahmanibalhumanzikrihimmuridunaqulmanyaklaokumbillayliwannahariminaarrahmanibalhumaaanthikrirabbihimmuaaridoon
Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
Am lahum ālihatun tamna‘uhum min dūninā, lā yastaṭī‘ūna naṣra anfusihim wa lā hum minnā yuṣḥabūn(a).
ام لهم ءالهه تمنعهم من دوننا  لا يستطيعون نصر انفسهم ولا هم منا يصحبون
or do they have gods to defend them other than us? they are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from us.
amlahumalihatuntamnauhumminduninalayastatiunanasraanfusihimwalahumminnayushabunaamlahumalihatuntamnaaauhummindooninalayastateeaaoonanasraanfusihimwalahumminnayushaboon

But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?
Bal matta‘nā hā'ulā'i wa ābā'ahum ḥattā ṭāla ‘alaihimul-‘umur(u), afalā yarauna annā na'til-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā, afahumul-gālibūn(a).
بل متعنا هؤلاء وءاباءهم حتي طال عليهم العمر  افلا يرون انا ناتي الارض ننقصها من اطرافها  افهم الغلبون

but, [on the contrary], we have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. then do they not see that we set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? is it they who will overcome?

balmattanahaulaiwaabaahumhattatalaalaihimulumuruafalayaraunaannanatilardananqusuhaminatrafihaafahumulgalibunabalmattaaanahaolaiwaabaahumhattatalaaaalayhimualaaumuruafalayarawnaannanateealardananqusuhaminatrafihaafahumualghaliboon
Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
Qul innamā unżirukum bil-waḥy(i), wa lā yasma‘uṣ-ṣummud-du‘ā'a iżā mā yunżarūn(a).
قل انما انذركم بالوحي  ولا يسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ما ينذرون
say, "i only warn you by revelation." but the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
qulinnamaunzirukumbilwahyiwalayasmaussummudduaaizamayunzarunaqulinnamaonthirukumbilwahyiwalayasmaaauassummuadduaaaaithamayuntharoon
And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
Wa la'im massathum nafḥatum min ‘ażābi rabbika layaqūlunna yā wailanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn(a).
ولئن مستهم نفحه من عذاب ربك ليقولن يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
and if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your lord should touch them, they would surely say, "o woe to us! indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
walaimmassathumnafhatumminazabirabbikalayaqulunnayawailanainnakunnazaliminawalainmassathumnafhatunminaaathabirabbikalayaqoolunnayawaylanainnakunnathalimeen

And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
Wa naḍa‘ul-mawāzīnal-qisṭa liyaumil-qiyāmati falā tuẓlamu nafsun syai'ā(n), wa in kāna miṡqāla ḥabbatim min khardalin atainā bihā, wa kafā binā ḥāsibīn(a).
ونضع الموزين القسط ليوم القيمه فلا تظلم نفس شيا  وان كان مثقال حبه من خردل اتينا بها  وكفي بنا حسبين

and we place the scales of justice for the day of resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. and if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, we will bring it forth. and sufficient are we as accountant.

wanadaulmawazinalqistaliyaumilqiyamatifalatuzlamunafsunsyaianwainkanamisqalahabbatimminkhardalinatainabihawakafabinahasibinawanadaaaualmawazeenaalqistaliyawmialqiyamatifalatuthlamunafsunshayanwainkanamithqalahabbatinminkhardalinataynabihawakafabinahasibeen
And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
Wa laqad ātainā mūsā wa hārūnal-furqāna wa ḍiyā'aw wa żikral lil-muttaqīn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا موسي وهرون الفرقان وضياء وذكرا للمتقين
and we had already given moses and aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
walaqadatainamusawaharunalfurqanawadiyaawwazikrallilmuttaqinawalaqadataynamoosawaharoonaalfurqanawadiyaanwathikranlilmuttaqeen
Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
Allażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum bil-gaibi wa hum minas-sā‘ati musyfiqūn(a).
الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب وهم من الساعه مشفقون
who fear their lord unseen, while they are of the hour apprehensive.
allazinayakhsyaunarabbahumbilgaibiwahumminassaatimusyfiqunaallatheenayakhshawnarabbahumbilghaybiwahumminaassaaaatimushfiqoon
And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
Wa hāżā żikrum mubārakun anzalnāh(u), afa antum lahū munkirūn(a).
وهذا ذكر مبارك انزلنه  افانتم له منكرون
and this [qur’an] is a blessed message which we have sent down. then are you with it unacquainted?
wahazazikrummubarakunanzalnahuafaantumlahumunkirunawahathathikrunmubarakunanzalnahuafaantumlahumunkiroon
And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
Wa laqad ātainā ibrāhīma rusydahū min qablu wa kunnā bihī ‘ālimīn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا ابرهيم رشده من قبل وكنا به علمين
and we had certainly given abraham his sound judgement before, and we were of him well-knowing
walaqadatainaibrahimarusydahuminqabluwakunnabihialiminawalaqadataynaibraheemarushdahuminqabluwakunnabihiaaalimeen
When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
Iż qāla li'abīhi wa qaumihī mā hāżihit-tamāṡīlul-latī antum lahā ‘ākifūn(a).
اذ قال لابيه وقومه ما هذه التماثيل التي انتم لها عكفون
when he said to his father and his people, "what are these statues to which you are devoted?"
izqalaliabihiwaqaumihimahazihittamasilullatiantumlahaakifunaithqalaliabeehiwaqawmihimahathihiattamatheeluallateeantumlahaaaakifoon
They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
Qālū wajadnā ābā'anā lahā ‘ābidīn(a).
قالوا وجدنا ءاباءنا لها عبدين
they said, "we found our fathers worshippers of them."
qaluwajadnaabaanalahaabidinaqaloowajadnaabaanalahaaaabideen
He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
Qāla laqad kuntum antum wa ābā'ukum fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
قال لقد كنتم انتم وءاباؤكم في ضلل مبين
he said, "you were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
qalalaqadkuntumantumwaabaukumfidalalimmubininqalalaqadkuntumantumwaabaokumfeedalalinmubeen
They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
Qālū aji'tanā bil-ḥaqqi am anta minal-lā‘ibīn(a).
قالوا اجئتنا بالحق ام انت من اللعبين
they said, "have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
qaluajitanabilhaqqiamantaminallaibinaqalooajitanabilhaqqiamantaminaallaaaibeen
He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
Qāla bar rabbukum rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍil-lażī faṭarahunn(a), wa ana ‘alā żālikum minasy-syāhidīn(a).
قال بل ربكم رب السموت والارض الذي فطرهن وانا علي ذلكم من الشهدين
he said, "[no], rather, your lord is the lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and i, to that, am of those who testify.
qalabarrabbukumrabbussamawatiwalardillazifatarahunnawaanaalazalikumminasysyahidinaqalabalrabbukumrabbuassamawatiwalardiallatheefatarahunnawaanaaaalathalikumminaashshahideen
And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
Wa tallāhi la'akīdanna aṣnāmakum ba‘da an tuwallū mudbirīn(a).
وتالله لاكيدن اصنمكم بعد ان تولوا مدبرين
and [i swear] by allah, i will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
watallahilaakidannaasnamakumbadaantuwallumudbirinawatallahilaakeedannaasnamakumbaaadaantuwalloomudbireen
So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
Fa ja‘alahum jużāżan illā kabīral lahum la‘allahum ilaihi yarji‘ūn(a).
فجعلهم جذذا الا كبيرا لهم لعلهم اليه يرجعون
so he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
fajaalahumjuzazanillakabirallahumlaallahumilaihiyarjiunafajaaaalahumjuthathanillakabeeranlahumlaaaallahumilayhiyarjiaaoon
They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
Qālū man fa‘ala hāżā bi'ālihatinā innahū laminaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
قالوا من فعل هذا بالهتنا انه لمن الظلمين
they said, "who has done this to our gods? indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
qalumanfaalahazabialihatinainnahulaminazzaliminaqaloomanfaaaalahathabialihatinainnahulaminaaththalimeen
They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
Qālū sami‘nā fatay yażkuruhum yuqālu lahū ibrāhīm(u).
قالوا سمعنا فتي يذكرهم يقال له ابرهيم
they said, "we heard a young man mention them who is called abraham."
qalusaminafatayyazkuruhumyuqalulahuibrahimuqaloosamiaanafatanyathkuruhumyuqalulahuibraheem
They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
Qālū fa'tū bihī ‘alā a‘yunin-nāsi la‘allahum yasyhadūn(a).
قالوا فاتوا به علي اعين الناس لعلهم يشهدون
they said, "then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
qalufatubihialaayuninnasilaallahumyasyhadunaqaloofatoobihiaaalaaaayuniannasilaaaallahumyashhadoon
They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
Qālū a'anta fa‘alta hāżā bi'ālihatinā yā ibrāhīm(u).
قالوا ءانت فعلت هذا بالهتنا يابرهيم
they said, "have you done this to our gods, o abraham?"
qaluaantafaaltahazabialihatinayaibrahimuqalooaantafaaaaltahathabialihatinayaibraheem
He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
Qāla bal fa‘alahū kabīruhum hāżā fas'alūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn(a).
قال بل فعله كبيرهم هذا فسلوهم ان كانوا ينطقون
he said, "rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
qalabalfaalahukabiruhumhazafasaluhuminkanuyantiqunaqalabalfaaaalahukabeeruhumhathafasaloohuminkanooyantiqoon
So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
Fa raja‘ū ilā anfusihim fa qālū innakum antumuẓ-ẓālimūn(a).
فرجعوا الي انفسهم فقالوا انكم انتم الظلمون
so they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
farajauilaanfusihimfaqaluinnakumantumuzzalimunafarajaaaooilaanfusihimfaqalooinnakumantumuaththalimoon
Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
Ṡumma nukisū ‘alā ru'ūsihim, laqad ‘alimta mā hā'ulā'i yanṭiqūn(a).
ثم نكسوا علي رءوسهم لقد علمت ما هؤلاء ينطقون
then they reversed themselves, [saying], "you have already known that these do not speak!"
summanukisualaruusihimlaqadalimtamahaulaiyantiqunathummanukisooaaalaruoosihimlaqadaaalimtamahaolaiyantiqoon
He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
Qāla afata‘budūna min dūnillāhi mā lā yanfa‘ukum syai'aw wa lā yaḍurrukum.
قال افتعبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعكم شيا ولا يضركم
he said, "then do you worship instead of allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
qalaafatabudunamindunillahimalayanfaukumsyaiawwalayadurrukumqalaafataaabudoonamindooniallahimalayanfaaaukumshayanwalayadurrukum
Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
Uffil lakum wa limā ta‘budūna min dūnillāh(i), afalā ta‘qilūn(a).
اف لكم ولما تعبدون من دون الله  افلا تعقلون
uff to you and to what you worship instead of allah. then will you not use reason?"
uffillakumwalimatabudunamindunillahiafalataqilunaoffinlakumwalimataaabudoonamindooniallahiafalataaaqiloon
They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
Qālū ḥarriqūhu wanṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fā‘ilīn(a).
قالوا حرقوه وانصروا ءالهتكم ان كنتم فعلين
they said, "burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
qaluharriquhuwansurualihatakuminkuntumfailinaqalooharriqoohuwansurooalihatakuminkuntumfaaaileen
We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
Qulnā yā nāru kūnī bardaw wa salāman ‘alā ibrāhīm(a).
قلنا ينار كوني بردا وسلما علي ابرهيم
we [i.e., allah] said, "o fire, be coolness and safety upon abraham."
qulnayanarukunibardawwasalamanalaibrahimaqulnayanarukooneebardanwasalamanaaalaibraheem
And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
Wa arādū bihī kaidan fa ja‘alnāhumul-akhsarīn(a).
وارادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الاخسرين
and they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but we made them the greatest losers.
waaradubihikaidanfajaalnahumulakhsarinawaaradoobihikaydanfajaaaalnahumualakhsareen
And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
Wa najjaināhu wa lūṭan ilal-arḍil-latī bāraknā fīhā lil-‘ālamīn(a).
ونجينه ولوطا الي الارض التي بركنا فيها للعلمين
and we delivered him and lot to the land which we had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
wanajjainahuwalutanilalardillatibaraknafihalilalaminawanajjaynahuwalootanilaalardiallateebaraknafeehalilaaalameen
And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
Wa wahabnā lahū isḥāqa wa ya‘qūba nāfilah(tan), wa kullan ja‘alnā  ṣāliḥīn(a).
ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب نافله  وكلا جعلنا صلحين
and we gave him isaac and jacob in addition, and all [of them] we made righteous.
wawahabnalahuishaqawayaqubanafilahtanwakullanjaalnasalihinawawahabnalahuishaqawayaaaqoobanafilatanwakullanjaaaalnasaliheen
And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
Wa ja‘alnāhum a'immatay yahdūna bi'amrinā wa auḥainā ilaihim fi‘lal-khairāti wa iqāmaṣ-ṣalāti wa ītā'az-zakāh(ti), wa kānū lanā ‘ābidīn(a).
وجعلنهم ائمه يهدون بامرنا واوحينا اليهم فعل الخيرت واقام الصلوه وايتاء الزكوه  وكانوا لنا عبدين
and we made them leaders guiding by our command. and we inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of us.

wajaalnahumaimmatayyahdunabiamrinawaauhainailaihimfilalkhairatiwaiqamassalatiwaitaazzakahtiwakanulanaabidinawajaaaalnahumaimmatanyahdoonabiamrinawaawhaynailayhimfiaalaalkhayratiwaiqamaassalatiwaeetaaazzakatiwakanoolanaaaabideen
And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
Wa lūṭan ātaināhu ḥumkaw wa ‘ilmaw wa najjaināhu minal-qaryatil-latī kānat ta‘malul-khabā'iṡ(a), innahum kānū qauma sau'in fāsiqīn(a).
ولوطا ءاتينه حكما وعلما ونجينه من القريه التي كانت تعمل الخبئث  انهم كانوا قوم سوء فسقين
and to lot we gave judgement and knowledge, and we saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

walutanatainahuhumkawwailmawwanajjainahuminalqaryatillatikanattamalulkhabaisainnahumkanuqaumasauinfasiqinawalootanataynahuhukmanwaaailmanwanajjaynahuminaalqaryatiallateekanattaaamalualkhabaithainnahumkanooqawmasawinfasiqeen
And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
Wa adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā,  innahū minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
وادخلنه في رحمتنا  انه من الصلحين
and we admitted him into our mercy. indeed, he was of the righteous.
waadkhalnahufirahmatinainnahuminassalihinawaadkhalnahufeerahmatinainnahuminaassaliheen
And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
Wa nūḥan iż nādā min qablu fastajabnā lahū fa najjaināhu wa ahlahū minal-karbil-‘aẓīm(i).
ونوحا اذ نادي من قبل فاستجبنا له فنجينه واهله من الكرب العظيم
and [mention] noah, when he called [to allah] before [that time], so we responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
wanuhaniznadaminqablufastajabnalahufanajjainahuwaahlahuminalkarbilazimiwanoohanithnadaminqablufastajabnalahufanajjaynahuwaahlahuminaalkarbialaaatheem
And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
Wa naṣarnāhu minal-qaumil-lażīna każżabū bi'āyātinā, innahum kānū qauma sau'in fa agraqnāhum ajma‘īn(a).
ونصرنه من القوم الذين كذبوا بايتنا  انهم كانوا قوم سوء فاغرقنهم اجمعين
and we aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied our signs. indeed, they were a people of evil, so we drowned them, all together.
wanasarnahuminalqaumillazinakazzabubiayatinainnahumkanuqaumasauinfaagraqnahumajmainawanasarnahuminaalqawmiallatheenakaththaboobiayatinainnahumkanooqawmasawinfaaghraqnahumajmaaaeen
And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
Wa dāwūda wa sulaimāna iż yaḥkumāni fil-ḥarṡi iż nafasyat fīhi ganamul-qaum(i), wa kunnā liḥukmihim syāhidīn(a).
وداود وسليمن اذ يحكمان في الحرث اذ نفشت فيه غنم القوم وكنا لحكمهم شهدين
and [mention] david and solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and we were witness to their judgement.
wadawudawasulaimanaizyahkumanifilharsiiznafasyatfihiganamulqaumiwakunnalihukmihimsyahidinawadawoodawasulaymanaithyahkumanifeealharthiithnafashatfeehighanamualqawmiwakunnalihukmihimshahideen

And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
Fa fahhamnāhā sulaimān(a), wa kullan ātainā ḥukmaw wa ‘ilmā(n), wa sakhkharnā ma‘a dāwūdal-jibāla yusabbiḥna waṭ-ṭair(a), wa kunnā fā‘ilīn(a).
ففهمنها سليمن  وكلا ءاتينا حكما وعلما  وسخرنا مع داود الجبال يسبحن والطير  وكنا فعلين

and we gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to solomon, and to each [of them] we gave judgement and knowledge. and we subjected the mountains to exalt [us], along with david and [also] the birds. and we were doing [that].

fafahhamnahasulaimanawakullanatainahukmawwailmanwasakhkharnamaadawudaljibalayusabbihnawattairawakunnafailinafafahhamnahasulaymanawakullanataynahukmanwaaailmanwasakhkharnamaaaadawoodaaljibalayusabbihnawattayrawakunnafaaaileen
And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
Wa ‘allamnāhu ṣan‘ata labūsil lakum lituḥṣinakum mim ba'sikum, fahal antum syākirūn(a).
وعلمنه صنعه لبوس لكم لتحصنكم من باسكم  فهل انتم شكرون
and we taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. so will you then be grateful?
waallamnahusanatalabusillakumlituhsinakummimbasikumfahalantumsyakirunawaaaallamnahusanaaatalaboosinlakumlituhsinakumminbasikumfahalantumshakiroon
And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
Wa lisulaimānar-rīḥa ‘āṣifatan tajrī bi'amrihī ilal-arḍil-latī bāraknā fīhā, wa kunnā bikulli syai'in ‘ālimīn(a).
ولسليمن الريح عاصفه تجري بامره الي الارض التي بركنا فيها  وكنا بكل شيء علمين
and to solomon [we subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which we had blessed. and we are ever, of all things, knowing.
walisulaimanarrihaasifatantajribiamrihiilalardillatibaraknafihawakunnabikullisyaiinaliminawalisulaymanaarreehaaaasifatantajreebiamrihiilaalardiallateebaraknafeehawakunnabikullishayinaaalimeen
And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
Wa minasy-syayāṭīna may yagūṣūna lahū wa ya‘malūna ‘amalan dūna żālik(a), wa kunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīn(a).
ومن الشيطين من يغوصون له ويعملون عملا دون ذلك  وكنا لهم حفظين
and of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. and we were of them a guardian.
waminasysyayatinamayyagusunalahuwayamalunaamalandunazalikawakunnalahumhafizinawaminaashshayateenimanyaghoosoonalahuwayaaamaloonaaaamalandoonathalikawakunnalahumhafitheen
And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
Wa ayyūba iż nādā rabbahū annī massaniyaḍ-ḍurru wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn(a).
وايوب اذ نادي ربه اني مسني الضر وانت ارحم الرحمين
and [mention] job, when he called to his lord, "indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the most merciful of the merciful."
waayyubaiznadarabbahuannimassaniyaddurruwaantaarhamurrahiminawaayyoobaithnadarabbahuanneemassaniyaaddurruwaantaarhamuarrahimeen
So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
Fastajabnā lahū fa kasyafnā mā bihī min ḍurriw wa ātaināhu ahlahū wa miṡlahum ma‘ahum raḥmatam min ‘indinā wa żikrā lil-‘ābidīn(a).
فاستجبنا له فكشفنا ما به من ضر  وءاتينه اهله ومثلهم معهم رحمه من عندنا وذكري للعبدين
so we responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. and we gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from us and a reminder for the worshippers [of allah].

fastajabnalahufakasyafnamabihimindurriwwaatainahuahlahuwamislahummaahumrahmatamminindinawazikralilabidinafastajabnalahufakashafnamabihimindurrinwaataynahuahlahuwamithlahummaaaahumrahmatanminaaindinawathikralilaaabideen
And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
Wa ismā‘īla wa idrīsa wa żal-kifl(i), kullum minaṣ-ṣābirīn(a).
واسمعيل وادريس وذا الكفل  كل من الصبرين
and [mention] ishmael and idrees and dhul-kifl; all were of the patient.
waismailawaidrisawazalkiflikullumminassabirinawaismaaaeelawaidreesawathaalkiflikullunminaassabireen
And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
Wa adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā, innahum minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
وادخلنهم في رحمتنا  انهم من الصلحين
and we admitted them into our mercy. indeed, they were of the righteous.
waadkhalnahumfirahmatinainnahumminassalihinawaadkhalnahumfeerahmatinainnahumminaassaliheen

And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
Wa żan-nūni iż żahaba mugāḍiban fa ẓanna allan naqdira ‘alaihi fa nādā fiẓ-ẓulumāti allā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
وذا النون اذ ذهب مغضبا فظن ان لن نقدر عليه فنادي في الظلمت ان لا اله الا انت سبحنك اني كنت من الظلمين

and [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that we would not decree [anything] upon him. and he called out within the darknesses, "there is no deity except you; exalted are you. indeed, i have been of the wrongdoers."

wazannuniizzahabamugadibanfazannaallannaqdiraalaihifanadafizzulumatiallailahaillaantasubhanakainnikuntuminazzaliminawathaannooniiththahabamughadibanfathannaanlannaqdiraaaalayhifanadafeeaththulumatianlailahaillaantasubhanakainneekuntuminaaththalimeen
So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
Fastajabnā lahū wa najjaināhu minal-gamm(i), wa każālika nunjil-mu'minīn(a).
فاستجبنا له ونجينه من الغم  وكذلك نجي المؤمنين
so we responded to him and saved him from the distress. and thus do we save the believers.
fastajabnalahuwanajjainahuminalgammiwakazalikanunjilmumininafastajabnalahuwanajjaynahuminaalghammiwakathalikanunjeealmumineen
And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
Wa zakariyyā iż nādā rabbahū rabbi lā tażarnī fardaw wa anta khairul-wāriṡīn(a).
وزكريا اذ نادي ربه رب لا تذرني فردا وانت خير الورثين
and [mention] zechariah, when he called to his lord, "my lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
wazakariyyaiznadarabbahurabbilatazarnifardawwaantakhairulwarisinawazakariyyaithnadarabbahurabbilatatharneefardanwaantakhayrualwaritheen
So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
Fastajabnā lah(ū), wa wahabnā lahū yaḥyā wa aṣlaḥnā lahū zaujah(ū), innahum kānū yusāri‘ūna fil-khairāti wa yad‘ūnanā ragabaw wa rahabā(n), wa kānū lanā khāsyi‘īn(a).
فاستجبنا له ووهبنا له يحيي واصلحنا له زوجه  انهم كانوا يسرعون في الخيرت ويدعوننا رغبا ورهبا  وكانوا لنا خشعين
so we responded to him, and we gave to him john, and amended for him his wife. indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate us in hope and fear, and they were to us humbly submissive.

fastajabnalahuwawahabnalahuyahyawaaslahnalahuzaujahuinnahumkanuyusariunafilkhairatiwayadunanaragabawwarahabanwakanulanakhasyiinafastajabnalahuwawahabnalahuyahyawaaslahnalahuzawjahuinnahumkanooyusariaaoonafeealkhayratiwayadaaoonanaraghabanwarahabanwakanoolanakhashiaaeen
And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
Wal-latī aḥṣanat farjahā fa nafakhnā fīhā mir rūḥinā wa ja‘alnāhā wabnahā āyatal lil-‘ālamīn(a).
والتي احصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيها من روحنا وجعلنها وابنها ءايه للعلمين
and [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., mary], so we blew into her [garment] through our angel [i.e., gabriel], and we made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
wallatiahsanatfarjahafanafakhnafihamirruhinawajaalnahawabnahaayatallilalaminawallateeahsanatfarjahafanafakhnafeehaminroohinawajaaaalnahawabnahaayatanlilaaalameen
Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
Inna hāżihī ummatukum ummataw wāḥidah(tan), wa ana rabbukum fa‘budūn(i).
ان هذه امتكم امه وحده وانا ربكم فاعبدون
indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so worship me.
innahazihiummatukumummatawwahidahtanwaanarabbukumfabuduniinnahathihiommatukumommatanwahidatanwaanarabbukumfaoaabudoon
And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
Wa taqaṭṭa‘ū amrahum bainahum, kullun ilainā rāji‘ūn(a).
وتقطعوا امرهم بينهم  كل الينا رجعون
and [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to us will return.
wataqattauamrahumbainahumkullunilainarajiunawataqattaaaooamrahumbaynahumkullunilaynarajiaaoon
So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
Famay ya‘mal minaṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa huwa mu'minun falā kufrāna lisa‘yih(ī), wa innā lahū kātibūn(a).
فمن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مؤمن فلا كفران لسعيه وانا له كتبون
so whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed we [i.e., our angels], of it, are recorders.
famayyamalminassalihatiwahuwamuminunfalakufranalisayihiwainnalahukatibunafamanyaaamalminaassalihatiwahuwamuminunfalakufranalisaaayihiwainnalahukatiboon
And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
Wa ḥarāmun ‘alā qaryatin ahlaknāhā, innahum lā yarji‘ūn(a).
وحرم علي قريه اهلكنها انهم لا يرجعون
and it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which we have destroyed that they will [ever] return
waharamunalaqaryatinahlaknahainnahumlayarjiunawaharamunaaalaqaryatinahlaknahaannahumlayarjiaaoon
Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
Ḥattā iżā futiḥat ya'jūju wa ma'jūju wa hum min kulli ḥadabiy yansilūn(a).
حتي اذا فتحت ياجوج وماجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون
until when [the dam of] gog and magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
hattaizafutihatyajujuwamajujuwahumminkullihadabiyyansilunahattaithafutihatyajoojuwamajoojuwahumminkullihadabinyansiloon

And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
Waqtarabal-wa‘dul-ḥaqqu fa iżā hiya syākhiṣatun abṣārul-lażīna kafarū, yā wailanā qad kunnā fī gaflatim min hāżā bal kunnā ẓālimīn(a).
واقترب الوعد الحق فاذا هي شخصه ابصر الذين كفروا يويلنا قد كنا في غفله من هذا بل كنا ظلمين

and [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "o woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

waqtarabalwadulhaqqufaizahiyasyakhisatunabsarullazinakafaruyawailanaqadkunnafigaflatimminhazabalkunnazaliminawaqtarabaalwaaadualhaqqufaithahiyashakhisatunabsaruallatheenakafarooyawaylanaqadkunnafeeghaflatinminhathabalkunnathalimeen
Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
Innakum wa mā ta‘budūna min dūnillāhi ḥaṣabu jahannam(a), antum lahā wāridūn(a).
انكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم انتم لها وردون
indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than allah are the firewood of hell. you will be coming to [enter] it.
innakumwamatabudunamindunillahihasabujahannamaantumlahawaridunainnakumwamataaabudoonamindooniallahihasabujahannamaantumlahawaridoon
Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
Lau kāna hā'ulā'i ālihatam mā waradūhā, wa kullun fīhā khālidūn(a).
لو كان هؤلاء ءالهه ما وردوها  وكل فيها خلدون
had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
laukanahaulaialihatammawaraduhawakullunfihakhalidunalawkanahaolaialihatanmawaradoohawakullunfeehakhalidoon
For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
Lahum fīhā zafīruw wa hum fīhā lā yasma‘ūn(a).
لهم فيها زفير وهم فيها لا يسمعون
for them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
lahumfihazafiruwwahumfihalayasmaunalahumfeehazafeerunwahumfeehalayasmaaaoon
Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
Innal-lażīna sabaqat lahum minnal-ḥusnā, ulā'ika ‘anhā mub‘adūn(a).
ان الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسني اولئك عنها مبعدون
indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from us - they are from it far removed.
innallazinasabaqatlahumminnalhusnaulaikaanhamubadunainnaallatheenasabaqatlahumminnaalhusnaolaikaaaanhamubaaadoon
They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
Lā yasma‘ūna ḥasīsahā, wa hum fīmasytahat anfusuhum khālidūn(a).
لا يسمعون حسيسها  وهم في ما اشتهت انفسهم خلدون
they will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
layasmaunahasisahawahumfimasytahatanfusuhumkhalidunalayasmaaaoonahaseesahawahumfeemaishtahatanfusuhumkhalidoon
They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
Lā yaḥzunuhumul-faza‘ul-akbaru wa tatalaqqāhumul-malā'ikah(tu), hāżā yaumukumul-lażī kuntum tū‘adūn(a).
لا يحزنهم الفزع الاكبر وتتلقيهم الملئكه هذا يومكم الذي كنتم توعدون
they will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "this is your day which you have been promised" -
layahzunuhumulfazaulakbaruwatatalaqqahumulmalaikahtuhazayaumukumullazikuntumtuadunalayahzunuhumualfazaaaualakbaruwatatalaqqahumualmalaikatuhathayawmukumuallatheekuntumtooaaadoon

The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
Yauma naṭwis-samā'a kaṭayyis-sijilli lil-kutib(i), kamā bada'nā awwala khalqin nu‘īduh(ū), wa‘dan ‘alainā, innā kunnā fā‘ilīn(a).
يوم نطوي السماء كطي السجل للكتب  كما بدانا اول خلق نعيده  وعدا علينا  انا كنا فعلين

the day when we will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. as we began the first creation, we will repeat it. [that is] a promise binding upon us. indeed, we will do it.

yaumanatwissamaakatayyissijillililkutibikamabadanaawwalakhalqinnuiduhuwadanalainainnakunnafailinayawmanatweeassamaakatayyiassijllililkutubikamabadanaawwalakhalqinnuaaeeduhuwaaadanaaalaynainnakunnafaaaileen
And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
Wa laqad katabnā fiz-zabūri mim ba‘diż-żikri annal-arḍa yariṡuhā ‘ibādiyaṣ-ṣāliḥūn(a).
ولقد كتبنا في الزبور من بعد الذكر ان الارض يرثها عبادي الصلحون
and we have already written in the book [of psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of paradise] is inherited by my righteous servants.
walaqadkatabnafizzaburimimbadizzikriannalardayarisuhaibadiyassalihunawalaqadkatabnafeeazzabooriminbaaadiaththikriannaalardayarithuhaaaibadiyaassalihoon
Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.
Inna fī hāżā labalāgal liqaumin ‘ābidīn(a).
ان في هذا لبلغا لقوم عبدين
indeed, in this [qur’an] is notification for a worshipping people.
innafihazalabalagalliqauminabidinainnafeehathalabalaghanliqawminaaabideen
And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
Wa mā arsalnāka illā raḥmatal lil-‘ālamīn(a).
وما ارسلنك الا رحمه للعلمين
and we have not sent you, [o muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
wamaarsalnakaillarahmatallilalaminawamaarsalnakaillarahmatanlilaaalameen
Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
Qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥid(un), fahal antum muslimūn(a).
قل انما يوحي الي انما الهكم اله وحد  فهل انتم مسلمون
say, "it is only revealed to me that your god is but one god; so will you be muslims [in submission to him]?"
qulinnamayuhailayyaannamailahukumilahuwwahidunfahalantummuslimunaqulinnamayoohailayyaannamailahukumilahunwahidunfahalantummuslimoon
But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
Fa in tawallau fa qul āżantukum ‘alā sawā'(in), wa in adrī aqarībun am ba‘īdum mā tū‘adūn(a).
فان تولوا فقل ءاذنتكم علي سواء  وان ادري اقريب ام بعيد ما توعدون
but if they turn away, then say, "i have announced to [all of] you equally. and i know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
faintawallaufaqulazantukumalasawainwainadriaqaribunambaidummatuadunafaintawallawfaqulathantukumaaalasawainwainadreeaqareebunambaaaeedunmatooaaadoon
Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
Innahū ya‘lamul-jahra minal-qauli wa ya‘lamu mā taktumūn(a).
انه يعلم الجهر من القول ويعلم ما تكتمون
indeed, he knows what is declared of speech, and he knows what you conceal.
innahuyalamuljahraminalqauliwayalamumataktumunainnahuyaaalamualjahraminaalqawliwayaaalamumataktumoon
And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
Wa in adrī la‘allahū fitnatul lakum wa matā‘un ilā ḥīn(in).
وان ادري لعله فتنه لكم ومتع الي حين
and i know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
wainadrilaallahufitnatullakumwamataunilahininwainadreelaaaallahufitnatunlakumwamataaaunilaheen
[The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
Qāla rabbiḥkum bil-ḥaqq(i), wa rabbunar-raḥmānul-musta‘ānu ‘alā mā taṣifūn(a).
قل رب احكم بالحق  وربنا الرحمن المستعان علي ما تصفون
[the prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "my lord, judge [between us] in truth. and our lord is the most merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
qalarabbihkumbilhaqqiwarabbunarrahmanulmustaanualamatasifunaqalarabbiohkumbilhaqqiwarabbunaarrahmanualmustaaaanuaaalamatasifoon
O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
Yā ayyuhan-nāsuttaqū rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-sā‘ati syai'un ‘aẓīm(un).
يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم  ان زلزله الساعه شيء عظيم
o mankind, fear your lord. indeed, the convulsion of the [final] hour is a terrible thing.
yaayyuhannasuttaqurabbakuminnazalzalatassaatisyaiunazimunyaayyuhaannasuittaqoorabbakuminnazalzalataassaaaatishayonaaatheem

On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.
Yauma taraunahā tażhalu kullu murḍi‘atin ‘ammā arḍa‘at wa taḍa‘u kullu żāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā wa taran-nāsa sukārā wa mā hum bisukārā wa lākinna ‘ażāballāhi syadīd(un).
يوم ترونها تذهل كل مرضعه عما ارضعت وتضع كل ذات حمل حملها وتري الناس سكري وما هم بسكري ولكن عذاب الله شديد

on the day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of allah is severe.

yaumataraunahatazhalukullumurdiatinammaardaatwatadaukulluzatihamlinhamlahawatarannasasukarawamahumbisukarawalakinnaazaballahisyadidunyawmatarawnahatathhalukullumurdiaaatinaaammaardaaaatwatadaaaukulluthatihamlinhamlahawataraannasasukarawamahumbisukarawalakinnaaaathabaallahishadeed
And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
Wa minan-nāsi may yujādilu fillāhi bigairi ‘ilmiw wa yattabi‘u kulla syaiṭānim marīd(in).
ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ويتبع كل شيطن مريد
and of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
waminannasimayyujadilufillahibigairiilmiwwayattabiukullasyaitanimmaridinwaminaannasimanyujadilufeeallahibighayriaailminwayattabiaaukullashaytaninmareed
It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
Kutiba ‘alaihi annahū man tawallāhu fa annahū yuḍilluhū wa yahdīhi ilā ‘ażābis-sa‘īr(i).
كتب عليه انه من تولاه فانه يضله ويهديه الي عذاب السعير
it has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the blaze.
kutibaalaihiannahumantawallahufaannahuyudilluhuwayahdihiilaazabissairikutibaaaalayhiannahumantawallahufaannahuyudilluhuwayahdeehiilaaaathabiassaaaeer

O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.

Yā ayyuhan-nāsu in kuntum fī raibim minal-ba‘ṡi fa innā khalaqnākum min turābin ṡumma min nuṭfatin ṡumma min ‘alaqatin ṡumma mim muḍgatim mukhallaqatiw wa gairi mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum, wa nuqirru fil-arḥāmi mā nasyā'u ilā ajalim musamman ṡumma nukhrijukum ṭiflan ṡumma litablugū asyuddakum, wa minkum may yutawaffā wa minkum may yuraddu ilā arżalil-‘umuri likailā ya‘lama ba‘da  ‘ilmin syai'ā(n), wa taral-arḍa hāmidatan fa iżā anzalnā ‘alaihal-mā'ahtazzat wa rabat wa ambatat min kulli zaujim bahīj(in).

يايها الناس ان كنتم في ريب من البعث فانا خلقنكم من تراب ثم من نطفه ثم من علقه ثم من مضغه مخلقه وغير مخلقه لنبين لكم  ونقر في الارحام ما نشاء الي اجل مسمي ثم نخرجكم طفلا ثم لتبلغوا اشدكم  ومنكم من يتوفي ومنكم من يرد الي ارذل العمر لكيلا يعلم من بعد علم شيا  وتري الارض هامده فاذا انزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت وانبتت من كل زوج بهيج

o people, if you should be in doubt about the resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, we created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that we may show you. and we settle in the wombs whom we will for a specified term, then we bring you out as a child, and then [we develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. and among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. and you see the earth barren, but when we send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.


That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
Żālika bi'annallāha huwal-ḥaqqu wa annahū yuḥyil-mautā wa annahū ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ذلك بان الله هو الحق وانه يحي الموتي وانه علي كل شيء قدير
that is because allah is the true reality and because he gives life to the dead and because he is over all things competent
zalikabiannallahahuwalhaqquwaannahuyuhyilmautawaannahualakullisyaiinqadirunthalikabiannaallahahuwaalhaqquwaannahuyuhyeealmawtawaannahuaaalakullishayinqadeer
And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.
Wa annas-sā‘ata ātiyatul lā raiba fīhā, wa annallāha yab‘aṡu man fil-qubūr(i).
وان الساعه ءاتيه لا ريب فيها وان الله يبعث من في القبور
and [that they may know] that the hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that allah will resurrect those in the graves.
waannassaataatiyatullaraibafihawaannallahayabasumanfilquburiwaannaassaaaataatiyatunlaraybafeehawaannaallahayabaaathumanfeealquboor
And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
Wa minan-nāsi may yujādilu fillāhi bigairi ‘ilmiw wa lā hudaw wa lā kitābim munīr(in).
ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ولا هدي ولا كتب منير
and of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from him],
waminannasimayyujadilufillahibigairiilmiwwalahudawwalakitabimmunirinwaminaannasimanyujadilufeeallahibighayriaailminwalahudanwalakitabinmuneer

Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
Ṡāniya ‘iṭfihī liyuḍilla ‘an sabīlillāh(i), lahū fid-dun-yā khizyuw wa nużīquhū yaumal-qiyāmati ‘ażābal-ḥarīq(i).
ثاني عطفه ليضل عن سبيل الله  له في الدنيا خزي  ونذيقه يوم القيمه عذاب الحريق

twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of allah. for him in the world is disgrace, and we will make him taste on the day of resurrection the punishment of the burning fire [while it is said],
saniyaitfihiliyudillaansabilillahilahufiddunyakhizyuwwanuziquhuyaumalqiyamatiazabalhariqithaniyaaaitfihiliyudillaaaansabeeliallahilahufeeaddunyakhizyunwanutheequhuyawmaalqiyamatiaaathabaalhareeq
"That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
Żālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa annallāha laisa biẓallāmil lil-‘abīd(i).
ذلك بما قدمت يداك وان الله ليس بظلم للعبيد
"that is for what your hands have put forth and because allah is not ever unjust to [his] servants."
zalikabimaqaddamatyadakawaannallahalaisabizallamillilabidithalikabimaqaddamatyadakawaannaallahalaysabithallaminlilaaabeed

And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
Wa minan-nāsi may ya‘budullāha ‘alā ḥarf(in), fa in aṣābahū khairuniṭma'anna  bih(ī), wa in aṣābathu fitnatuninqalaba ‘alā wajhih(ī), khasirad-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ta), żālika huwal-khusrānul-mubīn(u).
ومن الناس من يعبد الله علي حرف  فان اصابه خير اطمان به  وان اصابته فتنه انقلب علي وجهه خسر الدنيا والاخره  ذلك هو الخسران المبين

and of the people is he who worships allah on an edge. if he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. he has lost [this] world and the hereafter. that is what is the manifest loss.


He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
Yad‘ū min dūnillāhi mā lā yaḍurruhū wa mā lā yanfa‘uh(ū), żālika huwaḍ-ḍalālul-ba‘īd(u).
يدعوا من دون الله ما لا يضره وما لا ينفعه  ذلك هو الضلل البعيد
he invokes instead of allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. that is what is the extreme error.
yadumindunillahimalayadurruhuwamalayanfauhuzalikahuwaddalalulbaiduyadaaoomindooniallahimalayadurruhuwamalayanfaaauhuthalikahuwaaddalalualbaaaeed
He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
Yad‘ū laman ḍarruhū aqrabu min naf‘ih(ī), labi'sal-maulā wa labi'sal-‘asyīr(u).
يدعوا لمن ضره اقرب من نفعه  لبئس المولي ولبئس العشير
he invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
yadulamandarruhuaqrabuminnafihilabisalmaulawalabisalasyiruyadaaoolamandarruhuaqrabuminnafaaihilabisaalmawlawalabisaalaaasheer
Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.
Innallāha yudkhilul-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār(u), innallāha yaf‘alu mā yurīd(u).
ان الله يدخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر  ان الله يفعل ما يريد
indeed, allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. indeed, allah does what he intends.

innallahayudkhilullazinaamanuwaamilussalihatijannatintajrimintahtihalanharuinnallahayafalumayuriduinnaallahayudkhiluallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatijannatintajreemintahtihaalanharuinnaallahayafaaalumayureed

Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
Man kāna yaẓunnu allay yanṣurahullāhu fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samā'i ṡummalyaqṭa‘ falyanẓur hal yużhibanna kaiduhū mā yagīẓ(u).
من كان يظن ان لن ينصره الله في الدنيا والاخره فليمدد بسبب الي السماء ثم ليقطع فلينظر هل يذهبن كيده ما يغيظ

whoever should think that allah will not support him [i.e., prophet muhammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?

mankanayazunnuallayyansurahullahufiddunyawalakhiratifalyamdudbisababinilassamaisummalyaqtafalyanzurhalyuzhibannakaiduhumayagizumankanayathunnuanlanyansurahuallahufeeaddunyawalakhiratifalyamdudbisababinilaassamaithummaliyaqtaaafalyanthurhalyuthhibannakayduhumayagheeth
And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.
Wa każālika anzalnāhu āyātim bayyināt(in), wa annallāha yahdī may yurīd(u).
وكذلك انزلنه ءايت بينت وان الله يهدي من يريد
and thus have we sent it [i.e., the qur’an] down as verses of clear evidence and because allah guides whom he intends.
wakazalikaanzalnahuayatimbayyinatinwaannallahayahdimayyuriduwakathalikaanzalnahuayatinbayyinatinwaannaallahayahdeemanyureed

Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.
Innal-lażīna āmanū wal-lażīna hādū waṣ-ṣābi'īna wan-naṣārā wal-majūsa wal-lażīna asyrakū, innallāha yafṣilu bainahum yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in syahīd(un).
ان الذين ءامنوا والذين هادوا والصبين والنصري والمجوس والذين اشركوا ان الله يفصل بينهم يوم القيمه  ان الله علي كل شيء شهيد

indeed, those who have believed and those who were jews and the sabeans and the christians and the magians and those who associated with allah - allah will judge between them on the day of resurrection. indeed allah is, over all things, witness.



Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.

Alam tara annallāha yasjudu lahū man fis-samāwāti wa man fil-arḍi wasy-syamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujūmu wal-jibālu wasy-syajaru wad-dawābbu wa kaṡīrum minan-nās(i), wa kaṡīrun ḥaqqa ‘alaihil-‘ażāb(u), wa may yuhinillāhu famā lahū mim mukrim(in), innallāha yaf‘alu mā yasyā'(u).
الم تر ان الله يسجد له من في السموت ومن في الارض والشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناس  وكثير حق عليه العذاب  ومن يهن الله فما له من مكرم  ان الله يفعل ما يشاء

do you not see [i.e., know] that to allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? but upon many the punishment has been justified. and he whom allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. indeed, allah does what he wills.


These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
Hāżāni khaṣmānikhtaṣamū fī rabbihim fal-lażīna kafarū quṭṭi‘at lahum ṡiyābum min nār(in), yuṣabbu min fauqi ru'ūsihimul-ḥamīm(u).
هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم  فالذين كفروا قطعت لهم ثياب من نار يصب من فوق رءوسهم الحميم
these are two adversaries who have disputed over their lord. but those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. poured upon their heads will be scalding water

hazanikhasmanikhtasamufirabbihimfallazinakafaruquttiatlahumsiyabumminnarinyusabbuminfauqiruusihimulhamimuhathanikhasmaniikhtasamoofeerabbihimfallatheenakafarooquttiaaatlahumthiyabunminnarinyusabbuminfawqiruoosihimualhameem
By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
Yuṣharu bihī mā fī buṭūnihim wal-julūd(u).
يصهر به ما في بطونهم والجلود
by which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
yusharubihimafibutunihimwaljuluduyusharubihimafeebutoonihimwaljulood
And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
Wa lahum maqāmi‘u min ḥadīd(in).
ولهم مقمع من حديد
and for [striking] them are maces of iron.
walahummaqamiuminhadidinwalahummaqamiaauminhadeed
Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"
Kullamā arādū ay yakhrujū minhā min gammin u‘īdū fīhā, wa żūqū ‘ażābal-ḥarīq(i).
كلما ارادوا ان يخرجوا منها من غم اعيدوا فيها وذوقوا عذاب الحريق
every time they want to get out of it [i.e., hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "taste the punishment of the burning fire!"
kullamaaraduayyakhrujuminhamingamminuidufihawazuquazabalhariqikullamaaradooanyakhrujoominhaminghamminoaaeedoofeehawathooqooaaathabaalhareeq

Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
Innallāha yudkhilul-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru yuḥallauna fīhā min asāwira min żahabiw wa lu'lu'ā(n), wa libāsuhum fīhā ḥarīr(un).
ان الله يدخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر يحلون فيها من اساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا  ولباسهم فيها حرير

indeed, allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.

innallahayudkhilullazinaamanuwaamilussalihatijannatintajrimintahtihalanharuyuhallaunafihaminasawiraminzahabiwwaluluanwalibasuhumfihahariruninnaallahayudkhiluallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatijannatintajreemintahtihaalanharuyuhallawnafeehaminasawiraminthahabinwaluluanwalibasuhumfeehahareer
And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
Wa hudū ilaṭ-ṭayyibi minal-qaul(i), wa hudū ilā ṣirāṭil-ḥamīd(i).
وهدوا الي الطيب من القول وهدوا الي صرط الحميد
and they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the praiseworthy.
wahuduilattayyibiminalqauliwahuduilasiratilhamidiwahudooilaattayyibiminaalqawliwahudooilasiratialhameed

Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
Innal-lażīna kafarū wa yaṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi wal-masjidil-ḥarāmil-lażī ja‘alnāhu lin-nāsi sawā'anil-‘ākifu fīhi wal-bād(i), wa may yurid fīhi bi'ilḥādim biẓulmin nużiqhu min ‘ażābin alīm(in).
ان الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والمسجد الحرام الذي جعلنه للناس سواء العكف فيه والباد  ومن يرد فيه بالحاد بظلم نذقه من عذاب اليم

indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of allah and [from] al-masjid al-haram, which we made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - we will make him taste of a painful punishment.



And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
Wa iż bawwa'nā li'ibrāhīma makānal-baiti allā tusyrik bī syai'aw wa ṭahhir baitiya liṭ-ṭā'ifīna wal-qā'imīna war-rukka‘is-sujūd(i).
واذ بوانا لابرهيم مكان البيت ان لا تشرك بي شيا وطهر بيتي للطائفين والقائمين والركع السجود

and [mention, o muhammad], when we designated for abraham the site of the house, [saying], "do not associate anything with me and purify my house for those who perform tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.

waizbawwanaliibrahimamakanalbaitiallatusyrikbisyaiawwatahhirbaitiyalittaifinawalqaiminawarrukkaissujudiwaithbawwanaliibraheemamakanaalbaytianlatushrikbeeshayanwatahhirbaytiyalittaifeenawalqaimeenawarrukkaaaiassujood
And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
Wa ażżin fin-nāsi bil-ḥajji ya'tūka rijālaw wa ‘alā kulli ḍāmiriy ya'tīna min kulli fajjin ‘amīq(in).
واذن في الناس بالحج ياتوك رجالا وعلي كل ضامر ياتين من كل فج عميق
and proclaim to the people the hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
waazzinfinnasibilhajjiyatukarijalawwaalakullidamiriyyatinaminkullifajjinamiqinwaaththinfeeannasibilhajjiyatookarijalanwaaaalakullidamirinyateenaminkullifajjinaaameeq

That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
Liyasyhadū manāfi‘a lahum wa yażkurusmallāhi fī ayyāmim ma‘lūmātin ‘alā mā razaqahum mim bahīmatil-an‘ām(i), fa kulū minhā wa aṭ‘imul-bā'isal-faqīr(a).
ليشهدوا منفع لهم ويذكروا اسم الله في ايام معلومت علي ما رزقهم من بهيمه الانعم  فكلوا منها واطعموا البائس الفقير

that they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of allah on known [i.e., specific] days over what he has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. so eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.

liyasyhadumanafialahumwayazkurusmallahifiayyamimmalumatinalamarazaqahummimbahimatilanamifakuluminhawaatimulbaisalfaqiraliyashhadoomanafiaaalahumwayathkurooismaallahifeeayyaminmaaaloomatinaaalamarazaqahumminbaheematialanaaamifakuloominhawaataaimooalbaisaalfaqeer
Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."
Ṡummal yaqḍū tafaṡafahum wal yūfū nużūrahum wal yaṭṭawwafū bil-baitil-‘atīq(i).
ثم ليقضوا تفثهم وليوفوا نذورهم وليطوفوا بالبيت العتيق
then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform tawaf around the ancient house."
summalyaqdutafasafahumwalyufunuzurahumwalyattawwafubilbaitilatiqithummalyaqdootafathahumwalyoofoonuthoorahumwalyattawwafoobilbaytialaaateeq

That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
Żālika wa may yu‘aẓẓim ḥurumātillāhi fa huwa khairul lahū ‘inda rabbih(ī), wa uḥillat lakumul-an‘āmu illā mā yutlā ‘alaikum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-auṡāni wajtanibū qaulaz-zūr(i).
ذلك ومن يعظم حرمت الله فهو خير له عند ربه  واحلت لكم الانعم الا ما يتلي عليكم  فاجتنبوا الرجس من الاوثن واجتنبوا قول الزور

that [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of allah - it is best for him in the sight of his lord. and permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. so avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,



Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
Ḥunafā'a lillāhi gaira musyrikīna bih(ī), wa may yusyrik billāhi fa ka'annamā kharra minas-samā'i fa takhṭafuhuṭ-ṭairu au tahwī bihir-rīḥu fī makānin saḥīq(in).
حنفاء لله غير مشركين به  ومن يشرك بالله فكانما خر من السماء فتخطفه الطير او تهوي به الريح في مكان سحيق

inclining [only] to allah, not associating [anything] with him. and he who associates with allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.

hunafaalillahigairamusyrikinabihiwamayyusyrikbillahifakaannamakharraminassamaifatakhtafuhuttairuautahwibihirrihufimakaninsahiqinhunafaalillahighayramushrikeenabihiwamanyushrikbillahifakaannamakharraminaassamaifatakhtafuhuattayruawtahweebihiarreehufeemakaninsaheeq
That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
Żālika wa may yu‘aẓẓim sya‘ā'irallāhi fa innahā min taqwal-qulūb(i).
ذلك ومن يعظم شعئر الله فانها من تقوي القلوب
that [is so]. and whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
zalikawamayyuazzimsyaairallahifainnahamintaqwalqulubithalikawamanyuaaaththimshaaaairaallahifainnahamintaqwaalquloob
For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.
Lakum fīhā manāfi‘u ilā ajalim musamman ṡumma maḥilluhā ilal-baitil-‘atīq(i).
لكم فيها منفع الي اجل مسمي ثم محلها الي البيت العتيق
for you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient house.
lakumfihamanafiuilaajalimmusammansummamahilluhailalbaitilatiqilakumfeehamanafiaauilaajalinmusammanthummamahilluhailaalbaytialaaateeq

And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
Wa likulli ummatin ja‘alnā mansakal liyażkurusmallāhi ‘alā mā razaqahum mim bahīmatil-an‘ām(i), fa ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥidun fa lahū aslimū, wa basysyiril-mukhbitīn(a).
ولكل امه جعلنا منسكا ليذكروا اسم الله علي ما رزقهم من بهيمه الانعم  فالهكم اله وحد فله اسلموا  وبشر المخبتين

and for every [religious] community we have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of allah over what he has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. for your god is one god, so to him submit. and, [o muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their lord]

walikulliummatinjaalnamansakalliyazkurusmallahialamarazaqahummimbahimatilanamifailahukumilahuwwahidunfalahuaslimuwabasysyirilmukhbitinawalikulliommatinjaaaalnamansakanliyathkurooismaallahiaaalamarazaqahumminbaheematialanaaamifailahukumilahunwahidunfalahuaslimoowabashshirialmukhbiteen
Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
Allażīna iżā żukirallāhu wajilat qulūbuhum waṣ-ṣābirīna ‘alā mā aṣābahum wal-muqīmiṣ-ṣalāh(ti), wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn(a).
الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم والصبرين علي ما اصابهم والمقيمي الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
who, when allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what we have provided them.

allazinaizazukirallahuwajilatqulubuhumwassabirinaalamaasabahumwalmuqimissalahtiwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqunaallatheenaithathukiraallahuwajilatquloobuhumwassabireenaaaalamaasabahumwalmuqeemeeassalatiwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqoon

And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.

Wal-budna ja‘alnāhā lakum min sya‘ā'irillāhi lakum fīhā khair(un), fażkurusmallāhi ‘alaihā ṣawāff(a), fa iżā wajabat junūbuhā fa kulū minhā wa aṭ‘imul-qāni‘a wal-mu‘tarr(a), każālika sakhkharnāhā lakum la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
والبدن جعلنها لكم من شعئر الله لكم فيها خير  فاذكروا اسم الله عليها صواف  فاذا وجبت جنوبها فكلوا منها واطعموا القانع والمعتر  كذلك سخرنها لكم لعلكم تشكرون

and the camels and cattle we have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of allah; for you therein is good. so mention the name of allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. thus have we subjected them to you that you may be grateful.



Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.
Lay yanālallāha luḥūmuhā wa lā dimā'uhā wa lākiy yanāluhut-taqwā minkum, każālika sakhkharahā lakum litukabbirullāha ‘alā mā hadākum, wa basysyiril-muḥsinīn(a).
لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقوي منكم  كذلك سخرها لكم لتكبروا الله علي ما هديكم  وبشر المحسنين

their meat will not reach allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches him is piety from you. thus have we subjected them to you that you may glorify allah for that [to] which he has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

layyanalallahaluhumuhawaladimauhawalakiyyanaluhuttaqwaminkumkazalikasakhkharahalakumlitukabbirullahaalamahadakumwabasysyirilmuhsininalanyanalaallahaluhoomuhawaladimaohawalakinyanaluhuattaqwaminkumkathalikasakhkharahalakumlitukabbirooallahaaaalamahadakumwabashshirialmuhsineen
Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
Innallāha yudāfi‘u ‘anil-lażīna āmanū, innallāha lā yuḥibbu kulla khawwānin kafūr(in).
ان الله يدفع عن الذين ءامنوا  ان الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور
indeed, allah defends those who have believed. indeed, allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
innallahayudafiuanillazinaamanuinnallahalayuhibbukullakhawwaninkafurininnaallahayudafiaauaaaniallatheenaamanooinnaallahalayuhibbukullakhawwaninkafoor
Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.
Użina lil-lażīna yuqātalūna bi'annahum ẓulimū, wa innallāha ‘alā naṣrihim laqadīr(un).
اذن للذين يقتلون بانهم ظلموا  وان الله علي نصرهم لقدير
permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. and indeed, allah is competent to give them victory.
uzinalillazinayuqatalunabiannahumzulimuwainnallahaalanasrihimlaqadirunothinalillatheenayuqataloonabiannahumthulimoowainnaallahaaaalanasrihimlaqadeer

[They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

Allażīna ukhrijū min diyārihim bigairi ḥaqqin illā ay yaqūlū rabbunallāh(u), wa lau lā daf‘ullāhin-nāsa ba‘ḍahum biba‘ḍil lahuddimat ṣawāmi‘u wa biya‘uw wa ṣalawātuw wa masājidu yużkaru fīhasmullāhi kaṡīrā(n), wa layanṣurannallāhu may yanṣuruh(ū), innallāha laqawiyyun ‘azīz(un).
الذين اخرجوا من ديرهم بغير حق الا ان يقولوا ربنا الله  ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صومع وبيع وصلوت ومسجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا  ولينصرن الله من ينصره  ان الله لقوي عزيز

[they are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "our lord is allah." and were it not that allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of allah is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. and allah will surely support those who support him [i.e., his cause]. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might.


[And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
Allażīna im makkannāhum fil-arḍi aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta wa ātawuz-zakāta wa amarū bil-ma‘rūfi wa nahau ‘anil-munkar(i), wa lillāhi ‘āqibatul-umūr(i).
الذين ان مكنهم في الارض اقاموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه وامروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر  ولله عقبه الامور
[and they are] those who, if we give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. and to allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters.

allazinaimmakkannahumfilardiaqamussalatawaatawuzzakatawaamarubilmarufiwanahauanilmunkariwalillahiaqibatulumuriallatheenainmakkannahumfeealardiaqamooassalatawaatawooazzakatawaamaroobilmaaaroofiwanahawaaanialmunkariwalillahiaaaqibatualomoor
And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
Wa iy yukażżibūka faqad każżabat qablahum qaumu nūḥiw wa ‘āduw wa ṡamūd(u).
وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود
and if they deny you, [o muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of noah and ʿaad and thamud deny [their prophets],
waiyyukazzibukafaqadkazzabatqablahumqaumunuhiwwaaduwwasamuduwainyukaththibookafaqadkaththabatqablahumqawmunoohinwaaaadunwathamood
And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot.
Wa qaumu ibrāhīma wa qaumu lūṭ(in).
وقوم ابرهيم وقوم لوط
and the people of abraham and the people of lot.
waqaumuibrahimawaqaumulutinwaqawmuibraheemawaqawmuloot
And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
Wa aṣḥābu madyan(a), wa kużżiba mūsā fa amlaitu lil-kāfirīna ṡumma akhażtuhum, fa kaifa kāna nakīr(i).
واصحب مدين  وكذب موسي فامليت للكفرين ثم اخذتهم  فكيف كان نكير
and the inhabitants of madyan. and moses was denied, so i prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then i seized them, and how [terrible] was my reproach.
waashabumadyanawakuzzibamusafaamlaitulilkafirinasummaakhaztuhumfakaifakananakiriwaashabumadyanawakuththibamoosafaamlaytulilkafireenathummaakhathtuhumfakayfakananakeer
And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
Fa ka'ayyim min qaryatin ahlaknāhā wa hiya ẓālimatun fa hiya khāwiyatun ‘alā ‘urūsyihā, wa bi'rim mu‘aṭṭalatiw wa qaṣrim masyīd(in).
فكاين من قريه اهلكنها وهي ظالمه فهي خاويه علي عروشها وبئر معطله وقصر مشيد
and how many a city did we destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.

fakaayyimminqaryatinahlaknahawahiyazalimatunfahiyakhawiyatunalaurusyihawabirimmuattalatiwwaqasrimmasyidinfakaayyinminqaryatinahlaknahawahiyathalimatunfahiyakhawiyatunaaalaaaurooshihawabirinmuaaattalatinwaqasrinmasheed

So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
Afalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fa takūna lahum qulūbuy ya‘qilūna bihā au āżānuy yasma‘ūna bihā, fa innahā lā ta‘mal-abṣāru wa lākin ta‘mal-qulūbul-latī fiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
افلم يسيروا في الارض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها او ءاذان يسمعون بها  فانها لا تعمي الابصر ولكن تعمي القلوب التي في الصدور

so have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? for indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.

afalamyasirufilardifatakunalahumqulubuyyaqilunabihaauazanuyyasmaunabihafainnahalatamalabsaruwalakintamalqulubullatifissuduriafalamyaseeroofeealardifatakoonalahumquloobunyaaaqiloonabihaawathanunyasmaaaoonabihafainnahalataaamaalabsaruwalakintaaamaalquloobuallateefeeassudoor
And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
Wa yasta‘jilūnaka bil-‘ażābi wa lay yukhlifallāhu wa‘dah(ū), wa inna yauman ‘inda rabbika ka'alfi sanatim mimmā ta‘uddūn(a).
ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده  وان يوما عند ربك كالف سنه مما تعدون
and they urge you to hasten the punishment. but allah will never fail in his promise. and indeed, a day with your lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.

wayastajilunakabilazabiwalayyukhlifallahuwadahuwainnayaumanindarabbikakaalfisanatimmimmatauddunawayastaaajiloonakabilaaathabiwalanyukhlifaallahuwaaadahuwainnayawmanaaindarabbikakaalfisanatinmimmataaauddoon
And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
Wa ka'ayyim min qaryatin amlaitu lahā wa hiya ẓālimatun ṡumma akhażtuhā, wa ilayyal-maṣīr(u).
وكاين من قريه امليت لها وهي ظالمه ثم اخذتها والي المصير
and for how many a city did i prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. then i seized it, and to me is the [final] destination.
wakaayyimminqaryatinamlaitulahawahiyazalimatunsummaakhaztuhawailayyalmasiruwakaayyinminqaryatinamlaytulahawahiyathalimatunthummaakhathtuhawailayyaalmaseer
Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
Qul yā ayyuhan-nāsu innamā ana lakum nażīrum mubīn(un).
قل يايها الناس انما انا لكم نذير مبين
say, "o people, i am only to you a clear warner."
qulyaayyuhannasuinnamaanalakumnazirummubinunqulyaayyuhaannasuinnamaanalakumnatheerunmubeen
And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
Fal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum magfiratuw wa rizqun karīm(un).
فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره ورزق كريم
and those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
fallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilahummagfiratuwwarizqunkarimunfallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilahummaghfiratunwarizqunkareem
But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
Wal-lażīna sa‘au fī āyātinā mu‘ājizīna ulā'ika aṣḥābul-jaḥīm(i).
والذين سعوا في ءايتنا معجزين اولئك اصحب الجحيم
but the ones who strove against our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of hellfire.
wallazinasaaufiayatinamuajizinaulaikaashabuljahimiwallatheenasaaaawfeeayatinamuaaajizeenaolaikaashabualjaheem

And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
Wa mā arsalnā min qablika mir rasūliw wa lā nabiyyin illā iżā tamannā alqasy-syaiṭānu fī umniyyatih(ī), fa yansakhullāhu mā yulqisy-syaiṭānu ṡumma yuḥkimullāhu āyātih(ī), wallāhu ‘alīmun ḥakīm(un).
وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي الا اذا تمني القي الشيطن في امنيته فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطن ثم يحكم الله ءايته  والله عليم حكيم

and we did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. but allah abolishes that which satan throws in; then allah makes precise his verses. and allah is knowing and wise.


[That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
Liyaj‘ala mā yulqisy-syaiṭānu fitnatal lil-lażīna fī qulūbihim maraḍuw wal-qāsiyati qulūbuhum, wa innaẓ-ẓālimīna lafī syiqāqim ba‘īd(in).
ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطن فتنه للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسيه قلوبهم  وان الظلمين لفي شقاق بعيد
[that is] so he may make what satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. and indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.

liyajalamayulqisysyaitanufitnatallillazinafiqulubihimmaraduwwalqasiyatiqulubuhumwainnazzaliminalafisyiqaqimbaidinliyajaaalamayulqeeashshaytanufitnatanlillatheenafeequloobihimmaradunwalqasiyatiquloobuhumwainnaaththalimeenalafeeshiqaqinbaaaeed

And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
Wa liya‘lamal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma annahul-ḥaqqu mir rabbika fa yu'minū bihī fa tukhbita lahū qulūbuhum, wa innallāha lahādil-lażīna āmanū ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
وليعلم الذين اوتوا العلم انه الحق من ربك فيؤمنوا به فتخبت له قلوبهم  وان الله لهاد الذين ءامنوا الي صرط مستقيم

and so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. and indeed is allah the guide of those who have believed to a straight path.

waliyalamallazinautulilmaannahulhaqqumirrabbikafayuminubihifatukhbitalahuqulubuhumwainnallahalahadillazinaamanuilasiratimmustaqiminwaliyaaalamaallatheenaootooalaailmaannahualhaqquminrabbikafayuminoobihifatukhbitalahuquloobuhumwainnaallahalahadiallatheenaamanooilasiratinmustaqeem
But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
Wa lā yazālul-lażīna kafarū fī miryatim minhu ḥattā ta'tiyahumus-sā‘atu  bagtatan au ya'tiyahum ‘ażābu yaumin ‘aqīm(in).
