ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مريه منه حتي تاتيهم الساعه بغته او ياتيهم عذاب يوم عقيم
but those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren day.

walayazalullazinakafarufimiryatimminhuhattatatiyahumussaatubagtatanauyatiyahumazabuyauminaqiminwalayazaluallatheenakafaroofeemiryatinminhuhattatatiyahumuassaaaatubaghtatanawyatiyahumaaathabuyawminaaaqeem
[All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
Al-mulku yauma'iżil lillāh(i), yaḥkumu bainahum, fal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fī jannātin na‘īm(i).
الملك يومئذ لله يحكم بينهم  فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت في جنت النعيم
[all] sovereignty that day is for allah; he will judge between them. so they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the gardens of pleasure.
almulkuyaumaizillillahiyahkumubainahumfallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatifijannatinnaimialmulkuyawmaithinlillahiyahkumubaynahumfallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatifeejannatiannaaaeem
And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
Wal-lażīna kafarū wa każżabū bi'āyātinā fa ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābum muhīn(un).
والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا فاولئك لهم عذاب مهين
and they who disbelieved and denied our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
wallazinakafaruwakazzabubiayatinafaulaikalahumazabummuhinunwallatheenakafaroowakaththaboobiayatinafaolaikalahumaaathabunmuheen
And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.
Wal-lażīna hājarū fī sabīlillāhi ṡumma qutilū au mātū layarzuqannahumullāhu rizqan ḥasanā(n), wa innallāha lahuwa khairur-rāziqīn(a).
والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا او ماتوا ليرزقنهم الله رزقا حسنا  وان الله لهو خير الرزقين
and those who emigrated for the cause of allah and then were killed or died - allah will surely provide for them a good provision. and indeed, it is allah who is the best of providers.

wallazinahajarufisabilillahisummaqutiluaumatulayarzuqannahumullahurizqanhasananwainnallahalahuwakhairurraziqinawallatheenahajaroofeesabeeliallahithummaqutilooawmatoolayarzuqannahumuallahurizqanhasananwainnaallahalahuwakhayruarraziqeen
He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
Layudkhilannahum mudkhalay yarḍaunah(ū), wa innallāha la‘alīmun ḥalīm(un).
ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه  وان الله لعليم حليم
he will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, allah is knowing and forbearing.
layudkhilannahummudkhalayyardaunahuwainnallahalaalimunhalimunlayudkhilannahummudkhalanyardawnahuwainnaallahalaaaaleemunhaleem
That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
Żālika wa man ‘āqaba bimiṡli mā ‘ūqiba bihī ṡumma bugiya  ‘alaihi layanṣurannahullāh(u), innallāha la‘afuwwun gafūr(un).
ذلك ومن عاقب بمثل ما عوقب به ثم بغي عليه لينصرنه الله  ان الله لعفو غفور
that [is so]. and whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - allah will surely aid him. indeed, allah is pardoning and forgiving.

zalikawamanaqababimislimauqibabihisummabugiyaalaihilayansurannahullahuinnallahalaafuwwungafurunthalikawamanaaaqababimithlimaaaooqibabihithummabughiyaaaalayhilayansurannahuallahuinnaallahalaaaafuwwunghafoor
That is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
Żālika bi'annallāha yūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa yūlijun-nahāra fil-laili wa annallāha samī‘um baṣīr(un).
ذلك بان الله يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وان الله سميع بصير
that is because allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because allah is hearing and seeing.
zalikabiannallahayulijullailafinnahariwayulijunnaharafillailiwaannallahasamiumbasirunthalikabiannaallahayoolijuallaylafeeannahariwayoolijuannaharafeeallayliwaannaallahasameeaaunbaseer
That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
Żālika bi'annallāha huwal-ḥaqqu wa anna mā yad‘ūna min dūnihī huwal-bāṭilu wa annallāha huwal-‘aliyyul-kabīr(u).
ذلك بان الله هو الحق وان ما يدعون من دونه هو البطل وان الله هو العلي الكبير
that is because allah is the true reality, and that which they call upon other than him is falsehood, and because allah is the most high, the grand.
zalikabiannallahahuwalhaqquwaannamayadunamindunihihuwalbatiluwaannallahahuwalaliyyulkabiruthalikabiannaallahahuwaalhaqquwaannamayadaaoonamindoonihihuwaalbatiluwaannaallahahuwaalaaaliyyualkabeer
Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samā'i mā'ā(n), fa tuṣbiḥul-arḍu mukhḍarrah(tan), innallāha laṭīfun khabīr(un).
الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فتصبح الارض مخضره  ان الله لطيف خبير
do you not see that allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? indeed, allah is subtle and aware.
alamtaraannallahaanzalaminassamaimaanfatusbihulardumukhdarrahtaninnallahalatifunkhabirunalamtaraannaallahaanzalaminaassamaimaanfatusbihualardumukhdarrataninnaallahalateefunkhabeer
To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wa innallāha lahuwal-ganiyyul-ḥamīd(u).
له ما في السموت وما في الارض  وان الله لهو الغني الحميد
to him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. and indeed, allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy.
lahumafissamawatiwamafilardiwainnallahalahuwalganiyyulhamidulahumafeeassamawatiwamafeealardiwainnaallahalahuwaalghaniyyualhameed

Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
Alam tara annallāha sakhkhara lakum mā fil-arḍi wal-fulka tajrī fil-baḥri bi'amrih(ī), wa yumsikus-samā'a an taqa‘a ‘alal-arḍi illā bi'iżnih(ī), innallāha bin-nāsi lara'ūfur raḥīm(un).
الم تر ان الله سخر لكم ما في الارض والفلك تجري في البحر بامره ويمسك السماء ان تقع علي الارض الا باذنه  ان الله بالناس لرءوف رحيم

do you not see that allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by his command? and he restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by his permission. indeed allah, to the people, is kind and merciful.

alamtaraannallahasakhkharalakummafilardiwalfulkatajrifilbahribiamrihiwayumsikussamaaantaqaaalalardiillabiiznihiinnallahabinnasilaraufurrahimunalamtaraannaallahasakhkharalakummafeealardiwalfulkatajreefeealbahribiamrihiwayumsikuassamaaantaqaaaaaaalaalardiillabiithnihiinnaallahabinnasilaraoofunraheem
And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
Wa huwal-lażī aḥyākum, ṡumma yumītukum ṡumma yuḥyīkum, innal-insāna lakafūr(un).
وهو الذي احياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم  ان الانسن لكفور
and he is the one who gave you life; then he causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
wahuwallaziahyakumsummayumitukumsummayuhyikuminnalinsanalakafurunwahuwaallatheeahyakumthummayumeetukumthummayuhyeekuminnaalinsanalakafoor

For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
Likulli ummatin ja‘alnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu falā yunāzi‘unnaka fil-amri wad‘u ilā rabbik(a), innaka la‘alā hudam mustaqīm(in).
لكل امه جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه  فلا ينزعنك في الامر  وادع الي ربك  انك لعلي هدي مستقيم

for every [religious] community we have appointed rites which they perform. so, [o muhammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your lord. indeed, you are upon straight guidance.

likulliummatinjaalnamansakanhumnasikuhufalayunaziunnakafilamriwaduilarabbikainnakalaalahudammustaqiminlikulliommatinjaaaalnamansakanhumnasikoohufalayunaziaaunnakafeealamriwadaauilarabbikainnakalaaaalahudanmustaqeem
And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
Wa in jādalūka fa qulillāhu a‘lamu bimā ta‘malūn(a).
وان جدلوك فقل الله اعلم بما تعملون
and if they dispute with you, then say, "allah is most knowing of what you do.
wainjadalukafaqulillahualamubimatamalunawainjadalookafaquliallahuaaalamubimataaamaloon
Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
Allāhu yaḥkumu bainakum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn(a).
الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيمه فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
allah will judge between you on the day of resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
allahuyahkumubainakumyaumalqiyamatifimakuntumfihitakhtalifunaallahuyahkumubaynakumyawmaalqiyamatifeemakuntumfeehitakhtalifoon
Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
Alam ta‘lam annallāha ya‘lamu mā fis-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), inna żālika fī kitāb(in), inna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīr(un).
الم تعلم ان الله يعلم ما في السماء والارض  ان ذلك في كتب  ان ذلك علي الله يسير
do you not know that allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? indeed, that is in a record. indeed that, for allah, is easy.
alamtalamannallahayalamumafissamaiwalardiinnazalikafikitabininnazalikaalallahiyasirunalamtaaalamannaallahayaaalamumafeeassamaiwalardiinnathalikafeekitabininnathalikaaaalaallahiyaseer
And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
Wa ya‘budūna min dūnillāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānaw wa mā laisa lahum bihī ‘ilm(un), wa mā liẓ-ẓālimīna min naṣīr(in).
ويعبدون من دون الله ما لم ينزل به سلطنا وما ليس لهم به علم  وما للظلمين من نصير
and they worship besides allah that for which he has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. and there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
wayabudunamindunillahimalamyunazzilbihisultanawwamalaisalahumbihiilmunwamalizzaliminaminnasirinwayaaabudoonamindooniallahimalamyunazzilbihisultananwamalaysalahumbihiaailmunwamaliththalimeenaminnaseer

And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."

Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātin ta‘rifu fī wujūhil-lażīna kafarul-munkar(a), yakādūna yasṭūna bil-lażīna yatlūna ‘alaihim āyātinā, qul afa unabbi'ukum bisyarrim min żālikum, an-nār(u), wa‘adahallāhul-lażīna kafarū, wa bi'sal-maṣīr(u).
واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت تعرف في وجوه الذين كفروا المنكر  يكادون يسطون بالذين يتلون عليهم ءايتنا  قل افانبئكم بشر من ذلكم  النار وعدها الله الذين كفروا  وبئس المصير

and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. they are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them our verses. say, "then shall i inform you of [what is] worse than that? [it is] the fire which allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."



O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.

Yā ayyuhan-nāsu ḍuriba maṡalum fastami‘ū  lah(ū), innal-lażīna tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi lay yakhluqū żubābaw wa lawijtama‘ū lah(ū), wa iy yaslubhumuż-żubābu syai'al lā yastanqiżūhu minh(u), ḍa‘ufaṭ-ṭālibu wal-maṭlūb(u).
يايها الناس ضرب مثل فاستمعوا له  ان الذين تدعون من دون الله لن يخلقوا ذبابا ولو اجتمعوا له  وان يسلبهم الذباب شيا لا يستنقذوه منه  ضعف الطالب والمطلوب

o people, an example is presented, so listen to it. indeed, those you invoke besides allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. and if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. weak are the pursuer and pursued.


They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
Wa mā qadarullāha ḥaqqa qadrih(ī), innallāha laqawiyyun ‘azīz(un).
ما قدروا الله حق قدره  ان الله لقوي عزيز
they have not appraised allah with true appraisal. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might.
wamaqadarullahahaqqaqadrihiinnallahalaqawiyyunazizunmaqadarooallahahaqqaqadrihiinnaallahalaqawiyyunaaazeez
Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
Allāhu yaṣṭafī minal-malā'ikati rusulaw wa minan-nās(i), innallāha samī‘um baṣīr(un).
الله يصطفي من الملئكه رسلا ومن الناس  ان الله سميع بصير
allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. indeed, allah is hearing and seeing.
allahuyastafiminalmalaikatirusulawwaminannasiinnallahasamiumbasirunallahuyastafeeminaalmalaikatirusulanwaminaannasiinnaallahasameeaaunbaseer
He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.
Ya‘lamu mā baina aidīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa ilallāhi turja‘ul-umūr(u).
يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم  والي الله ترجع الامور
he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. and to allah will be returned [all] matters.
yalamumabainaaidihimwamakhalfahumwailallahiturjaulumuruyaaalamumabaynaaydeehimwamakhalfahumwailaallahiturjaaaualomoor
O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanurka‘ū wasjudū wa‘budū rabbakum waf‘alul-khaira la‘allakum  tufliḥūn(a).
يايها الذين ءامنوا اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم وافعلوا الخير لعلكم تفلحون
o you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your lord and do good - that you may succeed.
yaayyuhallazinaamanurkauwasjuduwabudurabbakumwafalulkhairalaallakumtuflihunayaayyuhaallatheenaamanooirkaaaoowasjudoowaaabudoorabbakumwafaaalooalkhayralaaaallakumtuflihoon

And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

Wa jāhidū fillāhi ḥaqqa jihādih(ī), huwajtabākum wa mā ja‘ala ‘alaikum fid-dīni min ḥaraj(in), millata abīkum ibrāhīm(a), huwa sammākumul-muslimīn(a), min qablu wa fī hāżā liyakūnar-rasūlu syahīdan ‘alaikum wa takūnū syuhadā'a ‘alan-nās(i), fa aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa ātuz-zakāta wa‘taṣimū billāh(i), huwa maulākum, fa ni‘mal-maulā wa ni‘man-naṣīr(u).

وجهدوا في الله حق جهاده  هو اجتبيكم وما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج  مله ابيكم ابرهيم  هو سميكم المسلمين من قبل وفي هذا ليكون الرسول شهيدا عليكم وتكونوا شهداء علي الناس  فاقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واعتصموا بالله هو موليكم  فنعم المولي ونعم النصير

and strive for allah with the striving due to him. he has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [it is] the religion of your father, abraham. he [i.e., allah] named you "muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. so establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to allah. he is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.


Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
Qad aflaḥal-mu'minūn(a).
قد افلح المؤمنون
certainly will the believers have succeeded:
qadaflahalmuminunaqadaflahaalmuminoon
They who are during their prayer humbly intent
Allażīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāsyi‘ūn(a).
الذين هم في صلاتهم خشعون
they who are during their prayer humbly intent
allazinahumfisalatihimkhasyiunaallatheenahumfeesalatihimkhashiaaoon
And they who turn away from ill speech
Wal-lażīna hum anil-lagwi muriḍūn(a).
والذين هم عن اللغو معرضون
and they who turn away from ill speech
wallazinahumanillagwimuridunawallatheenahumaaaniallaghwimuaaridoon
And they who are observant of zakāh
Wal-lażīna hum liz-zakāti fā‘ilūn(a).
والذين هم للزكوه فعلون
and they who are observant of zakah
wallazinahumlizzakatifailunawallatheenahumlizzakatifaaailoon
And they who guard their private parts
Wal-lażīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn(a).
والذين هم لفروجهم حفظون
and they who guard their private parts
wallazinahumlifurujihimhafizunawallatheenahumlifuroojihimhafithoon
Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
Illā ‘alā azwājihim au mā malakat aimānuhum fa innahum gairu malūmīn(a).
الا علي ازوجهم او ما ملكت ايمنهم فانهم غير ملومين
except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
illaalaazwajihimaumamalakataimanuhumfainnahumgairumaluminaillaaaalaazwajihimawmamalakataymanuhumfainnahumghayrumaloomeen
But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
Famanibtagā warā'a żālika fa ulā'ika humul-‘ādūn(a).
فمن ابتغي وراء ذلك فاولئك هم العادون
but whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
famanibtagawaraazalikafaulaikahumuladunafamaniibtaghawaraathalikafaolaikahumualaaadoon
And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
Wal-lażīna hum li'amānātihim wa ‘ahdihim rā‘ūn(a).
والذين هم لامنتهم وعهدهم رعون
and they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
wallazinahumliamanatihimwaahdihimraunawallatheenahumliamanatihimwaaaahdihimraaaoon
And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
Wal-lażīna hum ‘alā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūn(a).
والذين هم علي صلوتهم يحافظون
and they who carefully maintain their prayers -
wallazinahumalasalawatihimyuhafizunawallatheenahumaaalasalawatihimyuhafithoon
Those are the inheritors
Ulā'ika humul-wāriṡūn(a).
اولئك هم الورثون
those are the inheritors
ulaikahumulwarisunaolaikahumualwarithoon
Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
Allażīna yariṡūnal-firdaus(a), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).
الذين يرثون الفردوس هم فيها خلدون
who will inherit al-firdaus. they will abide therein eternally.
allazinayarisunalfirdausahumfihakhalidunaallatheenayarithoonaalfirdawsahumfeehakhalidoon
And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
Wa laqad khalaqnal-insāna min sulālatim min ṭīn(in).
ولقد خلقنا الانسن من سلله من طين
and certainly did we create man from an extract of clay.
walaqadkhalaqnalinsanaminsulalatimmintininwalaqadkhalaqnaalinsanaminsulalatinminteen
Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
Ṡumma ja‘alnāhu nuṭfatan fī qarārim makīn(in).
ثم جعلنه نطفه في قرار مكين
then we placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
summajaalnahunutfatanfiqararimmakininthummajaaaalnahunutfatanfeeqararinmakeen

Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.
Ṡumma khalaqnan-nuṭfata ‘alaqatan fa khalaqnal-‘alaqata muḍgatan fa khalaqnal-muḍgata ‘iẓāman fa kasaunal-‘iẓāma laḥmā(n), ṡumma ansya'nāhu khalqan ākhar(a), fa tabārakallāhu aḥsanul-khāliqīn(a).
ثم خلقنا النطفه علقه فخلقنا العلقه مضغه فخلقنا المضغه عظما فكسونا العظم لحما ثم انشانه خلقا ءاخر  فتبارك الله احسن الخلقين

then we made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and we made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and we made [from] the lump, bones, and we covered the bones with flesh; then we developed him into another creation. so blessed is allah, the best of creators.


Then indeed, after that you are to die.
Ṡumma innakum ba‘da żālika lamayyitūn(a).
ثم انكم بعد ذلك لميتون
then indeed, after that you are to die.
summainnakumbadazalikalamayyitunathummainnakumbaaadathalikalamayyitoon
Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
Ṡumma innakum yaumal-qiyāmati tub‘aṡūn(a).
ثم انكم يوم القيمه تبعثون
then indeed you, on the day of resurrection, will be resurrected.
summainnakumyaumalqiyamatitubasunathummainnakumyawmaalqiyamatitubaaathoon
And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
Wa laqad khalaqnā fauqakum sab‘a ṭarā'iq(a), wa mā kunnā ‘anil-khalqi gāfilīn(a).
ولقد خلقنا فوقكم سبع طرائق وما كنا عن الخلق غفلين
and we have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have we been of [our] creation unaware.
walaqadkhalaqnafauqakumsabataraiqawamakunnaanilkhalqigafilinawalaqadkhalaqnafawqakumsabaaataraiqawamakunnaaaanialkhalqighafileen
And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
Wa anzalnā minas-samā'i mā'am biqadarin fa askannāhu fil-arḍ(i), wa innā ‘alā żahābim bihī laqādirūn(a).
وانزلنا من السماء ماء بقدر فاسكنه في الارض  وانا علي ذهاب به لقدرون
and we have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. and indeed, we are able to take it away.
waanzalnaminassamaimaambiqadarinfaaskannahufilardiwainnaalazahabimbihilaqadirunawaanzalnaminaassamaimaanbiqadarinfaaskannahufeealardiwainnaaaalathahabinbihilaqadiroon
And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
Fa ansya'nā lakum bihī jannātim min nakhīliw wa a‘nāb(in), lakum fīhā fawākihu kaṡīratuw wa minhā ta'kulūn(a).
فانشانا لكم به جنت من نخيل واعنب لكم فيها فوكه كثيره ومنها تاكلون
and we brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
faansyanalakumbihijannatimminnakhiliwwaanabinlakumfihafawakihukasiratuwwaminhatakulunafaanshanalakumbihijannatinminnakheelinwaaaanabinlakumfeehafawakihukatheeratunwaminhatakuloon
And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
Wa syajaratan takhruju min ṭūri sainā'a tambutu bid-duhni wa ṣibgil lil-ākilīn(a).
وشجره تخرج من طور سيناء تنبت بالدهن وصبغ للاكلين
and [we brought forth] a tree issuing from mount sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
wasyajaratantakhrujuminturisainaatambutubidduhniwasibgillilakilinawashajaratantakhrujumintoorisaynaatanbutubidduhniwasibghinlilakileen
And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
Wa inna lakum fil-an‘āmi la‘ibrah(tan), nusqīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā wa lakum fīhā manāfi‘u kaṡīratuw wa minhā ta'kulūn(a).
وان لكم في الانعم لعبره  نسقيكم مما في بطونها ولكم فيها منفع كثيره ومنها تاكلون
and indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. we give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

wainnalakumfilanamilaibrahtannusqikummimmafibutunihawalakumfihamanafiukasiratuwwaminhatakulunawainnalakumfeealanaaamilaaaibratannusqeekummimmafeebutoonihawalakumfeehamanafiaaukatheeratunwaminhatakuloon
And upon them and on ships you are carried.
Wa ‘alaihā wa ‘alal-fulki tuḥmalūn(a).
وعليها وعلي الفلك تحملون
and upon them and on ships you are carried.
waalaihawaalalfulkituhmalunawaaaalayhawaaaalaalfulkituhmaloon
And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
Wa laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qaumihī fa qāla yā qaumi‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), afalā tattaqūn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه فقال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره  افلا تتقون
and we had certainly sent noah to his people, and he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him; then will you not fear him?"
walaqadarsalnanuhanilaqaumihifaqalayaqaumibudullahamalakumminilahingairuhuafalatattaqunawalaqadarsalnanoohanilaqawmihifaqalayaqawmioaabudooallahamalakumminilahinghayruhuafalatattaqoon

But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
Fa qālal-mala'ul-lażīna kafarū min qaumihī mā hāżā illā basyarum miṡlukum, yurīdu ay yatafaḍḍala ‘alaikum, wa lau syā'allāhu la'anzala malā'ikah(tan), mā sami‘nā bihāżā fī ābā'inal-awwalīn(a).
فقال الملؤا الذين كفروا من قومه ما هذا الا بشر مثلكم يريد ان يتفضل عليكم ولو شاء الله لانزل ملئكه ما سمعنا بهذا في ءابائنا الاولين

but the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "this is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if allah had willed [to send a messenger], he would have sent down angels. we have not heard of this among our forefathers.


He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
In huwa illā rajulum bihī jinnatun fa tarabbaṣū bihī ḥattā ḥīn(in).
ان هو الا رجل به جنه فتربصوا به حتي حين
he is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
inhuwaillarajulumbihijinnatunfatarabbasubihihattahinininhuwaillarajulunbihijinnatunfatarabbasoobihihattaheen
[Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
Qāla rabbinṣurnī bimā każżabūn(i).
قال رب انصرني بما كذبون
[noah] said, "my lord, support me because they have denied me."
qalarabbinsurnibimakazzabuniqalarabbionsurneebimakaththaboon

So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

Fa auḥainā ilaihi aniṣna‘il-fulka bi'a‘yuninā wa waḥyinā fa iżā jā'a amrunā wafārat-tannūr(u), fasluk fīhā min kullin zaujainiṡnaini wa ahlaka illā man sabaqa ‘alaihil-qaulu minhum, wa lā tukhāṭibnī fil-lażīna ẓalamū, innahum mugraqūn(a).
فاوحينا اليه ان اصنع الفلك باعيننا ووحينا فاذا جاء امرنا وفار التنور  فاسلك فيها من كل زوجين اثنين واهلك الا من سبق عليه القول منهم  ولا تخطبني في الذين ظلموا  انهم مغرقون

so we inspired to him, "construct the ship under our observation and our inspiration, and when our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. and do not address me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.


And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
Fa iżastawaita anta wa mam ma‘aka ‘alal-fulki fa qulil-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī najjānā minal-qaumiẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
فاذا استويت انت ومن معك علي الفلك فقل الحمد لله الذي نجينا من القوم الظلمين
and when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'praise to allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
faizastawaitaantawamammaakaalalfulkifaqulilhamdulillahillazinajjanaminalqaumizzaliminafaithaistawaytaantawamanmaaaakaaaalaalfulkifaqulialhamdulillahiallatheenajjanaminaalqawmiaththalimeen
And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
Wa qur rabbi anzilnī munzalam mubārakaw wa anta khairul-munzilīn(a).
وقل رب انزلني منزلا مباركا وانت خير المنزلين
and say, 'my lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and you are the best to accommodate [us].'"
waqurrabbianzilnimunzalammubarakawwaantakhairulmunzilinawaqulrabbianzilneemunzalanmubarakanwaantakhayrualmunzileen
Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
Inna fī żālika la'āyātiw wa in kunnā lamubtalīn(a).
ان في ذلك لايت وان كنا لمبتلين
indeed in that are signs, and indeed, we are ever testing [our servants].
innafizalikalaayatiwwainkunnalamubtalinainnafeethalikalaayatinwainkunnalamubtaleen
Then We produced after them a generation of others.
Ṡumma ansya'nā mim ba‘dihim qarnan ākharīn(a).
ثم انشانا من بعدهم قرنا ءاخرين
then we produced after them a generation of others.
summaansyanamimbadihimqarnanakharinathummaanshanaminbaaadihimqarnanakhareen
And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
Fa arsalnā fīhim rasūlam minhum ani‘budullāha mā lakum min ilāhin gairuh(ū), afalā tattaqūn(a).
فارسلنا فيهم رسولا منهم ان اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره  افلا تتقون
and we sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "worship allah; you have no deity other than him; then will you not fear him?"
faarsalnafihimrasulamminhumanibudullahamalakumminilahingairuhuafalatattaqunafaarsalnafeehimrasoolanminhumanioaabudooallahamalakumminilahinghayruhuafalatattaqoon

And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

Wa qālal-mala'u min qaumihil-lażīna kafarū wa każżabū biliqā'il-ākhirati wa atrafnāhum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, mā hāżā illā basyarum miṡlukum, ya'kulu mimmā ta'kulūna minhu wa yasyrabu mimmā tasyrabūn(a).
وقال الملا من قومه الذين كفروا وكذبوا بلقاء الاخره واترفنهم في الحيوه الدنيا ما هذا الا بشر مثلكم ياكل مما تاكلون منه ويشرب مما تشربون

and the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the hereafter while we had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "this is not but a man like yourselves. he eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.


And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
Wa la'in aṭa‘tum basyaram miṡlakum innakum iżal lakhāsirūn(a).
ولئن اطعتم بشرا مثلكم انكم اذا لخسرون
and if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
walainatatumbasyarammislakuminnakumizallakhasirunawalainataaatumbasharanmithlakuminnakumithanlakhasiroon
Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
Aya‘idukum annakum iżā mittum wa kuntum turābaw wa ‘iẓāman annakum mukhrajūn(a).
ايعدكم انكم اذا متم وكنتم ترابا وعظما انكم مخرجون
does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
ayaidukumannakumizamittumwakuntumturabawwaizamanannakummukhrajunaayaaaidukumannakumithamittumwakuntumturabanwaaaithamanannakummukhrajoon
How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
Haihāta haihāta limā tū‘adūn(a).
هيهات هيهات لما توعدون
how far, how far, is that which you are promised.
haihatahaihatalimatuadunahayhatahayhatalimatooaaadoon
It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
In hiya illā ḥayātunad-dun-yā namūtu wa naḥyā wa mā naḥnu bimab‘ūṡīn(a).
ان هي الا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
it [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
inhiyaillahayatunaddunyanamutuwanahyawamanahnubimabusinainhiyaillahayatunaaddunyanamootuwanahyawamanahnubimabaaootheen
He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
In huwa illā rajuluniftarā ‘alallāhi każibaw wa mā naḥnu lahū bimu'minīn(a).
ان هو الا رجل افتري علي الله كذبا وما نحن له بمؤمنين
he is not but a man who has invented a lie about allah, and we will not believe him."
inhuwaillarajuluniftaraalallahikazibawwamanahnulahubimumininainhuwaillarajuluniftaraaaalaallahikathibanwamanahnulahubimumineen
He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
Qāla rabbinṣurnī bimā każżabūn(i).
قال رب انصرني بما كذبون
he said, "my lord, support me because they have denied me."
qalarabbinsurnibimakazzabuniqalarabbionsurneebimakaththaboon
[Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
Qāla ‘ammā qalīlil layuṣbiḥunna nādimīn(a).
قال عما قليل ليصبحن ندمين
[allah] said, "after a little, they will surely become regretful."
qalaammaqalilillayusbihunnanadiminaqalaaaammaqaleelinlayusbihunnanadimeen
So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
Fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣaiḥatu bil-ḥaqqi fa ja'alahum guṡā'ā(n), fa bu‘dal lil-qaumiẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
فاخذتهم الصيحه بالحق فجعلنهم غثاء  فبعدا للقوم الظلمين
so the shriek seized them in truth, and we made them as [plant] stubble. then away with the wrongdoing people.
faakhazathumussaihatubilhaqqifajaalahumgusaanfabudallilqaumizzaliminafaakhathathumuassayhatubilhaqqifajaaaalnahumghuthaanfabuaadanlilqawmiaththalimeen
Then We produced after them other generations.
Ṡumma ansya'nā mim ba‘dihim qurūnan ākharīn(a).
ثم انشانا من بعدهم قرونا ءاخرين
then we produced after them other generations.
summaansyanamimbadihimqurunanakharinathummaanshanaminbaaadihimquroonanakhareen
No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wa mā yasta'khirūn(a).
ما تسبق من امه اجلها وما يستخرون
no nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
matasbiquminummatinajalahawamayastakhirunamatasbiquminommatinajalahawamayastakhiroon

Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
Ṡumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā, kullamā jā'a ummatar rasūluhā każżabūhu fa atba‘nā ba‘ḍahum ba‘ḍaw wa ja‘alnāhum aḥādīṡ(a), fa bu‘dal liqaumil lā yu'minūn(a).
ثم ارسلنا رسلنا تترا  كل ما جاء امه رسولها كذبوه  فاتبعنا بعضهم بعضا وجعلنهم احاديث  فبعدا لقوم لا يؤمنون

then we sent our messengers in succession. every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so we made them follow one another [to destruction], and we made them narrations. so away with a people who do not believe.

summaarsalnarusulanatatrakullamajaaummatarrasuluhakazzabuhufaatbanabadahumbadawwajaalnahumahadisafabudalliqaumillayuminunathummaarsalnarusulanatatrakullamajaaommatanrasooluhakaththaboohufaatbaaanabaaadahumbaaadanwajaaaalnahumahadeethafabuaadanliqawminlayuminoon
Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
Ṡumma arsalnā mūsā wa akhāhu hārūn(a), bi'āyātinā wa sulṭānim mubīn(in).
ثم ارسلنا موسي واخاه هرون بايتنا وسلطن مبين
then we sent moses and his brother aaron with our signs and a clear authority
summaarsalnamusawaakhahuharunabiayatinawasultanimmubininthummaarsalnamoosawaakhahuharoonabiayatinawasultaninmubeen
To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
Ilā fir‘auna wa mala'ihī fastakbarū wa kānū qauman ‘ālīn(a).
الي فرعون وملايه فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما عالين
to pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
ilafiraunawamalaihifastakbaruwakanuqaumanalinailafiraaawnawamalaihifastakbaroowakanooqawmanaaaleen
They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
Fa qālū anu'minu libasyaraini miṡlinā wa qaumuhumā lanā ‘ābidūn(a).
فقالوا انؤمن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عبدون
they said, "should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
faqaluanuminulibasyarainimislinawaqaumuhumalanaabidunafaqalooanuminulibasharaynimithlinawaqawmuhumalanaaaabidoon
So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
Fa każżabūhumā fa kānū minal-muhlakīn(a).
فكذبوهما فكانوا من المهلكين
so they denied them and were of those destroyed.
fakazzabuhumafakanuminalmuhlakinafakaththaboohumafakanoominaalmuhlakeen
And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
Wa laqad ātainā mūsal-kitāba la‘allahum yahtadūn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب لعلهم يهتدون
and we certainly gave moses the scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
walaqadatainamusalkitabalaallahumyahtadunawalaqadataynamoosaalkitabalaaaallahumyahtadoon
And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
Wa ja‘alnabna maryama wa ummahū āyataw wa āwaināhumā ilā rabwatin żāti qarāriw wa ma‘īn(in).
وجعلنا ابن مريم وامه ءايه وءاوينهما الي ربوه ذات قرار ومعين
and we made the son of mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
wajaalnabnamaryamawaummahuayatawwaawainahumailarabwatinzatiqarariwwamaininwajaaaalnaibnamaryamawaommahuayatanwaawaynahumailarabwatinthatiqararinwamaaaeen
[Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
Yā ayyuhar-rusulu kulū minaṭ-ṭayyibāti wa‘malū ṣāliḥā(n), innī bimā ta‘malūna ‘alīm(un).
يايها الرسل كلوا من الطيبت واعملوا صلحا  اني بما تعملون عليم
[allah said], "o messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. indeed i, of what you do, am knowing.
yaayyuharrusulukuluminattayyibatiwamalusalihaninnibimatamalunaalimunyaayyuhaarrusulukuloominaattayyibatiwaaamaloosalihaninneebimataaamaloonaaaaleem
And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
Wa inna hāżihī ummatukum ummataw wāḥidataw wa ana rabbukum fattaqūn(i).
وان هذه امتكم امه وحده وانا ربكم فاتقون
and indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so fear me."
wainnahazihiummatukumummatawwahidatawwaanarabbukumfattaquniwainnahathihiommatukumommatanwahidatanwaanarabbukumfattaqoon
But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
Fa taqaṭṭa‘ū amrahum bainahum zuburā(n), kullu ḥizbim bimā ladaihim fariḥūn(a).
فتقطعوا امرهم بينهم زبرا  كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
but they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
fataqattauamrahumbainahumzuburankulluhizbimbimaladaihimfarihunafataqattaaaooamrahumbaynahumzuburankulluhizbinbimaladayhimfarihoon
So leave them in their confusion for a time.
Fa żarhum fī gamratihim ḥattā ḥīn(in).
فذرهم في غمرتهم حتي حين
so leave them in their confusion for a time.
fazarhumfigamratihimhattahininfatharhumfeeghamratihimhattaheen
Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
Ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihī mim māliw wabanīn(a).
ايحسبون انما نمدهم به من مال وبنين
do they think that what we extend to them of wealth and children
ayahsabunaannamanumidduhumbihimimmaliwwabaninaayahsaboonaannamanumidduhumbihiminmalinwabaneen

Nusāri‘u lahum fil-khairāt(i), bal lā yasy‘urūn(a).
نسارع لهم في الخيرت  بل لا يشعرون
is [because] we hasten for them good things? rather, they do not perceive.
nusariulahumfilkhairatiballayasyurunanusariaaulahumfeealkhayratiballayashaauroon
Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
Innal-lażīna hum min khasy-yati rabbihim musyfiqūn(a).
ان الذين هم من خشيه ربهم مشفقون
indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their lord
innallazinahumminkhasyyatirabbihimmusyfiqunainnaallatheenahumminkhashyatirabbihimmushfiqoon
And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
Wal-lażīna hum bi'āyāti rabbihim yu'minūn(a).
والذين هم بايت ربهم يؤمنون
and they who believe in the signs of their lord
wallazinahumbiayatirabbihimyuminunawallatheenahumbiayatirabbihimyuminoon
And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
Wal-lażīna hum birabbihim lā yusyrikūn(a).
والذين هم بربهم لا يشركون
and they who do not associate anything with their lord
wallazinahumbirabbihimlayusyrikunawallatheenahumbirabbihimlayushrikoon
And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
Wal-lażīna yu'tūna mā ātaw wa qulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rāji‘ūn(a).
والذين يؤتون ما ءاتوا وقلوبهم وجله انهم الي ربهم رجعون
and they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their lord -
wallazinayutunamaatawwaqulubuhumwajilatunannahumilarabbihimrajiunawallatheenayutoonamaatawwaquloobuhumwajilatunannahumilarabbihimrajiaaoon
It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
Ulā'ika yusāri‘ūna fil-khairāti wa hum lahā sābiqūn(a).
اولئك يسرعون في الخيرت وهم لها سبقون
it is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
ulaikayusariunafilkhairatiwahumlahasabiqunaolaikayusariaaoonafeealkhayratiwahumlahasabiqoon
And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
Wa lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus‘ahā, wa ladainā kitābuy yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqqi wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ولا نكلف نفسا الا وسعها  ولدينا كتب ينطق بالحق  وهم لا يظلمون
and we charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
walanukallifunafsanillawusahawaladainakitabuyyantiqubilhaqqiwahumlayuzlamunawalanukallifunafsanillawusaaahawaladaynakitabunyantiqubilhaqqiwahumlayuthlamoon
But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
Bal qulūbuhum fī gamratim min hāżā wa lahum a‘mālum min dūni żālika hum lahā ‘āmilūn(a).
بل قلوبهم في غمره من هذا ولهم اعمل من دون ذلك هم لها عملون
but their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
balqulubuhumfigamratimminhazawalahumamalummindunizalikahumlahaamilunabalquloobuhumfeeghamratinminhathawalahumaaamalunmindoonithalikahumlahaaaamiloon
Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
Ḥattā iżā akhażnā mutrafīhim bil-‘ażābi iżā hum yaj'arūn(a).
حتي اذا اخذنا مترفيهم بالعذاب اذا هم يجرون
until when we seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to allah] for help.
hattaizaakhaznamutrafihimbilazabiizahumyajarunahattaithaakhathnamutrafeehimbilaaathabiithahumyajaroon
Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
Lā taj'arul-yaum(a), innakum minnā lā tunṣarūn(a).
لا تجروا اليوم  انكم منا لا تنصرون
do not cry out today. indeed, by us you will not be helped.
latajarulyaumainnakumminnalatunsarunalatajarooalyawmainnakumminnalatunsaroon
My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
Qad kānat āyātī tutlā ‘alaikum fa kuntum ‘alā a‘qābikum tankiṣūn(a).
قد كانت ءايتي تتلي عليكم فكنتم علي اعقبكم تنكصون
my verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
qadkanatayatitutlaalaikumfakuntumalaaqabikumtankisunaqadkanatayateetutlaaaalaykumfakuntumaaalaaaaqabikumtankisoon
In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
Mustakbirīn(a), bihī sāmiran tahjurūn(a).
مستكبرين به سمرا تهجرون
in arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
mustakbirinabihisamirantahjurunamustakbireenabihisamirantahjuroon
Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
Afalam yaddabbarul-qaula am jā'ahum mā lam ya'ti ābā'ahumul-awwalīn(a).
افلم يدبروا القول ام جاءهم ما لم يات ءاباءهم الاولين
then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the qur’an], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
afalamyaddabbarulqaulaamjaahummalamyatiabaahumulawwalinaafalamyaddabbarooalqawlaamjaahummalamyatiabaahumualawwaleen
Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
Am lam ya‘rifū rasūlahum fahum lahū munkirūn(a).
ام لم يعرفوا رسولهم فهم له منكرون
or did they not know their messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
amlamyarifurasulahumfahumlahumunkirunaamlamyaaarifoorasoolahumfahumlahumunkiroon
Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
Am yaqūlūna bihī jinnah(tun), bal jā'ahum bil-ḥaqqi wa akṡaruhum lil-ḥaqqi kārihūn(a).
ام يقولون به جنه  بل جاءهم بالحق واكثرهم للحق كرهون
or do they say, "in him is madness"? rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
amyaqulunabihijinnahtunbaljaahumbilhaqqiwaaksaruhumlilhaqqikarihunaamyaqooloonabihijinnatunbaljaahumbilhaqqiwaaktharuhumlilhaqqikarihoon

But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
Wa lawittaba‘al-ḥaqqu ahwā'ahum lafasadatis-samāwātu wal-arḍu wa man fīhinn(a), bal ataināhum biżikrihim fahum ‘an żikrihim mu‘riḍūn(a).
ولو اتبع الحق اهواءهم لفسدت السموت والارض ومن فيهن  بل اتينهم بذكرهم فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون

but if the truth [i.e., allah] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. rather, we have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

walawittabaalhaqquahwaahumlafasadatissamawatuwalarduwamanfihinnabalatainahumbizikrihimfahumanzikrihimmuridunawalawiittabaaaaalhaqquahwaahumlafasadatiassamawatuwalarduwamanfeehinnabalataynahumbithikrihimfahumaaanthikrihimmuaaridoon
Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
Am tas'aluhum kharjan fa kharāju rabbika khair(un), wa huwa khairur-rāziqīn(a).
ام تسلهم خرجا فخراج ربك خير  وهو خير الرزقين
or do you, [o muhammad], ask them for payment? but the reward of your lord is best, and he is the best of providers.
amtasaluhumkharjanfakharajurabbikakhairunwahuwakhairurraziqinaamtasaluhumkharjanfakharajurabbikakhayrunwahuwakhayruarraziqeen
And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

وانك لتدعوهم الي صرط مستقيم
and indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
wainnakalataduhumilasiratimmustaqiminwainnakalatadaaoohumilasiratinmustaqeem
But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
Wa innal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ‘aniṣ-ṣirāṭi lanākibūn(a).
وان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخره عن الصرط لنكبون
but indeed, those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the path.
wainnallazinalayuminunabilakhiratianissiratilanakibunawainnaallatheenalayuminoonabilakhiratiaaaniassiratilanakiboon

ولو رحمنهم وكشفنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا في طغينهم يعمهون
and even if we gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

ولقد اخذنهم بالعذاب فما استكانوا لربهم وما يتضرعون
and we had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
walaqadakhaznahumbilazabifamastakanulirabbihimwamayatadarraunawalaqadakhathnahumbilaaathabifamaistakanoolirabbihimwamayatadarraaaoon

Ḥattā iżā fataḥnā ‘alaihim bāban żā ‘ażābin syadīdin iżā hum fīhi mublisūn(a).
حتي اذا فتحنا عليهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد اذا هم فيه مبلسون
until when we have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
hattaizafatahnaalaihimbabanzaazabinsyadidinizahumfihimublisunahattaithafatahnaaaalayhimbabanthaaaathabinshadeedinithahumfeehimublisoon
And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

وهو الذي انشا لكم السمع والابصر والافده  قليلا ما تشكرون
and it is he who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
wahuwallaziyuhyiwayumituwalahukhtilafullailiwannahariafalataqilunawahuwaallatheeanshaalakumuassamaaawalabsarawalafidataqaleelanmatashkuroon

Bal qālū miṡla mā qālal-awwalūn(a).
وهو الذي ذراكم في الارض واليه تحشرون
and it is he who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to him you will be gathered.
balqalumislamaqalalawwalunawahuwaallatheetharaakumfeealardiwailayhituhsharoon
And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
Qālū a'iżā mitnā wa kunnā turābaw wa ‘iẓāman a'innā lamab‘ūṡūn(a).
وهو الذي يحي ويميت وله اختلف اليل والنهار  افلا تعقلون
and it is he who gives life and causes death, and his is the alternation of the night and the day. then will you not reason?
qaluaizamitnawakunnaturabawwaizamanainnalamabusunawahuwaallatheeyuhyeewayumeetuwalahuikhtilafuallayliwannahariafalataaaqiloon

بل قالوا مثل ما قال الاولون
rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
laqadwuidnanahnuwaabaunahazaminqabluinhazaillaasatirulawwalinabalqaloomithlamaqalaalawwaloon

Qālū a'iżā mitnā wa kunnā turābaw wa ‘iẓāman a'innā lamab‘ūṡūn(a).
قالوا اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبعوثون
they said, "when we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
qaluaizamitnawakunnaturabawwaizamanainnalamabusunaqalooaithamitnawakunnaturabanwaaaithamanainnalamabaaoothoon
We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

لقد وعدنا نحن وءاباؤنا هذا من قبل ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
we have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
laqadwuidnanahnuwaabaunahazaminqabluinhazaillaasatirulawwalinalaqadwuaaidnanahnuwaabaonahathaminqabluinhathaillaasateerualawwaleen
Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
Qul limanil-arḍu wa man fīhā in kuntum ta‘lamūn(a).
قل لمن الارض ومن فيها ان كنتم تعلمون
say, [o muhammad], "to whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
qullimanilarduwamanfihainkuntumtalamunaqullimanialarduwamanfeehainkuntumtaaalamoon

سيقولون لله  قل افلا تذكرون
they will say, "to allah." say, "then will you not remember?"
sayaqulunalillahiqulafalatazakkarunasayaqooloonalillahiqulafalatathakkaroon

say, "who is lord of the seven heavens and lord of the great throne?"
qulmarrabbussamawatissabiwarabbularsyilazimiqulmanrabbuassamawatiassabaaiwarabbualaaarshialaaatheem

Sayaqūlūna lillāh(i), qul afalā tattaqūn(a).
سيقولون لله  قل افلا تتقون
they will say, "[they belong] to allah." say, "then will you not fear him?"
sayaqulunalillahiqulafalatattaqunasayaqooloonalillahiqulafalatattaqoon
Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

قل من بيده ملكوت كل شيء وهو يجير ولا يجار عليه ان كنتم تعلمون
say, "in whose hand is the realm of all things - and he protects while none can protect against him - if you should know?"
qulmambiyadihimalakutukullisyaiiwwahuwayujiruwalayujarualaihiinkuntumtalamunaqulmanbiyadihimalakootukullishayinwahuwayujeeruwalayujaruaaalayhiinkuntumtaaalamoon
They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
Sayaqūlūna lillāh(i), qul fa annā tusḥarūn(a).
سيقولون لله  قل فاني تسحرون
they will say, "[all belongs] to allah." say, "then how are you deluded?"
sayaqulunalillahiqulfaannatusharunasayaqooloonalillahiqulfaannatusharoon
Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
Bal ataināhum bil-ḥaqqi wa innahum lakāżibūn(a).
بل اتينهم بالحق وانهم لكذبون
rather, we have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
balatainahumbilhaqqiwainnahumlakazibunabalataynahumbilhaqqiwainnahumlakathiboon

Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].
Mattakhażallāhu miw waladiw wa mā kāna ma‘ahū min ilāhin iżal lażahaba kullu ilāhim bimā khalaqa wa la‘alā ba‘ḍuhum ‘alā ba‘ḍ(in), subḥānallāhi ‘ammā yaṣifūn(a).
ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معه من اله  اذا لذهب كل اله بما خلق ولعلا بعضهم علي بعض  سبحن الله عما يصفون

allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with him any deity. [if there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. exalted is allah above what they describe [concerning him].

mattakhazallahumiwwaladiwwamakanamaahuminilahinizallazahabakulluilahimbimakhalaqawalaalabaduhumalabadinsubhanallahiammayasifunamaittakhathaallahuminwaladinwamakanamaaaahuminilahinithanlathahabakulluilahinbimakhalaqawalaaaalabaaaduhumaaalabaaadinsubhanaallahiaaammayasifoon
[He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
‘Ālimil-gaibi wasy-syahādati fa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
علم الغيب والشهده فتعلي عما يشركون
[he is] knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is he above what they associate [with him].
alimilgaibiwasysyahadatifataalaammayusyrikunaaaalimialghaybiwashshahadatifataaaalaaaammayushrikoon
Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
Qur rabbi immā turiyannī mā yū‘adūn(a).
قل رب اما تريني ما يوعدون
say, [o muhammad], "my lord, if you should show me that which they are promised,
qurrabbiimmaturiyannimayuadunaqulrabbiimmaturiyanneemayooaaadoon
My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
Rabbi falā taj‘alnī fil-qaumiẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
رب فلا تجعلني في القوم الظلمين
my lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
rabbifalatajalnifilqaumizzaliminarabbifalatajaaalneefeealqawmiaththalimeen
And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
Wa innā ‘alā an nuriyaka mā na‘iduhum laqādirūn(a).
وانا علي ان نريك ما نعدهم لقدرون
and indeed, we are able to show you what we have promised them.
wainnaalaannuriyakamanaiduhumlaqadirunawainnaaaalaannuriyakamanaaaiduhumlaqadiroon
Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
Idfa‘ bil-latī hiya aḥsanus-sayyi'ah(ta), naḥnu a‘lamu bimā yaṣifūn(a).
ادفع بالتي هي احسن السيئه  نحن اعلم بما يصفون
repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. we are most knowing of what they describe.
idfabillatihiyaahsanussayyiahtanahnualamubimayasifunaidfaaabillateehiyaahsanuassayyiatanahnuaaalamubimayasifoon
And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
Wa qur rabbi a‘ūżu bika min hamazātisy-syayāṭīn(i).
وقل رب اعوذ بك من همزت الشيطين
and say, "my lord, i seek refuge in you from the incitements of the devils,
waqurrabbiauzubikaminhamazatisysyayatiniwaqulrabbiaaaoothubikaminhamazatiashshayateen
And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
Wa a‘ūżu bika rabbi ay yaḥḍurūn(i).
واعوذ بك رب ان يحضرون
and i seek refuge in you, my lord, lest they be present with me."
waauzubikarabbiayyahduruniwaaaaoothubikarabbianyahduroon
[For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
Ḥattā iżā jā'a aḥadahumul-mautu qāla rabbirji‘ūn(i).
حتي اذا جاء احدهم الموت قال رب ارجعون
[for such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "my lord, send me back
hattaizajaaahadahumulmautuqalarabbirjiunihattaithajaaahadahumualmawtuqalarabbiirjiaaoon
That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
La‘allī a‘malu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā, innahā kalimatun huwa qā'iluhā, wa miw warā'ihim barzakhun ilā yaumi yub‘aṡūn(a).
لعلي اعمل صلحا فيما تركت  كلا  انها كلمه هو قائلها  ومن ورائهم برزخ الي يوم يبعثون
that i might do righteousness in that which i left behind." no! it is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the day they are resurrected.

laalliamalusalihanfimataraktukallainnahakalimatunhuwaqailuhawamiwwaraihimbarzakhunilayaumiyubasunalaaaalleeaaamalusalihanfeemataraktukallainnahakalimatunhuwaqailuhawaminwaraihimbarzakhunilayawmiyubaaathoon
So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
Fa iżā nufikha fiṣ-ṣūri falā ansāba bainahum yauma'iżiw wa lā yatasā'alūn(a).
فاذا نفخ في الصور فلا انساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلون
so when the horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that day, nor will they ask about one another.
faizanufikhafissurifalaansababainahumyaumaiziwwalayatasaalunafaithanufikhafeeassoorifalaansababaynahumyawmaithinwalayatasaaloon
And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
Faman ṡaqulat mawāzīnuhū fa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
فمن ثقلت موزينه فاولئك هم المفلحون
and those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
famansaqulatmawazinuhufaulaikahumulmuflihunafamanthaqulatmawazeenuhufaolaikahumualmuflihoon
But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
Wa man khaffat mawāzīnuhū fa ulā'ikal-lażīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūn(a).
ومن خفت موزينه فاولئك الذين خسروا انفسهم في جهنم خلدون
but those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in hell, abiding eternally.
wamankhaffatmawazinuhufaulaikallazinakhasiruanfusahumfijahannamakhalidunawamankhaffatmawazeenuhufaolaikaallatheenakhasirooanfusahumfeejahannamakhalidoon
The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
Talfaḥu wujūhahumun-nāru wa hum fīhā kāliḥūn(a).
تلفح وجوههم النار وهم فيها كلحون
the fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
talfahuwujuhahumunnaruwahumfihakalihunatalfahuwujoohahumuannaruwahumfeehakalihoon
[It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
Alam takun āyātī tutlā ‘alaikum fa kuntum bihā tukażżibūn(a).
الم تكن ءايتي تتلي عليكم فكنتم بها تكذبون
[it will be said], "were not my verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
alamtakunayatitutlaalaikumfakuntumbihatukazzibunaalamtakunayateetutlaaaalaykumfakuntumbihatukaththiboon
They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
Qālū rabbanā galabat ‘alainā syiqwatunā wa kunnā qauman ḍāllīn(a).
قالوا ربنا غلبت علينا شقوتنا وكنا قوما ضالين
they will say, "our lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
qalurabbanagalabatalainasyiqwatunawakunnaqaumandallinaqaloorabbanaghalabataaalaynashiqwatunawakunnaqawmandalleen
Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
Rabbanā akhrijnā minhā fa in ‘udnā fa innā ẓālimūn(a).
ربنا اخرجنا منها فان عدنا فانا ظلمون
our lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
rabbanaakhrijnaminhafainudnafainnazalimunarabbanaakhrijnaminhafainaaudnafainnathalimoon
He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
Qālakhsa'ū fīhā wa lā tukallimūn(i).
قال اخسوا فيها ولا تكلمون
he will say, "remain despised therein and do not speak to me.
qalakhsaufihawalatukallimuniqalaikhsaoofeehawalatukallimoon
Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
Innahū kāna farīqum min ‘ibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fagfir lanā warḥamnā wa anta khairur-rāḥimīn(a).
انه كان فريق من عبادي يقولون ربنا ءامنا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا وانت خير الرحمين
indeed, there was a party of my servants who said, 'our lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and you are the best of the merciful.'
innahukanafariqumminibadiyaqulunarabbanaamannafagfirlanawarhamnawaantakhairurrahiminainnahukanafareequnminaaibadeeyaqooloonarabbanaamannafaghfirlanawarhamnawaantakhayruarrahimeen
But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
Fattakhażtumūhum sikhriyyan ḥattā ansaukum żikrī wa kuntum minhum taḍḥakūn(a).
فاتخذتموهم سخريا حتي انسوكم ذكري وكنتم منهم تضحكون
but you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget my remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
fattakhaztumuhumsikhriyyanhattaansaukumzikriwakuntumminhumtadhakunafattakhathtumoohumsikhriyyanhattaansawkumthikreewakuntumminhumtadhakoon
Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
Innī jazaituhumul-yauma bimā ṣabarū, annahum humul-fā'izūn(a).
اني جزيتهم اليوم بما صبروا انهم هم الفائزون
indeed, i have rewarded them this day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
innijazaituhumulyaumabimasabaruannahumhumulfaizunainneejazaytuhumualyawmabimasabarooannahumhumualfaizoon
[Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
Qāla kam labiṡtum fil-arḍi ‘adada sinīn(a).
قل كم لبثتم في الارض عدد سنين
[allah] will say, "how long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
qalakamlabistumfilardiadadasininaqalakamlabithtumfeealardiaaadadasineen
They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
Qālū labiṡnā yauman au baḍa yaumin fas'alil-‘āddīn(a).
قالوا لبثنا يوما او بعض يوم فسل العادين
they will say, "we remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
qalulabisnayaumanaubadayauminfasaliladdinaqaloolabithnayawmanawbaaadayawminfasalialaaaddeen
He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
Qāla il labiṡtum illā qalīlal lau annakum kuntum ta‘lamūn(a).
قل ان لبثتم الا قليلا  لو انكم كنتم تعلمون
he will say, "you stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
qalaillabistumillaqalilallauannakumkuntumtalamunaqalainlabithtumillaqaleelanlawannakumkuntumtaaalamoon
Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
Afa ḥasibtum annamā khalaqnākum ‘abaṡaw wa annakum ilainā lā turja‘ūn(a).
افحسبتم انما خلقنكم عبثا وانكم الينا لا ترجعون
then did you think that we created you uselessly and that to us you would not be returned?"
afahasibtumannamakhalaqnakumabasawwaannakumilainalaturjaunaafahasibtumannamakhalaqnakumaaabathanwaannakumilaynalaturjaaaoon
So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
Fa ta‘ālallāhul-malikul-ḥaqq(u), lā ilāha illā huw(a), rabbul-‘arsyil-karīm(i).
فتعلي الله الملك الحق  لا اله الا هو رب العرش الكريم
so exalted is allah, the sovereign, the truth; there is no deity except him, lord of the noble throne.
fataalallahulmalikulhaqqulailahaillahuwarabbularsyilkarimifataaaalaallahualmalikualhaqqulailahaillahuwarabbualaaarshialkareem
And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
Wa may yad‘u ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara lā burhāna lahū bih(ī), fa innamā ḥisābuhū ‘inda rabbih(ī), innahū lā yufliḥul-kāfirūn(a).
ومن يدع مع الله الها ءاخر لا برهن له به فانما حسابه عند ربه  انه لا يفلح الكفرون
and whoever invokes besides allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his lord. indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

wamayyadumaallahiilahanakharalaburhanalahubihifainnamahisabuhuindarabbihiinnahulayuflihulkafirunawamanyadaaumaaaaallahiilahanakharalaburhanalahubihifainnamahisabuhuaaindarabbihiinnahulayuflihualkafiroon
And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
Wa qur rabbigfir warḥam wa anta khairur-rāḥimīn(a).
وقل رب اغفر وارحم وانت خير الرحمين
and, [o muhammad], say, "my lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the best of the merciful."
waqurrabbigfirwarhamwaantakhairurrahiminawaqulrabbiighfirwarhamwaantakhayruarrahimeen
[This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
Sūratun anzalnāhā wa faraḍnāhā wa anzalnā fīhā āyātim bayyinātil la‘allakum tażakkarūn(a).
سوره انزلنها وفرضنها وانزلنا فيها ءايت بينت لعلكم تذكرون
[this is] a surah which we have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
suratunanzalnahawafaradnahawaanzalnafihaayatimbayyinatillaallakumtazakkarunasooratunanzalnahawafaradnahawaanzalnafeehaayatinbayyinatinlaaaallakumtathakkaroon

The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.

Az-zāniyatu waz-zānī fajlidū kulla wāḥidim minhumā mi'ata jaldah(tan), wa lā ta'khużkum bihimā ra'fatun fī dīnillāhi in kuntum tu'minūna billāhi wal-yaumil-ākhir(i), walyasyhad ‘ażābahumā ṭā'ifatum minal-mu'minīn(a).
الزانيه والزاني فاجلدوا كل وحد منهما مائه جلده  ولا تاخذكم بهما رافه في دين الله ان كنتم تؤمنون بالله واليوم الاخر  وليشهد عذابهما طائفه من المؤمنين

the [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of allah, if you should believe in allah and the last day. and let a group of the believers witness their punishment.



The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.
Az-zānī lā yankiḥu illā zāniyatan au musyrikah(tan), waz-zāniyatu lā yankiḥuhā illā zānin au musyrik(un), wa ḥurrima żālika ‘alal-mu'minīn(a).
الزاني لا ينكح الا زانيه او مشركه والزانيه لا ينكحها الا زان او مشرك  وحرم ذلك علي المؤمنين

the fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.

azzanilayankihuillazaniyatanaumusyrikahtanwazzaniyatulayankihuhaillazaninaumusyrikunwahurrimazalikaalalmumininaazzaneelayankihuillazaniyatanawmushrikatanwazzaniyatulayankihuhaillazaninawmushrikunwahurrimathalikaaaalaalmumineen
And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
Wal-lażīna yarmūnal-muḥṣanāti ṡumma lam ya'tū bi'arba‘ati syuhadā'a fajlidūhum ṡamānīna jaldataw wa lā taqbalū lahum syahādatan abadā(n), wa ulā'ika humul-fāsiqūn(a).
والذين يرمون المحصنت ثم لم ياتوا باربعه شهداء فاجلدوهم ثمنين جلده ولا تقبلوا لهم شهده ابدا  واولئك هم الفسقون
and those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. and those are the defiantly disobedient,

wallazinayarmunalmuhsanatisummalamyatubiarbaatisyuhadaafajliduhumsamaninajaldatawwalataqbalulahumsyahadatanabadanwaulaikahumulfasiqunawallatheenayarmoonaalmuhsanatithummalamyatoobiarbaaaatishuhadaafajlidoohumthamaneenajaldatanwalataqbaloolahumshahadatanabadanwaolaikahumualfasiqoon
Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
Illal-lażīna tābū mim ba‘di żālika wa aṣlaḥū, fa innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).
الا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك واصلحوا فان الله غفور رحيم
except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful.
illallazinatabumimbadizalikawaaslahufainnallahagafururrahimunillaallatheenataboominbaaadithalikawaaslahoofainnaallahaghafoorunraheem

And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.
Wal-lażīna yarmūna azwājahum wa lam yakul lahum syuhadā'u illā anfusuhum fa syahādatu aḥadihim arba‘u syahādātim billāh(i), innahū laminaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
والذين يرمون ازوجهم ولم يكن لهم شهداء الا انفسهم فشهده احدهم اربع شهدت بالله  انه لمن الصدقين

and those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by allah that indeed, he is of the truthful.

wallazinayarmunaazwajahumwalamyakullahumsyuhadauillaanfusuhumfasyahadatuahadihimarbausyahadatimbillahiinnahulaminassadiqinawallatheenayarmoonaazwajahumwalamyakunlahumshuhadaoillaanfusuhumfashahadatuahadihimarbaaaushahadatinbillahiinnahulaminaassadiqeen
And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.
Wal-khāmisatu anna la‘natallāhi ‘alaihi in kāna minal-kāżibīn(a).
والخمسه ان لعنت الله عليه ان كان من الكذبين
and the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of allah be upon him if he should be of the liars.
walkhamisatuannalanatallahialaihiinkanaminalkazibinawalkhamisatuannalaaanataallahiaaalayhiinkanaminaalkathibeen
But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.
Wa yadra'u ‘anhal-‘ażāba an tasyhada arba‘a syahādātim billāhi innahū laminal-kāżibīn(a).
ويدرؤا عنها العذاب ان تشهد اربع شهدت بالله  انه لمن الكذبين
but it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by allah that indeed, he is of the liars.
wayadrauanhalazabaantasyhadaarbaasyahadatimbillahiinnahulaminalkazibinawayadraoaaanhaalaaathabaantashhadaarbaaaashahadatinbillahiinnahulaminaalkathibeen
And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
Wal-khāmisata anna gaḍaballāhi ‘alaihā in kāna minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
والخمسه ان غضب الله عليها ان كان من الصدقين
and the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of allah be upon her if he was of the truthful.
walkhamisataannagadaballahialaihainkanaminassadiqinawalkhamisataannaghadabaallahiaaalayhainkanaminaassadiqeen
And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.
Wa lau lā faḍlullāhi ‘alaikum wa raḥmatuhū wa annallāha tawwābun ḥakīm(un).
ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وان الله تواب حكيم
and if not for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy... and because allah is accepting of repentance and wise.
walaulafadlullahialaikumwarahmatuhuwaannallahatawwabunhakimunwalawlafadluallahiaaalaykumwarahmatuhuwaannaallahatawwabunhakeem

Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
Innal-lażīna jā'ū bil-ifki ‘uṣbatum minkum, lā taḥsabūhu syarral lakum, bal huwa khairul lakum, likullimri'im minhum maktasaba minal-iṡm(i), wal-lażī tawallā kibrahū minhum lahū ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
ان الذين جاءو بالافك عصبه منكم  لا تحسبوه شرا لكم  بل هو خير لكم  لكل امرئ منهم ما اكتسب من الاثم  والذي تولي كبره منهم له عذاب عظيم

indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. for every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., hellfire].


Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
Lau lā iż sami‘tumūhu ẓannal-mu'minūna wal-mu'minātu bi'anfusihim khairā(n), wa qālū hāżā ifkum mubīn(un).
لولا اذ سمعتموه ظن المؤمنون والمؤمنت بانفسهم خيرا وقالوا هذا افك مبين
why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "this is an obvious falsehood"?
laulaizsamitumuhuzannalmuminunawalmuminatubianfusihimkhairanwaqaluhazaifkummubinunlawlaithsamiaatumoohuthannaalmuminoonawalmuminatubianfusihimkhayranwaqaloohathaifkunmubeen
Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.
Lau lā jā'ū ‘alaihi bi'arba‘ati syuhadā'(a), fa iż lam ya'tū bisy-syuhadā'i fa ulā'ika ‘indallāhi humul-kāżibūn(a).
لولا جاءو عليه باربعه شهداء  فاذ لم ياتوا بالشهداء فاولئك عند الله هم الكذبون
why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? and when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of allah, who are the liars.
laulajaualaihibiarbaatisyuhadaafaizlamyatubisysyuhadaifaulaikaindallahihumulkazibunalawlajaooaaalayhibiarbaaaatishuhadaafaithlamyatoobishshuhadaifaolaikaaaindaallahihumualkathiboon
And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
Wa lau lā faḍlullāhi ‘alaikum wa raḥmatuhū fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirati lamassakum fīmā afaḍtum fīhi ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته في الدنيا والاخره لمسكم في ما افضتم فيه عذاب عظيم
and if it had not been for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy in this world and the hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
walaulafadlullahialaikumwarahmatuhufiddunyawalakhiratilamassakumfimaafadtumfihiazabunazimunwalawlafadluallahiaaalaykumwarahmatuhufeeaddunyawalakhiratilamassakumfeemaafadtumfeehiaaathabunaaatheem
When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
Iż talaqqaunahū bi'alsinatikum wa taqūlūna bi'afwāhikum mā laisa lakum bihī ‘ilmuw wa taḥsabūnahū hayyinā(n), wa huwa ‘indallāhi ‘aẓīm(un).
اذ تلقونه بالسنتكم وتقولون بافواهكم ما ليس لكم به علم وتحسبونه هينا وهو عند الله عظيم
when you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of allah, tremendous.

iztalaqqaunahubialsinatikumwataqulunabiafwahikummalaisalakumbihiilmuwwatahsabunahuhayyinanwahuwaindallahiazimunithtalaqqawnahubialsinatikumwataqooloonabiafwahikummalaysalakumbihiaailmunwatahsaboonahuhayyinanwahuwaaaindaallahiaaatheem
And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?
Wa lau lā iż sami‘tumūhu qultum mā yakūnu lanā an natakallama bihāżā, subḥānaka hāżā buhtānun ‘aẓīm(un).
ولولا اذ سمعتموه قلتم ما يكون لنا ان نتكلم بهذا سبحنك هذا بهتن عظيم
and why, when you heard it, did you not say, "it is not for us to speak of this. exalted are you, [o allah]; this is a great slander"?
walaulaizsamitumuhuqultummayakunulanaannatakallamabihazasubhanakahazabuhtanunazimunwalawlaithsamiaatumoohuqultummayakoonulanaannatakallamabihathasubhanakahathabuhtanunaaatheem
Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
Ya‘iẓukumullāhu an ta‘ūdū limiṡlihī abadan in kuntum mu'minīn(a).
يعظكم الله ان تعودوا لمثله ابدا ان كنتم مؤمنين
allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
yaizukumullahuantaudulimislihiabadaninkuntummumininayaaaithukumuallahuantaaaoodoolimithlihiabadaninkuntummumineen
And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
Wa yubayyinullāhu lakumul-āyāt(i), wallāhu ‘alīmun ḥakīm(un).
ويبين الله لكم الايت  والله عليم حكيم
and allah makes clear to you the verses [i.e., his rulings], and allah is knowing and wise.
wayubayyinullahulakumulayatiwallahualimunhakimunwayubayyinuallahulakumualayatiwallahuaaaleemunhakeem

Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.
Innal-lażīna yuḥibbūna an tasyī‘al-fāḥisyatu fil-lażīna āmanū lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un), fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wallāhu ya‘lamu wa antum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ان الذين يحبون ان تشيع الفحشه في الذين ءامنوا لهم عذاب اليم في الدنيا والاخره  والله يعلم وانتم لا تعلمون

indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the hereafter. and allah knows and you do not know.

innallazinayuhibbunaantasyialfahisyatufillazinaamanulahumazabunalimunfiddunyawalakhirahtiwallahuyalamuwaantumlatalamunainnaallatheenayuhibboonaantasheeaaaalfahishatufeeallatheenaamanoolahumaaathabunaleemunfeeaddunyawalakhiratiwallahuyaaalamuwaantumlataaalamoon
And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.
Wa lau lā faḍlullāhi ‘alaikum wa raḥmatuhū wa annallāha ra'ūfur raḥīm(un).
ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وان الله رءوف رحيم
and if it had not been for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy... and because allah is kind and merciful.
walaulafadlullahialaikumwarahmatuhuwaannallaharaufurrahimunwalawlafadluallahiaaalaykumwarahmatuhuwaannaallaharaoofunraheem

O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā tattabi‘ū khuṭuwātisy-syaiṭān(i), wa may yattabi‘ khuṭuwātisy-syaiṭāni fa innahū ya'muru bil-faḥsyā'i wal-munkar(i), wa lau lā faḍlullāhi ‘alaikum wa raḥmatuhū mā zakā minkum min aḥadin abadā(n), wa lākinnallāha yuzakkī may yasyā'(u), wallāhu samī‘un ‘alīm(un).
يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتبعوا خطوت الشيطن  ومن يتبع خطوت الشيطن فانه يامر بالفحشاء والمنكر  ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته ما زكي منكم من احد ابدا ولكن الله يزكي من يشاء  والله سميع عليم

o you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of satan. and whoever follows the footsteps of satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. and if not for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but allah purifies whom he wills, and allah is hearing and knowing.



And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
Wa lā ya'tali ulul-faḍli minkum was-sa‘ati ay yu'tū ulil-qurbā wal-masākīna wal-muhājirīna fī sabīlillāh(i), wal ya‘fū wal yaṣfaḥū, alā tuḥibbūna ay yagfirallāhu lakum, wallāhu gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ولا ياتل اولوا الفضل منكم والسعه ان يؤتوا اولي القربي والمسكين والمهجرين في سبيل الله  وليعفوا وليصفحوا  الا تحبون ان يغفر الله لكم  والله غفور رحيم

and let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of allah, and let them pardon and overlook. would you not like that allah should forgive you? and allah is forgiving and merciful.


Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
Innal-lażīna yarmūnal-muḥṣanātil-gāfilātil-mu'mināti lu‘inū fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa lahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
