Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
Tabārakal-lażī ja‘ala fis-samā'i burūjaw wa ja‘ala fīhā sirājaw wa qamaram munīrā(n).
تبارك الذي جعل في السماء بروجا وجعل فيها سرجا وقمرا منيرا
blessed is he who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
tabarakallazijaalafissamaiburujawwajaalafihasirajawwaqamarammunirantabarakaallatheejaaaalafeeassamaiburoojanwajaaaalafeehasirajanwaqamaranmuneera
And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
Wa huwal-lażī ja‘alal-laila wan-nahāra khilfatal liman arāda ay yażżakkara au arāda syukūrā(n).
وهو الذي جعل اليل والنهار خلفه لمن اراد ان يذكر او اراد شكورا
and it is he who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
wahuwallazijaalallailawannaharakhilfatallimanaradaayyazzakkaraauaradasyukuranwahuwaallatheejaaaalaallaylawannaharakhilfatanlimanaradaanyaththakkaraawaradashukoora
And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
Wa ‘ibādur-raḥmānil-lażīna yamsyūna ‘alal-arḍi haunaw wa iżā khāṭabahumul-jāhilūna qālū salāmā(n).
وعباد الرحمن الذين يمشون علي الارض هونا واذا خاطبهم الجهلون قالوا سلما
and the servants of the most merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
waibadurrahmanillazinayamsyunaalalardihaunawwaizakhatabahumuljahilunaqalusalamanwaaaibaduarrahmaniallatheenayamshoonaaaalaalardihawnanwaithakhatabahumualjahiloonaqaloosalama
And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
Wal-lażīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadaw wa qiyāmā(n).
والذين يبيتون لربهم سجدا وقيما
and those who spend [part of] the night to their lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
wallazinayabitunalirabbihimsujjadawwaqiyamanwallatheenayabeetoonalirabbihimsujjadanwaqiyama
And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
Wal-lażīna yaqūlūna rabbanaṣrif ‘annā ‘ażāba jahannam(a), inna ‘ażābahā kāna garāmā(n).
والذين يقولون ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم  ان عذابها كان غراما
and those who say, "our lord, avert from us the punishment of hell. indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
wallazinayaqulunarabbanasrifannaazabajahannamainnaazabahakanagaramanwallatheenayaqooloonarabbanaisrifaaannaaaathabajahannamainnaaaathabahakanagharama
Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
Innahā sā'at mustaqarraw wa muqāmā(n).
انها ساءت مستقرا ومقاما
indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
innahasaatmustaqarrawwamuqamaninnahasaatmustaqarranwamuqama
And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
Wal-lażīna iżā anfaqū lam yusrifū wa lam yaqturū wa kāna baina żālika qawāmā(n).
والذين اذا انفقوا لم يسرفوا ولم يقتروا وكان بين ذلك قواما
and [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
wallazinaizaanfaqulamyusrifuwalamyaqturuwakanabainazalikaqawamanwallatheenaithaanfaqoolamyusrifoowalamyaqturoowakanabaynathalikaqawama

And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
Wal-lażīna lā yad‘ūna ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara wa lā yaqtulūnan nafsal-latī ḥarramallāhu illā bil-ḥaqqi wa lā yaznūn(a), wa may yaf‘al żālika yalqa aṡāmā(n).
والذين لا يدعون مع الله الها ءاخر ولا يقتلون النفس التي حرم الله الا بالحق ولا يزنون  ومن يفعل ذلك يلق اثاما

and those who do not invoke with allah another deity or kill the soul which allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. and whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

wallazinalayadunamaallahiilahanakharawalayaqtulunannafsallatiharramallahuillabilhaqqiwalayaznunawamayyafalzalikayalqaasamanwallatheenalayadaaoonamaaaaallahiilahanakharawalayaqtuloonaannafsaallateeharramaallahuillabilhaqqiwalayaznoonawamanyafaaalthalikayalqaathama
Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
Yuḍā‘af lahul-‘ażābu yaumal-qiyāmati wa yakhlud fīhī muhānā(n).
يضعف له العذاب يوم القيمه ويخلد فيه مهانا
multiplied for him is the punishment on the day of resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
yudaaflahulazabuyaumalqiyamatiwayakhludfihimuhananyudaaaaflahualaaathabuyawmaalqiyamatiwayakhludfeehimuhana
Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
Illā man tāba wa āmana wa ‘amila ‘amalan ṣāliḥan fa ulā'ika yubaddilullāhu sayyi'ātihim ḥasanāt(in), wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
الا من تاب وءامن وعمل عملا صلحا فاولئك يبدل الله سياتهم حسنت  وكان الله غفورا رحيما
except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. for them allah will replace their evil deeds with good. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful.

And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
Wa man tāba wa ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa innahū yatūbu ilallāhi matābā(n).
ومن تاب وعمل صلحا فانه يتوب الي الله متابا
and he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to allah with [accepted] repentance.
wamantabawaamilasalihanfainnahuyatubuilallahimatabanwamantabawaaaamilasalihanfainnahuyatoobuilaallahimataba
And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
Wal-lażīna yasyhadūnaz-zūr(a), wa iżā marrū bil-lagwi marrū kirāmā(n).
والذين لا يشهدون الزور واذا مروا باللغو مروا كراما
and [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
wallazinayasyhadunazzurawaizamarrubillagwimarrukiramanwallatheenalayashhadoonaazzoorawaithamarroobillaghwimarrookirama
And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
Wal-lażīna iżā żukkirū bi'āyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ‘alaihā ṣummaw wa ‘umyānā(n).
والذين اذا ذكروا بايت ربهم لم يخروا عليها صما وعميانا
and those who, when reminded of the verses of their lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
wallazinaizazukkirubiayatirabbihimlamyakhirrualaihasummawwaumyananwallatheenaithathukkiroobiayatirabbihimlamyakhirrooaaalayhasummanwaaaumyana
And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
Wal-lażīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa żurriyyātinā qurrata a‘yuniw waj‘alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā(n).
والذين يقولون ربنا هب لنا من ازوجنا وذريتنا قره اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما
and those who say, "our lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
wallazinayaqulunarabbanahablanaminazwajinawazurriyyatinaqurrataayuniwwajalnalilmuttaqinaimamanwallatheenayaqooloonarabbanahablanaminazwajinawathurriyyatinaqurrataaaayuninwajaaalnalilmuttaqeenaimama
Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
Ulā'ika yujzaunal-gurfata bimā ṣabarū wa yulaqqauna fīhā taḥiyyataw wa salāmā(n).
اولئك يجزون الغرفه بما صبروا ويلقون فيها تحيه وسلما
those will be awarded the chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
ulaikayujzaunalgurfatabimasabaruwayulaqqaunafihatahiyyatawwasalamanolaikayujzawnaalghurfatabimasabaroowayulaqqawnafeehatahiyyatanwasalama
Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
Khālidīna fīhā, ḥasunat mustaqarraw wa muqāmā(n).
خلدين فيها  حسنت مستقرا ومقاما
abiding eternally therein. good is the settlement and residence.
khalidinafihahasunatmustaqarrawwamuqamankhalideenafeehahasunatmustaqarranwamuqama
Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
Qul mā ya‘ba'u bikum rabbī lau lā du‘ā'ukum, faqad każżabtum fa saufa yakūnu lizāmā(n).
قل ما يعبؤا بكم ربي لولا دعاؤكم  فقد كذبتم فسوف يكون لزاما
say, "what would my lord care for you if not for your supplication?" for you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
qulmayabaubikumrabbilauladuaukumfaqadkazzabtumfasaufayakunulizamanqulmayaaabaobikumrabbeelawladuaaaokumfaqadkaththabtumfasawfayakoonulizama
Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
Ṭā Sīm Mīm.
طسم
ta, seen, meem.
tasimmimtaseenmeem
These are the verses of the clear Book.
Tilka āyātul-kitābil-mubīn(i).
تلك ءايت الكتب المبين
these are the verses of the clear book.
tilkaayatulkitabilmubinitilkaayatualkitabialmubeen
Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
La‘allaka bākhi‘un nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīn(a).
لعلك بخع نفسك الا يكونوا مؤمنين
perhaps, [o muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
laallakabakhiunnafsakaallayakunumumininalaaaallakabakhiaaunnafsakaallayakoonoomumineen
If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
In nasya' nunazzil ‘alaihim minas-samā'i āyatan fa ẓallat a‘nāquhum lahā khāḍi‘īn(a).
ان نشا ننزل عليهم من السماء ءايه فظلت اعنقهم لها خضعين
if we willed, we could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
innasyanunazzilalaihimminassamaiayatanfazallatanaquhumlahakhadiinainnashanunazzilaaalayhimminaassamaiayatanfathallataaanaquhumlahakhadiaaeen
And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
Wa mā ya'tīhim min żikrim minar-raḥmāni muḥdaṡin illā kānū ‘anhu mu‘riḍīn(a).
وما ياتيهم من ذكر من الرحمن محدث الا كانوا عنه معرضين
and no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the most merciful except that they turn away from it.
wamayatihimminzikrimminarrahmanimuhdasinillakanuanhumuridinawamayateehimminthikrinminaarrahmanimuhdathinillakanooaaanhumuaarideen
For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
Faqad każżabū fa saya'tīhim ambā'u mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
فقد كذبوا فسياتيهم انبؤا ما كانوا به يستهزءون
for they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
faqadkazzabufasayatihimambaumakanubihiyastahziunafaqadkaththaboofasayateehimanbaomakanoobihiyastahzioon
Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
Awalam yarau ilal-arḍi kam ambatnā fīhā min kulli zaujin karīm(in).
اولم يروا الي الارض كم انبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
did they not look at the earth - how much we have produced therein from every noble kind?
awalamyarauilalardikamambatnafihaminkullizaujinkariminawalamyarawilaalardikamanbatnafeehaminkullizawjinkareem
Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ان في ذلك لايه  وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
innafizalikalaayahtanwamakanaaksaruhummumininainnafeethalikalaayatanwamakanaaktharuhummumineen
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Inna rabbaka lahuwal-‘azīzur-raḥīm(u).
وان ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
and indeed, your lord - he is the exalted in might, the merciful.
innarabbakalahuwalazizurrahimuwainnarabbakalahuwaalaaazeezuarraheem
And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
Wa iż nādā rabbuka mūsā ani'til-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
واذ نادي ربك موسي ان ائت القوم الظلمين
and [mention] when your lord called moses, [saying], "go to the wrongdoing people -
waiznadarabbukamusaanitilqaumazzaliminawaithnadarabbukamoosaaniitialqawmaaththalimeen
The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
Qauma fir‘aun(a), alā yattaqūn(a).
قوم فرعون  الا يتقون
the people of pharaoh. will they not fear allah?"
qaumafiraunaalayattaqunaqawmafiraaawnaalayattaqoon
He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
Qāla rabbi innī akhāfu ay yukażżibūn(i).
قال رب اني اخاف ان يكذبون
he said, "my lord, indeed i fear that they will deny me
qalarabbiinniakhafuayyukazzibuniqalarabbiinneeakhafuanyukaththiboon
And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
Wa yaḍīqu ṣadrī wa lā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa arsil ilā hārūn(a).
ويضيق صدري ولا ينطلق لساني فارسل الي هرون
and that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for aaron.
wayadiqusadriwalayantaliqulisanifaarsililaharunawayadeequsadreewalayantaliqulisaneefaarsililaharoon
And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
Wa lahum ‘alayya żambun fa akhāfu ay yaqtulūn(i).
ولهم علي ذنب فاخاف ان يقتلون
and they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so i fear that they will kill me."
walahumalayyazambunfaakhafuayyaqtuluniwalahumaaalayyathanbunfaakhafuanyaqtuloon
[Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
Qāla kallā, fażhabā bi'āyātinā innā ma‘akum mustami‘ūn(a).
قال كلا  فاذهبا بايتنا  انا معكم مستمعون
[allah] said, "no. go both of you with our signs; indeed, we are with you, listening.
qalakallafazhababiayatinainnamaakummustamiunaqalakallafathhababiayatinainnamaaaakummustamiaaoon
Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
Fa'tiyā fir‘auna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
فاتيا فرعون فقولا انا رسول رب العلمين
go to pharaoh and say, 'we are the messengers of the lord of the worlds,
fatiyafiraunafaqulainnarasulurabbilalaminafatiyafiraaawnafaqoolainnarasoolurabbialaaalameen
[Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
An arsil ma‘anā banī isrā'īl(a).
ان ارسل معنا بني اسرءيل
[commanded to say], "send with us the children of israel."'"
anarsilmaanabaniisrailaanarsilmaaaanabaneeisraeel
[Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
Qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdaw wa labiṡta fīnā min ‘umurika sinīn(a).
قال الم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين
[pharaoh] said, "did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
qalaalamnurabbikafinawalidawwalabistafinaminumurikasininaqalaalamnurabbikafeenawaleedanwalabithtafeenaminaaumurikasineen
And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
Wa fa‘alta fa‘latakal-latī fa‘alta wa anta minal-kāfirīn(a).
وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وانت من الكفرين
and [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
wafaaltafalatakallatifaaltawaantaminalkafirinawafaaaaltafaaalatakaallateefaaaaltawaantaminaalkafireen
[Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
Qāla fa‘altuhā iżaw wa ana minaḍ-ḍāllīn(a).
قال فعلتها اذا وانا من الضالين
[moses] said, "i did it, then, while i was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
qalafaaltuhaizawwaanaminaddallinaqalafaaaaltuhaithanwaanaminaaddalleen
So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
Fa farartu minkum lammā khiftukum fa wahaba lī rabbī ḥukmaw wa ja‘alanī minal-mursalīn(a).
ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين
so i fled from you when i feared you. then my lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
fafarartuminkumlammakhiftukumfawahabalirabbihukmawwajaalaniminalmursalinafafarartuminkumlammakhiftukumfawahabaleerabbeehukmanwajaaaalaneeminaalmursaleen
And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
Wa tilka ni‘matun tamunnuhā ‘alayya an ‘abbatta banī isrā'īl(a).
وتلك نعمه تمنها علي ان عبدت بني اسرءيل
and is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the children of israel?"
watilkanimatuntamunnuhaalayyaanabbattabaniisrailawatilkaniaamatuntamunnuhaaaalayyaanaaabbadtabaneeisraeel
Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
Qāla fir‘aunu wa mā rabbul-‘ālamīn(a).
قال فرعون وما رب العلمين
said pharaoh, "and what is the lord of the worlds?"
qalafiraunuwamarabbulalaminaqalafiraaawnuwamarabbualaaalameen
[Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
Qāla rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā, in kuntum mūqinīn(a).
قال رب السموت والارض وما بينهما  ان كنتم موقنين
[moses] said, "the lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
qalarabbussamawatiwalardiwamabainahumainkuntummuqininaqalarabbuassamawatiwalardiwamabaynahumainkuntummooqineen
[Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
Qāla liman ḥaulahū alā tastami‘ūn(a).

allazinayuqimunassalatawayutunazzakatawahumbilakhiratihumyuqinunaallatheenayuqeemoonaassalatawayutoonaazzakatawahumbilakhiratihumyooqinoon

ان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخره زينا لهم اعملهم فهم يعمهون
indeed, for those who do not believe in the hereafter, we have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
innallazinalayuminunabilakhiratizayyannalahumamalahumfahumyamahunainnaallatheenalayuminoonabilakhiratizayyannalahumaaamalahumfahumyaaamahoon

اولئك الذين لهم سوء العذاب وهم في الاخره هم الاخسرون
those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the hereafter they are the greatest losers.
ulaikallazinalahumsuulazabiwahumfilakhiratihumulakhsarunaolaikaallatheenalahumsoooalaaathabiwahumfeealakhiratihumualakhsaroon

wainnakalatulaqqalquranamilladunhakiminaliminwainnakalatulaqqaalquranaminladunhakeeminaaaleem
[Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
Iż qāla mūsā li'ahlihī innī ānastu nārā(n), sa'ātīkum minhā bikhabarin au ātīkum bisyihābin qabasil la‘allakum taṣṭalūn(a).
اذ قال موسي لاهله اني ءانست نارا ساتيكم منها بخبر او ءاتيكم بشهاب قبس لعلكم تصطلون
[mention] when moses said to his family, "indeed, i have perceived a fire. i will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."

Falammā jā'ahā nūdiya am būrika man fin-nāri wa man ḥaulahā, wa subḥānallāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
فلما جاءها نودي ان بورك من في النار ومن حولها وسبحن الله رب العلمين

يموسي انه انا الله العزيز الحكيم
o moses, indeed it is i - allah, the exalted in might, the wise."

Wa alqi ‘aṣāk(a), falammā ra'āhā tahtazzu ka'annahā jānnuw wallā mudbiraw wa lam yu‘aqqib, yā mūsā lā takhaf, innī lā yakhāfu ladayyal-mursalūn(a).
والق عصاك  فلما رءاها تهتز كانها جان ولي مدبرا ولم يعقب  يموسي لا تخف اني لا يخاف لدي المرسلون

and [he was told], "throw down your staff." but when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [allah said], "o moses, fear not. indeed, in my presence the messengers do not fear.

Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

الا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فاني غفور رحيم
otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, i am forgiving and merciful.
illamanzalamasummabaddalahusnambadasuinfainnigafururrahimunillamanthalamathummabaddalahusnanbaaadasooinfainneeghafoorunraheem

And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
Wa adkhil yadaka fī jaibika takhruj baiḍā'a min gairi sū'(in), fī tis‘i āyātin ilā fir‘auna wa qaumih(ī), innahum kānū qauman fāsiqīn(a).
وادخل يدك في جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء  في تسع ءايت الي فرعون وقومه  انهم كانوا قوما فسقين

and put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [these are] among the nine signs [you will take] to pharaoh and his people. indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
Falammā jā'athum āyātunā mubṣiratan qālū hāżā siḥrum mubīn(un).
فلما جاءتهم ءايتنا مبصره قالوا هذا سحر مبين
but when there came to them our visible signs, they said, "this is obvious magic."
falammajaathumayatunamubsiratanqaluhazasihrummubinunfalammajaathumayatunamubsiratanqaloohathasihrunmubeen
And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها انفسهم ظلما وعلوا  فانظر كيف كان عقبه المفسدين
and they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. so see how was the end of the corrupters.
wajahadubihawastaiqanathaanfusuhumzulmawwauluwwanfanzurkaifakanaaqibatulmufsidinawajahadoobihawastayqanathaanfusuhumthulmanwaaauluwwanfanthurkayfakanaaaaqibatualmufsideen
And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
Wa laqad ātainā dāwūda wa sulaimāna ‘ilmā(n), wa qālal-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī faḍḍalanā ‘alā kaṡīrim min ‘ibādihil-mu'minīn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا داود وسليمن علما  وقالا الحمد لله الذي فضلنا علي كثير من عباده المؤمنين
and we had certainly given to david and solomon knowledge, and they said, "praise [is due] to allah, who has favored us over many of his believing servants."

walaqadatainadawudawasulaimanailmanwaqalalhamdulillahillazifaddalanaalakasirimminibadihilmumininawalaqadataynadawoodawasulaymanaaailmanwaqalaalhamdulillahiallatheefaddalanaaaalakatheerinminaaibadihialmumineen

وورث سليمن داود  وقال يايها الناس علمنا منطق الطير واوتينا من كل شيء  ان هذا لهو الفضل المبين
and solomon inherited david. he said, "o people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. indeed, this is evident bounty."

wawarisasulaimanudawudawaqalayaayyuhannasuullimnamantiqattairiwautinaminkullisyaiininnahazalahuwalfadlulmubinuwawarithasulaymanudawoodawaqalayaayyuhaannasuaaullimnamantiqaattayriwaooteenaminkullishayininnahathalahuwaalfadlualmubeen
And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
Wa ḥusyira lisulaimāna junūduhū minal-jinni wal-insi waṭ-ṭairi fahum yūza‘ūn(a).
وحشر لسليمن جنوده من الجن والانس والطير فهم يوزعون
and gathered for solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
wahusyiralisulaimanajunuduhuminaljinniwalinsiwattairifahumyuzaunawahushiralisulaymanajunooduhuminaaljinniwalinsiwattayrifahumyoozaaaoon
Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
Ḥattā iżā atau ‘alā wādin-naml(i), qālat namlatuy yā ayyuhan-namludkhulū masākinakum, lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaimānu wa junūduhū wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
حتي اذا اتوا علي واد النمل قالت نمله يايها النمل ادخلوا مسكنكم لا يحطمنكم سليمن وجنوده وهم لا يشعرون
until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "o ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
Fatabassama ḍāḥikam min qaulihā wa qāla rabbi auzi‘nī an asykura ni‘matakal-latī an‘amta ‘alayya wa ‘alā wālidayya wa an a‘mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa adkhilnī biraḥmatika fī ‘ibādikaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
فتبسم ضاحكا من قولها وقال رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي ولدي وان اعمل صلحا ترضيه وادخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصلحين

so [solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "my lord, enable me to be grateful for your favor which you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which you approve. and admit me by your mercy into [the ranks of] your righteous servants."


And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
Wa tafaqqadaṭ-ṭaira fa qāla mā liya lā aral-hudhud(a), am kāna minal-gā'ibīn(a).
وتفقد الطير فقال ما لي لا اري الهدهد ام كان من الغائبين
and he took attendance of the birds and said, "why do i not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
watafaqqadattairafaqalamaliyalaaralhudhudaamkanaminalgaibinawatafaqqadaattayrafaqalamaliyalaaraalhudhudaamkanaminaalghaibeen
I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
La'u‘ażżibannahū ‘ażāban syadīdan au la'ażbaḥannahū au laya'tiyannī bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
لاعذبنه عذابا شديدا او لااذبحنه او لياتيني بسلطن مبين
i will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
lauazzibannahuazabansyadidanaulaazbahannahuaulayatiyannibisultanimmubininlaoaaaththibannahuaaathabanshadeedanawlaathbahannahuawlayatiyanneebisultaninmubeen
But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
Famakaṡa gaira ba‘īdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihī wa ji'tuka min saba'im binaba'iy yaqīn(in).
فمكث غير بعيد فقال احطت بما لم تحط به وجئتك من سبا بنبا يقين
but he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "i have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and i have come to you from sheba with certain news.
famakasagairabaidinfaqalaahattubimalamtuhitbihiwajitukaminsabaimbinabaiyyaqininfamakathaghayrabaaaeedinfaqalaahattubimalamtuhitbihiwajitukaminsabainbinabainyaqeen
Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

اني وجدت امراه تملكهم واوتيت من كل شيء ولها عرش عظيم
indeed, i found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
inniwajattumraatantamlikuhumwautiyatminkullisyaiiwwalahaarsyunazimuninneewajadtuimraatantamlikuhumwaootiyatminkullishayinwalahaaaarshunaaatheem

وجدتها وقومها يسجدون للشمس من دون الله وزين لهم الشيطن اعملهم فصدهم عن السبيل فهم لا يهتدون
i found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of allah, and satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [his] way, so they are not guided,

[And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
Allā yasjudū lillāhil-lażī yukhrijul-khab'a fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa ya‘lamu mā tukhfūna wa mā tu‘linūn(a).

[and] so they do not prostrate to allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

الله لا اله الا هو رب العرش العظيم
allah - there is no deity except him, lord of the great throne."
allahulailahaillahuwarabbularsyilazimiallahulailahaillahuwarabbualaaarshialaaatheem
[Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

قال سننظر اصدقت ام كنت من الكذبين
[solomon] said, "we will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
qalasananzuruasadaqtaamkuntaminalkazibinaqalasananthuruasadaqtaamkuntaminaalkathibeen
Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
Iżhab bikitābī hāżā fa alqih ilaihim ṡumma tawalla ‘anhum fanẓur māżā yarji‘ūn(a).
اذهب بكتبي هذا فالقه اليهم ثم تول عنهم فانظر ماذا يرجعون
take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

قالت يايها الملؤا اني القي الي كتب كريم
she said, "o eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
qalatyaayyuhalmalauinniulqiyailayyakitabunkarimunqalatyaayyuhaalmalaoinneeolqiyailayyakitabunkareem
Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Innahū min sulaimāna wa innahū bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm(i).
انه من سليمن وانه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
indeed, it is from solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'in the name of allah, the entirely merciful, the especially merciful,
innahuminsulaimanawainnahubismillahirrahmanirrahimiinnahuminsulaymanawainnahubismiallahiarrahmaniarraheem
Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
Allā ta‘lū ‘alayya wa'tūnī muslimīn(a).
الا تعلوا علي واتوني مسلمين
be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as muslims].'"
allatalualayyawatunimusliminaallataaalooaaalayyawatooneemuslimeen
She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
Qālat yā ayyuhal-mala'u aftūnī fī amrī, mā kuntu qāṭi‘atan amran ḥattā tasyhadūn(i).
قالت يايها الملؤا افتوني في امري ما كنت قاطعه امرا حتي تشهدون
she said, "o eminent ones, advise me in my affair. i would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
qalatyaayyuhalmalauaftunifiamrimakuntuqatiatanamranhattatasyhaduniqalatyaayyuhaalmalaoaftooneefeeamreemakuntuqatiaaatanamranhattatashhadoon
They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
Qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatiw wa ulū ba'sin syadīd(in), wal-amru ilaiki fanẓurī māżā ta'murīn(a).
قالوا نحن اولوا قوه واولوا باس شديد والامر اليك فانظري ماذا تامرين
they said, "we are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
qalunahnuuluquwwatiwwaulubasinsyadidinwalamruilaikifanzurimazatamurinaqaloonahnuolooquwwatinwaoloobasinshadeedinwalamruilaykifanthureemathatamureen
She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
Qālat innal-mulūka iżā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wa ja‘alū a‘izzata ahlihā ażillah(tan), wa każālika yaf‘alūn(a).
قالت ان الملوك اذا دخلوا قريه افسدوها وجعلوا اعزه اهلها اذله  وكذلك يفعلون
she said, "indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. and thus do they do.
qalatinnalmulukaizadakhaluqaryatanafsaduhawajaaluaizzataahlihaazillahtanwakazalikayafalunaqalatinnaalmulookaithadakhalooqaryatanafsadoohawajaaaalooaaaizzataahlihaathillatanwakathalikayafaaaloon
But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

واني مرسله اليهم بهديه فناظره بم يرجع المرسلون
but indeed, i will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
wainnimursilatunilaihimbihadiyyatinfanaziratunbimayarjiulmursalunawainneemursilatunilayhimbihadiyyatinfanathiratunbimayarjiaaualmursaloon
So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
Falammā jā'a sulaimāna qāla atumiddūnani  bimālin famā ātāniyallāhu khairum mimmā ātākum, bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūn(a).
فلما جاء سليمن قال اتمدونن بمال فما ءاتين الله خير مما ءاتيكم بل انتم بهديتكم تفرحون
so when they came to solomon, he said, "do you provide me with wealth? but what allah has given me is better than what he has given you. rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
Irji‘ ilaihim falana'tiyannahum bijunūdil lā qibala lahum bihā wa lanukhrijannahum minhā ażillataw wa hum ṣāgirūn(a).
ارجع اليهم فلناتينهم بجنود لا قبل لهم بها ولنخرجنهم منها اذله وهم صغرون
return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

irjiilaihimfalanatiyannahumbijunudillaqibalalahumbihawalanukhrijannahumminhaazillatawwahumsagirunairjiaailayhimfalanatiyannahumbijunoodinlaqibalalahumbihawalanukhrijannahumminhaathillatanwahumsaghiroon
[Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
Qāla yā ayyuhal-mala'u ayyukum ya'tīnī bi‘arsyihā qabla ay ya'tūnī muslimīn(a).
قال يايها الملؤا ايكم ياتيني بعرشها قبل ان ياتوني مسلمين
[solomon] said, "o assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
qalayaayyuhalmalauayyukumyatinibiarsyihaqablaayyatunimusliminaqalayaayyuhaalmalaoayyukumyateeneebiaaarshihaqablaanyatooneemuslimeen
A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
Qāla ‘ifrītum minal-jinni ana atīka bihī qabla an taqūma mim maqāmik(a), wa innī ‘alaihi laqawiyyun amīn(un).
قال عفريت من الجن انا ءاتيك به قبل ان تقوم من مقامك  واني عليه لقوي امين
a powerful one from among the jinn said, "i will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, i am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
qalaifritumminaljinnianaatikabihiqablaantaqumamimmaqamikawainnialaihilaqawiyyunaminunqalaaaifreetunminaaljinnianaateekabihiqablaantaqoomaminmaqamikawainneaaalayhilaqawiyyunameen

Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

Qālal-lażī ‘indahū ‘ilmum minal-kitābi ana ātīka bihī qabla ay yartadda ilaika ṭarfuk(a), falammā ra'āhu mustaqirran ‘indahū qāla hāżā min faḍli rabbī, liyabluwanī a'asykuru am akfur(u), wa man syakara fa'innamā yasykuru linafsih(ī), wa man kafara fa'inna rabbī ganiyyun karīm(un).
قال الذي عنده علم من الكتب انا ءاتيك به قبل ان يرتد اليك طرفك  فلما رءاه مستقرا عنده قال هذا من فضل ربي ليبلوني ءاشكر ام اكفر  ومن شكر فانما يشكر لنفسه  ومن كفر فان ربي غني كريم

said one who had knowledge from the scripture, "i will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." and when [solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "this is from the favor of my lord to test me whether i will be grateful or ungrateful. and whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. and whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my lord is free of need and generous."


He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
Qāla nakkirū lahā ‘arsyahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu minal-lażīna lā yahtadūn(a).
قال نكروا لها عرشها ننظر اتهتدي ام تكون من الذين لا يهتدون
he said, "disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
qalanakkirulahaarsyahananzuratahtadiamtakunuminallazinalayahtadunaqalanakkiroolahaaaarshahananthuratahtadeeamtakoonuminaallatheenalayahtadoon

So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
Falammā jā'at qīla ahakażā ‘arsyuk(i), qālat ka'annahū huw(a), wa ūtīnal-‘ilma min qablihā wa kunnā muslimīn(a).
فلما جاءت قيل اهكذا عرشك  قالت كانه هو  واوتينا العلم من قبلها وكنا مسلمين

so when she arrived, it was said [to her], "is your throne like this?" she said, "[it is] as though it was it." [solomon said], "and we were given knowledge before her, and we have been muslims [in submission to allah].
falammajaatqilaahakazaarsyukiqalatkaannahuhuwawautinalilmaminqablihawakunnamusliminafalammajaatqeelaahakathaaaarshukiqalatkaannahuhuwawaooteenaalaailmaminqablihawakunnamuslimeen
And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
Wa ṣaddahā mā kānat ta‘budu min dūnillāh(i), innahā kānat min qaumin kāfirīn(a).
وصدها ما كانت تعبد من دون الله  انها كانت من قوم كفرين
and that which she was worshipping other than allah had averted her [from submission to him]. indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
wasaddahamakanattabudumindunillahiinnahakanatminqauminkafirinawasaddahamakanattaaabudumindooniallahiinnahakanatminqawminkafireen

She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

Qīla lahadkhuliṣ-ṣarḥ(a), falammā ra'athu ḥasibathu lujjataw wa kasyafat ‘an sāqaihā, qāla innahū ṣarḥum mumarradum min qawārīr(a), qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa aslamtu ma‘a sulaimāna lillāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
قيل لها ادخلي الصرح  فلما راته حسبته لجه وكشفت عن ساقيها  قال انه صرح ممرد من قوارير  قالت رب اني ظلمت نفسي واسلمت مع سليمن لله رب العلمين

she was told, "enter the palace." but when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. he said, "indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." she said, "my lord, indeed i have wronged myself, and i submit with solomon to allah, lord of the worlds."


And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
Wa laqad arsalnā ilā ṡamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani‘budullāha fa'iżā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا الي ثمود اخاهم صلحا ان اعبدوا الله فاذا هم فريقان يختصمون
and we had certainly sent to thamud their brother salih, [saying], "worship allah," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
walaqadarsalnailasamudaakhahumsalihananibudullahafaizahumfariqaniyakhtasimunawalaqadarsalnailathamoodaakhahumsalihananioaabudooallahafaithahumfareeqaniyakhtasimoon
He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
Qāla yā qaumi lima tasta‘jilūna bis-sayyi'ati qablal-ḥasanah(ti), lau lā tastagfirūnallāha la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).
قال يقوم لم تستعجلون بالسيئه قبل الحسنه  لولا تستغفرون الله لعلكم ترحمون
he said, "o my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good? why do you not seek forgiveness of allah that you may receive mercy?"
qalayaqaumilimatastajilunabissayyiatiqablalhasanahtilaulatastagfirunallahalaallakumturhamunaqalayaqawmilimatastaaajiloonabissayyiatiqablaalhasanatilawlatastaghfiroonaallahalaaaallakumturhamoon
They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."
Qāluṭ ṭayyarnā bika wa bimam ma‘ak(a), qāla ṭā'irukum ‘indallāhi bal antum qaumun tuftanūn(a).
قالوا اطيرنا بك وبمن معك  قال طئركم عند الله  بل انتم قوم تفتنون
they said, "we consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." he said, "your omen [i.e., fate] is with allah. rather, you are a people being tested."
qaluttayyarnabikawabimammaakaqalatairukumindallahibalantumqaumuntuftanunaqalooittayyarnabikawabimanmaaaakaqalatairukumaaindaallahibalantumqawmuntuftanoon
And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
Wa kāna fil-madīnati tis‘atu rahṭiy yufsidūna fil-arḍi wa lā yuṣliḥūn(a).
وكان في المدينه تسعه رهط يفسدون في الارض ولا يصلحون
and there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
wakanafilmadinatitisaturahtiyyufsidunafilardiwalayuslihunawakanafeealmadeenatitisaaaturahtinyufsidoonafeealardiwalayuslihoon

They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
Qālū taqāsamū billāhi lanubayyitannahū wa ahlahū ṡumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihī mā syahidnā mahlika ahlihī wa innā laṣādiqūn(a).
قالوا تقاسموا بالله لنبيتنه واهله ثم لنقولن لوليه ما شهدنا مهلك اهله وانا لصدقون

they said, "take a mutual oath by allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. then we will say to his executor, 'we did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"

qalutaqasamubillahilanubayyitannahuwaahlahusummalanaqulannaliwaliyyihimasyahidnamahlikaahlihiwainnalasadiqunaqalootaqasamoobillahilanubayyitannahuwaahlahuthummalanaqoolannaliwaliyyihimashahidnamahlikaahlihiwainnalasadiqoon
And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
Wa makarū makraw wa makarnā makraw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ومكروا مكرا ومكرنا مكرا وهم لا يشعرون
and they planned a plan, and we planned a plan, while they perceived not.
wamakarumakrawwamakarnamakrawwahumlayasyurunawamakaroomakranwamakarnamakranwahumlayashaauroon
Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
Fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum wa qaumahum ajma‘īn(a).
فانظر كيف كان عقبه مكرهم انا دمرنهم وقومهم اجمعين
then look how was the outcome of their plan - that we destroyed them and their people, all.
fanzurkaifakanaaqibatumakrihimannadammarnahumwaqaumahumajmainafanthurkayfakanaaaaqibatumakrihimannadammarnahumwaqawmahumajmaaaeen
So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
Fatilka buyūtuhum khāwiyatam bimā ẓalamū, inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy ya‘lamūn(a).
فتلك بيوتهم خاويه بما ظلموا  ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يعلمون
so those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
fatilkabuyutuhumkhawiyatambimazalamuinnafizalikalaayatalliqaumiyyalamunafatilkabuyootuhumkhawiyatanbimathalamooinnafeethalikalaayatanliqawminyaaalamoon
And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
Wa anjainal-lażīna āmanū wa kānū yattaqūn(a).
وانجينا الذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
and we saved those who believed and used to fear allah.
waanjainallazinaamanuwakanuyattaqunawaanjaynaallatheenaamanoowakanooyattaqoon
And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
Wa lūṭan iż qāla liqaumihī ata'tūnal-fāḥisyata wa antum tubṣirūn(a).
ولوطا اذ قال لقومه اتاتون الفحشه وانتم تبصرون
and [mention] lot, when he said to his people, "do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
walutanizqalaliqaumihiatatunalfahisyatawaantumtubsirunawalootanithqalaliqawmihiatatoonaalfahishatawaantumtubsiroon
Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
A'innakum lata'tūnar-rijāla syahwatam min dūnin-nisā'(i), bal antum qaumun tajhalūn(a).
ائنكم لتاتون الرجال شهوه من دون النساء  بل انتم قوم تجهلون
do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
ainnakumlatatunarrijalasyahwatamminduninnisaibalantumqaumuntajhalunaainnakumlatatoonaarrijalashahwatanmindooniannisaibalantumqawmuntajhaloon
But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
Famā kāna jawāba qaumihī illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭim min qaryatikum, innahum unāsuy yataṭahharūn(a).
فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا اخرجوا ءال لوط من قريتكم  انهم اناس يتطهرون
but the answer of his people was not except that they said, "expel the family of lot from your city. indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
famakanajawabaqaumihiillaanqaluakhrijualalutimminqaryatikuminnahumunasuyyatatahharunafamakanajawabaqawmihiillaanqalooakhrijooalalootinminqaryatikuminnahumonasunyatatahharoon
So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
Fa'anjaināhu wa ahlahū illamra'atahū qaddarnāhā minal-gābirīn(a).
فانجينه واهله الا امراته قدرنها من الغبرين
so we saved him and his family, except for his wife; we destined her to be of those who remained behind.
faanjainahuwaahlahuillamraatahuqaddarnahaminalgabirinafaanjaynahuwaahlahuillaimraatahuqaddarnahaminaalghabireen
And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
Wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim maṭarā(n), fasā'a maṭarul-munżarīn(a).
وامطرنا عليهم مطرا  فساء مطر المنذرين
and we rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
waamtarnaalaihimmataranfasaamatarulmunzarinawaamtarnaaaalayhimmataranfasaamatarualmunthareen
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"
Qulil-ḥamdu lillāhi wa salāmun ‘alā ‘ibādihil-lażīnaṣṭafā, āllāhu khairun ammā yusyrikūn(a).
قل الحمد لله وسلم علي عباده الذين اصطفي  ءالله خير اما يشركون
say, [o muhammad], "praise be to allah, and peace upon his servants whom he has chosen. is allah better or what they associate with him?"
qulilhamdulillahiwasalamunalaibadihillazinastafaallahukhairunammayusyrikunaqulialhamdulillahiwasalamunaaalaaaibadihiallatheenaistafaallahukhayrunammayushrikoon

[More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
Am man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa ambatnā bihī ḥadā'iqa żāta bahjah(tin), mā kāna lakum an tumbitū syajarahā, a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), bal hum qaumuy ya‘dilūn(a).
امن خلق السموت والارض وانزل لكم من السماء ماء فانبتنا به حدائق ذات بهجه ما كان لكم ان تنبتوا شجرها  اءله مع الله  بل هم قوم يعدلون

[more precisely], is he [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? is there a deity with allah? [no], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to him].



Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.
Am man ja‘alal-arḍa qarāraw wa ja‘ala khilālahā anhāraw wa ja‘ala lahā rawāsiya wa ja‘ala bainal-baḥraini ḥājizā(n), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
امن جعل الارض قرارا وجعل خللها انهرا وجعل لها روسي وجعل بين البحرين حاجزا  اءله مع الله  بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون

is he [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? is there a deity with allah? [no], but most of them do not know.

ammanjaalalardaqararawwajaalakhilalahaanharawwajaalalaharawasiyawajaalabainalbahrainihajizanailahummaallahibalaksaruhumlayalamunaammanjaaaalaalardaqararanwajaaaalakhilalahaanharanwajaaaalalaharawasiyawajaaaalabaynaalbahraynihajizanailahunmaaaaallahibalaktharuhumlayaaalamoon
Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
Am may yujībul-muḍṭarra iżā da‘āhu wa yaksyifus-sū'a wa yaj‘alukum khulafā'a fil-arḍ(i), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), qalīlam mā tażakkarūn(a).
امن يجيب المضطر اذا دعاه ويكشف السوء ويجعلكم خلفاء الارض  اءله مع الله  قليلا ما تذكرون
is he [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? is there a deity with allah? little do you remember.

ammayyujibulmudtarraizadaahuwayaksyifussuawayajalukumkhulafaafilardiailahummaallahiqalilammatazakkarunaammanyujeebualmudtarraithadaaaahuwayakshifuassooawayajaaalukumkhulafaaalardiailahunmaaaaallahiqaleelanmatathakkaroon

Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
Am may yahdīkum fī ẓulumātil-barri wal-baḥri wa may yursilur-riyāḥa busyram baina yadai raḥmatih(ī), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), ta‘ālallāhu ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
امن يهديكم في ظلمت البر والبحر ومن يرسل الريح بشرا بين يدي رحمته  اءله مع الله  تعلي الله عما يشركون

is he [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before his mercy? is there a deity with allah? high is allah above whatever they associate with him.

ammayyahdikumfizulumatilbarriwalbahriwamayyursilurriyahabusyrambainayadairahmatihiailahummaallahitaalallahuammayusyrikunaammanyahdeekumfeethulumatialbarriwalbahriwamanyursiluarriyahabushranbaynayadayrahmatihiailahunmaaaaallahitaaaalaallahuaaammayushrikoon
Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
Am may yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū wa may yarzuqukum minas-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), qul hātū burhānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
امن يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده ومن يرزقكم من السماء والارض  اءله مع الله  قل هاتوا برهنكم ان كنتم صدقين
is he [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? is there a deity with allah? say, "produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

ammayyabdaulkhalqasummayuiduhuwamayyarzuqukumminassamaiwalardiailahummaallahiqulhatuburhanakuminkuntumsadiqinaammanyabdaoalkhalqathummayuaaeeduhuwamanyarzuqukumminaassamaiwalardiailahunmaaaaallahiqulhatooburhanakuminkuntumsadiqeen
Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
Qul lā ya‘lamu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍil gaiba illallāh(u), wa mā yasy‘urūna ayyāna yub‘aṡūn(a).
قل لا يعلم من في السموت والارض الغيب الا الله  وما يشعرون ايان يبعثون
say, "none in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except allah, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
qullayalamumanfissamawatiwalardilgaibaillallahuwamayasyurunaayyanayubasunaqullayaaalamumanfeeassamawatiwalardialghaybaillaallahuwamayashaauroonaayyanayubaaathoon
Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
Balid dāraka ‘ilmuhum fil-ākhirah(ti), bal hum fī syakkim minhā, bal hum minhā ‘amūn(a).
بل ادرك علمهم في الاخره  بل هم في شك منها  بل هم منها عمون
rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the hereafter. rather, they are in doubt about it. rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
baliddarakailmuhumfilakhirahtibalhumfisyakkimminhabalhumminhaamunabaliiddarakaaailmuhumfeealakhiratibalhumfeeshakkinminhabalhumminhaaaamoon
And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū a'iżā kunnā turābaw wa ābā'unā a'innā lamukhrajūn(a).
وقال الذين كفروا اءذا كنا تربا وءاباؤنا ائنا لمخرجون
and those who disbelieve say, "when we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
waqalallazinakafaruaizakunnaturabawwaabaunaainnalamukhrajunawaqalaallatheenakafarooaithakunnaturabanwaabaonaainnalamukhrajoon
We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
Laqad wu‘idnā hāżā naḥnu wa ābā'unā min qabl(u), in hāżā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn(a).
لقد وعدنا هذا نحن وءاباؤنا من قبل ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
we have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. this is not but legends of the former peoples."
laqadwuidnahazanahnuwaabaunaminqabluinhazaillaasatirulawwalinalaqadwuaaidnahathanahnuwaabaonaminqabluinhathaillaasateerualawwaleen
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mujrimīn(a).
قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبه المجرمين
say, [o muhammad], "proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
qulsirufilardifanzurukaifakanaaqibatulmujriminaqulseeroofeealardifanthurookayfakanaaaaqibatualmujrimeen
And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
Wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wa lā takun fī ḍaiqim mimmā yamkurūn(a).
ولا تحزن عليهم ولا تكن في ضيق مما يمكرون
and grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
walatahzanalaihimwalatakunfidaiqimmimmayamkurunawalatahzanaaalayhimwalatakunfeedayqinmimmayamkuroon
And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
and they say, "when is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
wayaqulunamatahazalwaduinkuntumsadiqinawayaqooloonamatahathaalwaaaduinkuntumsadiqeen
Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
Qul ‘asā ay yakūna radifa lakum ba‘ḍul-lażī tasta‘jilūn(a).
قل عسي ان يكون ردف لكم بعض الذي تستعجلون
say, "perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
qulasaayyakunaradifalakumbadullazitastajilunaqulaaasaanyakoonaradifalakumbaaaduallatheetastaaajiloon
And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."
Wa inna rabbaka lażū faḍlin ‘alan-nāsi wa lākinna akṡarahum lā yasykurūn(a).
وان ربك لذو فضل علي الناس ولكن اكثرهم لا يشكرون
and indeed, your lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."
wainnarabbakalazufadlinalannasiwalakinnaaksarahumlayasykurunawainnarabbakalathoofadlinaaalaannasiwalakinnaaktharahumlayashkuroon
And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
Wa inna rabbaka laya‘lamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wa mā yu‘linūn(a).
وان ربك ليعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
and indeed, your lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
wainnarabbakalayalamumatukinnusuduruhumwamayulinunawainnarabbakalayaaalamumatukinnusudooruhumwamayuaalinoon
And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
Wa mā min gā'ibatin fis-samā'i wal-arḍi illā fī kitābim mubīn(in).
وما من غائبه في السماء والارض الا في كتب مبين
and there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear register.
wamamingaibatinfissamaiwalardiillafikitabimmubininwamaminghaibatinfeeassamaiwalardiillafeekitabinmubeen
Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
Inna hāżal-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ‘alā banī isrā'īla akṡaral-lażī hum fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ان هذا القرءان يقص علي بني اسرءيل اكثر الذي هم فيه يختلفون
indeed, this qur’an relates to the children of israel most of that over which they disagree.
innahazalquranayaqussualabaniisrailaaksarallazihumfihiyakhtalifunainnahathaalquranayaqussuaaalabaneeisraeelaaktharaallatheehumfeehiyakhtalifoon
And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
Wa innahū lahudaw wa raḥmatul lil-mu'minīn(a).
وانه لهدي ورحمه للمؤمنين
and indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
wainnahulahudawwarahmatullilmumininawainnahulahudanwarahmatunlilmumineen
Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
Inna rabbaka yaqḍī bainahum biḥukmih(ī), wa huwal-‘azīzul-‘alīm(u).
ان ربك يقضي بينهم بحكمه  وهو العزيز العليم
indeed, your lord will judge between them by his [wise] judgement. and he is the exalted in might, the knowing.
innarabbakayaqdibainahumbihukmihiwahuwalazizulalimuinnarabbakayaqdeebaynahumbihukmihiwahuwaalaaazeezualaaaleem
So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
Fatawakkal ‘alallāh(i), innaka ‘alal-ḥaqqil mubīn(i).
فتوكل علي الله  انك علي الحق المبين
so rely upon allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
fatawakkalalallahiinnakaalalhaqqilmubinifatawakkalaaalaallahiinnakaaaalaalhaqqialmubeen
Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
Innaka lā tusmi‘ul-mautā wa lā tusmi‘uṣ-ṣummad-du‘ā'a iżā wallau mudbirīn(a).
انك لا تسمع الموتي ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ولوا مدبرين
indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
innakalatusmiulmautawalatusmiussummadduaaizawallaumudbirinainnakalatusmiaaualmawtawalatusmiaauassummaadduaaaaithawallawmudbireen
And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].
Wa mā anta bihādil-‘umyi ‘an ḍalālatihim, in tusmi‘u illā may yu'minu bi'āyātinā fahum muslimūn(a).
وما انت بهدي العمي عن ضللتهم  ان تسمع الا من يؤمن بايتنا فهم مسلمون
and you cannot guide the blind away from their error. you will only make hear those who believe in our verses so they are muslims [i.e., submitting to allah].
wamaantabihadilumyiandalalatihimintusmiuillamayyuminubiayatinafahummuslimunawamaantabihadeealaaumyiaaandalalatihimintusmiaauillamanyuminubiayatinafahummuslimoon
And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
Wa iżā waqa‘al-qaulu ‘alaihim akhrajnā lahum dābbatam minal-arḍi tukallimuhum annan-nāsa kānū bi'āyātinā lā yūqinūn(a).
واذا وقع القول عليهم اخرجنا لهم دابه من الارض تكلمهم ان الناس كانوا بايتنا لا يوقنون
and when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, we will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of our verses, not certain [in faith].

waizawaqaalqaulualaihimakhrajnalahumdabbatamminalarditukallimuhumannannasakanubiayatinalayuqinunawaithawaqaaaaalqawluaaalayhimakhrajnalahumdabbatanminaalarditukallimuhumannaannasakanoobiayatinalayooqinoon
And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
Wa yauma naḥsyuru min kulli ummatin faujam mimmay yukażżibu bi'āyātinā fahum yūza‘ūn(a).
ويوم نحشر من كل امه فوجا ممن يكذب بايتنا فهم يوزعون
and [warn of] the day when we will gather from every nation a company of those who deny our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
wayaumanahsyuruminkulliummatinfaujammimmayyukazzibubiayatinafahumyuzaunawayawmanahshuruminkulliommatinfawjanmimmanyukaththibubiayatinafahumyoozaaaoon
Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
Ḥattā iżā jā'ū qāla akażżabtum bi'āyātī wa lam tuḥīṭū bihā ‘ilman ammāżā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
حتي اذا جاءو قال اكذبتم بايتي ولم تحيطوا بها علما اماذا كنتم تعملون
until, when they arrive [at the place of judgement], he will say, "did you deny my signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
hattaizajauqalaakazzabtumbiayatiwalamtuhitubihailmanammazakuntumtamalunahattaithajaooqalaakaththabtumbiayateewalamtuheetoobihaaailmanammathakuntumtaaamaloon
And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
Wa waqa‘al-qaulu ‘alaihim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūn(a).
ووقع القول عليهم بما ظلموا فهم لا ينطقون
and the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
wawaqaalqaulualaihimbimazalamufahumlayantiqunawawaqaaaaalqawluaaalayhimbimathalamoofahumlayantiqoon
Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Alam yarau annā ja‘alnal-laila liyaskunū fīhi wan-nahāra mubṣirā(n), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
الم يروا انا جعلنا اليل ليسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
do they not see that we made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
alamyarauannajaalnallailaliyaskunufihiwannaharamubsiraninnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyuminunaalamyarawannajaaaalnaallaylaliyaskunoofeehiwannaharamubsiraninnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyuminoon
And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
Wa yauma yunfakhu fiṣ-ṣūri fa fazi‘a man fis-samāwāti wa man fil-arḍi illā man syā'allāh(u), wa kullun atauhu dākhirīn(a).
ويوم ينفخ في الصور ففزع من في السموت ومن في الارض الا من شاء الله  وكل اتوه دخرين
and [warn of] the day the horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom allah wills. and all will come to him humbled.
wayaumayunfakhufissurifafaziamanfissamawatiwamanfilardiillamansyaallahuwakullunatauhudakhirinawayawmayunfakhufeeassoorifafaziaaamanfeeassamawatiwamanfeealardiillamanshaaallahuwakullunatawhudakhireen
And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.
Wa taral-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidataw wa hiya tamurru marras saḥāb(i), ṣun‘allāhil-lażī atqana kulla syai'(in), innahū khabīrum bimā taf‘alūn(a).
وتري الجبال تحسبها جامده وهي تمر مر السحاب  صنع الله الذي اتقن كل شيء  انه خبير بما تفعلون
and you see the mountains, thinking them motionless, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [it is] the work of allah, who perfected all things. indeed, he is aware of that which you do.

wataraljibalatahsabuhajamidatawwahiyatamurrumarrassahabisunallahillaziatqanakullasyaiininnahukhabirumbimatafalunawataraaljibalatahsabuhajamidatanwahiyatamurrumarraassahabisunaaaallahiallatheeatqanakullashayininnahukhabeerunbimatafaaaloon
Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
Man jā'a bil-ḥasanati falahū khairum minhā, wa hum min faza‘iy yauma'iżin āminūn(a).
من جاء بالحسنه فله خير منها وهم من فزع يومئذ ءامنون
whoever comes [at judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that day, will be safe.
manjaabilhasanatifalahukhairumminhawahumminfazaiyyaumaizinaminunamanjaabilhasanatifalahukhayrunminhawahumminfazaaainyawmaithinaminoon
And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
Wa man jā'a bis-sayyi'ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fin-nār(i), hal tujzauna illā mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ومن جاء بالسيئه فكبت وجوههم في النار هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
and whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the fire, [and it will be said], "are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
wamanjaabissayyiatifakubbatwujuhuhumfinnarihaltujzaunaillamakuntumtamalunawamanjaabissayyiatifakubbatwujoohuhumfeeannarihaltujzawnaillamakuntumtaaamaloon

[Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh].
Innamā umirtu an a‘buda rabba hāżihil-baldatil-lażī ḥarramahā wa lahū kullu syai'iw wa umirtu an akūna minal-muslimīn(a).
انما امرت ان اعبد رب هذه البلده الذي حرمها وله كل شيء  وامرت ان اكون من المسلمين

[say, o muhammad], "i have only been commanded to worship the lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. and i am commanded to be of the muslims [i.e., those who submit to allah].

innamaumirtuanabudarabbahazihilbaldatillaziharramahawalahukullusyaiiwwaumirtuanakunaminalmusliminainnamaomirtuanaaabudarabbahathihialbaldatiallatheeharramahawalahukullushayinwaomirtuanakoonaminaalmuslimeen
And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
Wa an atluwal-qur'ān(a), famanihtadā fa'innamā yahtadī linafsih(ī), wa man ḍalla faqul innamā ana minal-munżirīn(a).
وان اتلوا القرءان  فمن اهتدي فانما يهتدي لنفسه  ومن ضل فقل انما انا من المنذرين
and to recite the qur’an." and whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "i am only [one] of the warners."
waanatluwalquranafamanihtadafainnamayahtadilinafsihiwamandallafaqulinnamaanaminalmunzirinawaanatluwaalquranafamaniihtadafainnamayahtadeelinafsihiwamandallafaqulinnamaanaminaalmunthireen
And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
Wa qulil-ḥamdu lillāhi sayurīkum āyātihī fata‘rifūnahā, wa mā rabbuka bigāfilin ‘ammā ta‘malūn(a).
وقل الحمد لله سيريكم ءايته فتعرفونها  وما ربك بغفل عما تعملون
and say, "[all] praise is [due] to allah. he will show you his signs, and you will recognize them. and your lord is not unaware of what you do."
waqulilhamdulillahisayurikumayatihifatarifunahawamarabbukabigafilinammatamalunawaqulialhamdulillahisayureekumayatihifataaarifoonahawamarabbukabighafilinaaammataaamaloon
Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
Ṭā Sīm Mīm.
طسم
ta, seen, meem.
tasimmimtaseenmeem
These are verses of the clear Book.
Tilka āyātul-kitābil-mubīn(i).
تلك ءايت الكتب المبين
these are verses of the clear book.
tilkaayatulkitabilmubinitilkaayatualkitabialmubeen
We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
Natlū ‘alaika min naba'i mūsā wa fir‘auna bil-ḥaqqi liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
نتلوا عليك من نبا موسي وفرعون بالحق لقوم يؤمنون
we recite to you from the news of moses and pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
natlualaikaminnabaimusawafiraunabilhaqqiliqaumiyyuminunanatlooaaalaykaminnabaimoosawafiraaawnabilhaqqiliqawminyuminoon

Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
Inna fir‘auna ‘alā fil-arḍi wa ja‘ala ahlahā syiya‘ay yastaḍ‘ifu ṭā'ifatam minhum yużabbiḥu abnā'ahum wa yastaḥyī nisā'ahum, innahū kāna minal-mufsidīn(a).
ان فرعون علا في الارض وجعل اهلها شيعا يستضعف طائفه منهم يذبح ابناءهم ويستحي نساءهم  انه كان من المفسدين

indeed, pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. indeed, he was of the corrupters.

innafiraunaalafilardiwajaalaahlahasyiyaayyastadifutaifatamminhumyuzabbihuabnaahumwayastahyinisaahuminnahukanaminalmufsidinainnafiraaawnaaaalafeealardiwajaaaalaahlahashiyaaaanyastadaaifutaifatanminhumyuthabbihuabnaahumwayastahyeenisaahuminnahukanaminaalmufsideen
And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
Wa nurīdu an namunna ‘alal-lażīnastuḍ‘ifū fil-arḍi wa naj‘alahum a'immataw wa naj‘alahumul-wāriṡīn(a).
ونريد ان نمن علي الذين استضعفوا في الارض ونجعلهم ائمه ونجعلهم الورثين
and we wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
wanuriduannamunnaalallazinastudifufilardiwanajalahumaimmatawwanajalahumulwarisinawanureeduannamunnaaaalaallatheenaistudaaifoofeealardiwanajaaalahumaimmatanwanajaaalahumualwaritheen
And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Hāmān and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
Wa numakkina lahum fil-arḍi wa nuriya fir‘auna wa hāmāna wa junūdahumā minhum mā kānū yaḥżarūn(a).
ونمكن لهم في الارض ونري فرعون وهمن وجنودهما منهم ما كانوا يحذرون
and establish them in the land and show pharaoh and [his minister] haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
wanumakkinalahumfilardiwanuriyafiraunawahamanawajunudahumaminhummakanuyahzarunawanumakkinalahumfeealardiwanuriyafiraaawnawahamanawajunoodahumaminhummakanooyahtharoon

And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
Wa auḥainā ilā mūsā an arḍi‘īh(i), fa'iżā khifti ‘alaihi fa'alqīhi fil yammi wa lā takhāfī wa lā taḥzanī, innā rāddūhu ilaiki wa jā‘ilūhu minal-mursalīn(a).
واوحينا الي ام موسي ان ارضعيه  فاذا خفت عليه فالقيه في اليم ولا تخافي ولا تحزني  انا رادوه اليك وجاعلوه من المرسلين

and we inspired to the mother of moses, "suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. indeed, we will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."

waauhainailamusaanardiihifaizakhiftialaihifaalqihifilyammiwalatakhafiwalatahzaniinnaradduhuilaikiwajailuhuminalmursalinawaawhaynailaommimoosaanardiaaeehifaithakhiftiaaalayhifaalqeehifeealyammiwalatakhafeewalatahzaneeinnaraddoohuilaykiwajaaailoohuminaalmursaleen
And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Hāmān and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
Faltaqaṭahū ālu fir‘auna liyakūna lahum ‘aduwwaw wa ḥazanā(n), inna fir‘auna wa hāmāna wa junūdahumā kānū khāṭi'īn(a).
فالتقطه ءال فرعون ليكون لهم عدوا وحزنا  ان فرعون وهمن وجنودهما كانوا خطين
and the family of pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. indeed, pharaoh and haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
faltaqatahualufiraunaliyakunalahumaduwwawwahazananinnafiraunawahamanawajunudahumakanukhatiinafaltaqatahualufiraaawnaliyakoonalahumaaaduwwanwahazananinnafiraaawnawahamanawajunoodahumakanookhatieen

And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye [i.e., pleasure] for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.
Wa qālatimra'atu fir‘auna qurratu ‘ainil lī wa lak(a), lā taqtulūh(u), ‘asā ay yanfa‘anā au nattakhiżahū waladaw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
وقالت امرات فرعون قرت عين لي ولك  لا تقتلوه عسي ان ينفعنا او نتخذه ولدا وهم لا يشعرون

and the wife of pharaoh said, "[he will be] a comfort of the eye [i.e., pleasure] for me and for you. do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." and they perceived not.

waqalatimraatufiraunaqurratuainilliwalakalataqtuluhuasaayyanfaanaaunattakhizahuwaladawwahumlayasyurunawaqalatiimraatufiraaawnaqurratuaaayninleewalakalataqtuloohuaaasaanyanfaaaanaawnattakhithahuwaladanwahumlayashaauroon
And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.
Wa aṣbaḥa fu'ādu ummi mūsā fārigā(n), in kādat latubdī bihī lau lā ar rabaṭnā ‘alā qalbihā litakūna minal-mu'minīn(a).
واصبح فؤاد ام موسي فرغا  ان كادت لتبدي به لولا ان ربطنا علي قلبها لتكون من المؤمنين
and the heart of moses' mother became empty [of all else]. she was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had we not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

وقال موسي ربي اعلم بمن جاء بالهدي من عنده ومن تكون له عقبه الدار  انه لا يفلح الظلمون
and moses said, "my lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from him and to whom will be succession in the home. indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed."

waqalamusarabbialamubimanjaabilhudaminindihiwamantakunulahuaqibatuddariinnahulayuflihuzzalimunawaqalamoosarabbeeaaalamubimanjaabilhudaminaaindihiwamantakoonulahuaaaqibatuaddariinnahulayuflihuaththalimoon

And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."
Wa qāla fir‘aunu yā ayyuhal-mala'u mā ‘alimtu lakum min ilāhin gairī, fa'auqid lī yā hāmānu ‘alaṭ-ṭīni faj‘al lī ṣarḥal la‘allī aṭṭali‘u ilā ilāhi mūsā, wa innī la'aẓunnuhū minal-kāżibīn(a).
وقال فرعون يايها الملا ما علمت لكم من اله غيري فاوقد لي يهمن علي الطين فاجعل لي صرحا لعلي اطلع الي اله موسي واني لاظنه من الكذبين

and pharaoh said, "o eminent ones, i have not known you to have a god other than me. then ignite for me, o haman, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that i may look at the god of moses. and indeed, i do think he is among the liars."


And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.
Wastakbara huwa wa judūduhū fil-arḍi bigairil-ḥaqqi wa ẓannū annahum ilainā lā yurja‘ūn(a).
واستكبر هو وجنوده في الارض بغير الحق وظنوا انهم الينا لا يرجعون
and he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to us.
wastakbarahuwawajududuhufilardibigairilhaqqiwazannuannahumilainalayurjaunawastakbarahuwawajunooduhufeealardibighayrialhaqqiwathannooannahumilaynalayurjaaaoon
So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.
Fa'akhażnāhu wa junūdahū fanabażnāhum fil-yamm(i), fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
فاخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم في اليم  فانظر كيف كان عقبه الظلمين
so we took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. so see how was the end of the wrongdoers.
faakhaznahuwajunudahufanabaznahumfilyammifanzurkaifakanaaqibatuzzaliminafaakhathnahuwajunoodahufanabathnahumfeealyammifanthurkayfakanaaaaqibatuaththalimeen
And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
Wa ja‘alnāhum a'immatay yad‘ūna ilan-nār(i), wa yaumal-qiyāmati lā yunṣarūn(a).
وجعلنهم ائمه يدعون الي النار  ويوم القيمه لا ينصرون
and we made them leaders inviting to the fire, and on the day of resurrection they will not be helped.
wajaalnahumaimmatayyadunailannariwayaumalqiyamatilayunsarunawajaaaalnahumaimmatanyadaaoonailaannariwayawmaalqiyamatilayunsaroon
And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.
Wa atba‘nāhum fī hāżihid-dun-yā la‘nah(tan), wa yaumal-qiyāmati hum minal-maqbūḥīn(a).
واتبعنهم في هذه الدنيا لعنه  ويوم القيمه هم من المقبوحين
and we caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the day of resurrection they will be of the despised.
waatbanahumfihazihiddunyalanahtanwayaumalqiyamatihumminalmaqbuhinawaatbaaanahumfeehathihiaddunyalaaanatanwayawmaalqiyamatihumminaalmaqbooheen
And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.
Wa laqad ātainā mūsal-kitāba mim ba‘di mā ahlaknal-qurūnal ūlā baṣā'ira lin-nāsi wa hudaw wa raḥmatal la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب من بعد ما اهلكنا القرون الاولي بصائر للناس وهدي ورحمه لعلهم يتذكرون
and we gave moses the scripture, after we had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.

walaqadatainamusalkitabamimbadimaahlaknalqurunalulabasairalinnasiwahudawwarahmatallaallahumyatazakkarunawalaqadataynamoosaalkitabaminbaaadimaahlaknaalquroonaaloolabasairalinnasiwahudanwarahmatanlaaaallahumyatathakkaroon
And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
Wa mā kunta bijānibil-garbiyyi iż qaḍainā ilā mūsal-amra wa mā kunta minasy-syāhidīn(a).
وما كنت بجانب الغربي اذ قضينا الي موسي الامر وما كنت من الشهدين
and you, [o muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when we revealed to moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
wamakuntabijanibilgarbiyyiizqadainailamusalamrawamakuntaminasysyahidinawamakuntabijanibialgharbiyyiithqadaynailamoosaalamrawamakuntaminaashshahideen

But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].
Wa lākinnā ansya'nā qurūnan fataṭāwala ‘alaihimul-‘umur(u), wa mā kunta ṡāwiyan fī ahli madyana tatlū ‘alaihim āyātinā, wa lākinnā kunnā mursilīn(a).
ولكنا انشانا قرونا فتطاول عليهم العمر  وما كنت ثاويا في اهل مدين تتلوا عليهم ءايتنا ولكنا كنا مرسلين

but we produced [many] generations [after moses], and prolonged was their duration. and you were not a resident among the people of madyan, reciting to them our verses, but we were senders [of this message].

walakinnaansyanaqurunanfatatawalaalaihimulumuruwamakuntasawiyanfiahlimadyanatatlualaihimayatinawalakinnakunnamursilinawalakinnaanshanaquroonanfatatawalaaaalayhimualaaumuruwamakuntathawiyanfeeahlimadyanatatlooaaalayhimayatinawalakinnakunnamursileen
And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.
Wa mā kunta bijānibiṭ-ṭūri iż nādainā wa lākir raḥmatam mir rabbika litunżira qaumam mā atāhum min nażīrim min qablika la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
وما كنت بجانب الطور اذ نادينا ولكن رحمه من ربك لتنذر قوما ما اتيهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يتذكرون
and you were not at the side of the mount when we called [moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

wamakuntabijanibitturiiznadainawalakirrahmatammirrabbikalitunziraqaumammaatahumminnazirimminqablikalaallahumyatazakkarunawamakuntabijanibiattooriithnadaynawalakinrahmatanminrabbikalitunthiraqawmanmaatahumminnatheerinminqablikalaaaallahumyatathakkaroon

And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...
Wa lau lā an tuṣībahum muṣībatum bimā qaddamat aidīhim fayaqūlū rabbanā lau lā arsalta ilainā rasūlan fanattabi‘a āyātika wa nakūna minal-mu'minīn(a).
ولولا ان تصيبهم مصيبه بما قدمت ايديهم فيقولوا ربنا لولا ارسلت الينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك ونكون من المؤمنين

and if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "our lord, why did you not send us a messenger so we could have followed your verses and been among the believers?"...

walaulaantusibahummusibatumbimaqaddamataidihimfayaqulurabbanalaulaarsaltailainarasulanfanattabiaayatikawanakunaminalmumininawalawlaantuseebahummuseebatunbimaqaddamataydeehimfayaqooloorabbanalawlaarsaltailaynarasoolanfanattabiaaaayatikawanakoonaminaalmumineen

But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."
Falammā jā'ahumul-ḥaqqu min ‘indinā qālū lau lā ūtiya miṡla mā ūtiya mūsā, awalam yakfurū bimā ūtiya mūsā min qabl(u), qālū siḥrāni taẓāharā, wa qālū innā bikullin kāfirūn(a).
فلما جاءهم الحق من عندنا قالوا لولا اوتي مثل ما اوتي موسي  اولم يكفروا بما اوتي موسي من قبل  قالوا سحران تظهرا وقالوا انا بكل كفرون
