but when the truth came to them from us, they said, "why was he not given like that which was given to moses?" did they not disbelieve in that which was given to moses before? they said, "[they are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."

falammajaahumulhaqquminindinaqalulaulautiyamislamautiyamusaawalamyakfurubimautiyamusaminqabluqalusihranitazaharawaqaluinnabikullinkafirunafalammajaahumualhaqquminaaindinaqaloolawlaootiyamithlamaootiyamoosaawalamyakfuroobimaootiyamoosaminqabluqaloosihranitathaharawaqalooinnabikullinkafiroon
Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allāh which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."
Qul fa'tū bikitābim min ‘indillāhi huwa ahdā minhumā attabi‘hu in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
قل فاتوا بكتب من عند الله هو اهدي منهما اتبعه ان كنتم صدقين
say, "then bring a scripture from allah which is more guiding than either of them that i may follow it, if you should be truthful."
qulfatubikitabimminindillahihuwaahdaminhumaattabihuinkuntumsadiqinaqulfatoobikitabinminaaindiallahihuwaahdaminhumaattabiaahuinkuntumsadiqeen

But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allāh? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
Fa illam yastajībū laka fa‘lam annamā yattabi‘ūna ahwā'ahum, wa man aḍallu mimmanittaba‘a hawāhu bigairi hudam minallāh(i), innallāha lā yahdil-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
فان لم يستجيبوا لك فاعلم انما يتبعون اهواءهم  ومن اضل ممن اتبع هويه بغير هدي من الله  ان الله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين

but if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. and who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from allah? indeed, allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

faillamyastajibulakafalamannamayattabiunaahwaahumwamanadallumimmanittabaahawahubigairihudamminallahiinnallahalayahdilqaumazzaliminafainlamyastajeeboolakafaaalamannamayattabiaaoonaahwaahumwamanadallumimmaniittabaaaahawahubighayrihudanminaallahiinnaallahalayahdeealqawmaaththalimeen
And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
Wa laqad waṣṣalnā lahumul-qaula la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ولقد وصلنا لهم القول لعلهم يتذكرون
and we have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the qur’an] that they might be reminded.
walaqadwassalnalahumulqaulalaallahumyatazakkarunawalaqadwassalnalahumualqawlalaaaallahumyatathakkaroon
Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.
Allażīna ātaināhumul-kitāba min qablihī hum bihī yu'minūn(a).
الذين ءاتينهم الكتب من قبله هم به يؤمنون
those to whom we gave the scripture before it - they are believers in it.
allazinaatainahumulkitabaminqablihihumbihiyuminunaallatheenaataynahumualkitabaminqablihihumbihiyuminoon
And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh]."
Wa iżā yutlā ‘alaihim qālū āmannā bihī innahul-ḥaqqu mir rabbinā innā kunnā min qablihī muslimīn(a).
واذا يتلي عليهم قالوا ءامنا به انه الحق من ربنا انا كنا من قبله مسلمين
and when it is recited to them, they say, "we have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our lord. indeed we were, [even] before it, muslims [i.e., submitting to allah]."
waizayutlaalaihimqaluamannabihiinnahulhaqqumirrabbinainnakunnaminqablihimusliminawaithayutlaaaalayhimqalooamannabihiinnahualhaqquminrabbinainnakunnaminqablihimuslimeen
Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.
Ulā'ika yu'tauna ajrahum marrataini bimā ṣabarū wa yadra'ūna bil-ḥasanatis-sayyi'ata wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn(a).
اولئك يؤتون اجرهم مرتين بما صبروا ويدرءون بالحسنه السيئه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what we have provided them they spend.
ulaikayutaunaajrahummarratainibimasabaruwayadraunabilhasanatissayyiatawamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqunaolaikayutawnaajrahummarrataynibimasabaroowayadraoonabilhasanatiassayyiatawamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqoon
And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."
Wa iżā sami‘ul-lagwa a‘raḍū ‘anhu wa qālū lanā a‘mālunā wa lakum a‘mālukum, salāmun ‘alaikum, lā nabtagil-jāhilīn(a).
واذا سمعوا اللغو اعرضوا عنه وقالوا لنا اعملنا ولكم اعملكم سلم عليكم لا نبتغي الجهلين
and when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "for us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."
waizasamiullagwaaraduanhuwaqalulanaamalunawalakumamalukumsalamunalaikumlanabtagiljahilinawaithasamiaaooallaghwaaaaradooaaanhuwaqaloolanaaaamalunawalakumaaamalukumsalamunaaalaykumlanabtagheealjahileen
Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
Innaka lā tahdī man aḥbabta wa lākinnallāha yahdī may yasyā'(u), wa huwa a‘lamu bil-muhtadīn(a).
انك لا تهدي من احببت ولكن الله يهدي من يشاء  وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
indeed, [o muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but allah guides whom he wills. and he is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
innakalatahdimanahbabtawalakinnallahayahdimayyasyauwahuwaalamubilmuhtadinainnakalatahdeemanahbabtawalakinnaallahayahdeemanyashaowahuwaaaalamubilmuhtadeen

And they [i.e., the Quraysh] say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have We not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
Wa qālū in natabi‘il-hudā ma‘aka nutakhaṭṭaf min arḍinā, awalam numakkil lahum ḥaraman āminay yujbā ilaihi ṡamarātu kulli syai'ir rizqam mil ladunnā wa lākinna akṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
وقالوا ان نتبع الهدي معك نتخطف من ارضنا  اولم نمكن لهم حرما ءامنا يجبي اليه ثمرت كل شيء رزقا من لدنا ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون

and they [i.e., the quraysh] say, "if we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from us? but most of them do not know.



And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.
Wa kam ahlaknā min qaryatim baṭirat ma‘īsyatahā, fatilka masākinuhum lam tuskam mim ba‘dihim illā qalīlā(n), wa kunnā naḥnul-wāriṡīn(a).
وكم اهلكنا من قريه بطرت معيشتها  فتلك مسكنهم لم تسكن من بعدهم الا قليلا  وكنا نحن الورثين

and how many a city have we destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. and it is we who were the inheritors.

wakamahlaknaminqaryatimbatiratmaisyatahafatilkamasakinuhumlamtuskammimbadihimillaqalilanwakunnanahnulwarisinawakamahlaknaminqaryatinbatiratmaaaeeshatahafatilkamasakinuhumlamtuskanminbaaadihimillaqaleelanwakunnanahnualwaritheen

And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother [i.e., principal city] a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.
Wa mā kāna rabbuka muhlikal-qurā ḥattā yab‘aṡa fī ummihā rasūlay yatlū ‘alaihim āyātinā, wa mā kunnā muhlikil-qurā illā wa ahluhā ẓālimūn(a).
وما كان ربك مهلك القري حتي يبعث في امها رسولا يتلوا عليهم ءايتنا  وما كنا مهلكي القري الا واهلها ظلمون

and never would your lord have destroyed the cities until he had sent to their mother [i.e., principal city] a messenger reciting to them our verses. and we would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.

wamakanarabbukamuhlikalqurahattayabasafiummiharasulayyatlualaihimayatinawamakunnamuhlikilquraillawaahluhazalimunawamakanarabbukamuhlikaalqurahattayabaaathafeeommiharasoolanyatlooaaalayhimayatinawamakunnamuhlikeealquraillawaahluhathalimoon
And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allāh is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?
Wa mā ūtītum min syai'in famatā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa zīnatuhā, wa mā ‘indallāhi khairuw wa abqā, afalā ta‘qilūn(a).
وما اوتيتم من شيء فمتع الحيوه الدنيا وزينتها  وما عند الله خير وابقي  افلا تعقلون
and whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. and what is with allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?
wamautitumminsyaiinfamataulhayatiddunyawazinatuhawamaindallahikhairuwwaabqaafalataqilunawamaooteetumminshayinfamataaaualhayatiaddunyawazeenatuhawamaaaindaallahikhayrunwaabqaafalataaaqiloon

Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will meet [i.e., obtain] like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?
Afamaw wa‘adnāhu wa‘dan ḥasanan fahuwa lāqīhi kamam matta‘nāhu matā‘al-ḥayātid-dun-yā ṡumma huwa yaumal-qiyāmati minal-muḥḍarīn(a).
افمن وعدنه وعدا حسنا فهو لقيه كمن متعنه متع الحيوه الدنيا ثم هو يوم القيمه من المحضرين

then is he whom we have promised a good promise which he will meet [i.e., obtain] like he for whom we provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the day of resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in hell]?

afamawwaadnahuwadanhasananfahuwalaqihikamammattanahumataalhayatiddunyasummahuwayaumalqiyamatiminalmuhdarinaafamanwaaaadnahuwaaadanhasananfahuwalaqeehikamanmattaaanahumataaaaalhayatiaddunyathummahuwayawmaalqiyamatiminaalmuhdareen
And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
Wa yauma yunādīhim fayaqūlu aina syurakā'iyal-lażīna kuntum taz‘umūn(a).
ويوم يناديهم فيقول اين شركاءي الذين كنتم تزعمون
and [warn of] the day he will call them and say, "where are my 'partners' which you used to claim?"
wayaumayunadihimfayaquluainasyurakaiyallazinakuntumtazumunawayawmayunadeehimfayaqooluaynashurakaiyaallatheenakuntumtazaaumoon

Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us."
Wa qālal-lażīna ḥaqqa ‘alaihimul-qaulu rabbanā hā'ulā'il-lażīna agwainā, agwaināhum kamā gawainā, tabarra'nā ilaika mā kānū iyyānā ya‘budūn(a).
قال الذين حق عليهم القول ربنا هؤلاء الذين اغوينا اغوينهم كما غوينا  تبرانا اليك  ما كانوا ايانا يعبدون

those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "our lord, these are the ones we led to error. we led them to error just as we were in error. we declare our disassociation [from them] to you. they did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us."

waqalallazinahaqqaalaihimulqaulurabbanahaulaillazinaagwainaagwainahumkamagawainatabarranailaikamakanuiyyanayabudunaqalaallatheenahaqqaaaalayhimualqawlurabbanahaolaiallatheenaaghwaynaaghwaynahumkamaghawaynatabarranailaykamakanooiyyanayaaabudoon
And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners,'" and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!
Wa qīlad‘ū syurakā'akum fada‘auhum falam yastajībū lahum wa ra'awul-‘ażāb(a), lau annahum kānū yahtadūn(a).
وقيل ادعوا شركاءكم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وراوا العذاب  لو انهم كانوا يهتدون
and it will be said, "invoke your 'partners,'" and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. if only they had followed guidance!
waqiladusyurakaakumfadaauhumfalamyastajibulahumwaraawulazabalauannahumkanuyahtadunawaqeelaodaaooshurakaakumfadaaaawhumfalamyastajeeboolahumwaraawooalaaathabalawannahumkanooyahtadoon
And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"
Wa yauma yunādīhim fayaqūlu māżā ajabtumul-mursalīn(a).
ويوم يناديهم فيقول ماذا اجبتم المرسلين
and [mention] the day he will call them and say, "what did you answer the messengers?"
wayaumayunadihimfayaqulumazaajabtumulmursalinawayawmayunadeehimfayaqoolumathaajabtumualmursaleen
But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
Fa ‘amiyat ‘alaihimul-ambā'u yauma'iżin fahum lā yatasā'alūn(a).
فعميت عليهم الانباء يومئذ فهم لا يتساءلون
but the information will be unapparent to them that day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
faamiyatalaihimulambauyaumaizinfahumlayatasaalunafaaaamiyataaalayhimualanbaoyawmaithinfahumlayatasaaloon
But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is expected [i.e., promised by Allāh] that he will be among the successful.
Fa ammā man tāba wa āmana wa ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa‘asā ay yakūna minal-mufliḥīn(a).
فاما من تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا فعسي ان يكون من المفلحين
but as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is expected [i.e., promised by allah] that he will be among the successful.
faammamantabawaamanawaamilasalihanfaasaayyakunaminalmuflihinafaammamantabawaamanawaaaamilasalihanfaaaasaanyakoonaminaalmufliheen
And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allāh and high above what they associate with Him.
Wa rabbuka yakhluqu mā yasyā'u wa yakhtār(u), mā kāna lahumul-khiyarah(tu), subḥānallāhi wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
وربك يخلق ما يشاء ويختار  ما كان لهم الخيره  سبحن الله وتعلي عما يشركون
and your lord creates what he wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. exalted is allah and high above what they associate with him.
warabbukayakhluqumayasyauwayakhtarumakanalahumulkhiyarahtusubhanallahiwataalaammayusyrikunawarabbukayakhluqumayashaowayakhtarumakanalahumualkhiyaratusubhanaallahiwataaaalaaaammayushrikoon
And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
Wa rabbuka ya‘lamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wa mā yu‘linūn(a).
وربك يعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
and your lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
warabbukayalamumatukinnusuduruhumwamayulinunawarabbukayaaalamumatukinnusudooruhumwamayuaalinoon
And He is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.
Wa huwallāhu lā ilāha illā huw(a), lahul-ḥamdu fil-ūlā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa lahul-ḥukmu wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
وهو الله لا اله الا هو  له الحمد في الاولي والاخره  وله الحكم واليه ترجعون
and he is allah; there is no deity except him. to him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the hereafter. and his is the [final] decision, and to him you will be returned.
wahuwallahulailahaillahuwalahulhamdufilulawalakhirahtiwalahulhukmuwailaihiturjaunawahuwaallahulailahaillahuwalahualhamdufeealoolawalakhiratiwalahualhukmuwailayhiturjaaaoon
Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"
Qul ara'aitum in ja‘alallāhu ‘alaikumul-laila sarmadan ilā yaumil-qiyāmati man ilāhun gairullāhi ya'tīkum biḍiyā'(in), afalā tasma‘ūn(a).
قل ارءيتم ان جعل الله عليكم اليل سرمدا الي يوم القيمه من اله غير الله ياتيكم بضياء  افلا تسمعون
say, "have you considered: if allah should make for you the night continuous until the day of resurrection, what deity other than allah could bring you light? then will you not hear?"

qularaaituminjaalallahualaikumullailasarmadanilayaumilqiyamatimanilahungairullahiyatikumbidiyainafalatasmaunaqularaaytuminjaaaalaallahuaaalaykumuallaylasarmadanilayawmialqiyamatimanilahunghayruallahiyateekumbidiyainafalatasmaaaoon

Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?"
Qul ara'aitum in ja‘alallāhu ‘alaikumun-nahāra  sarmadan ilā yaumil-qiyāmati man ilāhun gairullāhi ya'tīkum bilailin taskunūna fīh(i),  afalā tubṣirūn(a).
قل ارءيتم ان جعل الله عليكم النهار سرمدا الي يوم القيمه من اله غير الله ياتيكم بليل تسكنون فيه  افلا تبصرون

say, "have you considered: if allah should make for you the day continuous until the day of resurrection, what deity other than allah could bring you a night in which you may rest? then will you not see?"

qularaaituminjaalallahualaikumunnaharasarmadanilayaumilqiyamatimanilahungairullahiyatikumbilailintaskununafihiafalatubsirunaqularaaytuminjaaaalaallahuaaalaykumuannaharasarmadanilayawmialqiyamatimanilahunghayruallahiyateekumbilaylintaskunoonafeehiafalatubsiroon
And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.
Wa mir raḥmatihī ja‘ala lakumul-laila wan-nahāra litaskunū fīhi wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ومن رحمته جعل لكم اليل والنهار لتسكنوا فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
and out of his mercy he made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from his bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.
wamirrahmatihijaalalakumullailawannaharalitaskunufihiwalitabtaguminfadlihiwalaallakumtasykurunawaminrahmatihijaaaalalakumuallaylawannaharalitaskunoofeehiwalitabtaghoominfadlihiwalaaaallakumtashkuroon
And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
Wa yauma yunādīhim fayaqūlu aina syurakā'iyal-lażīna kuntum taz‘umūn(a).
ويوم يناديهم فيقول اين شركاءي الذين كنتم تزعمون
and [warn of] the day he will call them and say, "where are my 'partners' which you used to claim?"
wayaumayunadihimfayaquluainasyurakaiyallazinakuntumtazumunawayawmayunadeehimfayaqooluaynashurakaiyaallatheenakuntumtazaaumoon
And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allāh, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.
Wa naza‘nā min kulli ummatin syahīdan faqulnā hātū burhānakum fa‘alimū annal-ḥaqqa lillāhi wa ḍalla ‘anhum mā kānū yaftarūn(a).
ونزعنا من كل امه شهيدا فقلنا هاتوا برهنكم فعلموا ان الحق لله وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
and we will extract from every nation a witness and say, "produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.

wanazanaminkulliummatinsyahidanfaqulnahatuburhanakumfaalimuannalhaqqalillahiwadallaanhummakanuyaftarunawanazaaanaminkulliommatinshaheedanfaqulnahatooburhanakumfaaaalimooannaalhaqqalillahiwadallaaaanhummakanooyaftaroon

Indeed, Qārūn was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allāh does not like the exultant.
Inna qārūna kāna min qaumi mūsā fabagā ‘alaihim, wa ātaināhu minal-kunūzi  mā inna mafātiḥahū latanū'u bil-‘uṣbati ulil-quwwah(ti), iż qāla lahū qaumuhū lā tafraḥ, innallāha lā yuḥibbul-fariḥīn(a).
ان قرون كان من قوم موسي فبغي عليهم  وءاتينه من الكنوز ما ان مفاتحه لتنوا بالعصبه اولي القوه اذ قال له قومه لا تفرح  ان الله لا يحب الفرحين

indeed, qarun was from the people of moses, but he tyrannized them. and we gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "do not exult. indeed, allah does not like the exultant.



But seek, through that which Allāh has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allāh has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allāh does not like corrupters."
Wabtagi fīmā ātākallāhud-dāral-ākhirata wa lā tansa naṣībaka minad-dun-yā wa aḥsin kama aḥsanallāhu ilaika wa lā tabgil-fasāda fil-arḍ(i), innallāha lā yuḥibbul-mufsidīn(a).
وابتغ فيما ءاتيك الله الدار الاخره  ولا تنس نصيبك من الدنيا  واحسن كما احسن الله اليك  ولا تبغ الفساد في الارض  ان الله لا يحب المفسدين

but seek, through that which allah has given you, the home of the hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. and do good as allah has done good to you. and desire not corruption in the land. indeed, allah does not like corrupters."

wabtagifimaatakallahuddaralakhiratawalatansanasibakaminaddunyawaahsinkamaahsanallahuilaikawalatabgilfasadafilardiinnallahalayuhibbulmufsidinawabtaghifeemaatakaallahuaddaraalakhiratawalatansanaseebakaminaaddunyawaahsinkamaahsanaallahuilaykawalatabghialfasadafeealardiinnaallahalayuhibbualmufsideen

He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allāh had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.
Qāla innamā ūtītuhū ‘alā ‘ilmin ‘indī, awalam ya‘lam annallāha qad ahlaka min qablihī minal-qurūni man huwa asyaddu minhu quwwataw wa akṡaru jam‘ā(n), wa lā yus'alu ‘an żunūbihimul-mujrimūn(a).
قال انما اوتيته علي علم عندي  اولم يعلم ان الله قد اهلك من قبله من القرون من هو اشد منه قوه واكثر جمعا  ولا يسل عن ذنوبهم المجرمون

he said, "i was only given it because of knowledge i have." did he not know that allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? but the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.


So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."
Fa kharaja ‘alā qaumihī fī zīnatih(ī), qālal-lażīna yurīdūnal-ḥayātad-dun-yā yā laita lanā miṡla mā ūtiya qārūn(u), innahū lażū ḥaẓẓin ‘aẓīm(in).
فخرج علي قومه في زينته  قال الذين يريدون الحيوه الدنيا يليت لنا مثل ما اوتي قرون انه لذو حظ عظيم
so he came out before his people in his adornment. those who desired the worldly life said, "oh, would that we had like what was given to qarun. indeed, he is one of great fortune."

fakharajaalaqaumihifizinatihiqalallazinayuridunalhayataddunyayalaitalanamislamautiyaqarunuinnahulazuhazzinaziminfakharajaaaalaqawmihifeezeenatihiqalaallatheenayureedoonaalhayataaddunyayalaytalanamithlamaootiyaqaroonuinnahulathoohaththinaaatheem
But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allāh is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient."
Wa qālal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma wailakum ṡawābullāhi khairul liman āmana wa ‘amila ṣāliḥā(n), wa lā yulaqqāhā illaṣ-ṣābirūn(a).
وقال الذين اوتوا العلم ويلكم ثواب الله خير لمن ءامن وعمل صلحا ولا يلقيها الا الصبرون
but those who had been given knowledge said, "woe to you! the reward of allah is better for he who believes and does righteousness. and none are granted it except the patient."

waqalallazinautulilmawailakumsawabullahikhairullimanamanawaamilasalihanwalayulaqqahaillassabirunawaqalaallatheenaootooalaailmawaylakumthawabuallahikhayrunlimanamanawaaaamilasalihanwalayulaqqahaillaassabiroon
And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.
Fakhasafnā bihī wa bidārihil-arḍ(a), famā kāna lahū min fi'atiy yanṣurūnahū min dūnillāh(i), wa mā kāna minal-muntaṣirīn(a).
فخسفنا به وبداره الارض فما كان له من فئه ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان من المنتصرين
and we caused the earth to swallow him and his home. and there was for him no company to aid him other than allah, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.
fakhasafnabihiwabidarihilardafamakanalahuminfiatiyyansurunahumindunillahiwamakanaminalmuntasirinafakhasafnabihiwabidarihialardafamakanalahuminfiatinyansuroonahumindooniallahiwamakanaminaalmuntasireen

And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allāh extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allāh had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"

Wa aṣbaḥal-lażīna tamannau makānahū bil-amsi yaqūlūna waika'annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī wa yaqdir(u), lau lā am mannallāhu ‘alainā lakhasafa binā, waika'annahū lā yufliḥul-kāfirūn(a).
واصبح الذين تمنوا مكانه بالامس يقولون ويكان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر  لولا ان من الله علينا لخسف بنا  ويكانه لا يفلح الكفرون

and those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "oh, how allah extends provision to whom he wills of his servants and restricts it! if not that allah had conferred favor on us, he would have caused it to swallow us. oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"


That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
Tilkad-dārul-ākhiratu naj‘aluhā lil-lażīna lā yurīdūna ‘uluwwan fil-arḍi wa lā fasādā(n), wal-‘āqibatu lil-muttaqīn(a).
تلك الدار الاخره نجعلها للذين لا يريدون علوا في الارض ولا فسادا  والعقبه للمتقين
that home of the hereafter we assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. and the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

tilkaddarulakhiratunajaluhalillazinalayuridunauluwwanfilardiwalafasadanwalaqibatulilmuttaqinatilkaaddarualakhiratunajaaaluhalillatheenalayureedoonaaauluwwanfeealardiwalafasadanwalaaaqibatulilmuttaqeen

Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.
Man jā'a bil-ḥasanati falahū khairum minhā, wa man jā'a bis-sayyi'ati falā yujzal-lażīna ‘amilus-sayyi'āti illā mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
من جاء بالحسنه فله خير منها  ومن جاء بالسيئه فلا يجزي الذين عملوا السيات الا ما كانوا يعملون

whoever comes [on the day of judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.

manjaabilhasanatifalahukhairumminhawamanjaabissayyiatifalayujzallazinaamilussayyiatiillamakanuyamalunamanjaabilhasanatifalahukhayrunminhawamanjaabissayyiatifalayujzaallatheenaaaamilooassayyiatiillamakanooyaaamaloon
Indeed, [O Muḥammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur’ān will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."
Innal-lażī faraḍa ‘alaikal-qur'āna larādduka ilā ma‘ād(in), qur rabbī a‘lamu man jā'a bil-hudā wa man huwa fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ان الذي فرض عليك القرءان لرادك الي معاد  قل ربي اعلم من جاء بالهدي ومن هو في ضلل مبين
indeed, [o muhammad], he who imposed upon you the qur’an will take you back to a place of return. say, "my lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."

innallazifaradaalaikalquranalaraddukailamaadinqurrabbialamumanjaabilhudawamanhuwafidalalimmubinininnaallatheefaradaaaalaykaalquranalaraddukailamaaaadinqulrabbeeaaalamumanjaabilhudawamanhuwafeedalalinmubeen
And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.
Wa mā kunta tarjū ay yulqā ilaikal-kitābu illā raḥmatam mir rabbika falā takūnanna ẓahīral lil-kāfirīn(a).
وما كنت ترجوا ان يلقي اليك الكتب الا رحمه من ربك  فلا تكونن ظهيرا للكفرين
and you were not expecting that the book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your lord. so do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.
wamakuntatarjuayyulqailaikalkitabuillarahmatammirrabbikafalatakunannazahirallilkafirinawamakuntatarjooanyulqailaykaalkitabuillarahmatanminrabbikafalatakoonannathaheeranlilkafireen
And never let them avert you from the verses of Allāh after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allāh.
Wa lā yaṣuddunnaka ‘an āyātillāhi ba‘da iż unzilat ilaika wad‘u ilā rabbika wa lā takūnanna minal-musyrikīn(a).
ولا يصدنك عن ءايت الله بعد اذ انزلت اليك  وادع الي ربك  ولا تكونن من المشركين
and never let them avert you from the verses of allah after they have been revealed to you. and invite [people] to your lord. and never be of those who associate others with allah.
walayasuddunnakaanayatillahibadaizunzilatilaikawaduilarabbikawalatakunannaminalmusyrikinawalayasuddunnakaaaanayatiallahibaaadaithonzilatilaykawadaauilarabbikawalatakoonannaminaalmushrikeen
And do not invoke with Allāh another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
Wa lā tad‘u ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhar(a), lā ilāha illā huw(a), kullu syai'in hālikun illā wajhah(ū), lahul-ḥukmu wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ولا تدع مع الله الها ءاخر  لا اله الا هو  كل شيء هالك الا وجهه  له الحكم واليه ترجعون
and do not invoke with allah another deity. there is no deity except him. everything will be destroyed except his face. his is the judgement, and to him you will be returned.

walatadumaallahiilahanakharalailahaillahuwakullusyaiinhalikunillawajhahulahulhukmuwailaihiturjaunawalatadaaumaaaaallahiilahanakharalailahaillahuwakullushayinhalikunillawajhahulahualhukmuwailayhiturjaaaoon
Alif, Lām, Meem.
Alif lām mīm.
الم
alif, lam, meem.
aliflammimaliflammeem
Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?
Aḥasiban-nāsu ay yutrakū ay yaqūlū āmannā wa hum lā yuftanūn(a).
احسب الناس ان يتركوا ان يقولوا ءامنا وهم لا يفتنون
do the people think that they will be left to say, "we believe" and they will not be tried?
ahasibannasuayyutrakuayyaquluamannawahumlayuftanunaahasibaannasuanyutrakooanyaqoolooamannawahumlayuftanoon
But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
Wa laqad fatannal-lażīna min qablihim falaya‘lamannallāhul-lażīna ṣadaqū wa laya‘lamannal-kāżibīn(a).
ولقد فتنا الذين من قبلهم  فليعلمن الله الذين صدقوا وليعلمن الكذبين
but we have certainly tried those before them, and allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and he will surely make evident the liars.
walaqadfatannallazinaminqablihimfalayalamannallahullazinasadaquwalayalamannalkazibinawalaqadfatannaallatheenaminqablihimfalayaaalamannaallahuallatheenasadaqoowalayaaalamannaalkathibeen
Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] Us? Evil is what they judge.
Am ḥasibal-lażīna ya‘malūnas-sayyi'āti ay yasbiqūnā, sā'a mā yaḥkumūn(a).
ام حسب الذين يعملون السيات ان يسبقونا  ساء ما يحكمون
or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] us? evil is what they judge.
amhasiballazinayamalunassayyiatiayyasbiqunasaamayahkumunaamhasibaallatheenayaaamaloonaassayyiatianyasbiqoonasaamayahkumoon
Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allāh - indeed, the term [decreed by] Allāh is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Man kāna yarjū liqā'allāhi fa'inna ajalallāhi la'āt(in), wa huwas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).
من كان يرجوا لقاء الله فان اجل الله لات  وهو السميع العليم
whoever should hope for the meeting with allah - indeed, the term [decreed by] allah is coming. and he is the hearing, the knowing.
mankanayarjuliqaallahifainnaajalallahilaatinwahuwassamiulalimumankanayarjooliqaaallahifainnaajalaallahilaatinwahuwaassameeaaualaaaleem
And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allāh is Free from need of the worlds.
Wa man jāhada fa'innamā yujāhidu linafsih(ī), innallāha laganiyyun ‘anil-‘ālamīn(a).
ومن جهد فانما يجهد لنفسه  ان الله لغني عن العلمين
and whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. indeed, allah is free from need of the worlds.
wamanjahadafainnamayujahidulinafsihiinnallahalaganiyyunanilalaminawamanjahadafainnamayujahidulinafsihiinnaallahalaghaniyyunaaanialaaalameen
And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
Wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ‘anhum sayyi'ātihim wa lanajziyannahum aḥsanal-lażī kānū ya‘malūn(a).
والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لنكفرن عنهم سياتهم ولنجزينهم احسن الذي كانوا يعملون
and those who believe and do righteous deeds - we will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

wallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilanukaffirannaanhumsayyiatihimwalanajziyannahumahsanallazikanuyamalunawallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilanukaffirannaaaanhumsayyiatihimwalanajziyannahumahsanaallatheekanooyaaamaloon

And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
Wa waṣṣainal-insāna biwālidaihi ḥusnā(n), wa in jāhadāka litusyrika bī mā laisa laka bihī ‘ilmun falā tuṭi‘humā, ilayya marji‘ukum fa'unabbi'ukum bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ووصينا الانسن بولديه حسنا  وان جهداك لتشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما  الي مرجعكم فانبئكم بما كنتم تعملون

and we have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. but if they endeavor to make you associate with me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. to me is your return, and i will inform you about what you used to do.

wawassainalinsanabiwalidaihihusnanwainjahadakalitusyrikabimalaisalakabihiilmunfalatutihumailayyamarjiukumfaunabbiukumbimakuntumtamalunawawassaynaalinsanabiwalidayhihusnanwainjahadakalitushrikabeemalaysalakabihiaailmunfalatutiaahumailayyamarjiaaukumfaonabbiokumbimakuntumtaaamaloon
And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
Wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanudkhilannahum fiṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لندخلنهم في الصلحين
and those who believe and do righteous deeds - we will surely admit them among the righteous [into paradise].
wallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilanudkhilannahumfissalihinawallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilanudkhilannahumfeeassaliheen

And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allāh, he considers the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allāh. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allāh most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds [i.e., all creatures]?

Wa minan-nāsi may yaqūlu āmannā billāhi fa'iżā ūżiya  fillāhi ja‘ala fitnatan-nāsi ka‘ażābillāh(i), wa la'in jā'a naṣrum mir rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā ma‘akum, awa laisallāhu bi'a‘lama bimā fī ṣudūril-‘ālamīn(a).
ومن الناس من يقول ءامنا بالله فاذا اوذي في الله جعل فتنه الناس كعذاب الله ولئن جاء نصر من ربك ليقولن انا كنا معكم  اوليس الله باعلم بما في صدور العلمين

and of the people are some who say, "we believe in allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] allah, he considers the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of allah. but if victory comes from your lord, they say, "indeed, we were with you." is not allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds [i.e., all creatures]?


And Allāh will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
Wa laya‘lamannallāhul-lażīna āmanū wa laya‘lamannal-munāfiqīn(a).
وليعلمن الله الذين ءامنوا وليعلمن المنفقين
and allah will surely make evident those who believe, and he will surely make evident the hypocrites.
walayalamannallahullazinaamanuwalayalamannalmunafiqinawalayaaalamannaallahuallatheenaamanoowalayaaalamannaalmunafiqeen
And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-lażīna āmanuttabi‘ū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum, wa mā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min syai'(in), innahum lakāżibūn(a).
وقال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا اتبعوا سبيلنا ولنحمل خطيكم وما هم بحملين من خطيهم من شيء  انهم لكذبون
and those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "follow our way, and we will carry your sins." but they will not carry anything of their sins. indeed, they are liars.

waqalallazinakafarulillazinaamanuttabiusabilanawalnahmilkhatayakumwamahumbihamilinaminkhatayahumminsyaiininnahumlakazibunawaqalaallatheenakafaroolillatheenaamanooittabiaaoosabeelanawalnahmilkhatayakumwamahumbihamileenaminkhatayahumminshayininnahumlakathiboon
But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
Wa layaḥmilunna aṡqālahum wa aṡqālam ma‘a aṡqālihim wa layus'alunna yaumal-qiyāmati ‘ammā kānū yaftarūn(a).
وليحملن اثقالهم واثقالا مع اثقالهم  وليسلن يوم القيمه عما كانوا يفترون
but they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the day of resurrection about what they used to invent.
walayahmilunnaasqalahumwaasqalammaaasqalihimwalayusalunnayaumalqiyamatiammakanuyaftarunawalayahmilunnaathqalahumwaathqalanmaaaaathqalihimwalayusalunnayawmaalqiyamatiaaammakanooyaftaroon
And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
Wa laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qaumihī falabiṡa fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ‘āmā(n), fa'akhażahumuṭ-ṭūfānu wa hum ẓālimūn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه فلبث فيهم الف سنه الا خمسين عاما فاخذهم الطوفان وهم ظلمون
and we certainly sent noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.

walaqadarsalnanuhanilaqaumihifalabisafihimalfasanatinillakhamsinaamanfaakhazahumuttufanuwahumzalimunawalaqadarsalnanoohanilaqawmihifalabithafeehimalfasanatinillakhamseenaaaamanfaakhathahumuattoofanuwahumthalimoon
But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.
Fa'anjaināhu wa aṣḥābas-safīnati wa ja‘alnāhā āyatal lil-‘ālamīn(a).
فانجينه واصحب السفينه وجعلنها ءايه للعلمين
but we saved him and the companions of the ship, and we made it a sign for the worlds.
faanjainahuwaashabassafinatiwajaalnahaayatallilalaminafaanjaynahuwaashabaassafeenatiwajaaaalnahaayatanlilaaalameen
And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.
Wa ibrāhīma iż qāla liqaumihi‘budullāha wattaqūh(u), żālikum khairul lakum in kuntum ta‘lamūn(a).
وابرهيم اذ قال لقومه اعبدوا الله واتقوه  ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
and [we sent] abraham, when he said to his people, "worship allah and fear him. that is best for you, if you should know.
waibrahimaizqalaliqaumihibudullahawattaquhuzalikumkhairullakuminkuntumtalamunawaibraheemaithqalaliqawmihioaabudooallahawattaqoohuthalikumkhayrunlakuminkuntumtaaalamoon

You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."
Innamā ta‘budūna min dūnillāhi auṡānaw wa takhluqūna ifkā(n), innal-lażīna ta‘budūna min dūnillāhi lā yamlikūna lakum rizqan fabtagū ‘indallāhir-rizqa wa‘budūhu wasykurū lah(ū), ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
انما تعبدون من دون الله اوثنا وتخلقون افكا  ان الذين تعبدون من دون الله لا يملكون لكم رزقا فابتغوا عند الله الرزق واعبدوه واشكروا له  اليه ترجعون

you only worship, besides allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. indeed, those you worship besides allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. so seek from allah provision and worship him and be grateful to him. to him you will be returned."


And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.
Wa in tukażżibū faqad każżaba umamum min qablikum, wa mā ‘alar-rasūli illal-balāgul-mubīn(u).
وان تكذبوا فقد كذب امم من قبلكم  وما علي الرسول الا البلغ المبين
and if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. and there is not upon the messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.
waintukazzibufaqadkazzabaumamumminqablikumwamaalarrasuliillalbalagulmubinuwaintukaththiboofaqadkaththabaomamunminqablikumwamaaaalaarrasooliillaalbalaghualmubeen
Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
Awalam yarau kaifa yubdi'ullāhul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduh(ū), inna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīr(un).
اولم يروا كيف يبدئ الله الخلق ثم يعيده  ان ذلك علي الله يسير
have they not considered how allah begins creation and then repeats it? indeed that, for allah, is easy.
awalamyaraukaifayubdiullahulkhalqasummayuiduhuinnazalikaalallahiyasirunawalamyarawkayfayubdioallahualkhalqathummayuaaeeduhuinnathalikaaaalaallahiyaseer
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."
Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa bada'al-khalqa ṡummallāhu yunsyi'un-nasy'atal-ākhirah(ta), innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف بدا الخلق  ثم الله ينشئ النشاه الاخره  ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
say, [o muhammad], "travel through the land and observe how he began creation. then allah will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. indeed allah, over all things, is competent."

qulsirufilardifanzurukaifabadaalkhalqasummallahuyunsyiunnasyatalakhirahtainnallahaalakullisyaiinqadirunqulseeroofeealardifanthurookayfabadaaalkhalqathummaallahuyunshioannashataalakhiratainnaallahaaaalakullishayinqadeer
He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
Yu‘ażżibu may yasyā'u wa yarḥamu may yasyā'(u), wa ilaihi tuqlabūn(a).
يعذب من يشاء ويرحم من يشاء  واليه تقلبون
he punishes whom he wills and has mercy upon whom he wills, and to him you will be returned.
yuazzibumayyasyauwayarhamumayyasyauwailaihituqlabunayuaaaththibumanyashaowayarhamumanyashaowailayhituqlaboon
And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.
Wa mā antum bimu‘jizīna fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'(i), wa mā lakum min dūnillāhi miw waliyyiw wa lā naṣīr(in).
وما انتم بمعجزين في الارض ولا في السماء  وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
and you will not cause failure [to allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. and you have not other than allah any protector or any helper.
wamaantumbimujizinafilardiwalafissamaiwamalakummindunillahimiwwaliyyiwwalanasirinwamaantumbimuaajizeenafeealardiwalafeeassamaiwamalakummindooniallahiminwaliyyinwalanaseer
And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
Wal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyātillāhi wa liqā'ihī ulā'ika ya'isū mir raḥmatī wa ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
والذين كفروا بايت الله ولقائه اولئك يئسوا من رحمتي واولئك لهم عذاب اليم
and the ones who disbelieve in the signs of allah and the meeting with him - those have despaired of my mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
wallazinakafarubiayatillahiwaliqaihiulaikayaisumirrahmatiwaulaikalahumazabunalimunwallatheenakafaroobiayatiallahiwaliqaihiolaikayaisoominrahmateewaolaikalahumaaathabunaleem
And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allāh saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Famā kāna jawāba qaumihī illā an qaluqtulūhu au ḥarriqūhu fa anjāhullāhu minan-nār(i), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا اقتلوه او حرقوه فانجيه الله من النار  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
and the answer of his [i.e., abraham's] people was not but that they said, "kill him or burn him," but allah saved him from the fire. indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

famakanajawabaqaumihiillaanqaluqtuluhuauharriquhufaanjahullahuminannariinnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyuminunafamakanajawabaqawmihiillaanqaloooqtuloohuawharriqoohufaanjahuallahuminaannariinnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyuminoon

And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

Wa qāla innamattakhażtum min dūnillāhi auṡānam mawaddata bainikum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, ṡumma yaumal-qiyāmati yakfuru ba‘ḍukum biba‘ḍiw wa yal‘anu ba‘ḍukum ba‘ḍā(n), wa ma'wākumun nāru wa mā lakum min nāṣirīn(a).
وقال انما اتخذتم من دون الله اوثنا موده بينكم في الحيوه الدنيا  ثم يوم القيمه يكفر بعضكم ببعض ويلعن بعضكم بعضا وماويكم النار وما لكم من نصرين

and [abraham] said, "you have only taken, other than allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. then on the day of resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the fire, and you will not have any helpers."


And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
Fa āmana lahū lūṭ(un), wa qāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī, innahū huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
فامن له لوط  وقال اني مهاجر الي ربي  انه هو العزيز الحكيم
and lot believed him. [abraham] said, "indeed, i will emigrate to [the service of] my lord. indeed, he is the exalted in might, the wise."
faamanalahulutunwaqalainnimuhajirunilarabbiinnahuhuwalazizulhakimufaamanalahulootunwaqalainneemuhajirunilarabbeeinnahuhuwaalaaazeezualhakeem
And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
Wa wahabnā lahū isḥāqa wa ya‘qūba wa ja‘alnā fī żurriyyatihin nubuwwata wal-kitāba wa ātaināhu ajrahū fid-dun-yā, wa innahū fil-ākhirati laminaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب وجعلنا في ذريته النبوه والكتب وءاتينه اجره في الدنيا  وانه في الاخره لمن الصلحين
and we gave to him isaac and jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. and we gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the hereafter among the righteous.

wawahabnalahuishaqawayaqubawajaalnafizurriyyatihinnubuwwatawalkitabawaatainahuajrahufiddunyawainnahufilakhiratilaminassalihinawawahabnalahuishaqawayaaaqoobawajaaaalnafeethurriyyatihiannubuwwatawalkitabawaataynahuajrahufeeaddunyawainnahufeealakhiratilaminaassaliheen
And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
Wa lūṭan iż qāla liqaumihī innakum lata'tūnal-fāḥisyata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadim minal-‘ālamīn(a).
ولوطا اذ قال لقومه انكم لتاتون الفحشه ما سبقكم بها من احد من العلمين
and [mention] lot, when he said to his people, "indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
walutanizqalaliqaumihiinnakumlatatunalfahisyatamasabaqakumbihaminahadimminalalaminawalootanithqalaliqawmihiinnakumlatatoonaalfahishatamasabaqakumbihaminahadinminaalaaalameen

Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."
A'innakum lata'tūnar-rijāla wa taqṭa‘ūnas-sabīl(a), wa ta'tūna fī nādīkumul-munkar(a), famā kāna jawāba qaumihī illā an qālu'tinā bi‘ażābillāhi in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
ائنكم لتاتون الرجال وتقطعون السبيل وتاتون في ناديكم المنكر  فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله ان كنت من الصدقين

indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." and the answer of his people was not but that they said, "bring us the punishment of allah, if you should be of the truthful."

ainnakumlatatunarrijalawataqtaunassabilawatatunafinadikumulmunkarafamakanajawabaqaumihiillaanqalutinabiazabillahiinkuntaminassadiqinaainnakumlatatoonaarrijalawataqtaaaoonaassabeelawatatoonafeenadeekumualmunkarafamakanajawabaqawmihiillaanqalooitinabiaaathabiallahiinkuntaminaassadiqeen
He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
Qāla rabbinṣurnī ‘alal-qaumil-mufsidīn(a).
قال رب انصرني علي القوم المفسدين
he said, "my lord, support me against the corrupting people."
qalarabbinsurnialalqaumilmufsidinaqalarabbionsurneeaaalaalqawmialmufsideen
And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
Wa lammā jā'at rusulunā ibrāhīma bil-busyrā, qālū innā muhlikū ahli hāżihil-qaryah(ti), inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīn(a).
ولما جاءت رسلنا ابرهيم بالبشري قالوا انا مهلكوا اهل هذه القريه  ان اهلها كانوا ظلمين
and when our messengers [i.e., angels] came to abraham with the good tidings, they said, "indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., lot's] city. indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
walammajaatrusulunaibrahimabilbusyraqaluinnamuhlikuahlihazihilqaryahtiinnaahlahakanuzaliminawalammajaatrusulunaibraheemabilbushraqalooinnamuhlikooahlihathihialqaryatiinnaahlahakanoothalimeen
[Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."
Qāla inna fīhā lūṭā(n), qālū naḥnu a‘lamu biman fīhā, lanunajjiyannahū wa ahlahū illamra'atahū kānat minal-gābirīn(a).
قال ان فيها لوطا  قالوا نحن اعلم بمن فيها  لننجينه واهله الا امراته كانت من الغبرين
[abraham] said, "indeed, within it is lot." they said, "we are more knowing of who is within it. we will surely save him and his family, except his wife. she is to be of those who remain behind."
qalainnafihalutanqalunahnualamubimanfihalanunajjiyannahuwaahlahuillamraatahukanatminalgabirinaqalainnafeehalootanqaloonahnuaaalamubimanfeehalanunajjiyannahuwaahlahuillaimraatahukanatminaalghabireen

And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
Wa lammā an jā'at rusulunā lūṭan sī'a bihim wa ḍāqa bihim żar‘aw wa qālū lā takhaf wa lā taḥzan, innā munajjūka wa ahlaka illamra'ataka kānat minal-gābirīn(a).
ولما ان جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا وقالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن  انا منجوك واهلك الا امراتك كانت من الغبرين

and when our messengers [i.e., angels] came to lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. they said, "fear not, nor grieve. indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.

walammaanjaatrusulunalutansiabihimwadaqabihimzarawwaqalulatakhafwalatahzaninnamunajjukawaahlakaillamraatakakanatminalgabirinawalammaanjaatrusulunalootanseeabihimwadaqabihimtharaaanwaqaloolatakhafwalatahzaninnamunajjookawaahlakaillaimraatakakanatminaalghabireen
Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
Innā munzilūna ‘alā ahli hāżihil-qaryati rijzam minas-samā'i bimā kānū yafsuqūn(a).
انا منزلون علي اهل هذه القريه رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
innamunzilunaalaahlihazihilqaryatirijzamminassamaibimakanuyafsuqunainnamunziloonaaaalaahlihathihialqaryatirijzanminaassamaibimakanooyafsuqoon
And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
Wa laqad taraknā minhā āyatam bayyinatal liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ولقد تركنا منها ءايه بينه لقوم يعقلون
and we have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
walaqadtaraknaminhaayatambayyinatalliqaumiyyaqilunawalaqadtaraknaminhaayatanbayyinatanliqawminyaaaqiloon
And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
Wa ilā madyana akhāhum syu‘aibā(n), faqāla yā qaumi‘budullāha warjul-yaumal-ākhira wa lā ta‘ṡau fil-arḍi mufsidīn(a).
والي مدين اخاهم شعيبا فقال يقوم اعبدوا الله وارجوا اليوم الاخر ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
and to madyan [we sent] their brother shuʿayb, and he said, "o my people, worship allah and expect the last day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
wailamadyanaakhahumsyuaibanfaqalayaqaumibudullahawarjulyaumalakhirawalatasaufilardimufsidinawailamadyanaakhahumshuaaaybanfaqalayaqawmioaabudooallahawarjooalyawmaalakhirawalataaathawfeealardimufsideen
But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
Fa każżabūhu fa'akhażathumur-rajfatu fa'aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāṡimīn(a).
فكذبوه فاخذتهم الرجفه فاصبحوا في دارهم جثمين
but they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
fakazzabuhufaakhazathumurrajfatufaasbahufidarihimjasiminafakaththaboohufaakhathathumuarrajfatufaasbahoofeedarihimjathimeen

And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
Wa ‘ādaw wa ṡamūda wa qat tabayyana lakum mim masākinihim, wa zayyana lahumusy-syaiṭānu a‘mālahum faṣaddahum ‘anis-sabīli wa kānū mustabṣirīn(a).
وعادا وثمودا وقد تبين لكم من مسكنهم  وزين لهم الشيطن اعملهم فصدهم عن السبيل وكانوا مستبصرين

and [we destroyed] ʿaad and thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. and satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.

waadawwasamudawaqattabayyanalakummimmasakinihimwazayyanalahumusysyaitanuamalahumfasaddahumanissabiliwakanumustabsirinawaaaadanwathamoodawaqadtabayyanalakumminmasakinihimwazayyanalahumuashshaytanuaaamalahumfasaddahumaaaniassabeeliwakanoomustabsireen
And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].
Wa qārūna wa fir‘auna wa hāmān(a), wa laqad jā'ahum mūsā bil-bayyināti fastakbarū fil-arḍi wa mā kānū sābiqīn(a).
وقرون وفرعون وهمن  ولقد جاءهم موسي بالبينت فاستكبروا في الارض وما كانوا سبقين
and [we destroyed] qarun and pharaoh and haman. and moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of our punishment].
waqarunawafiraunawahamanawalaqadjaahummusabilbayyinatifastakbarufilardiwamakanusabiqinawaqaroonawafiraaawnawahamanawalaqadjaahummoosabilbayyinatifastakbaroofeealardiwamakanoosabiqeen

So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allāh would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.

Fakullan akhażnā biżambih(ī), faminhum man arsalnā ‘alaihi ḥāṣibā(n), wa minhum man akhażathuṣ-ṣaiḥah(tu), wa minhum man khasafnā bihil-arḍ(a), wa minhum man agraqnā, wa mā kānallāhu liyaẓlimahum wa lākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
فكلا اخذنا بذنبه  فمنهم من ارسلنا عليه حاصبا ومنهم من اخذته الصيحه ومنهم من خسفنا به الارض ومنهم من اغرقنا  وما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون

so each we seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom we sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom we caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom we drowned. and allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.


The example of those who take allies other than Allāh is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
Maṡalul-lażīnattakhażū min dūnillāhi auliyā'a kamaṡalil-‘ankabūt(i), ittakhażat baitā(n), wa inna auhanal-buyūti labaitul-‘ankabūt(i), lau kānū ya‘lamūn(a).
مثل الذين اتخذوا من دون الله اولياء كمثل العنكبوت اتخذت بيتا  وان اوهن البيوت لبيت العنكبوت  لو كانوا يعلمون
the example of those who take allies other than allah is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. and indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.

masalullazinattakhazumindunillahiauliyaakamasalilankabutiittakhazatbaitanwainnaauhanalbuyutilabaitulankabutilaukanuyalamunamathaluallatheenaittakhathoomindooniallahiawliyaakamathalialaaankabootiittakhathatbaytanwainnaawhanaalbuyootilabaytualaaankabootilawkanooyaaalamoon
Indeed, Allāh knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Innallāha ya‘lamu mā yad‘ūna min dūnihī min syai'(in), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ان الله يعلم ما يدعون من دونه من شيء  وهو العزيز الحكيم
indeed, allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than him. and he is the exalted in might, the wise.
innallahayalamumayadunamindunihiminsyaiinwahuwalazizulhakimuinnaallahayaaalamumayadaaoonamindoonihiminshayinwahuwaalaaazeezualhakeem
And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
Wa tilkal-amṡālu naḍribuhā lin-nās(i), wa mā ya‘qiluhā illal-‘ālimūn(a).
وتلك الامثل نضربها للناس  وما يعقلها الا العلمون
and these examples we present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
watilkalamsalunadribuhalinnasiwamayaqiluhaillalalimunawatilkaalamthalunadribuhalinnasiwamayaaaqiluhaillaalaaalimoon
Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
Khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), inna fī żālika la'āyatal lil-mu'minīn(a).
خلق الله السموت والارض بالحق  ان في ذلك لايه للمؤمنين
allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
khalaqallahussamawatiwalardabilhaqqiinnafizalikalaayatallilmumininakhalaqaallahuassamawatiwalardabilhaqqiinnafeethalikalaayatanlilmumineen

Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.
Utlu mā ūḥiya ilaika minal-kitābi wa aqimiṣ-ṣalāh(ta), innaṣ-ṣalāta tanhā ‘anil-faḥsyā'i wal-munkar(i), wa lażikrullāhi akbar(u), wallāhu ya‘lamu mā taṣna‘ūn(a).
اتل ما اوحي اليك من الكتب واقم الصلوه  ان الصلوه تنهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر  ولذكر الله اكبر  والله يعلم ما تصنعون

recite, [o muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the book and establish prayer. indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of allah is greater. and allah knows that which you do.

utlumauhiyailaikaminalkitabiwaaqimissalahtainnassalatatanhaanilfahsyaiwalmunkariwalazikrullahiakbaruwallahuyalamumatasnaunaotlumaoohiyailaykaminaalkitabiwaaqimiassalatainnaassalatatanhaaaanialfahshaiwalmunkariwalathikruallahiakbaruwallahuyaaalamumatasnaaaoon

And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
Wa lā tujādilū ahlal-kitābi illā bil-latī hiya aḥsan(u), illal-lażīna ẓalamū minhum wa qūlū āmannā bil-lażī unzila ilainā wa unzila ilaikum wa ilāhunā wa ilāhukum wāḥiduw wa naḥnu lahū muslimūn(a).
ولا تجدلوا اهل الكتب الا بالتي هي احسن الا الذين ظلموا منهم  وقولوا ءامنا بالذي انزل الينا وانزل اليكم والهنا والهكم وحد ونحن له مسلمون

and do not argue with the people of the scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "we believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. and our god and your god is one; and we are muslims [in submission] to him."



And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
Wa każālika anzalnā ilaikal-kitāb(a), fal-lażīna ātaināhumul-kitāba yu'minūna bih(ī), wa min hā'ulā'i may yu'minu bih(ī), wa mā yajḥadu bi'āyātinā illal-kāfirūn(a).
وكذلك انزلنا اليك الكتب  فالذين ءاتينهم الكتب يؤمنون به  ومن هؤلاء من يؤمن به  وما يجحد بايتنا الا الكفرون

and thus we have sent down to you the book [i.e., the qur’an]. and those to whom we [previously] gave the scripture believe in it. and among these [people of makkah] are those who believe in it. and none reject our verses except the disbelievers.

wakazalikaanzalnailaikalkitabafallazinaatainahumulkitabayuminunabihiwaminhaulaimayyuminubihiwamayajhadubiayatinaillalkafirunawakathalikaanzalnailaykaalkitabafallatheenaataynahumualkitabayuminoonabihiwaminhaolaimanyuminubihiwamayajhadubiayatinaillaalkafiroon
And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
Wa mā kunta tatlū min qablihī min kitābiw wa lā takhuṭṭuhū biyamīnika iżal lartābal-mubṭilūn(a).
وما كنت تتلوا من قبله من كتب ولا تخطه بيمينك  اذا لارتاب المبطلون
and you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
wamakuntatatluminqablihiminkitabiwwalatakhuttuhubiyaminikaizallartabalmubtilunawamakuntatatloominqablihiminkitabinwalatakhuttuhubiyameenikaithanlartabaalmubtiloon
Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
Bal huwa āyātum bayyinātun fī ṣudūril-lażīna ūtul-‘ilm(a), wa mā yajḥadu bi'āyātinā illaẓ-ẓālimūn(a).
بل هو ءايت بينت في صدور الذين اوتوا العلم  وما يجحد بايتنا الا الظلمون
rather, it [i.e., the qur’an] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. and none reject our verses except the wrongdoers.
balhuwaayatumbayyinatunfisudurillazinautulilmawamayajhadubiayatinaillazzalimunabalhuwaayatunbayyinatunfeesudooriallatheenaootooalaailmawamayajhadubiayatinaillaaththalimoon
But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
Wa qālū lau lā unzila ‘alaihi āyātum mir rabbih(ī), qul innamal-āyātu ‘indallāh(i), wa innamā ana nażīrum mubīn(un).
وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ءايت من ربه  قل انما الايت عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
but they say, "why are not signs sent down to him from his lord?" say, "the signs are only with allah, and i am only a clear warner."
waqalulaulaunzilaalaihiayatummirrabbihiqulinnamalayatuindallahiwainnamaananazirummubinunwaqaloolawlaonzilaaaalayhiayatunminrabbihiqulinnamaalayatuaaindaallahiwainnamaananatheerunmubeen
And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
Awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ‘alaikal-kitāba yutlā ‘alaihim, inna fī żālika laraḥmataw wa żikrā liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
اولم يكفهم انا انزلنا عليك الكتب يتلي عليهم  ان في ذلك لرحمه وذكري لقوم يؤمنون
and is it not sufficient for them that we revealed to you the book [i.e., the qur’an] which is recited to them? indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
awalamyakfihimannaanzalnaalaikalkitabayutlaalaihiminnafizalikalarahmatawwazikraliqaumiyyuminunaawalamyakfihimannaanzalnaaaalaykaalkitabayutlaaaalayhiminnafeethalikalarahmatanwathikraliqawminyuminoon
Say, "Sufficient is Allāh between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allāh - it is those who are the losers."
Qul kafā billāhi bainī wa bainakum syahīdā(n), ya‘lamu mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wal-lażīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wa kafarū billāhi ulā'ika humul-khāsirūn(a).
قل كفي بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا  يعلم ما في السموت والارض  والذين ءامنوا بالبطل وكفروا بالله اولئك هم الخسرون
say, "sufficient is allah between me and you as witness. he knows what is in the heavens and earth. and they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in allah - it is those who are the losers."

qulkafabillahibainiwabainakumsyahidanyalamumafissamawatiwalardiwallazinaamanubilbatiliwakafarubillahiulaikahumulkhasirunaqulkafabillahibayneewabaynakumshaheedanyaaalamumafeeassamawatiwalardiwallatheenaamanoobilbatiliwakafaroobillahiolaikahumualkhasiroon
And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
Wa yasta‘jilūnaka bil-‘ażāb(i), wa lau lā ajalum musammal lajā'ahumul-‘ażāb(u), wa laya'tiyannahum bagtataw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ويستعجلونك بالعذاب  ولولا اجل مسمي لجاءهم العذاب ولياتينهم بغته وهم لا يشعرون
and they urge you to hasten the punishment. and if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. but it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.

wayastajilunakabilazabiwalaulaajalummusammallajaahumulazabuwalayatiyannahumbagtatawwahumlayasyurunawayastaaajiloonakabilaaathabiwalawlaajalunmusammanlajaahumualaaathabuwalayatiyannahumbaghtatanwahumlayashaauroon
They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
Yasta‘jilūnaka bil-‘ażāb(i), wa inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatum bil-kāfirīn(a).
يستعجلونك بالعذاب وان جهنم لمحيطه بالكفرين
they urge you to hasten the punishment. and indeed, hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
yastajilunakabilazabiwainnajahannamalamuhitatumbilkafirinayastaaajiloonakabilaaathabiwainnajahannamalamuheetatunbilkafireen
On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."
Yauma yagsyāhumul-‘ażābu min fauqihim wa min taḥti arjulihim wa yaqūlu żūqū mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
يوم يغشيهم العذاب من فوقهم ومن تحت ارجلهم ويقول ذوقوا ما كنتم تعملون
on the day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "taste [the result of] what you used to do."
yaumayagsyahumulazabuminfauqihimwamintahtiarjulihimwayaquluzuqumakuntumtamalunayawmayaghshahumualaaathabuminfawqihimwamintahtiarjulihimwayaqooluthooqoomakuntumtaaamaloon
O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
Yā ‘ibādiyal-lażīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsi‘atun fa iyyāya fa‘budūn(i).
يعبادي الذين ءامنوا ان ارضي وسعه فايي فاعبدون
o my servants who have believed, indeed my earth is spacious, so worship only me.
yaibadiyallazinaamanuinnaardiwasiatunfaiyyayafabuduniyaaaibadiyaallatheenaamanooinnaardeewasiaaatunfaiyyayafaaabudoon
Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
Kullu nafsin żā'iqatul-maut(i), ṡumma ilainā turja‘ūn(a).
كل نفس ذائقه الموت  ثم الينا ترجعون
every soul will taste death. then to us will you be returned.
kullunafsinzaiqatulmautisummailainaturjaunakullunafsinthaiqatualmawtithummailaynaturjaaaoon

And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
Wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwi'annahum minal-jannati gurafan tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā, ni‘ma ajrul-‘āmilīn(a).
والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لنبوئنهم من الجنه غرفا تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها  نعم اجر العملين

and those who have believed and done righteous deeds - we will surely assign to them of paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

wallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilanubawwiannahumminaljannatigurafantajrimintahtihalanharukhalidinafihanimaajrulamilinawallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilanubawwiannahumminaaljannatighurafantajreemintahtihaalanharukhalideenafeehaniaamaajrualaaamileen
Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
Al-lażīna ṣabarū wa ‘alā rabbihim yatawakkalūn(a).
الذين صبروا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
who have been patient and upon their lord rely.
allazinasabaruwaalarabbihimyatawakkalunaallatheenasabaroowaaaalarabbihimyatawakkaloon
And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Wa ka'ayyim min dābbatil lā taḥmilu rizqahā, allāhu yarzuquhā wa iyyākum, wa huwas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).
وكاين من دابه لا تحمل رزقها الله يرزقها واياكم  وهو السميع العليم
and how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. allah provides for it and for you. and he is the hearing, the knowing.
wakaayyimmindabbatillatahmilurizqahaallahuyarzuquhawaiyyakumwahuwassamiulalimuwakaayyinmindabbatinlatahmilurizqahaallahuyarzuquhawaiyyakumwahuwaassameeaaualaaaleem
If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Then how are they deluded?
Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunnallāh(u), fa'annā yu'fakūn(a).
ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض وسخر الشمس والقمر ليقولن الله  فاني يؤفكون
if you asked them, "who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "allah." then how are they deluded?

walainsaaltahummankhalaqassamawatiwalardawasakhkharasysyamsawalqamaralayaqulunnallahufaannayufakunawalainsaaltahummankhalaqaassamawatiwalardawasakhkharaashshamsawalqamaralayaqoolunnaallahufaannayufakoon
Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
Allāhu yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī wa yaqdiru lah(ū), innallāha bikulli syai'in ‘alīm(un).
الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له  ان الله بكل شيء عليم
allah extends provision for whom he wills of his servants and restricts for him. indeed allah is, of all things, knowing.
allahuyabsuturrizqalimayyasyauminibadihiwayaqdirulahuinnallahabikullisyaiinalimunallahuyabsutuarrizqalimanyashaominaaibadihiwayaqdirulahuinnaallahabikullishayinaaaleem

And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Praise to Allāh"; but most of them do not reason.
Wa la'in sa'altahum man nazzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa'aḥyā bihil-arḍa mim ba‘di mautihā layaqūlunnallāh(u), qulil-ḥamdu lillāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘qilūn(a).
ولئن سالتهم من نزل من السماء ماء فاحيا به الارض من بعد موتها ليقولن الله  قل الحمد لله  بل اكثرهم لا يعقلون

and if you asked them, "who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "allah." say, "praise to allah"; but most of them do not reason.

walainsaaltahummannazzalaminassamaimaanfaahyabihilardamimbadimautihalayaqulunnallahuqulilhamdulillahibalaksaruhumlayaqilunawalainsaaltahummannazzalaminaassamaimaanfaahyabihialardaminbaaadimawtihalayaqoolunnaallahuqulialhamdulillahibalaktharuhumlayaaaqiloon
And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
Wa mā hāżihil-ḥayātud-dun-yā illā lahwuw wa la‘ib(un), wa innad-dāral-ākhirata  lahiyal-ḥayawān(u), lau kānū ya‘lamūn(a).
وما هذه الحيوه الدنيا الا لهو ولعب  وان الدار الاخره لهي الحيوان  لو كانوا يعلمون
and this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. and indeed, the home of the hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
wamahazihilhayatuddunyaillalahwuwwalaibunwainnaddaralakhiratalahiyalhayawanulaukanuyalamunawamahathihialhayatuaddunyaillalahwunwalaaaibunwainnaaddaraalakhiratalahiyaalhayawanulawkanooyaaalamoon
And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
Fa'iżā rakibū fil-fulki da‘awullāha mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn(a), falammā najjāhum ilal-barri iżā hum yusyrikūn(a).
فاذا ركبوا في الفلك دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر اذا هم يشركون
and when they board a ship, they supplicate allah, sincere to him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. but when he delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with him
faizarakibufilfulkidaawullahamukhlisinalahuddinafalammanajjahumilalbarriizahumyusyrikunafaitharakiboofeealfulkidaaaawooallahamukhliseenalahuaddeenafalammanajjahumilaalbarriithahumyushrikoon
So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
Liyakfurū bimā ātaināhum wa liyatamatta‘ū, fasaufa ya‘lamūn(a).
ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم وليتمتعوا  فسوف يعلمون
so that they will deny what we have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. but they are going to know.
liyakfurubimaatainahumwaliyatamattaufasaufayalamunaliyakfuroobimaataynahumwaliyatamattaaaoofasawfayaaalamoon
Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
Awalam yarau annā ja‘alnā ḥaraman āminaw wa yutakhaṭṭafun-nāsu min ḥaulihim, afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wa bini‘matillāhi yakfurūn(a).
اولم يروا انا جعلنا حرما ءامنا ويتخطف الناس من حولهم  افبالبطل يؤمنون وبنعمه الله يكفرون
have they not seen that we made [makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of allah they disbelieve?

awalamyarauannajaalnaharamanaminawwayutakhattafunnasuminhaulihimafabilbatiliyuminunawabinimatillahiyakfurunaawalamyarawannajaaaalnaharamanaminanwayutakhattafuannasuminhawlihimafabilbatiliyuminoonawabiniaamatiallahiyakfuroon
And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
Wa man aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ‘alallāhi każiban au każżaba bil-ḥaqqi lammā jā'ah(ū), alaisa fī jahannama maṡwal lil-kāfirīn(a).
ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بالحق لما جاءه  اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
and who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? is there not in hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?

wamanazlamumimmaniftaraalallahikazibanaukazzababilhaqqilammajaahualaisafijahannamamaswallilkafirinawamanathlamumimmaniiftaraaaalaallahikathibanawkaththababilhaqqilammajaahualaysafeejahannamamathwanlilkafireen
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
Wal-lażīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā, wa innallāha lama‘al-muḥsinīn(a).
والذين جهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا  وان الله لمع المحسنين
and those who strive for us - we will surely guide them to our ways. and indeed, allah is with the doers of good.
wallazinajahadufinalanahdiyannahumsubulanawainnallahalamaalmuhsininawallatheenajahadoofeenalanahdiyannahumsubulanawainnaallahalamaaaaalmuhsineen
Alif, Lām, Meem.
Alif lām mīm.
الم
alif, lam, meem.
aliflammimaliflammeem
The Byzantines have been defeated
Gulibatir-rūm(u).
غلبت الروم
the byzantines have been defeated
gulibatirrumughulibatiarroom
In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
Fī adnal-arḍi wa hum mim ba‘di galabihim sayaglibūn(a).
في ادني الارض وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون
in the nearest land. but they, after their defeat, will overcome
fiadnalardiwahummimbadigalabihimsayaglibunafeeadnaalardiwahumminbaaadighalabihimsayaghliboon
Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
Fī biḍ‘i sinīn(a), lillāhil-amru min qablu wa mim ba‘d(u), wa yauma'iżiy yafraḥul-mu'minūn(a).
في بضع سنين  لله الامر من قبل ومن بعد  ويومئذ يفرح المؤمنون
within three to nine years. to allah belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. and that day the believers will rejoice
fibidisininalillahilamruminqabluwamimbaduwayaumaiziyyafrahulmuminunafeebidaaisineenalillahialamruminqabluwaminbaaaduwayawmaithinyafrahualmuminoon
In the victory of Allāh. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Binaṣrillāh(i), yanṣuru may yasyā'(u), wa huwal-‘azīzur-raḥīm(u).
بنصر الله  ينصر من يشاء  وهو العزيز الرحيم
in the victory of allah. he gives victory to whom he wills, and he is the exalted in might, the merciful.
binasrillahiyansurumayyasyauwahuwalazizurrahimubinasriallahiyansurumanyashaowahuwaalaaazeezuarraheem
[It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
Wa‘dallāh(i), lā yukhlifullāhu wa‘dahū wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
وعد الله  لا يخلف الله وعده ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
[it is] the promise of allah. allah does not fail in his promise, but most of the people do not know.
wadallahilayukhlifullahuwadahuwalakinnaaksarannasilayalamunawaaadaallahilayukhlifuallahuwaaadahuwalakinnaaktharaannasilayaaalamoon
They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
Ya‘lamūna ẓāhiram minal-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa hum ‘anil-ākhirati hum gāfilūn(a).
يعلمون ظهرا من الحيوه الدنيا وهم عن الاخره هم غفلون
they know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the hereafter, are unaware.
yalamunazahiramminalhayatiddunyawahumanilakhiratihumgafilunayaaalamoonathahiranminaalhayatiaddunyawahumaaanialakhiratihumghafiloon

Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
Awalam yatafakkarū fī anfusihim, mā khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā illā bil-ḥaqqi wa ajalim musammā(n), wa inna kaṡīram minan-nāsi biliqā'i rabbihim lakāfirūn(a).
اولم يتفكروا في انفسهم  ما خلق الله السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق واجل مسمي  وان كثيرا من الناس بلقائ ربهم لكفرون

do they not contemplate within themselves? allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. and indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their lord, are disbelievers.

awalamyatafakkarufianfusihimmakhalaqallahussamawatiwalardawamabainahumaillabilhaqqiwaajalimmusammanwainnakasiramminannasibiliqairabbihimlakafirunaawalamyatafakkaroofeeanfusihimmakhalaqaallahuassamawatiwalardawamabaynahumaillabilhaqqiwaajalinmusammanwainnakatheeranminaannasibiliqairabbihimlakafiroon

Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.

Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qablihim, kānū asyadda minhum quwwataw wa aṡārul-arḍa wa ‘amarūhā akṡara mimmā ‘amarūhā wa jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināt(i), famā kānallāhu liyaẓlimahum wa lākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
