اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبلهم  كانوا اشد منهم قوه واثاروا الارض وعمروها اكثر مما عمروها وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت  فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون

have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? they were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. and allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.


Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
Ṡumma kāna ‘āqibatal-lażīna asā'us-sū'ā an każżabū bi'āyātillāhi wa kānū bihā yastahzi'ūn(a).
ثم كان عقبه الذين اسوا السواي ان كذبوا بايت الله وكانوا بها يستهزءون
then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of allah and used to ridicule them.
summakanaaqibatallazinaasaussuaankazzabubiayatillahiwakanubihayastahziunathummakanaaaaqibataallatheenaasaooassooaankaththaboobiayatiallahiwakanoobihayastahzioon
Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
Allāhu yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū ṡumma ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
الله يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده ثم اليه ترجعون
allah begins creation; then he will repeat it; then to him you will be returned.
allahuyabdaulkhalqasummayuiduhusummailaihiturjaunaallahuyabdaoalkhalqathummayuaaeeduhuthummailayhiturjaaaoon
And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yublisul-mujrimūn(a).
ويوم تقوم الساعه يبلس المجرمون
and the day the hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
wayaumataqumussaatuyublisulmujrimunawayawmataqoomuassaaaatuyublisualmujrimoon
And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
Wa lam yakul lahum min syurakā'ihim syufa‘ā'u wa kānū bisyurakā'ihim kāfirīn(a).
ولم يكن لهم من شركائهم شفعؤا وكانوا بشركائهم كفرين
and there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
walamyakullahumminsyurakaihimsyufaauwakanubisyurakaihimkafirinawalamyakunlahumminshurakaihimshufaaaaowakanoobishurakaihimkafireen
And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yauma'iżiy yatafarraqūn(a).
ويوم تقوم الساعه يومئذ يتفرقون
and the day the hour appears - that day they will become separated.
wayaumataqumussaatuyaumaiziyyatafarraqunawayawmataqoomuassaaaatuyawmaithinyatafarraqoon
And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
Fa ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fahum fī rauḍatiy yuḥbarūn(a).
فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فهم في روضه يحبرون
and as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of paradise], delighted.
faammallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatifahumfiraudatiyyuhbarunafaammaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatifahumfeerawdatinyuhbaroon
But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
Wa ammal-lażīna kafarū wa każżabū bi'āyātinā wa liqā'il-ākhirati fa'ulā'ika fil-‘ażābi muḥḍarūn(a).
واما الذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا ولقائ الاخره فاولئك في العذاب محضرون
but as for those who disbelieved and denied our verses and the meeting of the hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
waammallazinakafaruwakazzabubiayatinawaliqailakhiratifaulaikafilazabimuhdarunawaammaallatheenakafaroowakaththaboobiayatinawaliqaialakhiratifaolaikafeealaaathabimuhdaroon
So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
Fa subḥānallāhi ḥīna tumsūna wa ḥīna tuṣbiḥūn(a).
فسبحن الله حين تمسون وحين تصبحون
so exalted is allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
fasubhanallahihinatumsunawahinatusbihunafasubhanaallahiheenatumsoonawaheenatusbihoon
And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
Wa lahul-ḥamdu fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa ‘asyiyyaw wa ḥīna tuẓhirūn(a).
وله الحمد في السموت والارض وعشيا وحين تظهرون
and to him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. and [exalted is he] at night and when you are at noon.
walahulhamdufissamawatiwalardiwaasyiyyawwahinatuzhirunawalahualhamdufeeassamawatiwalardiwaaaashiyyanwaheenatuthhiroon
He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
Yukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wa yukhrijul-mayyita minal-ḥayyi wa yuḥyil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, wa każālika tukhrajūn(a).
يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ويحي الارض بعد موتها  وكذلك تخرجون
he brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. and thus will you be brought out.

yukhrijulhayyaminalmayyitiwayukhrijulmayyitaminalhayyiwayuhyilardabadamautihawakazalikatukhrajunayukhrijualhayyaminaalmayyitiwayukhrijualmayyitaminaalhayyiwayuhyeealardabaaadamawtihawakathalikatukhrajoon
And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
Wa min āyātihī an khalaqakum min turābin ṡumma iżā antum basyarun tantasyirūn(a).
ومن ءايته ان خلقكم من تراب ثم اذا انتم بشر تنتشرون
and of his signs is that he created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
waminayatihiankhalaqakumminturabinsummaizaantumbasyaruntantasyirunawaminayatihiankhalaqakumminturabinthummaithaantumbasharuntantashiroon

And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
Wa min āyātihī an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājal litaskunū ilaihā wa ja‘ala bainakum mawaddataw wa raḥmah(tan), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ومن ءايته ان خلق لكم من انفسكم ازوجا لتسكنوا اليها وجعل بينكم موده ورحمه  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون

and of his signs is that he created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and he placed between you affection and mercy. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

waminayatihiankhalaqalakumminanfusikumazwajallitaskunuilaihawajaalabainakummawaddatawwarahmahtaninnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyatafakkarunawaminayatihiankhalaqalakumminanfusikumazwajanlitaskunooilayhawajaaaalabaynakummawaddatanwarahmataninnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyatafakkaroon
And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
Wa min āyātihī khalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakhtilāfu alsinatikum wa alwānikum, inna fī żālika la'āyātil lil-‘ālimīn(a).
ومن ءايته خلق السموت والارض واختلف السنتكم والونكم  ان في ذلك لايت للعلمين
and of his signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
waminayatihikhalqussamawatiwalardiwakhtilafualsinatikumwaalwanikuminnafizalikalaayatillilaliminawaminayatihikhalquassamawatiwalardiwakhtilafualsinatikumwaalwanikuminnafeethalikalaayatinlilaaalimeen
And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
Wa min āyātihī manāmukum bil-laili wan-nahāri wabtigā'ukum min faḍlih(ī), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yasma‘ūn(a).
ومن ءايته منامكم باليل والنهار وابتغاؤكم من فضله  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يسمعون
and of his signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of his bounty. indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
waminayatihimanamukumbillailiwannahariwabtigaukumminfadlihiinnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyasmaunawaminayatihimanamukumbillayliwannahariwabtighaokumminfadlihiinnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyasmaaaoon

And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
Wa min āyātihī yurīkumul-barqa khaufaw wa ṭama‘aw wa yunazzilu minas-samā'i mā'an fa yuḥyī bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ومن ءايته يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينزل من السماء ماء فيحي به الارض بعد موتها  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون

and of his signs is [that] he shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and he sends down rain from the sky by which he brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

waminayatihiyurikumulbarqakhaufawwatamaawwayunazziluminassamaimaanfayuhyibihilardabadamautihainnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyaqilunawaminayatihiyureekumualbarqakhawfanwatamaaaanwayunazziluminaassamaimaanfayuhyeebihialardabaaadamawtihainnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyaaaqiloon
And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
Wa min āyātihī an taqūmas-samā'u wal-arḍu bi'amrih(ī), ṡumma iżā da‘ākum da‘watam minal-arḍi iżā antum takhrujūn(a).
ومن ءايته ان تقوم السماء والارض بامره  ثم اذا دعاكم دعوه من الارض اذا انتم تخرجون
and of his signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by his command. then when he calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
waminayatihiantaqumassamauwalardubiamrihisummaizadaakumdawatamminalardiizaantumtakhrujunawaminayatihiantaqoomaassamaowalardubiamrihithummaithadaaaakumdaaawatanminaalardiithaantumtakhrujoon
And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
Wa lahū man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), kullul lahū qānitūn(a).
وله من في السموت والارض  كل له قنتون
and to him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. all are to him devoutly obedient.
walahumanfissamawatiwalardikullullahuqanitunawalahumanfeeassamawatiwalardikullunlahuqanitoon

And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Wa huwal-lażī yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū wa huwa ahwanu ‘alaih(i), wa lahul-maṡalul-a‘lā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
وهو الذي يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده وهو اهون عليه  وله المثل الاعلي في السموت والارض  وهو العزيز الحكيم

and it is he who begins creation; then he repeats it, and that is [even] easier for him. to him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. and he is the exalted in might, the wise.

wahuwallaziyabdaulkhalqasummayuiduhuwahuwaahwanualaihiwalahulmasalulalafissamawatiwalardiwahuwalazizulhakimuwahuwaallatheeyabdaoalkhalqathummayuaaeeduhuwahuwaahwanuaaalayhiwalahualmathalualaaalafeeassamawatiwalardiwahuwaalaaazeezualhakeem

He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

Ḍaraba lakum maṡalam min anfusikum, hal lakum mim mā malakat aimānukum min syurakā'a fī mā razaqnākum fa'antum fīhi sawā'un takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum, każālika nufaṣṣilul-āyāti liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ضرب لكم مثلا من انفسكم  هل لكم من ما ملكت ايمنكم من شركاء في ما رزقنكم فانتم فيه سواء تخافونهم كخيفتكم انفسكم  كذلك نفصل الايت لقوم يعقلون

he presents to you an example from yourselves. do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what we have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? thus do we detail the verses for a people who use reason.


But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
Balittaba‘al-lażīna ẓalamū ahwā'ahum bigairi ‘ilm(in), famay yahdī man aḍallallāh(u), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
بل اتبع الذين ظلموا اهواءهم بغير علم  فمن يهدي من اضل الله  وما لهم من نصرين
but those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. then who can guide one whom allah has sent astray? and for them there are no helpers.
balittabaallazinazalamuahwaahumbigairiilminfamayyahdimanadallallahuwamalahumminnasirinabaliittabaaaaallatheenathalamooahwaahumbighayriaailminfamanyahdeemanadallaallahuwamalahumminnasireen

So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
Fa aqim wajhaka lid-dīni ḥanīfā(n), fiṭratallāhil-latī faṭaran-nāsa ‘alaihā, lā tabdīla likhalqillāh(i), żālikad-dīnul-qayyim(u), wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
فاقم وجهك للدين حنيفا  فطرت الله التي فطر الناس عليها  لا تبديل لخلق الله  ذلك الدين القيم ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون

so direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [adhere to] the fitrah of allah upon which he has created [all] people. no change should there be in the creation of allah. that is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

faaqimwajhakaliddinihanifanfitratallahillatifatarannasaalaihalatabdilalikhalqillahizalikaddinulqayyimuwalakinnaaksarannasilayalamunafaaqimwajhakaliddeenihaneefanfitrataallahiallateefataraannasaaaalayhalatabdeelalikhalqiallahithalikaaddeenualqayyimuwalakinnaaktharaannasilayaaalamoon
[Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
Munībīna ilaihi wattaqūhu wa aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa lā takūnū minal-musyrikīn(a).
منيبين اليه واتقوه واقيموا الصلوه ولا تكونوا من المشركين
[adhere to it], turning in repentance to him, and fear him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with allah
munibinailaihiwattaquhuwaaqimussalatawalatakunuminalmusyrikinamuneebeenailayhiwattaqoohuwaaqeemooassalatawalatakoonoominaalmushrikeen
[Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
Minal-lażīna farraqū dīnahum wa kānū syiya‘ā(n), kullu ḥizbim bimā ladaihim fariḥūn(a).
من الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا  كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
[or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
minallazinafarraqudinahumwakanusyiyaankulluhizbimbimaladaihimfarihunaminaallatheenafarraqoodeenahumwakanooshiyaaaankulluhizbinbimaladayhimfarihoon
And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
Wa iżā massan-nāsa ḍurrun da‘au rabbahum munībīna ilaihi ṡumma iżā ażāqahum minhu raḥmatan iżā farīqum minhum birabbihim yusyrikūn(a).
واذا مس الناس ضر دعوا ربهم منيبين اليه ثم اذا اذاقهم منه رحمه اذا فريق منهم بربهم يشركون
and when adversity touches the people, they call upon their lord, turning in repentance to him. then when he lets them taste mercy from him, at once a party of them associate others with their lord,

waizamassannasadurrundaaurabbahummunibinailaihisummaizaazaqahumminhurahmatanizafariqumminhumbirabbihimyusyrikunawaithamassaannasadurrundaaaawrabbahummuneebeenailayhithummaithaathaqahumminhurahmatanithafareequnminhumbirabbihimyushrikoon
So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
Liyakfurū bimā ātaināhum, fatamatta‘ū, fasaufa ta‘lamūn(a).
ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم  فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
so that they will deny what we have granted them. then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
liyakfurubimaatainahumfatamattaufasaufatalamunaliyakfuroobimaataynahumfatamattaaaoofasawfataaalamoon
Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
Am anzalnā ‘alaihim sulṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihī yusyrikūn(a).
ام انزلنا عليهم سلطنا فهو يتكلم بما كانوا به يشركون
or have we sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with him?
amanzalnaalaihimsultananfahuwayatakallamubimakanubihiyusyrikunaamanzalnaaaalayhimsultananfahuwayatakallamubimakanoobihiyushrikoon
And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
Wa iżā ażaqnan-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā, wa in tuṣibhum sayyi'atum bimā qaddamat aidīhim iżā hum yaqnaṭūn(a).
واذا اذقنا الناس رحمه فرحوا بها  وان تصبهم سيئه بما قدمت ايديهم اذا هم يقنطون
and when we let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
waizaazaqnannasarahmatanfarihubihawaintusibhumsayyiatumbimaqaddamataidihimizahumyaqnatunawathaathaqnaannasarahmatanfarihoobihawaintusibhumsayyiatunbimaqaddamataydeehimithahumyaqnatoon
Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Awalam yarau annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
اولم يروا ان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
do they not see that allah extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]? indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
awalamyarauannallahayabsuturrizqalimayyasyauwayaqdiruinnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyuminunaawalamyarawannaallahayabsutuarrizqalimanyashaowayaqdiruinnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyuminoon
So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
Fa āti żal-qurbā ḥaqqahū wal-miskīna wabnas-sabīl(i), żālika khairul lil-lażīna yurīdūna wajhallāh(i), wa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
فات ذا القربي حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل  ذلك خير للذين يريدون وجه الله  واولئك هم المفلحون
so give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. that is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of allah, and it is they who will be the successful.

faatizalqurbahaqqahuwalmiskinawabnassabilizalikakhairullillazinayuridunawajhallahiwaulaikahumulmuflihunafaatithaalqurbahaqqahuwalmiskeenawabnaassabeelithalikakhayrunlillatheenayureedoonawajhaallahiwaolaikahumualmuflihoon

And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.
Wa mā ātaitum mir ribal liyarbuwa fī amwālin-nāsi falā yarbū ‘indallāh(i), wa mā ātaitum min zakātin turīdūna wajhallāhi fa'ulā'ika humul-muḍ‘ifūn(a).
وما ءاتيتم من ربا ليربوا في امول الناس فلا يربوا عند الله  وما ءاتيتم من زكوه تريدون وجه الله فاولئك هم المضعفون

and whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with allah. but what you give in zakah, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of allah - those are the multipliers.

wamaataitummirriballiyarbuwafiamwalinnasifalayarbuindallahiwamaataitumminzakatinturidunawajhallahifaulaikahumulmudifunawamaataytumminribanliyarbuwafeeamwaliannasifalayarbooaaindaallahiwamaataytumminzakatintureedoonawajhaallahifaolaikahumualmudaaifoon

Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
Allāhul-lażī khalaqakum ṡumma razaqakum ṡumma yumītukum ṡumma yuḥyīkum, hal min syurakā'ikum may yaf‘alu min żālikum min syai'(in), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
الله الذي خلقكم ثم رزقكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم  هل من شركائكم من يفعل من ذلكم من شيء  سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون

allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? exalted is he and high above what they associate with him.

allahullazikhalaqakumsummarazaqakumsummayumitukumsummayuhyikumhalminsyurakaikummayyafaluminzalikumminsyaiinsubhanahuwataalaammayusyrikunaallahuallatheekhalaqakumthummarazaqakumthummayumeetukumthummayuhyeekumhalminshurakaikummanyafaaaluminthalikumminshayinsubhanahuwataaaalaaaammayushrikoon

Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
Żaharal-fasādu fil-barri wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aidin-nāsi liyużīqahum ba‘ḍal-lażī ‘amilū la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ظهر الفساد في البر والبحر بما كسبت ايدي الناس ليذيقهم بعض الذي عملوا لعلهم يرجعون

corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so he [i.e., allah] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

zaharalfasadufilbarriwalbahribimakasabataidinnasiliyuziqahumbadallaziamilulaallahumyarjiunathaharaalfasadufeealbarriwalbahribimakasabataydeeannasiliyutheeqahumbaaadaallatheeaaamiloolaaaallahumyarjiaaoon
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qabl(u), kāna akṡaruhum musyrikīn(a).
قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبل  كان اكثرهم مشركين
say, [o muhammad], "travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. most of them were associators [of others with allah].
qulsirufilardifanzurukaifakanaaqibatullazinaminqablukanaaksaruhummusyrikinaqulseeroofeealardifanthurookayfakanaaaaqibatuallatheenaminqablukanaaktharuhummushrikeen
So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.
Fa aqim wajhaka lid-dīnil-qayyimi min qabli ay ya'tiya yaumul lā maradda lahū minallāhi yauma'iżiy yaṣṣadda‘ūn(a).
فاقم وجهك للدين القيم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله  يومئذ يصدعون
so direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a day comes from allah of which there is no repelling. that day, they will be divided.
faaqimwajhakaliddinilqayyimiminqabliayyatiyayaumullamaraddalahuminallahiyaumaiziyyassaddaunafaaqimwajhakaliddeenialqayyimiminqablianyatiyayawmunlamaraddalahuminaallahiyawmaithinyassaddaaaoon
Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
Man kafara fa ‘alaihi kufruh(ū), wa man ‘amila ṣāliḥan fali'anfusihim yamhadūn(a).
من كفر فعليه كفره  ومن عمل صلحا فلانفسهم يمهدون
whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. and whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
mankafarafaalaihikufruhuwamanamilasalihanfalianfusihimyamhadunamankafarafaaaalayhikufruhuwamanaaamilasalihanfalianfusihimyamhadoon
That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
Liyajziyal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlih(ī), innahū lā yuḥibbul-kāfirīn(a).
ليجزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من فضله  انه لا يحب الكفرين
that he may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of his bounty. indeed, he does not like the disbelievers.
liyajziyallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatiminfadlihiinnahulayuhibbulkafirinaliyajziyaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatiminfadlihiinnahulayuhibbualkafireen

And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
Wa min āyātihī ay yursilar-riyāḥa mubasysyirātiw wa liyużīqakum mir raḥmatihī wa litajriyal-fulka bi'amrihī wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ومن ءايته ان يرسل الرياح مبشرت وليذيقكم من رحمته ولتجري الفلك بامره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون

and of his signs is that he sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste his mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at his command and so you may seek of his bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.

waminayatihiayyursilarriyahamubasysyiratiwwaliyuziqakummirrahmatihiwalitajriyalfulkabiamrihiwalitabtaguminfadlihiwalaallakumtasykurunawaminayatihianyursilaarriyahamubashshiratinwaliyutheeqakumminrahmatihiwalitajriyaalfulkubiamrihiwalitabtaghoominfadlihiwalaaaallakumtashkuroon

And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.
Wa laqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qaumihim fajā'ūhum bil-bayyināti fantaqamnā minal-lażīna ajramū, wa kāna ḥaqqan ‘alainā naṣrul-mu'minīn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا من قبلك رسلا الي قومهم فجاءوهم بالبينت فانتقمنا من الذين اجرموا  وكان حقا علينا نصر المؤمنين

and we have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then we took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon us was support of the believers.

walaqadarsalnaminqablikarusulanilaqaumihimfajauhumbilbayyinatifantaqamnaminallazinaajramuwakanahaqqanalainanasrulmumininawalaqadarsalnaminqablikarusulanilaqawmihimfajaoohumbilbayyinatifantaqamnaminaallatheenaajramoowakanahaqqanaaalaynanasrualmumineen

It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

Allāhul-lażī yursilur-riyāḥa fatuṡīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhū fis-samā'i kaifa yasyā'u wa yaj‘aluhū kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilālih(ī), fa'iżā aṣāba bihī may yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī iżā hum yastabsyirūn(a).
الله الذي يرسل الريح فتثير سحابا فيبسطه في السماء كيف يشاء ويجعله كسفا فتري الودق يخرج من خلله  فاذا اصاب به من يشاء من عباده اذا هم يستبشرون

it is allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however he wills, and he makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. and when he causes it to fall upon whom he wills of his servants, immediately they rejoice


Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
Wa in kānū min qabli ay yunazzala ‘alaihim min qablihī lamublisīn(a).
وان كانوا من قبل ان ينزل عليهم من قبله لمبلسين
although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
wainkanuminqabliayyunazzalaalaihimminqablihilamublisinawainkanoominqablianyunazzalaaaalayhimminqablihilamubliseen
So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
Fanẓur ilā āṡāri raḥmatillāhi kaifa yuḥyil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, inna żālika lamuḥyil-mautā, wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
فانظر الي ءاثر رحمت الله كيف يحي الارض بعد موتها  ان ذلك لمحي الموتي  وهو علي كل شيء قدير
so observe the effects of the mercy of allah - how he gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and he is over all things competent.

fanzurilaasarirahmatillahikaifayuhyilardabadamautihainnazalikalamuhyilmautawahuwaalakullisyaiinqadirunfanthurilaatharirahmatiallahikayfayuhyeealardabaaadamawtihainnathalikalamuhyeealmawtawahuwaaaalakullishayinqadeer
But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
Wa la'in arsalnā rīḥan fara'auhu muṣfarral laẓallū mim ba‘dihī yakfurūn(a).
ولئن ارسلنا ريحا فراوه مصفرا لظلوا من بعده يكفرون
but if we should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
walainarsalnarihanfaraauhumusfarrallazallumimbadihiyakfurunawalainarsalnareehanfaraawhumusfarranlathalloominbaaadihiyakfuroon
So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
Fa innaka lā tusmi‘ul-mautā wa lā tusmi‘uṣ-ṣummad-du‘ā'a iżā wallau mudbirīn(a).
فانك لا تسمع الموتي ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ولوا مدبرين
so indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
fainnakalatusmiulmautawalatusmiussummadduaaizawallaumudbirinafainnakalatusmiaaualmawtawalatusmiaauassummaadduaaaaithawallawmudbireen
And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
Wa mā anta bihādil-‘umyi ‘an ḍalālatihim, in tusmi‘u illā may yu'minu bi'āyātinā fahum muslimūn(a).
وما انت بهد العمي عن ضللتهم  ان تسمع الا من يؤمن بايتنا فهم مسلمون
and you cannot guide the blind away from their error. you will only make hear those who believe in our verses so they are muslims [in submission to allah].
wamaantabihadilumyiandalalatihimintusmiuillamayyuminubiayatinafahummuslimunawamaantabihadialaaumyiaaandalalatihimintusmiaauillamanyuminubiayatinafahummuslimoon
Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
Allāhul-lażī khalaqakum min ḍa‘fin ṡumma ja‘ala mim ba‘di ḍa‘fin quwwatan ṡumma ja‘ala mim ba‘di quwwatin ḍa‘faw wa syaibah(tan), yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), wa huwal-‘alīmul-qadīr(u).
الله الذي خلقكم من ضعف ثم جعل من بعد ضعف قوه ثم جعل من بعد قوه ضعفا وشيبه  يخلق ما يشاء  وهو العليم القدير
allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. he creates what he wills, and he is the knowing, the competent.

allahullazikhalaqakummindafinsummajaalamimbadidafinquwwatansummajaalamimbadiquwwatindafawwasyaibahtanyakhluqumayasyauwahuwalalimulqadiruallahuallatheekhalaqakummindaaafinthummajaaaalaminbaaadidaaafinquwwatanthummajaaaalaminbaaadiquwwatindaaafanwashaybatanyakhluqumayashaowahuwaalaaaleemualqadeer
And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
Wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yuqsimul-mujrimūn(a), mā labiṡū gaira sā‘ah(tin), każālika kānū yu'fakūn(a).
ويوم تقوم الساعه يقسم المجرمون ما لبثوا غير ساعه  كذلك كانوا يؤفكون
and the day the hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. thus they were deluded.
wayaumataqumussaatuyuqsimulmujrimunamalabisugairasaahtinkazalikakanuyufakunawayawmataqoomuassaaaatuyuqsimualmujrimoonamalabithooghayrasaaaatinkathalikakanooyufakoon
But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."
Wa qālal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma wal-īmāna laqad labiṡtum fī kitābillāhi ilā yaumil-ba‘ṡ(i), fa hāżā yaumul-baṡi wa lākinnakum kuntum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
وقال الذين اوتوا العلم والايمن لقد لبثتم في كتب الله الي يوم البعث  فهذا يوم البعث ولكنكم كنتم لا تعلمون
but those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "you remained the extent of allah's decree until the day of resurrection, and this is the day of resurrection, but you did not used to know."

waqalallazinautulilmawalimanalaqadlabistumfikitabillahiilayaumilbasifahazayaumulbasiwalakinnakumkuntumlatalamunawaqalaallatheenaootooalaailmawaleemanalaqadlabithtumfeekitabiallahiilayawmialbaaathifahathayawmualbaaathiwalakinnakumkuntumlataaalamoon
So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
Fa yauma'iżil lā yanfa‘ul-lażīna ẓalamū ma‘żiratuhum wa lā hum yusta‘tabūn(a).
فيومئذ لا ينفع الذين ظلموا معذرتهم ولا هم يستعتبون
so that day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [allah].
fayaumaizillayanfaullazinazalamumaziratuhumwalahumyustatabunafayawmaithinlayanfaaauallatheenathalamoomaaathiratuhumwalahumyustaaataboon

And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
Wa laqad ḍarabnā lin-nāsi fī hāżal-qur'āni min kulli maṡal(in), wa la'in ji'tahum bi'āyatil layaqūlannal-lażīna kafarū in antum illā mubṭilūn(a).
ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل  ولئن جئتهم بايه ليقولن الذين كفروا ان انتم الا مبطلون

and we have certainly presented to the people in this qur’an from every [kind of] example. but, [o muhammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "you [believers] are but falsifiers."

walaqaddarabnalinnasifihazalquraniminkullimasalinwalainjitahumbiayatillayaqulannallazinakafaruinantumillamubtilunawalaqaddarabnalinnasifeehathaalquraniminkullimathalinwalainjitahumbiayatinlayaqoolannaallatheenakafarooinantumillamubtiloon
Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.
Każālika yaṭba‘ullāhu ‘alā qulūbil-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a).
كذلك يطبع الله علي قلوب الذين لا يعلمون
thus does allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.
kazalikayatbaullahualaqulubillazinalayalamunakathalikayatbaaauallahuaaalaquloobiallatheenalayaaalamoon
So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
Faṣbir inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqquw wa lā yastakhiffannakal-lażīna lā yūqinūn(a).
فاصبر ان وعد الله حق  ولا يستخفنك الذين لا يوقنون
so be patient. indeed, the promise of allah is truth. and let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
fasbirinnawadallahihaqquwwalayastakhiffannakallazinalayuqinunafasbirinnawaaadaallahihaqqunwalayastakhiffannakaallatheenalayooqinoon
Alif, Lām, Meem.
Alif lām mīm.
الم
alif, lam, meem.
aliflammimaliflammeem
These are verses of the wise Book,
Tilka āyātul-kitābil-ḥakīm(i).
تلك ءايت الكتب الحكيم
these are verses of the wise book,
tilkaayatulkitabilhakimitilkaayatualkitabialhakeem
As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
Hudaw wa raḥmatal lil-muḥsinīn(a).
هدي ورحمه للمحسنين
as guidance and mercy for the doers of good
hudawwarahmatallilmuhsininahudanwarahmatanlilmuhsineen
Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].
Allażīna yuqīmūnaṣ-ṣalāta wa yu'tūnaz-zakāta wa hum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn(a).
الذين يقيمون الصلوه ويؤتون الزكوه وهم بالاخره هم يوقنون
who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the hereafter, are certain [in faith].
allazinayuqimunassalatawayutunazzakatawahumbilakhiratihumyuqinunaallatheenayuqeemoonaassalatawayutoonaazzakatawahumbilakhiratihumyooqinoon
Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
Ulā'ika ‘alā hudam mir rabbihim wa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).
اولئك علي هدي من ربهم  واولئك هم المفلحون
those are on [right] guidance from their lord, and it is those who are the successful.
ulaikaalahudammirrabbihimwaulaikahumulmuflihunaolaikaaaalahudanminrabbihimwaolaikahumualmuflihoon

And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
Wa minan-nāsi may yasytarī lahwal-ḥadīṡi liyuḍilla ‘an sabīlillāhi bigairi ‘ilmiw wa yattakhiżahā huzuwā(n), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābum muhīn(un).
ومن الناس من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله بغير علم ويتخذها هزوا  اولئك لهم عذاب مهين

and of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of allah without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., his way] in ridicule. those will have a humiliating punishment.

waminannasimayyasytarilahwalhadisiliyudillaansabilillahibigairiilmiwwayattakhizahahuzuwanulaikalahumazabummuhinunwaminaannasimanyashtareelahwaalhadeethiliyudillaaaansabeeliallahibighayriaailminwayattakhithahahuzuwanolaikalahumaaathabunmuheen
And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihi āyātunā wallā mustakbiran ka'allam yasma‘hā ka'anna fī użunaihi waqrā(n), fabasyyirhu bi‘ażābin alīm(in).
واذا تتلي عليه ءايتنا ولي مستكبرا كان لم يسمعها كان في اذنيه وقرا  فبشره بعذاب اليم
and when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. so give him tidings of a painful punishment.

waizatutlaalaihiayatunawallamustakbirankaallamyasmahakaannafiuzunaihiwaqranfabasyyirhubiazabinaliminwaithatutlaaaalayhiayatunawallamustakbirankaanlamyasmaaahakaannafeeothunayhiwaqranfabashshirhubiaaathabinaleem
Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,
Innal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun na‘īm(i).
ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت النعيم
indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the gardens of pleasure,
innallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilahumjannatunnaimiinnaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilahumjannatuannaaaeem
Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Khālidīna fīhā, wa‘dallāhi ḥaqqā(n), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
خلدين فيها  وعد الله حقا  وهو العزيز الحكيم
wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of allah [which is] truth. and he is the exalted in might, the wise.
khalidinafihawadallahihaqqanwahuwalazizulhakimukhalideenafeehawaaadaallahihaqqanwahuwaalaaazeezualhakeem

He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.
Khalaqas-samāwāti bigairi ‘amadin taraunahā wa alqā fil-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa baṡṡa fīhā min kulli dābbah(tin), wa anzalnā minas-samā'i mā'an fa ambatnā fīhā min kulli zaujin karīm(in).
خلق السموت بغير عمد ترونها  والقي في الارض روسي ان تميد بكم وبث فيها من كل دابه  وانزلنا من السماء ماء فانبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم

he created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. and we sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.


This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
Hāżā khalqullāhi fa arūnī māżā khalaqal-lażīna min dūnih(ī), baliẓ-ẓālimūna fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
هذا خلق الله فاروني ماذا خلق الذين من دونه  بل الظلمون في ضلل مبين
this is the creation of allah. so show me what those other than him have created. rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
hazakhalqullahifaarunimazakhalaqallazinamindunihibalizzalimunafidalalimmubininhathakhalquallahifaarooneemathakhalaqaallatheenamindoonihibaliaththalimoonafeedalalinmubeen

And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
Wa laqad ātainā luqmānal-ḥikmata anisykur lillāh(i), wa may yasykur fa'innamā yasykuru linafsih(ī), wa man kafara fa'innallāha ganiyyun ḥamīd(un).
ولقد ءاتينا لقمن الحكمه ان اشكر لله  ومن يشكر فانما يشكر لنفسه  ومن كفر فان الله غني حميد

and we had certainly given luqman wisdom [and said], "be grateful to allah." and whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. and whoever denies [his favor] - then indeed, allah is free of need and praiseworthy.

walaqadatainaluqmanalhikmataanisykurlillahiwamayyasykurfainnamayasykurulinafsihiwamankafarafainnallahaganiyyunhamidunwalaqadataynaluqmanaalhikmataanioshkurlillahiwamanyashkurfainnamayashkurulinafsihiwamankafarafainnaallahaghaniyyunhameed
And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."
Wa iż qāla luqmānu libnihī wa huwa ya‘iẓuhū yā bunayya lā tusyrik billāh(i), innasy-syirka laẓulmun ‘aẓīm(un).
واذ قال لقمن لابنه وهو يعظه يبني لا تشرك بالله  ان الشرك لظلم عظيم
and [mention, o muhammad], when luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "o my son, do not associate [anything] with allah. indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."
waizqalaluqmanulibnihiwahuwayaizuhuyabunayyalatusyrikbillahiinnasysyirkalazulmunazimunwaithqalaluqmanulibnihiwahuwayaaaithuhuyabunayyalatushrikbillahiinnaashshirkalathulmunaaatheem

And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.
Wa waṣṣainal-insāna biwālidaih(i), ḥamalathu ummuhū wahnan ‘alā wahniw wa fiṣāluhū fī ‘āmaini anisykur lī wa liwālidaik(a), ilayyal-maṣīr(u).
ووصينا الانسن بولديه حملته امه وهنا علي وهن وفصله في عامين ان اشكر لي ولولديك الي المصير

and we have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. his mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. be grateful to me and to your parents; to me is the [final] destination.

wawassainalinsanabiwalidaihihamalathuummuhuwahnanalawahniwwafisaluhufiamainianisykurliwaliwalidaikailayyalmasiruwawassaynaalinsanabiwalidayhihamalathuommuhuwahnanaaalawahninwafisaluhufeeaaamaynianioshkurleewaliwalidaykailayyaalmaseer

But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

Wa in jāhadāka ‘alā an tusyrika bī mā laisa laka bihī ‘ilmun falā tuṭi‘humā wa ṣāḥibhumā fid-dun-yā ma‘rūfā(n), wattabi‘ sabīla man anāba ilayya(a), ṡumma ilayya marji‘ukum fa unabbi'ukum bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
وان جهداك علي ان تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما  وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا  واتبع سبيل من اناب الي  ثم الي مرجعكم فانبئكم بما كنتم تعملون

but if they endeavor to make you associate with me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to me [in repentance]. then to me will be your return, and i will inform you about what you used to do.



[And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
Yā bunayya innahā in taku miṡqāla ḥabbatim min khardalin fatakun fī ṣakhratin au fis-samāwāti au fil-arḍi ya'ti bihallāh(u), innallāha laṭīfun khabīr(un).
يبني انها ان تك مثقال حبه من خردل فتكن في صخره او في السموت او في الارض يات بها الله  ان الله لطيف خبير

[and luqman said], "o my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, allah will bring it forth. indeed, allah is subtle and aware.

yabunayyainnahaintakumisqalahabbatimminkhardalinfatakunfisakhratinaufissamawatiaufilardiyatibihallahuinnallahalatifunkhabirunyabunayyainnahaintakumithqalahabbatinminkhardalinfatakunfeesakhratinawfeeassamawatiawfeealardiyatibihaallahuinnaallahalateefunkhabeer
O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
Yā bunayya aqimiṣ-ṣalāta wa'mur bil-ma‘rūfi wanha ‘anil-munkari waṣbir ‘alā mā aṣābak(a), inna żālika min ‘azmil-umūr(i).
يبني اقم الصلوه وامر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر علي ما اصابك  ان ذلك من عزم الامور
o my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
yabunayyaaqimissalatawamurbilmarufiwanhaanilmunkariwasbiralamaasabakainnazalikaminazmilumuriyabunayyaaqimiassalatawamurbilmaaaroofiwanhaaaanialmunkariwasbiraaalamaasabakainnathalikaminaaazmialomoor
And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
Wa lā tuṣa‘‘ir khaddaka lin-nāsi wa lā tamsyi fil-arḍi maraḥā(n), innallāha lā yuḥibbu kulla mukhtālin fakhūr(in).
ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الارض مرحا  ان الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
and do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. indeed, allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
walatusairkhaddakalinnasiwalatamsyifilardimarahaninnallahalayuhibbukullamukhtalinfakhurinwalatusaaaaairkhaddakalinnasiwalatamshifeealardimarahaninnaallahalayuhibbukullamukhtalinfakhoor
And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
Waqṣid fī masy-yika wagḍuḍ min ṣautik(a), inna ankaral-aṣwāti laṣautul-ḥamīr(i).
واقصد في مشيك واغضض من صوتك  ان انكر الاصوت لصوت الحمير
and be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
waqsidfimasyyikawagdudminsautikainnaankaralaswatilasautulhamiriwaqsidfeemashyikawaghdudminsawtikainnaankaraalaswatilasawtualhameer

Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

Alam tarau annallāha sakhkhara lakum mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍi wa asbaga ‘alaikum ni‘amahū ẓāhirataw wa bāṭinah(tan), wa minan-nāsi may yujādilu fillāhi bigairi ‘ilmiw wa lā hudaw wa lā kitābim munīr(in).
الم تروا ان الله سخر لكم ما في السموت وما في الارض واسبغ عليكم نعمه ظهره وباطنه  ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ولا هدي ولا كتب منير

do you not see that allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you his favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? but of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from him].


And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
Wa iżā qīla lahumuttabi‘ū mā anzalallāhu qālū bal nattabi‘u mā wajadnā ‘alaihi ābā'anā, awalau kānasy-syaiṭānu yad‘ūhum ilā ‘ażābis-sa‘īr(i).
واذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما انزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه ءاباءنا  اولو كان الشيطن يدعوهم الي عذاب السعير
and when it is said to them, "follow what allah has revealed," they say, "rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." even if satan was inviting them to the punishment of the blaze?

waizaqilalahumuttabiumaanzalallahuqalubalnattabiumawajadnaalaihiabaanaawalaukanasysyaitanuyaduhumilaazabissairiwaithaqeelalahumuittabiaaoomaanzalaallahuqaloobalnattabiaaumawajadnaaaalayhiabaanaawalawkanaashshaytanuyadaaoohumilaaaathabiassaaaeer
And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.
Wa may yuslim wajhahū ilallāhi wa huwa muḥsinun faqadistamsaka bil-‘urwatil-wuṡqā, wa ilallāhi ‘āqibatul-umūr(i).
ومن يسلم وجهه الي الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروه الوثقي  والي الله عقبه الامور
and whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. and to allah will be the outcome of [all] matters.
wamayyuslimwajhahuilallahiwahuwamuhsinunfaqadistamsakabilurwatilwusqawailallahiaqibatulumuriwamanyuslimwajhahuilaallahiwahuwamuhsinunfaqadiistamsakabilaaurwatialwuthqawailaallahiaaaqibatualomoor
And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
Wa man kafara falā yaḥzunka kufruh(ū), ilainā marji‘uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimā ‘amilū, innallāha ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره  الينا مرجعهم فننبئهم بما عملوا  ان الله عليم بذات الصدور
and whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. to us is their return, and we will inform them of what they did. indeed, allah is knowing of that within the breasts.

wamankafarafalayahzunkakufruhuilainamarjiuhumfanunabbiuhumbimaamiluinnallahaalimumbizatissuduriwamankafarafalayahzunkakufruhuilaynamarjiaauhumfanunabbiohumbimaaaamilooinnaallahaaaaleemunbithatiassudoor
We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
Numatti‘uhum qalīlan ṡumma naḍṭarruhum ilā ‘ażābin galīẓ(in).
نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم الي عذاب غليظ
we grant them enjoyment for a little; then we will force them to a massive punishment.
numattiuhumqalilansummanadtarruhumilaazabingalizinnumattiaauhumqaleelanthummanadtarruhumilaaaathabinghaleeth
And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.
Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa  layaqūlunnallāh(u), qulil-ḥamdu lillāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله  قل الحمد لله  بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
and if you asked them, "who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "allah." say, "[all] praise is [due] to allah"; but most of them do not know.
walainsaaltahummankhalaqassamawatiwalardalayaqulunnallahuqulilhamdulillahibalaksaruhumlayalamunawalainsaaltahummankhalaqaassamawatiwalardalayaqoolunnaallahuqulialhamdulillahibalaktharuhumlayaaalamoon
To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), innallāha huwal-ganiyyul-ḥamīd(u).
لله ما في السموت والارض  ان الله هو الغني الحميد
to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. indeed, allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy.
lillahimafissamawatiwalardiinnallahahuwalganiyyulhamidulillahimafeeassamawatiwalardiinnaallahahuwaalghaniyyualhameed

And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
Wa lau anna mā fil-arḍi min syajaratin aqlāmuw wal-baḥru yamudduhū mim ba‘dihī sab‘atu abḥurim mā nafidat kalimātullāh(i), innallāha ‘azīzun ḥakīm(un).
ولو انما في الارض من شجره اقلم والبحر يمده من بعده سبعه ابحر ما نفدت كلمت الله  ان الله عزيز حكيم

and if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of allah would not be exhausted. indeed, allah is exalted in might and wise.

walauannamafilardiminsyajaratinaqlamuwwalbahruyamudduhumimbadihisabatuabhurimmanafidatkalimatullahiinnallahaazizunhakimunwalawannamafeealardiminshajaratinaqlamunwalbahruyamudduhuminbaaadihisabaaatuabhurinmanafidatkalimatuallahiinnaallahaaaazeezunhakeem
Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
Mā khalqukum wa lā ba‘ṡukum illā kanafsiw wāḥidah(tin), innallāha samī‘um baṣīr(un).
ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم الا كنفس وحده  ان الله سميع بصير
your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. indeed, allah is hearing and seeing.
makhalqukumwalabasukumillakanafsiwwahidahtininnallahasamiumbasirunmakhalqukumwalabaaathukumillakanafsinwahidatininnaallahasameeaaunbaseer

Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?
Alam tara annallāha yūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa yūlijun-nahāra fil-laili wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamar(a), kulluy yajrī ilā ajalim musammaw wa annallāha bimā ta‘malūna khabīr(un).
الم تر ان الله يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري الي اجل مسمي وان الله بما تعملون خبير

do you not see [i.e., know] that allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that allah, of whatever you do, is aware?


That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
Żālika bi'annallāha huwal-ḥaqqu wa anna mā yad‘ūna min dūnihil-bāṭil(u), wa annallāha huwal-‘aliyyul-kabīr(u).
ذلك بان الله هو الحق وان ما يدعون من دونه البطل وان الله هو العلي الكبير
that is because allah is the true reality, and that what they call upon other than him is falsehood, and because allah is the most high, the grand.
zalikabiannallahahuwalhaqquwaannamayadunamindunihilbatiluwaannallahahuwalaliyyulkabiruthalikabiannaallahahuwaalhaqquwaannamayadaaoonamindoonihialbatiluwaannaallahahuwaalaaaliyyualkabeer
Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
Alam tara annal-fulka tajrī fil-baḥri bini‘matillāhi liyuriyakum min āyātih(ī), inna fī żālika  la'āyātil likulli ṣabbārin syakūr(in).
الم تر ان الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله ليريكم من ءايته  ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of allah that he may show you of his signs? indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

alamtaraannalfulkatajrifilbahribinimatillahiliyuriyakumminayatihiinnafizalikalaayatillikullisabbarinsyakurinalamtaraannaalfulkatajreefeealbahribiniaamatiallahiliyuriyakumminayatihiinnafeethalikalaayatinlikullisabbarinshakoor

And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
Wa iżā gasyiyahum maujun kaẓ-ẓulali da‘awullāha mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn(a), falammā najjāhum ilal-barri faminhum muqtaṣid(un), wa mā yajḥadu bi'āyātinā illā kullu khattārin kafūr(in).
واذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر فمنهم مقتصد  وما يجحد بايتنا الا كل ختار كفور

and when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate allah, sincere to him in religion [i.e., faith]. but when he delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. and none rejects our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.



O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

Ya ayyuhan-nāsuttaqū rabbakum wakhsyau yaumal lā yajzī wālidun ‘aw waladih(ī), wa lā maulūdun huwa jāzin ‘aw wālidihī syai'ā(n), inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqqun falā tagurrannakumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, wa lā yagurrannakum billāhil-garūr(u).
يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيا  ان وعد الله حق  فلا تغرنكم الحيوه الدنيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور

o mankind, fear your lord and fear a day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. indeed, the promise of allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about allah by the deceiver [i.e., satan].



Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

Innallāha ‘indahū ‘ilmus-sā‘ah(ti), wa yunazzilul-gaiṡ(a), wa ya‘lamu mā fil-arḥām(i), wa mā tadrī nafsum māżā taksibu gadā(n), wa mā tadrī nafsum bi'ayyi arḍin tamūt(u), innallāha ‘alīmun khabīr(un).
ان الله عنده علم الساعه وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الارحام  وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا  وما تدري نفس باي ارض تموت  ان الله عليم خبير

indeed, allah [alone] has knowledge of the hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. and no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. indeed, allah is knowing and aware.


Alif, Lām, Meem.
Alif lām mīm.
الم
alif, lam, meem.
aliflammimaliflammeem
[This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
Tanzīlul-kitābi lā raiba fīhi mir rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
تنزيل الكتب لا ريب فيه من رب العلمين
[this is] the revelation of the book about which there is no doubt from the lord of the worlds.
tanzilulkitabilaraibafihimirrabbilalaminatanzeelualkitabilaraybafeehiminrabbialaaalameen
Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
Am yaqūlūnaftarāhu balhuwal-ḥaqqu mir rabbika litunżira qaumam mā atāhum min nażīrim min qablika la‘allahum yahtadūn(a).
ام يقولون افتريه  بل هو الحق من ربك لتنذر قوما ما اتيهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يهتدون
or do they say, "he invented it"? rather, it is the truth from your lord, [o muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

amyaqulunaftarahubalhuwalhaqqumirrabbikalitunziraqaumammaatahumminnazirimminqablikalaallahumyahtadunaamyaqooloonaiftarahubalhuwaalhaqquminrabbikalitunthiraqawmanmaatahumminnatheerinminqablikalaaaallahumyahtadoon

It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
Allāhul-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā fī sittati ayyāmin ṡummastawā ‘alal-‘arsy(i), mā lakum min dūnihī miw waliyyiw wa lā syafī‘(in), afalā tatażakkarūn(a).
الله الذي خلق السموت والارض وما بينهما في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش  ما لكم من دونه من ولي ولا شفيع  افلا تتذكرون

it is allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then he established himself above the throne. you have not besides him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

allahullazikhalaqassamawatiwalardawamabainahumafisittatiayyaminsummastawaalalarsyimalakummindunihimiwwaliyyiwwalasyafiinafalatatazakkarunaallahuallatheekhalaqaassamawatiwalardawamabaynahumafeesittatiayyaminthummaistawaaaalaalaaarshimalakummindoonihiminwaliyyinwalashafeeaainafalatatathakkaroon
He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
Yudabbirul-amra minas-samā'i ilal-arḍi ṡumma ya‘ruju ilaihi fī yaumin kāna miqdāruhū alfa sanatim mimmā ta‘uddūn(a).
يدبر الامر من السماء الي الارض ثم يعرج اليه في يوم كان مقداره الف سنه مما تعدون
he arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to him in a day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
yudabbirulamraminassamaiilalardisummayarujuilaihifiyauminkanamiqdaruhualfasanatimmimmatauddunayudabbirualamraminaassamaiilaalardithummayaaarujuilayhifeeyawminkanamiqdaruhualfasanatinmimmataaauddoon
That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
Żālika ‘ālimul-gaibi wasy-syahādatil-‘azīzur-raḥīm(u).
ذلك علم الغيب والشهده العزيز الرحيم
that is the knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the exalted in might, the merciful,
zalikaalimulgaibiwasysyahadatilazizurrahimuthalikaaaalimualghaybiwashshahadatialaaazeezuarraheem
Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
Allażī aḥsana kulla syai'in khalaqahū wa bada'a khalqal-insāni min ṭīn(in).
الذي احسن كل شيء خلقه  وبدا خلق الانسن من طين
who perfected everything which he created and began the creation of man from clay.
allaziahsanakullasyaiinkhalaqahuwabadaakhalqalinsanimintininallatheeahsanakullashayinkhalaqahuwabadaakhalqaalinsaniminteen
Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
Ṡumma ja‘ala naslahū min sulālatim mim mā'im mahīn(in).
ثم جعل نسله من سلله من ماء مهين
then he made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
summajaalanaslahuminsulalatimmimmaimmahininthummajaaaalanaslahuminsulalatinminmainmaheen
Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
Ṡumma sawwāhu wa nafakha fīhi mir rūḥihī wa ja‘ala lakumus-sam‘a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idah(ta), qalīlam mā tasykurūn(a).
ثم سويه ونفخ فيه من روحه  وجعل لكم السمع والابصر والافده  قليلا ما تشكرون
then he proportioned him and breathed into him from his [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
summasawwahuwanafakhafihimirruhihiwajaalalakumussamawalabsarawalafidahtaqalilammatasykurunathummasawwahuwanafakhafeehiminroohihiwajaaaalalakumuassamaaawalabsarawalafidataqaleelanmatashkuroon
And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
Wa qālū a'iżā ḍalalnā fil-arḍi a'innā lafī khalqin jadīd(in), bal hum biliqā'i rabbihim kāfirūn(a).
وقالوا اءذا ضللنا في الارض اءنا لفي خلق جديد  بل هم بلقاء ربهم كفرون
and they say, "when we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" rather, they are, in the meeting with their lord, disbelievers.
waqaluaizadalalnafilardiainnalafikhalqinjadidinbalhumbiliqairabbihimkafirunawaqalooaithadalalnafeealardiainnalafeekhalqinjadeedinbalhumbiliqairabbihimkafiroon
Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
Qul yatawaffākum malakul-mautil-lażī wukkila bikum ṡumma ilā rabbikum turja‘ūn(a).
قل يتوفيكم ملك الموت الذي وكل بكم ثم الي ربكم ترجعون
say, "the angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. then to your lord you will be returned."
qulyatawaffakummalakulmautillaziwukkilabikumsummailarabbikumturjaunaqulyatawaffakummalakualmawtiallatheewukkilabikumthummailarabbikumturjaaaoon

If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
Wa lau tarā iżil-mujrimūna nākisū ru'ūsihim ‘inda rabbihim, rabbanā abṣarnā wa sami‘nā farji‘nā na‘mal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūn(a).
ولو تري اذ المجرمون ناكسوا رءوسهم عند ربهم ربنا ابصرنا وسمعنا فارجعنا نعمل صلحا انا موقنون

if you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their lord, [saying], "our lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. indeed, we are [now] certain."

walautaraizilmujrimunanakisuruusihimindarabbihimrabbanaabsarnawasaminafarjinanamalsalihaninnamuqinunawalawtaraithialmujrimoonanakisooruoosihimaaindarabbihimrabbanaabsarnawasamiaanafaarjiaananaaamalsalihaninnamooqinoon
And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
Wa lau syi'nā la'ātainā kulla nafsin hudāhā wa lākin ḥaqqal-qaulu minnī la'amla'anna  jahannama minal-jinnati wan-nāsi ajma‘īn(a).
ولو شئنا لاتينا كل نفس هديها ولكن حق القول مني لاملان جهنم من الجنه والناس اجمعين
and if we had willed, we could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from me will come into effect [that] "i will surely fill hell with jinn and people all together.

walausyinalaatainakullanafsinhudahawalakinhaqqalqauluminnilaamlaannajahannamaminaljinnatiwannasiajmainawalawshinalaataynakullanafsinhudahawalakinhaqqaalqawluminneelaamlaannajahannamaminaaljinnatiwannasiajmaaaeen
So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
Fa żūqū bimā nasītum liqā'a yaumikum hāżā, innā nasīnākum wa żūqū ‘ażābal-khuldi bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
فذوقوا بما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا انا نسينكم  وذوقوا عذاب الخلد بما كنتم تعملون
so taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your day; indeed, we have [accordingly] forgotten you. and taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
fazuqubimanasitumliqaayaumikumhazainnanasinakumwazuquazabalkhuldibimakuntumtamalunafathooqoobimanaseetumliqaayawmikumhathainnanaseenakumwathooqooaaathabaalkhuldibimakuntumtaaamaloon
Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
Innamā yu'minu bi'āyātinal-lażīna iżā żukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadaw wa sabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wa hum lā yastakbirūn(a).
انما يؤمن بايتنا الذين اذا ذكروا بها خروا سجدا وسبحوا بحمد ربهم وهم لا يستكبرون
only those believe in our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [allah] with praise of their lord, and they are not arrogant.

innamayuminubiayatinallazinaizazukkirubihakharrusujjadawwasabbahubihamdirabbihimwahumlayastakbirunainnamayuminubiayatinaallatheenaithathukkiroobihakharroosujjadanwasabbahoobihamdirabbihimwahumlayastakbiroon
Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
Tatajāfā junūbuhum ‘anil-maḍāji‘i yad‘ūna rabbahum khaufaw wa ṭama‘ā(n), wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn(a).
تتجافي جنوبهم عن المضاجع يدعون ربهم خوفا وطمعا ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their lord in fear and aspiration, and from what we have provided them, they spend.
tatajafajunubuhumanilmadajiiyadunarabbahumkhaufawwatamaanwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqunatatajafajunoobuhumaaanialmadajiaaiyadaaoonarabbahumkhawfanwatamaaaanwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqoon
And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
Falā ta‘lamu nafsum mā ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a‘yun(in), jazā'am bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
فلا تعلم نفس ما اخفي لهم من قره اعين جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
and no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
falatalamunafsummaukhfiyalahumminqurratiayuninjazaambimakanuyamalunafalataaalamunafsunmaokhfiyalahumminqurratiaaayuninjazaanbimakanooyaaamaloon
Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
Afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqā(n), lā yastawūn(a).
افمن كان مؤمنا كمن كان فاسقا  لا يستون
then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? they are not equal.
afamankanamuminankamankanafasiqanlayastawunaafamankanamuminankamankanafasiqanlayastawoon
As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
Ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātul-ma'wā, nuzulam bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
اما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فلهم جنت الماوي نزلا بما كانوا يعملون
as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the gardens of refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
ammallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatifalahumjannatulmawanuzulambimakanuyamalunaammaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatifalahumjannatualmawanuzulanbimakanooyaaamaloon

But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
Wa ammal-lażīna fasaqū fa ma'wākumun nāru kullamā arādū ay yakhrujū minhā u‘īdū fīhā wa qīla lahum żūqū ‘ażāban nāril-lażī kuntum bihī tukażżibūn(a).
واما الذين فسقوا فماويهم النار  كلما ارادوا ان يخرجوا منها اعيدوا فيها وقيل لهم ذوقوا عذاب النار الذي كنتم به تكذبون

but as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the fire. every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "taste the punishment of the fire which you used to deny."

waammallazinafasaqufamawakumunnarukullamaaraduayyakhrujuminhauidufihawaqilalahumzuquazabannarillazikuntumbihitukazzibunawaammaallatheenafasaqoofamawahumuannarukullamaaradooanyakhrujoominhaoaaeedoofeehawaqeelalahumthooqooaaathabaannariallatheekuntumbihitukaththiboon
And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
Wa lanużīqannahum minal-‘ażābil-adnā dūnal-‘ażābil-akbari la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ولنذيقنهم من العذاب الادني دون العذاب الاكبر لعلهم يرجعون
and we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
walanuziqannahumminalazabiladnadunalazabilakbarilaallahumyarjiunawalanutheeqannahumminaalaaathabialadnadoonaalaaathabialakbarilaaaallahumyarjiaaoon
And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
Wa man aẓlamu mimman żukkira bi'āyāti rabbihī ṡumma a‘raḍa ‘anhā, innā minal-mujrimīna muntaqimūn(a).
ومن اظلم ممن ذكر بايت ربه ثم اعرض عنها  انا من المجرمين منتقمون
and who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his lord; then he turns away from them? indeed we, from the criminals, will take retribution.
wamanazlamumimmanzukkirabiayatirabbihisummaaradaanhainnaminalmujriminamuntaqimunawamanathlamumimmanthukkirabiayatirabbihithummaaaaradaaaanhainnaminaalmujrimeenamuntaqimoon
And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.
Wa laqad ātainā mūsal-kitāba falā takun fī miryatim mil liqā'ihī wa ja‘alnāhu hudal libanī isrā'īl(a).
ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب فلا تكن في مريه من لقائه  وجعلنه هدي لبني اسرءيل
and we certainly gave moses the scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. and we made it [i.e., the torah] guidance for the children of israel.
walaqadatainamusalkitabafalatakunfimiryatimmilliqaihiwajaalnahuhudallibaniisrailawalaqadataynamoosaalkitabafalatakunfeemiryatinminliqaihiwajaaaalnahuhudanlibaneeisraeel
And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
Wa ja‘alnā minhum a'immatay yahdūna bi'amrinā lammā ṣabarū, wa kānū bi'āyātinā yūqinūn(a).
وجعلنا منهم ائمه يهدون بامرنا لما صبروا  وكانوا بايتنا يوقنون
and we made from among them leaders guiding by our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of our signs.
wajaalnaminhumaimmatayyahdunabiamrinalammasabaruwakanubiayatinayuqinunawajaaaalnaminhumaimmatanyahdoonabiamrinalammasabaroowakanoobiayatinayooqinoon
Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
Inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu bainahum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ان ربك هو يفصل بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
innarabbakahuwayafsilubainahumyaumalqiyamatifimakanufihiyakhtalifunainnarabbakahuwayafsilubaynahumyawmaalqiyamatifeemakanoofeehiyakhtalifoon
Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim minal-qurūni yamsyūna fī masākinihim, inna fī żālika la'āyāt(in), afalā yasma‘ūn(a).
اولم يهد لهم كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مسكنهم  ان في ذلك لايت  افلا يسمعون
has it not become clear to them how many generations we destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?

awalamyahdilahumkamahlaknaminqablihimminalquruniyamsyunafimasakinihiminnafizalikalaayatinafalayasmaunaawalamyahdilahumkamahlaknaminqablihimminaalqurooniyamshoonafeemasakinihiminnafeethalikalaayatinafalayasmaaaoon
Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
Awalam yarau annā nasūqul-mā'a ilal-arḍil juruzi fanukhriju bihī zar‘an ta'kulu minhu an‘āmuhum wa anfushum, afalā yubṣirūn(a).
اولم يروا انا نسوق الماء الي الارض الجرز فنخرج به زرعا تاكل منه انعمهم وانفسهم  افلا يبصرون
have they not seen that we drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? then do they not see?

awalamyarauannanasuqulmaailalardiljuruzifanukhrijubihizarantakuluminhuanamuhumwaanfushumafalayubsirunaawalamyarawannanasooqualmaailaalardialjuruzifanukhrijubihizaraaantakuluminhuanaaamuhumwaanfusuhumafalayubsiroon
And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ويقولون متي هذا الفتح ان كنتم صدقين
and they say, "when will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
wayaqulunamatahazalfathuinkuntumsadiqinawayaqooloonamatahathaalfathuinkuntumsadiqeen
Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
Qul yaumal-fatḥi lā yanfa‘ul-lażīna kafarū īmānuhum wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).
قل يوم الفتح لا ينفع الذين كفروا ايمنهم ولا هم ينظرون
say, [o muhammad], "on the day of conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
qulyaumalfathilayanfaullazinakafaruimanuhumwalahumyunzarunaqulyawmaalfathilayanfaaauallatheenakafarooeemanuhumwalahumyuntharoon
So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
Fa a‘riḍ ‘anhum wantaẓir innahum muntaẓirūn(a).
فاعرض عنهم وانتظر انهم منتظرون
so turn away from them and wait. indeed, they are waiting.
faaridanhumwantazirinnahummuntazirunafaaaaridaaanhumwantathirinnahummuntathiroon
O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyuttaqillāha wa lā tuṭi‘il-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīn(a), innallāha kāna ‘alīman ḥakīmā(n).
يايها النبي اتق الله ولا تطع الكفرين والمنفقين  ان الله كان عليما حكيما
o prophet, fear allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. indeed, allah is ever knowing and wise.
yaayyuhannabiyyuttaqillahawalatutiilkafirinawalmunafiqinainnallahakanaalimanhakimanyaayyuhaannabiyyuittaqiallahawalatutiaaialkafireenawalmunafiqeenainnaallahakanaaaaleemanhakeema
And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
Wattabi‘ mā yūḥā ilaika mir rabbik(a), innallāha kāna bimā ta‘malūna khabīrā(n).
واتبع ما يوحي اليك من ربك  ان الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
and follow that which is revealed to you from your lord. indeed allah is ever, of what you do, aware.
wattabimayuhailaikamirrabbikainnallahakanabimatamalunakhabiranwattabiaamayoohailaykaminrabbikainnaallahakanabimataaamaloonakhabeera
And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
Wa tawakkal ‘alallāh(i), wa kafā billāhi wakīlā(n).
وتوكل علي الله  وكفي بالله وكيلا
and rely upon allah; and sufficient is allah as disposer of affairs.
watawakkalalallahiwakafabillahiwakilanwatawakkalaaalaallahiwakafabillahiwakeela

Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.

Mā ja‘alallāhu lirajulim min qalbaini fī jaufih(ī), wa mā ja‘ala azwājakumul-lā'ī tuẓāhirūna minhunna  ummahātikum, wa mā ja‘ala ad‘iyā'akum abnā'akum, żālikum qaulukum bi'afwāhikum, wallāhu yaqūlul-ḥaqqa wa huwa yahdis-sabīl(a).
ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفه  وما جعل ازوجكم الي تظهرون منهن امهتكم  وما جعل ادعياءكم ابناءكم  ذلكم قولكم بافوهكم  والله يقول الحق وهو يهدي السبيل

allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. and he has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. and he has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. that is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but allah says the truth, and he guides to the [right] way.



Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

Ud‘ūhum li'ābā'ihim huwa aqsaṭu ‘indallāh(i), fa illam ta‘lamū ābā'ahum fa ikhwānukum fid-dīni wa mawālīkum, wa laisa ‘alaikum junāḥun fīmā akhṭa'tum bihī wa lākim mā ta‘ammadat qulūbukum, wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ادعوهم لابائهم هو اقسط عند الله  فان لم تعلموا ءاباءهم فاخونكم في الدين وموليكم  وليس عليكم جناح فيما اخطاتم به ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم  وكان الله غفورا رحيما

call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of allah. but if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. and there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful.



The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.

An-nabiyyu aulā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa azwājuhū ummahātuhum, wa ulul-arḥāmi ba‘ḍuhum aulā biba‘ḍin fī kitābillāhi minal-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an taf‘alū ilā auliyā'ikum ma‘rūfā(n), kāna żālika fil-kitābi masṭūrā(n).
النبي اولي بالمؤمنين من انفسهم  وازوجه امهتهم  واولوا الارحام بعضهم اولي ببعض في كتب الله من المؤمنين والمهجرين الا ان تفعلوا الي اوليائكم معروفا  كان ذلك في الكتب مسطورا

the prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. and those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. that was in the book inscribed.


And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant
