walatanfausysyafaatuindahuillalimanazinalahuhattaizafuzziaanqulubihimqalumazaqalarabbukumqalulhaqqawahuwalaliyyulkabiruwalatanfaaauashshafaaaatuaaindahuillalimanathinalahuhattaithafuzziaaaaaanquloobihimqaloomathaqalarabbukumqalooalhaqqawahuwaalaaaliyyualkabeer
Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), qulillāh(u), wa innā au iyyākum la‘alā hudan au fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
قل من يرزقكم من السموت والارض  قل الله  وانا او اياكم لعلي هدي او في ضلل مبين
say, "who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" say, "allah. and indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
qulmayyarzuqukumminassamawatiwalardiqulillahuwainnaauiyyakumlaalahudanaufidalalimmubininqulmanyarzuqukumminaassamawatiwalardiquliallahuwainnaawiyyakumlaaaalahudanawfeedalalinmubeen
Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
Qul lā tus'alūna ‘ammā ajramnā wa lā nus'alu ‘ammā ta‘malūn(a).
قل لا تسلون عما اجرمنا ولا نسل عما تعملون
say, "you will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
qullatusalunaammaajramnawalanusaluammatamalunaqullatusaloonaaaammaajramnawalanusaluaaammataaamaloon
Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."
Qul yajma‘u bainanā rabbunā ṡumma yaftaḥu bainanā bil-ḥaqq(i), wa huwal-fattāḥul-‘alīm(u).
قل يجمع بيننا ربنا ثم يفتح بيننا بالحق وهو الفتاح العليم
say, "our lord will bring us together; then he will judge between us in truth. and he is the knowing judge."
qulyajmaubainanarabbunasummayaftahubainanabilhaqqiwahuwalfattahulalimuqulyajmaaaubaynanarabbunathummayaftahubaynanabilhaqqiwahuwaalfattahualaaaleem
Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
Qul arūniyal-lażīna alḥaqtum bihī syurakā'a kallā, bal huwallāhul-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
قل اروني الذين الحقتم به شركاء  كلا  بل هو الله العزيز الحكيم
say, "show me those whom you have attached to him as partners. no! rather, he [alone] is allah, the exalted in might, the wise."
qularuniyallazinaalhaqtumbihisyurakaakallabalhuwallahulazizulhakimuqularooniyaallatheenaalhaqtumbihishurakaakallabalhuwaallahualaaazeezualhakeem
And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
Wa mā arsalnāka illā kāffatal lin-nāsi basyīraw wa nażīraw wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
وما ارسلنك الا كافه للناس بشيرا ونذيرا ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
and we have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. but most of the people do not know.
wamaarsalnakaillakaffatallinnasibasyirawwanazirawwalakinnaaksarannasilayalamunawamaarsalnakaillakaffatanlinnasibasheeranwanatheeranwalakinnaaktharaannasilayaaalamoon
And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
wayaqulunamatahazalwaduinkuntumsadiqinawayaqooloonamatahathaalwaaaduinkuntumsadiqeen
Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
Qul lakum mī‘ādu yaumil lā tasta'khirūna ‘anhu sā‘ataw wa lā tastaqdimūn(a).
قل لكم ميعاد يوم لا تستخرون عنه ساعه ولا تستقدمون
say, "for you is the appointment of a day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
qullakummiaduyaumillatastakhirunaanhusaatawwalatastaqdimunaqullakummeeaaaduyawminlatastakhiroonaaaanhusaaaatanwalatastaqdimoon

And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."

Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lan nu'mina bihāżal-qur'āni wa lā bil-lażī baina yadaih(i), wa lau tarā iżiẓ-ẓālimūna mauqūfūna ‘inda rabbihim, yarji‘u ba‘ḍuhum ilā ba‘ḍinil-qaul(a), yaqūlul-lażīnastuḍ‘ifū lil-lażīnastakbarū lau lā antum lakunnā mu'minīn(a).
وقال الذين كفروا لن نؤمن بهذا القرءان ولا بالذي بين يديه  ولو تري اذ الظلمون موقوفون عند ربهم يرجع بعضهم الي بعض القول يقول الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا لولا انتم لكنا مؤمنين

and those who disbelieve say, "we will never believe in this qur’an nor in that before it." but if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their lord, refuting each others' words... those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "if not for you, we would have been believers."


Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
Qālal-lażīnastakbarū lil-lażīnastuḍ‘ifū anaḥnu ṣadadnākum ‘anil-hudā ba‘da iż jā'akum bal kuntum mujrimīn(a).
قال الذين استكبروا للذين استضعفوا انحن صددنكم عن الهدي بعد اذ جاءكم  بل كنتم مجرمين
those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? rather, you were criminals."
qalallazinastakbarulillazinastudifuanahnusadadnakumanilhudabadaizjaakumbalkuntummujriminaqalaallatheenaistakbaroolillatheenaistudaaifooanahnusadadnakumaaanialhudabaaadaithjaakumbalkuntummujrimeen

Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

Wa qālal-lażīnastuḍ‘ifū lil-lażīnastakbarū bal makrul-laili wan-nahāri iż ta'murūnanā an nakfura billāhi wa naj‘ala lahū andādā(n), wa asarrun-nadāmata lammā ra'awul-‘ażāb(a), wa ja‘alnal-aglāla fī a‘nāqil-lażīna kafarū, hal yujzauna illā mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
وقال الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا بل مكر اليل والنهار اذ تامروننا ان نكفر بالله ونجعل له اندادا  واسروا الندامه لما راوا العذاب وجعلنا الاغلل في اعناق الذين كفروا  هل يجزون الا ما كانوا يعملون

those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in allah and attribute to him equals." but they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and we will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?


And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
Wa mā arsalnā min qaryatim min nażīrin illā qāla mutrafūhā, innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn(a).
وما ارسلنا في قريه من نذير الا قال مترفوها انا بما ارسلتم به كفرون
and we did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
wamaarsalnaminqaryatimminnazirinillaqalamutrafuhainnabimaursiltumbihikafirunawamaarsalnafeeqaryatinminnatheerinillaqalamutrafoohainnabimaorsiltumbihikafiroon
And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
Wa qālū naḥnu akṡaru amwālaw wa aulādā(n), wa mā naḥnu bimu‘ażżabīn(a).
وقالوا نحن اكثر امولا واولدا وما نحن بمعذبين
and they said, "we are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
waqalunahnuaksaruamwalawwaauladanwamanahnubimuazzabinawaqaloonahnuaktharuamwalanwaawladanwamanahnubimuaaaththabeen
Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
Qul inna rabbī yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdiru wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
قل ان ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
say, "indeed, my lord extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
qulinnarabbiyabsuturrizqalimayyasyauwayaqdiruwalakinnaaksarannasilayalamunaqulinnarabbeeyabsutuarrizqalimanyashaowayaqdiruwalakinnaaktharaannasilayaaalamoon

And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].
Wa mā amwālukum wa lā aulādukum bil-latī tuqarribukum ‘indanā zulfā illā man āmana wa ‘amila ṣāliḥā(n), fa'ulā'ika lahum jazā'uḍ-ḍi‘fi bimā ‘amilū wa hum fil-gurufāti āminūn(a).
وما امولكم ولا اولدكم بالتي تقربكم عندنا زلفي الا من ءامن وعمل صلحا فاولئك لهم جزاء الضعف بما عملوا وهم في الغرفت ءامنون

and it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. for them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of paradise], safe [and secure].

wamaamwalukumwalaauladukumbillatituqarribukumindanazulfaillamanamanawaamilasalihanfaulaikalahumjazauddifibimaamiluwahumfilgurufatiaminunawamaamwalukumwalaawladukumbillateetuqarribukumaaindanazulfaillamanamanawaaaamilasalihanfaolaikalahumjazaoaddiaafibimaaaamiloowahumfeealghurufatiaminoon
And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
Wal-lażīna yas‘auna fī āyātinā mu‘ājizīna ulā'ika fil-‘ażābi muḥḍarūn(a).
والذين يسعون في ءايتنا معجزين اولئك في العذاب محضرون
and the ones who strive against our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
wallazinayasaunafiayatinamuajizinaulaikafilazabimuhdarunawallatheenayasaaawnafeeayatinamuaaajizeenaolaikafeealaaathabimuhdaroon

Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
Qul inna rabbī yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī wa yaqdiru lah(ū), wa mā anfaqtum min syai'in fahuwa yukhlifuh(ū), wa huwa khairur-rāziqīn(a).
قل ان ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له  وما انفقتم من شيء فهو يخلفه  وهو خير الرزقين

say, "indeed, my lord extends provision for whom he wills of his servants and restricts [it] for him. but whatever thing you spend [in his cause] - he will compensate it; and he is the best of providers."

qulinnarabbiyabsuturrizqalimayyasyauminibadihiwayaqdirulahuwamaanfaqtumminsyaiinfahuwayukhlifuhuwahuwakhairurraziqinaqulinnarabbeeyabsutuarrizqalimanyashaominaaibadihiwayaqdirulahuwamaanfaqtumminshayinfahuwayukhlifuhuwahuwakhayruarraziqeen
And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
Wa yauma yaḥsyuruhum jamī‘an ṡumma yaqūlu lil-malā'ikati ahā'ulā'i iyyākum kānū ya‘budūn(a).
ويوم يحشرهم جميعا ثم يقول للملئكه اهؤلاء اياكم كانوا يعبدون
and [mention] the day when he will gather them all and then say to the angels, "did these [people] used to worship you?"
wayaumayahsyuruhumjamiansummayaqululilmalaikatiahaulaiiyyakumkanuyabudunawayawmayahshuruhumjameeaaanthummayaqoolulilmalaikatiahaolaiiyyakumkanooyaaabudoon
They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
Qālū subḥānaka anta waliyyunā min dūnihim, bal kānū ya‘budūnal-jinna akṡaruhum bihim mu'minūn(a).
قالوا سبحنك انت ولينا من دونهم  بل كانوا يعبدون الجن  اكثرهم بهم مؤمنون
they will say, "exalted are you! you, [o allah], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
qalusubhanakaantawaliyyunamindunihimbalkanuyabudunaljinnaaksaruhumbihimmuminunaqaloosubhanakaantawaliyyunamindoonihimbalkanooyaaabudoonaaljinnaaktharuhumbihimmuminoon

But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."
Fal-yauma lā yamliku ba‘ḍukum liba‘ḍin naf‘aw wa ḍarrā(n), wa naqūlu lil-lażīna ẓalamū żūqū ‘ażāban-nāril-latī kuntum bihā tukażżibūn(a).
فاليوم لا يملك بعضكم لبعض نفعا ولا ضرا ونقول للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون

but today [i.e., the day of judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and we will say to those who wronged, "taste the punishment of the fire, which you used to deny."

falyaumalayamlikubadukumlibadinnafawwadarranwanaqululillazinazalamuzuquazabannarillatikuntumbihatukazzibunafalyawmalayamlikubaaadukumlibaaadinnafaaanwaladarranwanaqoolulillatheenathalamoothooqooaaathabaannariallateekuntumbihatukaththiboon

And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātin qālū mā hāżā illā rajuluy yurīdu ay yaṣuddakum ‘ammā kāna ya‘budu ābā'ukum, wa qālū mā hāżā illā ifkum muftarā(n), wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-ḥaqqi lammā jā'ahum, in hāżā illā siḥrum mubīn(un).
واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت قالوا ما هذا الا رجل يريد ان يصدكم عما كان يعبد ءاباؤكم وقالوا ما هذا الا افك مفتري  وقال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم ان هذا الا سحر مبين

and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "this is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." and they say, "this is not except a lie invented." and those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "this is not but obvious magic."


And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.
Wa mā ātaināhum min kutubiy yadrusūnahā wa mā arsalnā ilaihim qablaka min nażīr(in).
وما ءاتينهم من كتب يدرسونها  وما ارسلنا اليهم قبلك من نذير
and we had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and we had not sent to them before you, [o muhammad], any warner.
wamaatainahumminkutubiyyadrusunahawamaarsalnailaihimqablakaminnazirinwamaataynahumminkutubinyadrusoonahawamaarsalnailayhimqablakaminnatheer

And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.
Wa każżabal-lażīna min qablihim, wa mā balagū mi‘syāra mā ātaināhum fakażżabū rusulī, fakaifa kāna nakīr(i).
وكذب الذين من قبلهم وما بلغوا معشار ما ءاتينهم فكذبوا رسلي  فكيف كان نكير

and those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of makkah] have not attained a tenth of what we had given them. but they [i.e., the former peoples] denied my messengers, so how [terrible] was my reproach.
wakazzaballazinaminqablihimwamabalagumisyaramaatainahumfakazzaburusulifakaifakananakiriwakaththabaallatheenaminqablihimwamabalaghoomiaasharamaataynahumfakaththaboorusuleefakayfakananakeer

Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
Qul innamā a‘iẓukum biwāḥidah(tin), an taqūmū lillāhi maṡnā wa furādā ṡumma tatafakkarū, mā biṣāḥibikum min jinnah(tin), in huwa illā nażīrul lakum baina yadai ‘ażābin syadīd(in).
قل انما اعظكم بوحده  ان تقوموا لله مثني وفردي ثم تتفكروا  ما بصاحبكم من جنه  ان هو الا نذير لكم بين يدي عذاب شديد

say, "i only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for allah, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." there is not in your companion any madness. he is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

qulinnamaaizukumbiwahidahtinantaqumulillahimasnawafuradasummatatafakkarumabisahibikumminjinnahtininhuwaillanazirullakumbainayadaiazabinsyadidinqulinnamaaaaithukumbiwahidatinantaqoomoolillahimathnawafuradathummatatafakkaroomabisahibikumminjinnatininhuwaillanatheerunlakumbaynayadayaaathabinshadeed
Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."
Qul mā sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum, in ajriya illā ‘alallāh(i), wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'in syahīd(un).
قل ما سالتكم من اجر فهو لكم  ان اجري الا علي الله  وهو علي كل شيء شهيد
say, "whatever payment i might have asked of you - it is yours. my payment is only from allah, and he is, over all things, witness."
qulmasaaltukumminajrinfahuwalakuminajriyaillaalallahiwahuwaalakullisyaiinsyahidunqulmasaaltukumminajrinfahuwalakuminajriyaillaaaalaallahiwahuwaaaalakullishayinshaheed
Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
Qul inna rabbī yaqżifu bil-ḥaqq(i), ‘allāmul-guyūb(i).
قل ان ربي يقذف بالحق علم الغيوب
say, "indeed, my lord projects the truth, knower of the unseen."
qulinnarabbiyaqzifubilhaqqiallamulguyubiqulinnarabbeeyaqthifubilhaqqiaaallamualghuyoob
Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."
Qul jā'al-ḥaqqu wa mā yubdi'ul-bāṭilu wa mā yu‘īd(u).
قل جاء الحق وما يبدئ البطل وما يعيد
say, "the truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."
quljaalhaqquwamayubdiulbatiluwamayuiduquljaaalhaqquwamayubdioalbatiluwamayuaaeed
Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
Qul in ḍalaltu fa'innamā aḍillu ‘alā nafsī, wa inihtadaitu  fabimā yūḥī ilayya rabbī, innahū samī‘un qarīb(un).
قل ان ضللت فانما اضل علي نفسي  وان اهتديت فبما يوحي الي ربي  انه سميع قريب
say, "if i should err, i would only err against myself. but if i am guided, it is by what my lord reveals to me. indeed, he is hearing and near."
qulindalaltufainnamaadillualanafsiwainihtadaitufabimayuhiilayyarabbiinnahusamiunqaribunqulindalaltufainnamaadilluaaalanafseewainiihtadaytufabimayooheeilayyarabbeeinnahusameeaaunqareeb
And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
Wa lau tarā iż fazi‘ū falā fauta wa ukhiżū mim makānin qarīb(in).
ولو تري اذ فزعوا فلا فوت واخذوا من مكان قريب
and if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
walautaraizfaziufalafautawaukhizumimmakaninqaribinwalawtaraithfaziaaoofalafawtawaokhithoominmakaninqareeb
And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
Wa qālū āmannā bih(ī), wa annā lahumut-tanāwusyu mim makānim ba‘īd(in).
وقالوا ءامنا به واني لهم التناوش من مكان بعيد
and they will [then] say, "we believe in it!" but how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
waqaluamannabihiwaannalahumuttanawusyumimmakanimbaidinwaqalooamannabihiwaannalahumuattanawushuminmakaninbaaaeed
And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.
Wa qad kafarū bihī min qabl(u), wa yaqżifūna bil-gaibi mim makānim ba‘īd(in).
وقد كفروا به من قبل  ويقذفون بالغيب من مكان بعيد
and they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.
waqadkafarubihiminqabluwayaqzifunabilgaibimimmakanimbaidinwaqadkafaroobihiminqabluwayaqthifoonabilghaybiminmakaninbaaaeed
And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
Wa ḥīla bainahum wa baina mā yasytahūn(a), kamā fu‘ila bi'asy-yā‘ihim min qabl(u), innahum fī syakkim murīb(in).
وحيل بينهم وبين ما يشتهون كما فعل باشياعهم من قبل  انهم كانوا في شك مريب
and prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
wahilabainahumwabainamayasytahunakamafuilabiasyyaihimminqabluinnahumfisyakkimmuribinwaheelabaynahumwabaynamayashtahoonakamafuaailabiashyaaaihimminqabluinnahumkanoofeeshakkinmureeb

[All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
Al-ḥamdu lillāhi fāṭiris-samāwāti wal-arḍi jā‘ilil-malāikati rusulā(n), ulī ajniḥatim maṡnā wa ṡulāṡa wa rubā‘(a), yazīdu fil-khalqi mā yasyā'(u), innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
الحمد لله فاطر السموت والارض جاعل الملئكه رسلا اولي اجنحه مثني وثلث وربع  يزيد في الخلق ما يشاء  ان الله علي كل شيء قدير

[all] praise is [due] to allah, creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. he increases in creation what he wills. indeed, allah is over all things competent.


Whatever Allāh grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Mā yaftaḥillāhu lin-nāsi mir raḥmatin falā mumsika lahā, wa mā yumsik falā mursila lahū mim ba‘dih(ī), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ما يفتح الله للناس من رحمه فلا ممسك لها  وما يمسك فلا مرسل له من بعده  وهو العزيز الحكيم
whatever allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever he withholds - none can release it thereafter. and he is the exalted in might, the wise.

mayaftahillahulinnasimirrahmatinfalamumsikalahawamayumsikfalamursilalahumimbadihiwahuwalazizulhakimumayaftahiallahulinnasiminrahmatinfalamumsikalahawamayumsikfalamursilalahuminbaaadihiwahuwaalaaazeezualhakeem
O mankind, remember the favor of Allāh upon you. Is there any creator other than Allāh who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
Yā ayyuhan-nāsużkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum, hal min khāliqin gairullāhi yarzuqukum minas-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), lā ilāha illā huw(a), fa'annā tu'fakūn(a).
يايها الناس اذكروا نعمت الله عليكم  هل من خلق غير الله يرزقكم من السماء والارض  لا اله الا هو  فاني تؤفكون
o mankind, remember the favor of allah upon you. is there any creator other than allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? there is no deity except him, so how are you deluded?

yaayyuhannasuzkurunimatallahialaikumhalminkhaliqingairullahiyarzuqukumminassamaiwalardilailahaillahuwafaannatufakunayaayyuhaannasuothkurooniaamataallahiaaalaykumhalminkhaliqinghayruallahiyarzuqukumminaassamaiwalardilailahaillahuwafaannatufakoon
And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
Wa iy yukażżibūka faqad kużżibat rusulum min qablik(a), wa ilallāhi turja‘ul-umūr(u).
وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت رسل من قبلك  والي الله ترجع الامور
and if they deny you, [o muhammad] - already were messengers denied before you. and to allah are returned [all] matters.
waiyyukazzibukafaqadkuzzibatrusulumminqablikawailallahiturjaulumuruwainyukaththibookafaqadkuththibatrusulunminqablikawailaallahiturjaaaualomoor
O mankind, indeed the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].
Yā ayyuhan-nāsu inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqqun falā tagurrannakumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, wa lā yagurrannakum billāhil-garūr(u).
يايها الناس ان وعد الله حق  فلا تغرنكم الحيوه الدنيا  ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور
o mankind, indeed the promise of allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about allah by the deceiver [i.e., satan].
yaayyuhannasuinnawadallahihaqqunfalatagurrannakumulhayatuddunyawalayagurrannakumbillahilgaruruyaayyuhaannasuinnawaaadaallahihaqqunfalataghurrannakumualhayatuaddunyawalayaghurrannakumbillahialgharoor
Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.
Innasy-syaiṭāna lakum ‘aduwwun fattakhiżūhu ‘aduwwā(n), innamā yad‘ū  ḥizbahū liyakūnū min aṣḥābis-sa‘īr(i).
ان الشيطن لكم عدو فاتخذوه عدوا  انما يدعوا حزبه ليكونوا من اصحب السعير
indeed, satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. he only invites his party to be among the companions of the blaze.
innasysyaitanalakumaduwwunfattakhizuhuaduwwaninnamayaduhizbahuliyakunuminashabissairiinnaashshaytanalakumaaaduwwunfattakhithoohuaaaduwwaninnamayadaaoohizbahuliyakoonoominashabiassaaaeer
Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
Allażīna kafarū lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum magfiratuw wa ajrun kabīr(un).
الذين كفروا لهم عذاب شديد  والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره واجر كبير
those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
allazinakafarulahumazabunsyadidunwallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatilahummagfiratuwwaajrunkabirunallatheenakafaroolahumaaathabunshadeedunwallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatilahummaghfiratunwaajrunkabeer

Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allāh sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what they do.
Afaman zuyyina lahū sū'u ‘amalihī fara'āhu ḥasanā(n), fa'innallāha yuḍillu may yasyā'u wa yahdī may yasyā'(u), falā tażhab nafsuka ‘alaihim ḥasarāt(in), innallāha ‘alīmum bimā yaṣna‘ūn(a).
افمن زين له سوء عمله فرءاه حسنا  فان الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء  فلا تذهب نفسك عليهم حسرت  ان الله عليم بما يصنعون

then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? for indeed, allah sends astray whom he wills and guides whom he wills. so do not let yourself perish over them in regret. indeed, allah is knowing of what they do.


And it is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.
Wallāhul-lażī arsalar-riyāḥa fatuṡīru saḥāban fasuqnāhu ilā baladim mayyitin fa'aḥyainā bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, każālikan-nusyūr(u).
والله الذي ارسل الريح فتثير سحابا فسقنه الي بلد ميت فاحيينا به الارض بعد موتها  كذلك النشور
and it is allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and we drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. thus is the resurrection.

wallahullaziarsalarriyahafatusirusahabanfasuqnahuilabaladimmayyitinfaahyainabihilardabadamautihakazalikannusyuruwallahuallatheearsalaarriyahafatutheerusahabanfasuqnahuilabaladinmayyitinfaahyaynabihialardabaaadamawtihakathalikaannushoor

Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allāh belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.

Man kāna yurīdul-‘izzata falillāhil-‘izzatu jamī‘ā(n), ilaihi yaṣ‘adul-kalimuṭ-ṭayyibu wal-‘amaluṣ-ṣāliḥu yarfa‘uh(ū), wal-lażīna yamkurūnas-sayyi'āti lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wa makru ulā'ika huwa yabūr(u).
من كان يريد العزه فلله العزه جميعا  اليه يصعد الكلم الطيب والعمل الصلح يرفعه  والذين يمكرون السيات لهم عذاب شديد  ومكر اولئك هو يبور

whoever desires honor [through power] - then to allah belongs all honor. to him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. but they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.



And Allāh created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allāh is easy.

Wallāhu khalaqakum min turābin ṡumma min nuṭfatin ṡumma ja‘alakum azwājā(n), wa mā taḥmilu min unṡā wa lā taḍa‘u illā bi‘ilmih(ī), wa mā yu‘ammaru mim mu‘ammariw wa lā yunqaṣu min ‘umurihī illā fī kitāb(in), inna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīr(un).
والله خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطفه ثم جعلكم ازوجا  وما تحمل من انثي ولا تضع الا بعلمه  وما يعمر من معمر ولا ينقص من عمره الا في كتب  ان ذلك علي الله يسير

and allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then he made you mates. and no female conceives nor does she give birth except with his knowledge. and no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. indeed, that for allah is easy.



And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

Wa mā yastawil-baḥrān(i), hāżā ‘ażbun furātun sā'igun syarābuhū wa hāżā milḥun ujāj(un), wa min kullin ta'kulūna laḥman ṭariyyaw wa tastakhrijūna ḥilyatan talbasūnahā, wa taral-fulka fīhi mawākhira litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
وما يستوي البحران هذا عذب فرات سائغ شرابه وهذا ملح اجاج  ومن كل تاكلون لحما طريا وتستخرجون حليه تلبسونها  وتري الفلك فيه مواخر لتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون

and not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. one is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. and from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of his bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.



He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

Yūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa yūlijun-nahāra fil-lail(i), wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamara kulluy yajrī li'ajalim musammā(n), żālikumullāhu rabbukum lahul-mulk(u), wal-lażīna tad‘ūna min dūnihī mā yamlikūna min qiṭmīr(in).
يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لاجل مسمي  ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك  والذين تدعون من دونه ما يملكون من قطمير

he causes the night to enter the day, and he causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. that is allah, your lord; to him belongs sovereignty. and those whom you invoke other than him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.



If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Aware [of all matters].
In tad‘ūhum lā yasma‘ū du‘ā'akum, wa lau sami‘ū mastajābū lakum, wa yaumal-qiyāmati yakfurūna bisyirkikum, wa lā yunabbi'uka miṡlu khabīr(in).
ان تدعوهم لا يسمعوا دعاءكم ولو سمعوا ما استجابوا لكم  ويوم القيمه يكفرون بشرككم  ولا ينبئك مثل خبير

if you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. and on the day of resurrection they will deny your association. and none can inform you like [one] aware [of all matters].

intaduhumlayasmauduaakumwalausamiumastajabulakumwayaumalqiyamatiyakfurunabisyirkikumwalayunabbiukamislukhabirinintadaaoohumlayasmaaaooduaaaakumwalawsamiaaoomaistajaboolakumwayawmaalqiyamatiyakfuroonabishirkikumwalayunabbiokamithlukhabeer
O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
Yā ayyuhan-nāsu antumul-fuqarā'u ilallāh(i), wallāhu huwal-ganiyyul-ḥamīd(u).
يايها الناس انتم الفقراء الي الله  والله هو الغني الحميد
o mankind, you are those in need of allah, while allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy.
yaayyuhannasuantumulfuqarauilallahiwallahuhuwalganiyyulhamiduyaayyuhaannasuantumualfuqaraoilaallahiwallahuhuwaalghaniyyualhameed
If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
Iy yasya' yużhibkum wa ya'ti bikhalqin jadīd(in).
ان يشا يذهبكم ويات بخلق جديد
if he wills, he can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
iyyasyayuzhibkumwayatibikhalqinjadidininyashayuthhibkumwayatibikhalqinjadeed
And that is for Allāh not difficult.
Wa mā żālika ‘alallāhi bi‘azīz(in).
وما ذلك علي الله بعزيز
and that is for allah not difficult.
wamazalikaalallahibiazizinwamathalikaaaalaallahibiaaazeez

And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allāh is the [final] destination.

Wa lā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, wa in tad‘u muṡqalatun ilā ḥimlihā lā yuḥmal minhu syai'uw wa lau kāna żā qurbā, innamā tunżirul-lażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum bil-gaibi wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāh(ta), wa man tazakkā fa innamā yatazakkā linafsih(ī), wa ilallāhil-maṣīr(u).
ولا تزر وازره وزر اخري  وان تدع مثقله الي حملها لا يحمل منه شيء ولو كان ذا قربي  انما تنذر الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب واقاموا الصلوه  ومن تزكي فانما يتزكي لنفسه  والي الله المصير

and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. and if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. you can only warn those who fear their lord unseen and have established prayer. and whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. and to allah is the [final] destination.


Not equal are the blind and the seeing,
Wa mā yastawil-a‘mā wal-baṣīr(u).
وما يستوي الاعمي والبصير
not equal are the blind and the seeing,
wamayastawilamawalbasiruwamayastaweealaaamawalbaseer
Nor are the darknesses and the light,
Wa laẓ-ẓulumātu wa lan-nūr(u).
ولا الظلمت ولا النور
nor are the darknesses and the light,
walazzulumatuwalannuruwalaaththulumatuwalaannoor
Nor are the shade and the heat,
Wa laẓ-ẓillu wa lal-ḥarūr(u).
ولا الظل ولا الحرور
nor are the shade and the heat,
walazzilluwalalharuruwalaaththilluwalaalharoor
And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
Wa mā yastawil-aḥyā'u wa lal-amwāt(u), innallāha yusmi‘u may yasyā'(u), wa mā anta bimusmi‘im man fil-qubūr(i).
وما يستوي الاحياء ولا الاموت  ان الله يسمع من يشاء  وما انت بمسمع من في القبور
and not equal are the living and the dead. indeed, allah causes to hear whom he wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
wamayastawilahyauwalalamwatuinnallahayusmiumayyasyauwamaantabimusmiimmanfilquburiwamayastaweealahyaowalaalamwatuinnaallahayusmiaaumanyashaowamaantabimusmiaainmanfeealquboor
You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.
In anta illā nażīr(un).
ان انت الا نذير
you, [o muhammad], are not but a warner.
inantaillanaziruninantaillanatheer
Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.
Innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqqi basyīraw wa nażīrā(n), wa im min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nażīr(un).
انا ارسلنك بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا  وان من امه الا خلا فيها نذير
indeed, we have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. and there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.
innaarsalnakabilhaqqibasyirawwanaziranwaimminummatinillakhalafihanaziruninnaarsalnakabilhaqqibasheeranwanatheeranwainminommatinillakhalafeehanatheer
And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.
Wa iy yukażżibūka faqad każżabal-lażīna min qablihim, jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināti wa biz-zuburi wa bil-kitābil-munīr(i).
وان يكذبوك فقد كذب الذين من قبلهم جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت وبالزبر وبالكتب المنير
and if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening scripture.

waiyyukazzibukafaqadkazzaballazinaminqablihimjaathumrusuluhumbilbayyinatiwabizzuburiwabilkitabilmuniriwainyukaththibookafaqadkaththabaallatheenaminqablihimjaathumrusuluhumbilbayyinatiwabizzuburiwabilkitabialmuneer
Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
Ṡumma akhażtul-lażīna kafarū fakaifa kāna nakīr(i).
ثم اخذت الذين كفروا  فكيف كان نكير
then i seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was my reproach.
summaakhaztullazinakafarufakaifakananakirithummaakhathtuallatheenakafaroofakayfakananakeer
Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.
Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samā'i mā'ā(n), fa'akhrajnā bihī ṡamarātim mukhtalifan alwānuhā, wa minal-jibāli judadum bīḍuw wa khumrum mukhtalifun alwānuhā wa garābību sūd(un).
الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فاخرجنا به ثمرت مختلفا الونها  ومن الجبال جدد بيض وحمر مختلف الونها وغرابيب سود
do you not see that allah sends down rain from the sky, and we produce thereby fruits of varying colors? and in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

alamtaraannallahaanzalaminassamaimaanfaakhrajnabihisamaratimmukhtalifanalwanuhawaminaljibalijudadumbiduwwakhumrummukhtalifunalwanuhawagarabibusudunalamtaraannaallahaanzalaminaassamaimaanfaakhrajnabihithamaratinmukhtalifanalwanuhawaminaaljibalijudadunbeedunwahumrunmukhtalifunalwanuhawagharabeebusood

And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allāh, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
Wa minan-nāsi wad-dawābbi wal-an‘āmi mukhtalifun alwānuhū każālik(a), innamā yakhsyallāha min ‘ibādihil-ulamā'(u), innallāha ‘azīzun gafūr(un).
ومن الناس والدواب والانعم مختلف الونه كذلك  انما يخشي الله من عباده العلمؤا  ان الله عزيز غفور

and among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. only those fear allah, from among his servants, who have knowledge. indeed, allah is exalted in might and forgiving.

waminannasiwaddawabbiwalanamimukhtalifunalwanuhukazalikainnamayakhsyallahaminibadihilulamauinnallahaazizungafurunwaminaannasiwaddawabbiwalanaaamimukhtalifunalwanuhukathalikainnamayakhshaallahaminaaibadihialaaulamaoinnaallahaaaazeezunghafoor

Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allāh and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -
Innal-lażīna yatlūna kitāballāhi wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta wa anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirraw wa ‘alāniyatay yarjūna tijāratal lan tabūr(a).
ان الذين يتلون كتب الله واقاموا الصلوه وانفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانيه يرجون تجره لن تبور

indeed, those who recite the book of allah and establish prayer and spend [in his cause] out of what we have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -

innallazinayatlunakitaballahiwaaqamussalatawaanfaqumimmarazaqnahumsirrawwaalaniyatayyarjunatijaratallantaburainnaallatheenayatloonakitabaallahiwaaqamooassalatawaanfaqoomimmarazaqnahumsirranwaaaalaniyatanyarjoonatijaratanlantaboor
That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
Liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wa yazīdahum min faḍlih(ī), innahū gafūrun syakūr(un).
ليوفيهم اجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله  انه غفور شكور
that he may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of his bounty. indeed, he is forgiving and appreciative.
liyuwaffiyahumujurahumwayazidahumminfadlihiinnahugafurunsyakurunliyuwaffiyahumojoorahumwayazeedahumminfadlihiinnahughafoorunshakoor
And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allāh, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing.
Wal-lażī auḥainā ilaika minal-kitābi huwal-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqal limā baina yadaih(i), innallāha bi‘ibādihī lakhabīrum baṣīr(un).
والذي اوحينا اليك من الكتب هو الحق مصدقا لما بين يديه  ان الله بعباده لخبير بصير
and that which we have revealed to you, [o muhammad], of the book is the truth, confirming what was before it. indeed allah, of his servants, is aware and seeing.

wallaziauhainailaikaminalkitabihuwalhaqqumusaddiqallimabainayadaihiinnallahabiibadihilakhabirumbasirunwallatheeawhaynailaykaminaalkitabihuwaalhaqqumusaddiqanlimabaynayadayhiinnaallahabiaaibadihilakhabeerunbaseer

Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allāh. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
Ṡumma auraṡnal-kitābal-lażīnaṣṭafainā min ‘ibādinā, fa minhum ẓālimul linafsih(ī), wa minhum muqtaṣid(un), wa minhum sābiqum bil-khairāti bi'iżnillāh(i), żālika huwal-faḍlul-kabīr(u).
ثم اورثنا الكتب الذين اصطفينا من عبادنا  فمنهم ظالم لنفسه ومنهم مقتصد ومنهم سابق بالخيرت باذن الله  ذلك هو الفضل الكبير

then we caused to inherit the book those we have chosen of our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of allah. that [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.


[For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
Jannātu ‘adniy yadkhulūnahā yuḥallauna fīhā min asāwira min żahabiw wa lu'lu'ā(n), wa libāsuhum fīhā ḥarīr(un).
جنت عدن يدخلونها يحلون فيها من اساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا  ولباسهم فيها حرير
[for them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
jannatuadniyyadkhulunahayuhallaunafihaminasawiraminzahabiwwaluluanwalibasuhumfihaharirunjannatuaaadninyadkhuloonahayuhallawnafeehaminasawiraminthahabinwaluluanwalibasuhumfeehahareer
And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
Wa qālul-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī ażhaba ‘annal-ḥazan(a), inna rabbanā lagafūrun syakūr(un).
وقالوا الحمد لله الذي اذهب عنا الحزن  ان ربنا لغفور شكور
and they will say, "praise to allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. indeed, our lord is forgiving and appreciative -
waqalulhamdulillahillaziazhabaannalhazanainnarabbanalagafurunsyakurunwaqalooalhamdulillahiallatheeathhabaaaannaalhazanainnarabbanalaghafoorunshakoor
He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
Allażī aḥallanā dāral-muqāmati min faḍlih(ī), lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabuw wa lā yamassunā fīhā lugūb(un).
الذي احلنا دار المقامه من فضله لا يمسنا فيها نصب ولا يمسنا فيها لغوب
he who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., paradise] out of his bounty. there touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
allaziahallanadaralmuqamatiminfadlihilayamassunafihanasabuwwalayamassunafihalugubunallatheeahallanadaraalmuqamatiminfadlihilayamassunafeehanasabunwalayamassunafeehalughoob
And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.
Wal-lażīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannam(a), lā yuqḍā ‘alaihim fayamūtū wa lā yukhaffafu ‘anhum min ‘ażābihā, każālika najzī kulla kafūr(in).
والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم لا يقضي عليهم فيموتوا ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها  كذلك نجزي كل كفور
and for those who disbelieve will be the fire of hell. [death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. thus do we recompense every ungrateful one.

wallazinakafarulahumnarujahannamalayuqdaalaihimfayamutuwalayukhaffafuanhumminazabihakazalikanajzikullakafurinwallatheenakafaroolahumnarujahannamalayuqdaaaalayhimfayamootoowalayukhaffafuaaanhumminaaathabihakathalikanajzeekullakafoor

And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.

Wa hum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā, rabbanā akhirjnā na‘mal ṣāliḥan gairal-lażī kunnā na‘mal(u), awalam nu‘ammirkum mā yatażakkaru fīhi man tażakkara wa jā'akumun nażīr(u), fa żūqū famā liẓ-ẓālimīna min naṣīr(in).
وهم يصطرخون فيها ربنا اخرجنا نعمل صلحا غير الذي كنا نعمل  اولم نعمركم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم النذير  فذوقوا فما للظلمين من نصير

and they will cry out therein, "our lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" but did we not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? so taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.


Indeed, Allāh is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
Innallāha ‘ālimu gaibis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), innahū ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ان الله علم غيب السموت والارض  انه عليم بذات الصدور
indeed, allah is knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts.
innallahaalimugaibissamawatiwalardiinnahualimumbizatissuduriinnaallahaaaalimughaybiassamawatiwalardiinnahuaaaleemunbithatiassudoor

It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.
Huwal-lażī ja‘alakum khalā'ifa fil-arḍ(i), faman kafara fa‘alaihi kufruh(ū), wa lā yazīdul-kāfirīna kufruhum ‘inda rabbihim illā maqtā(n), wa lā yazīdul-kāfirīna kufruhum illā khasārā(n).
هو الذي جعلكم خلئف في الارض  فمن كفر فعليه كفره  ولا يزيد الكفرين كفرهم عند ربهم الا مقتا  ولا يزيد الكفرين كفرهم الا خسارا

it is he who has made you successors upon the earth. and whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.



Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."

Qul ara'aitum syurakā'akumul-lażīna tad‘ūna min dūnillāh(i), arūnī māżā khalaqū minal-arḍi am lahum syirkun fis-samāwāt(i), am ātaināhum kitāban fahum ‘alā bayyinatim minh(u), bal iy ya‘iduẓ-ẓālimūna ba‘ḍuhum ba‘ḍan illā gurūrā(n).
قل ارءيتم شركاءكم الذين تدعون من دون الله اروني ماذا خلقوا من الارض ام لهم شرك في السموت ام ءاتينهم كتبا فهم علي بينت منه  بل ان يعد الظلمون بعضهم بعضا الا غرورا

say, "have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides allah? show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with him] in the heavens? or have we given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [no], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."


Indeed, Allāh holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
Innallāha yumsikus-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā, wa la'in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadim mim ba‘dih(ī), innahū kāna ḥalīman gafūrā(n).
ان الله يمسك السموت والارض ان تزولا  ولئن زالتا ان امسكهما من احد من بعده  انه كان حليما غفورا
indeed, allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. and if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after him. indeed, he is forbearing and forgiving.

innallahayumsikussamawatiwalardaantazulawalainzalatainamsakahumaminahadimmimbadihiinnahukanahalimangafuraninnaallahayumsikuassamawatiwalardaantazoolawalainzalatainamsakahumaminahadinminbaaadihiinnahukanahaleemanghafoora

And they swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion
Wa aqsamū billāhi jahda aimānihim la'in jā'ahum nażīrul layakūnunna ahdā min iḥdal-umam(i), falammā jā'ahum nażīrum mā zādahum illā nufūrā(n).
واقسموا بالله جهد ايمنهم لئن جاءهم نذير ليكونن اهدي من احدي الامم  فلما جاءهم نذير ما زادهم الا نفورا

and they swore by allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. but when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion

waaqsamubillahijahdaaimanihimlainjaahumnazirullayakununnaahdaminihdalumamifalammajaahumnazirummazadahumillanufuranwaaqsamoobillahijahdaaymanihimlainjaahumnatheerunlayakoonunnaahdaminihdaalomamifalammajaahumnatheerunmazadahumillanufoora

[Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of Allāh any change, and you will never find in the way of Allāh any alteration.

Istikbāran fil-arḍi wa makras-sayyi'(i), wa lā yaḥīqul-makrus-sayyi'u illā bi'ahlih(ī), fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnatal-awwalīn(a), falan tajida lisunnatillāhi tabdīlā(n), wa lan tajida lisunnatillāhi taḥwīlā(n).
استكبارا في الارض ومكر السيئ  ولا يحيق المكر السيئ الا باهله  فهل ينظرون الا سنت الاولين  فلن تجد لسنت الله تبديلا  ولن تجد لسنت الله تحويلا

[due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? but you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of allah any change, and you will never find in the way of allah any alteration.



Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.

Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fa yanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qablihim wa kānū asyadda minhum quwwah(tan), wa mā kānallāhu liyu‘jizahū min syai'in fis-samāwāti wa lā fil-arḍ(i), innahū kāna ‘alīman qadīrā(n).
اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبلهم وكانوا اشد منهم قوه  وما كان الله ليعجزه من شيء في السموت ولا في الارض  انه كان عليما قديرا

have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? and they were greater than them in power. but allah is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. indeed, he is ever knowing and competent.



And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
Wa lau yu'ākhiżullāhun-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ‘alā ẓahrihā min dābbatiw wa lākiy yu'akhkhiruhum ilā ajalim musammā(n), fa iżā jā'a ajaluhum fa innallāha kāna bi‘ibādihī baṣīrā(n).
ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك علي ظهرها من دابه ولكن يؤخرهم الي اجل مسمي  فاذا جاء اجلهم فان الله كان بعباده بصيرا

and if allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, he would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. but he defers them for a specified term. and when their time comes, then indeed allah has ever been, of his servants, seeing.


Yā, Seen.
Yā sīn.
يس
ya, seen.
yasinyaseen
By the wise Qur’ān,
Wal-qur'ānil-ḥakīm(i).
والقرءان الحكيم
by the wise qur’an,
walquranilhakimiwalquranialhakeem
Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
Innaka laminal-mursalīn(a).
انك لمن المرسلين
indeed you, [o muhammad], are from among the messengers,
innakalaminalmursalinainnakalaminaalmursaleen
On a straight path.
‘Alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
علي صرط مستقيم
on a straight path.
alasiratimmustaqiminaaalasiratinmustaqeem
[This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
Tanzīlal-‘azīzir-raḥīm(i).
تنزيل العزيز الرحيم
[this is] a revelation of the exalted in might, the merciful,
tanzilalazizirrahimitanzeelaalaaazeeziarraheem
That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
Litunżira qaumam mā unżira ābā'uhum fahum gāfilūn(a).
لتنذر قوما ما انذر ءاباؤهم فهم غفلون
that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
litunziraqaumammaunziraabauhumfahumgafilunalitunthiraqawmanmaonthiraabaohumfahumghafiloon
Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
Laqad ḥaqqal-qaulu ‘alā akṡarihim fahum lā yu'minūn(a).
لقد حق القول علي اكثرهم فهم لا يؤمنون
already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
laqadhaqqalqaulualaaksarihimfahumlayuminunalaqadhaqqaalqawluaaalaaktharihimfahumlayuminoon
Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
Innā ja‘alnā fī a‘nāqihim aglālan fa hiya ilal-ażqāni fahum muqmaḥūn(a).
انا جعلنا في اعنقهم اغللا فهي الي الاذقان فهم مقمحون
indeed, we have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
innajaalnafianaqihimaglalanfahiyailalazqanifahummuqmahunainnajaaaalnafeeaaanaqihimaghlalanfahiyailaalathqanifahummuqmahoon
And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
Wa ja‘alnā mim baini aidīhim saddaw wa min khalfihim saddan fa agsyaināhum fahum lā yubṣirūn(a).
وجعلنا من بين ايديهم سدا ومن خلفهم سدا فاغشينهم فهم لا يبصرون
and we have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
wajaalnamimbainiaidihimsaddawwaminkhalfihimsaddanfaagsyainahumfahumlayubsirunawajaaaalnaminbayniaydeehimsaddanwaminkhalfihimsaddanfaaghshaynahumfahumlayubsiroon
And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
Wa sawā'un ‘alaihim a'anżartahum am lam tunżirhum lā yu'minūn(a).
وسواء عليهم ءانذرتهم ام لم تنذرهم لا يؤمنون
and it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
wasawaunalaihimaanzartahumamlamtunzirhumlayuminunawasawaonaaalayhimaanthartahumamlamtunthirhumlayuminoon
You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
Innamā tunżiru manittaba‘aż-żikra  wa khasyiyar-raḥmāna bil-gaib(i), fa basysyirhu bimagfiratiw wa ajrin karīm(in).
انما تنذر من اتبع الذكر وخشي الرحمن بالغيب  فبشره بمغفره واجر كريم
you can only warn one who follows the message and fears the most merciful unseen. so give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
innamatunzirumanittabaazzikrawakhasyiyarrahmanabilgaibifabasysyirhubimagfiratiwwaajrinkarimininnamatunthirumaniittabaaaaaththikrawakhashiyaarrahmanabilghaybifabashshirhubimaghfiratinwaajrinkareem
Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
Innā naḥnu nuḥyil-mautā wa naktubu mā qaddamū wa āṡārahum, wa kulla syai'in aḥṣaināhu fī imāmim mubīn(in).
انا نحن نحي الموتي ونكتب ما قدموا وءاثرهم  وكل شيء احصينه في امام مبين
indeed, it is we who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things we have enumerated in a clear register.
innanahnunuhyilmautawanaktubumaqaddamuwaasarahumwakullasyaiinahsainahufiimamimmubinininnanahnunuhyeealmawtawanaktubumaqaddamoowaatharahumwakullashayinahsaynahufeeimaminmubeen
And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
Waḍrib lahum maṡalan aṣḥābal-qaryah(ti), iż jā'ahal-mursalūn(a).
واضرب لهم مثلا اصحب القريه اذ جاءها المرسلون
and present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
wadriblahummasalanashabalqaryahtiizjaahalmursalunawadriblahummathalanashabaalqaryatiithjaahaalmursaloon
When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
Iż arsalnā ilaihimuṡnaini fa każżabūhumā fa ‘azzaznā biṡāliṡin faqālū innā ilaikum mursalūn(a).
اذ ارسلنا اليهم اثنين فكذبوهما فعززنا بثالث فقالوا انا اليكم مرسلون
when we sent to them two but they denied them, so we strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "indeed, we are messengers to you."
izarsalnailaihimusnainifakazzabuhumafaazzaznabisalisinfaqaluinnailaikummursalunaitharsalnailayhimuithnaynifakaththaboohumafaaaazzaznabithalithinfaqalooinnailaykummursaloon
They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
Qālū mā antum illā basyarum miṡlunā, wa mā anzalar-raḥmānu min syai'(in), in antum illā takżibūn(a).
قالوا ما انتم الا بشر مثلنا وما انزل الرحمن من شيء ان انتم الا تكذبون
they said, "you are not but human beings like us, and the most merciful has not revealed a thing. you are only telling lies."
qalumaantumillabasyarummislunawamaanzalarrahmanuminsyaiininantumillatakzibunaqaloomaantumillabasharunmithlunawamaanzalaarrahmanuminshayininantumillatakthiboon
They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
Qālū rabbunā ya‘lamu innā ilaikum lamursalūn(a).
قالوا ربنا يعلم انا اليكم لمرسلون
they said, "our lord knows that we are messengers to you,
qalurabbunayalamuinnailaikumlamursalunaqaloorabbunayaaalamuinnailaykumlamursaloon
And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
Wa mā ‘alainā illal-balāgul-mubīn(u).
وما علينا الا البلغ المبين
and we are not responsible except for clear notification."
wamaalainaillalbalagulmubinuwamaaaalaynaillaalbalaghualmubeen
They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
Qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum, la'il lam tantahū lanarjumannakum wa layamassannakum minnā ‘ażābun alīm(un).
قالوا انا تطيرنا بكم  لئن لم تنتهوا لنرجمنكم وليمسنكم منا عذاب اليم
they said, "indeed, we consider you a bad omen. if you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

to warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.

and we have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

so let not their speech grieve you. indeed, we know what they conceal and what they declare.

[they will be asked], "what is [wrong] with you? why do you not help each other?"

indeed, that is how we deal with the criminals.

and were saying, "are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

rather, he [i.e., the prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
baljaabilhaqqiwasaddaqalmursalinabaljaabilhaqqiwasaddaqaalmursaleen
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
Innakum lażā'iqul-‘ażābil-alīm(i).
انكم لذائقوا العذاب الاليم
indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
innakumlazaiqulazabilalimiinnakumlathaiqooalaaathabialaleem
And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
Wa mā tujzauna illā mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
وما تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
wamatujzaunaillamakuntumtamalunawamatujzawnaillamakuntumtaaamaloon
But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
Illā ‘ibādallāhil-mukhlaṣīn(a).
الا عباد الله المخلصين
but not the chosen servants of allah.
illaibadallahilmukhlasinaillaaaibadaallahialmukhlaseen
Those will have a provision determined -
Ulā'ika lahum rizqum ma‘lūm(un).
اولئك لهم رزق معلوم
those will have a provision determined -
ulaikalahumrizqummalumunolaikalahumrizqunmaaaloom
Fruits; and they will be honored
Fawākihu wa hum mukramūn(a).
فوكه  وهم مكرمون
fruits; and they will be honored
fawakihuwahummukramunafawakihuwahummukramoon
In gardens of pleasure
Fī jannātin na‘īm(i).
في جنت النعيم
in gardens of pleasure
fijannatinnaimifeejannatiannaaaeem
On thrones facing one another.
‘Alā sururim mutaqābilīn(a).
علي سرر متقبلين
on thrones facing one another.
alasururimmutaqabilinaaaalasururinmutaqabileen
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
Yuṭāfu ‘alaihim bika'sim mim ma‘īn(in).
يطاف عليهم بكاس من معين
there will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
yutafualaihimbikasimmimmaininyutafuaaalayhimbikasinminmaaaeen
White and delicious to the drinkers;
Baiḍā'a lażżatil lisy-syāribīn(a).
بيضاء لذه للشربين
white and delicious to the drinkers;
baidaalazzatillisysyaribinabaydaalaththatinlishsharibeen
No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
Lā fīhā gauluw wa lā hum ‘anhā yunzafūn(a).
لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
no bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
lafihagauluwwalahumanhayunzafunalafeehaghawlunwalahumaaanhayunzafoon
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
Wa ‘indahum qāṣirātuṭ-ṭarfi ‘īn(un).
وعندهم قصرت الطرف عين
and with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
waindahumqasiratuttarfiinunwaaaindahumqasiratuattarfiaaeen
As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
Ka'annahum baiḍum maknūn(un).
كانهن بيض مكنون
as if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
kaannahumbaidummaknununkaannahunnabaydunmaknoon
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
Fa'aqbala ba‘ḍuhum ‘alā ba‘ḍiy yatasā'alūn(a).
فاقبل بعضهم علي بعض يتساءلون
and they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
faaqbalabaduhumalabadiyyatasaalunafaaqbalabaaaduhumaaalabaaadinyatasaaloon
A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
Qāla qā'ilum minhum innī kāna lī qarīn(un).
قال قائل منهم اني كان لي قرين
a speaker among them will say, "indeed, i had a companion [on earth].
qalaqailumminhuminnikanaliqarinunqalaqailunminhuminneekanaleeqareen
Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
Yaqūlu a'innaka laminal-muṣaddiqīn(a).
يقول اءنك لمن المصدقين
who would say, 'are you indeed of those who believe
yaquluainnakalaminalmusaddiqinayaqooluainnakalaminaalmusaddiqeen
That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
A'iżā mitnā wa kunnā turāban a'innā lamadīnūn(a).
اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمدينون
that when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
aizamitnawakunnaturabanainnalamadinunaaithamitnawakunnaturabanwaaaithamanainnalamadeenoon
He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
Qāla hal antum muṭṭali‘ūn(a).
قال هل انتم مطلعون
he will say, "would you [care to] look?"
qalahalantummuttaliunaqalahalantummuttaliaaoon
And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
Faṭṭala‘a fa ra'āhu fī sawā'il-jaḥīm(i).
فاطلع فرءاه في سواء الجحيم
and he will look and see him in the midst of the hellfire.
fattalaafaraahufisawailjahimifattalaaaafaraahufeesawaialjaheem
He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
Qāla tallāhi in kitta laturdīn(i).
قال تالله ان كدت لتردين
he will say, "by allah, you almost ruined me.
qalatallahiinkittalaturdiniqalatallahiinkidtalaturdeen
If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
Wa lau lā ni‘matu rabbī lakuntu minal-muḥḍarīn(a).
ولولا نعمه ربي لكنت من المحضرين
if not for the favor of my lord, i would have been of those brought in [to hell].
walaulanimaturabbilakuntuminalmuhdarinawalawlaniaamaturabbeelakuntuminaalmuhdareen
Then, are we not to die
Afamā naḥnu bimayyitīn(a).
افما نحن بميتين
then, are we not to die
afamanahnubimayyitinaafamanahnubimayyiteen
Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
Illā mautatunal-ūlā wa mā naḥnu bimu‘ażżabīn(a).
الا موتتنا الاولي وما نحن بمعذبين
except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
illamautatunalulawamanahnubimuazzabinaillamawtatanaaloolawamanahnubimuaaaththabeen
Indeed, this is the great attainment.
Inna hāżā lahuwal-fauzul-‘aẓīm(u).
ان هذا لهو الفوز العظيم
indeed, this is the great attainment.
innahazalahuwalfauzulazimuinnahathalahuwaalfawzualaaatheem
For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
Limiṡli hāżā falya‘malil-‘āmilūn(a).
لمثل هذا فليعمل العملون
for the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
limislihazafalyamalilamilunalimithlihathafalyaaamalialaaamiloon
Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
Ażālika khairun nuzulan am syajaratuz-zaqqūm(i).
اذلك خير نزلا ام شجره الزقوم
is that [i.e., paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
azalikakhairunnuzulanamsyajaratuzzaqqumiathalikakhayrunnuzulanamshajaratuazzaqqoom
Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
Innā ja‘alnāhā fitnatal liẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
انا جعلنها فتنه للظلمين
indeed, we have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
innajaalnahafitnatallizzaliminainnajaaaalnahafitnatanliththalimeen
Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
Innahā syajaratun takhruju fī aṣlil-jaḥīm(i).
انها شجره تخرج في اصل الجحيم
indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the hellfire,
innahasyajaratuntakhrujufiasliljahimiinnahashajaratuntakhrujufeeaslialjaheem
Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
Ṭal‘uhā ka'annahū ru'ūsusy-syayāṭīn(i).
طلعها كانه رءوس الشيطين
its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
taluhakaannahuruususysyayatinitalaauhakaannahuruoosuashshayateen
And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
Fa innahum la'ākilūna minhā fa māli'ūna minhal-buṭūn(a).
فانهم لاكلون منها فمالون منها البطون
and indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
fainnahumlaakilunaminhafamaliunaminhalbutunafainnahumlaakiloonaminhafamalioonaminhaalbutoon
Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
Ṡumma inna lahum ‘alaihā lasyaubam min ḥamīm(in).
ثم ان لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
summainnalahumalaihalasyaubamminhamiminthummainnalahumaaalayhalashawbanminhameem
Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
Ṡumma inna marji‘ahum la'ilal-jaḥīm(i).
ثم ان مرجعهم لالي الجحيم
then indeed, their return will be to the hellfire.
summainnamarjiahumlailaljahimithummainnamarjiaaahumlailaaljaheem
Indeed they found their fathers astray.
Innahum alfau ābā'ahum ḍāllīn(a).
انهم الفوا ءاباءهم ضالين
indeed they found their fathers astray.
innahumalfauabaahumdallinainnahumalfawabaahumdalleen
So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
Fahum ‘alā āṡārihim yuhra‘ūn(a).
فهم علي ءاثرهم يهرعون
so they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
fahumalaasarihimyuhraunafahumaaalaatharihimyuhraaaoon
And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
Wa laqad ḍalla qablahum akṡarul-awwalīn(a).
ولقد ضل قبلهم اكثر الاولين
and there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
walaqaddallaqablahumaksarulawwalinawalaqaddallaqablahumaktharualawwaleen
And We had already sent among them warners.
Wa laqad arsalnā fīhim munżirīn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا فيهم منذرين
and we had already sent among them warners.
walaqadarsalnafihimmunzirinawalaqadarsalnafeehimmunthireen
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
Fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-munżarīn(a).
فانظر كيف كان عقبه المنذرين
then look how was the end of those who were warned -
fanzurkaifakanaaqibatulmunzarinafanthurkayfakanaaaaqibatualmunthareen
But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
Illā ‘ibādallāhil-mukhlaṣīn(a).
الا عباد الله المخلصين
but not the chosen servants of allah.
illaibadallahilmukhlasinaillaaaibadaallahialmukhlaseen
And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
Wa laqad nādānā nūḥun falani‘mal-mujībūn(a).
ولقد نادينا نوح فلنعم المجيبون
and noah had certainly called us, and [we are] the best of responders.
walaqadnadananuhunfalanimalmujibunawalaqadnadananoohunfalaniaamaalmujeeboon
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
Wa najjaināhu wa ahlahū minal-karbil-‘aẓīm(i).
ونجينه واهله من الكرب العظيم
and we saved him and his family from the great affliction.
wanajjainahuwaahlahuminalkarbilazimiwanajjaynahuwaahlahuminaalkarbialaaatheem
And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
Wa ja‘alnā żurriyyatahū humul-bāqīn(a).
وجعلنا ذريته هم الباقين
and we made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
wajaalnazurriyyatahuhumulbaqinawajaaaalnathurriyyatahuhumualbaqeen
And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
Wa taraknā ‘alaihi fil-ākhirīn(a).
وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
and left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
wataraknaalaihifilakhirinawataraknaaaalayhifeealakhireen
"Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
Salāmun ‘alā nūḥin fil-‘ālamīn(a).
سلم علي نوح في العلمين
"peace upon noah among the worlds."
salamunalanuhinfilalaminasalamunaaalanoohinfeealaaalameen
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Innā każālika najzil-muḥsinīn(a).
انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
indeed, we thus reward the doers of good.
innakazalikanajzilmuhsininainnakathalikanajzeealmuhsineen
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
Innahū min ‘ibādinal-mu'minīn(a).
انه من عبادنا المؤمنين
indeed, he was of our believing servants.
innahuminibadinalmumininainnahuminaaibadinaalmumineen
Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
Ṡumma agraqnal-ākharīn(a).
ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
then we drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
summaagraqnalakharinathummaaghraqnaalakhareen
And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
Wa inna min syī‘atihī la'ibrāhīm(a).
وان من شيعته لابرهيم
and indeed, among his kind was abraham,
wainnaminsyiatihilaibrahimawainnaminsheeaaatihilaibraheem
When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
Iż jā'a rabbahū biqalbin salīm(in).
اذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم
when he came to his lord with a sound heart
izjaarabbahubiqalbinsaliminithjaarabbahubiqalbinsaleem
[And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
Iż qāla li'abīhi wa qaumihī māżā ta‘budūn(a).
اذ قال لابيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
[and] when he said to his father and his people, "what do you worship?
izqalaliabihiwaqaumihimazatabudunaithqalaliabeehiwaqawmihimathataaabudoon
Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
A'ifkan ālihatan dūnallāhi turīdūn(a).
ائفكا ءالهه دون الله تريدون
is it falsehood [as] gods other than allah you desire?
aifkanalihatandunallahituridunaaifkanalihatandoonaallahitureedoon
Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
Famā ẓannukum birabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
فما ظنكم برب العلمين
then what is your thought about the lord of the worlds?"
famazannukumbirabbilalaminafamathannukumbirabbialaaalameen
And he cast a look at the stars.
Fa naẓara naẓratan fin-nujūm(i).
فنظر نظره في النجوم
and he cast a look at the stars.
fanazaranazratanfinnujumifanatharanathratanfeeannujoom
And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
Fa qāla innī saqīm(un).
فقال اني سقيم
and said, "indeed, i am [about to be] ill."
faqalainnisaqimunfaqalainneesaqeem
So they turned away from him, departing.
Fa tawallau ‘anhu mudbirīn(a).
فتولوا عنه مدبرين
so they turned away from him, departing.
fatawallauanhumudbirinafatawallawaaanhumudbireen
Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
Farāga ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā ta'kulūn(a).
فراغ الي ءالهتهم فقال الا تاكلون
then he turned to their gods and said, "do you not eat?
faragailaalihatihimfaqalaalatakulunafaraghailaalihatihimfaqalaalatakuloon
What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
Mā lakum lā tanṭiqūn(a).
ما لكم لا تنطقون
what is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
malakumlatantiqunamalakumlatantiqoon
And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
Farāga ‘alaihim ḍarbam bil-yamīn(i).
فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين
and he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
faragaalaihimdarbambilyaminifaraghaaaalayhimdarbanbilyameen
Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
Fa aqbalū ilaihi yaziffūn(a).
فاقبلوا اليه يزفون
then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
faaqbaluilaihiyaziffunafaaqbalooilayhiyaziffoon
He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
Qāla ata‘budūna mā tanḥitūn(a).
قال اتعبدون ما تنحتون
he said, "do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
qalaatabudunamatanhitunaqalaataaabudoonamatanhitoon
While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
Wallāhu khalaqakum wa mā ta‘malūn(a).
والله خلقكم وما تعملون
while allah created you and that which you do?"
wallahukhalaqakumwamatamalunawallahukhalaqakumwamataaamaloon
They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
Qālubnū lahū bun-yānan fa'alqūhu fil-jaḥīm(i).
قالوا ابنوا له بنينا فالقوه في الجحيم
they said, "construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
qalubnulahubunyananfaalquhufiljahimiqalooibnoolahubunyananfaalqoohufeealjaheem
And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
Fa arādū bihī kaidan faja‘alnāhumul-asfalīn(a).
فارادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الاسفلين
and they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but we made them the most debased.
faaradubihikaidanfajaalnahumulasfalinafaaradoobihikaydanfajaaaalnahumualasfaleen
And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
Wa qāla innī żāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīn(i).
وقال اني ذاهب الي ربي سيهدين
and [then] he said, "indeed, i will go to [where i am ordered by] my lord; he will guide me.
waqalainnizahibunilarabbisayahdiniwaqalainneethahibunilarabbeesayahdeen
My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
رب هب لي من الصلحين
my lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
rabbihabliminassalihinarabbihableeminaassaliheen
So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
Fa basysyarnāhu bigulāmin ḥalīm(in).
فبشرنه بغلم حليم
so we gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
fabasysyarnahubigulaminhaliminfabashsharnahubighulaminhaleem

And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
Falammā balaga ma‘ahus-sa‘ya qāla yā bunayya innī arā fil-manāmi annī ażbaḥuka fanẓur māżā tarā, qāla yā abatif‘al mā tu'mar(u), satajidunī in syā'allāhu minaṣ-ṣābirīn(a).
فلما بلغ معه السعي قال يبني اني اري في المنام اني اذبحك فانظر ماذا تري  قال يابت افعل ما تؤمر  ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصبرين

and when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "o my son, indeed i have seen in a dream that i [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." he said, "o my father, do as you are commanded. you will find me, if allah wills, of the steadfast."

falammabalagamaahussayaqalayabunayyainniarafilmanamianniazbahukafanzurmazataraqalayaabatifalmatumarusatajiduniinsyaallahuminassabirinafalammabalaghamaaaahuassaaayaqalayabunayyainneearafeealmanamianneeathbahukafanthurmathataraqalayaabatiifaaalmatumarusatajiduneeinshaaallahuminaassabireen
And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
Falammā aslamā wa tallahū lil-jabīn(i).
فلما اسلما وتله للجبين
and when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
falammaaslamawatallahuliljabinifalammaaslamawatallahuliljabeen
We called to him, "O Abraham,
Wa nādaināhu ay yā ibrāhīm(u).
وندينه ان يابرهيم
we called to him, "o abraham,
wanadainahuayyaibrahimuwanadaynahuanyaibraheem
You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Qad ṣaddaqtar-ru'yā, innā każālika najzil-muḥsinīn(a).
قد صدقت الرءيا  انا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
you have fulfilled the vision." indeed, we thus reward the doers of good.
qadsaddaqtarruyainnakazalikanajzilmuhsininaqadsaddaqtaarruyainnakathalikanajzeealmuhsineen
Indeed, this was the clear trial.
Inna hāżā lahuwal-balā'ul-mubīn(u).
ان هذا لهو البلؤا المبين
indeed, this was the clear trial.
innahazalahuwalbalaulmubinuinnahathalahuwaalbalaoalmubeen
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
Wa fadaināhu biżibḥin ‘aẓīm(in).
وفدينه بذبح عظيم
and we ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
wafadainahubizibhinaziminwafadaynahubithibhinaaatheem
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
Wa taraknā ‘alaihi fil-ākhirīn(a).
وتركنا عليه في الاخرين
and we left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
wataraknaalaihifilakhirinawataraknaaaalayhifeealakhireen
"Peace upon Abraham."
Salāmun ‘alā ibrāhīm(a).
سلم علي ابرهيم
"peace upon abraham."
salamunalaibrahimasalamunaaalaibraheem
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Każālika najzil-muḥsinīn(a).
كذلك نجزي المحسنين
indeed, we thus reward the doers of good.
kazalikanajzilmuhsininakathalikanajzeealmuhsineen
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
Innahū min ‘ibādinal-mu'minīn(a).
انه من عبادنا المؤمنين
indeed, he was of our believing servants.
innahuminibadinalmumininainnahuminaaibadinaalmumineen
And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
Wa basysyarnāhu bi'isḥāqa nabiyyam minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
وبشرنه باسحق نبيا من الصلحين
and we gave him good tidings of isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
wabasysyarnahubiishaqanabiyyamminassalihinawabashsharnahubiishaqanabiyyanminaassaliheen
