indeed, we chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the hereafter].
innaakhlasnahumbikhalisatinzikraddariinnaakhlasnahumbikhalisatinthikraaddar
And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
Wa innahum ‘indanā laminal-muṣṭafainal-akhyār(i).
وانهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الاخيار
and indeed they are, to us, among the chosen and outstanding.
wainnahumindanalaminalmustafainalakhyariwainnahumaaindanalaminaalmustafaynaalakhyar
And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
Ważkur ismā‘īla wal-yasa‘a wa żal-kifl(i), wa kullum minal-akhyār(i).
واذكر اسمعيل واليسع وذا الكفل  وكل من الاخيار
and remember ishmael, elisha and dhul-kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
wazkurismailawalyasaawazalkifliwakullumminalakhyariwathkurismaaaeelawailyasaaaawathaalkifliwakullunminaalakhyar
This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
Hāżā żikr(un), wa inna lil-muttaqīna laḥusna ma'āb(in).
هذا ذكر  وان للمتقين لحسن ماب
this is a reminder. and indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
hazazikrunwainnalilmuttaqinalahusnamaabinhathathikrunwainnalilmuttaqeenalahusnamaab
Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
Jannāti ‘adnim mufattaḥatal lahumul-abwāb(u).
جنت عدن مفتحه لهم الابوب
gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
jannatiadnimmufattahatallahumulabwabujannatiaaadninmufattahatanlahumualabwab
Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
Muttaki'īna fīhā yad‘ūna fīhā bifākihatin kaṡīratiw wa syarāb(in).
متكين فيها يدعون فيها بفكهه كثيره وشراب
reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
muttakiinafihayadunafihabifakihatinkasiratiwwasyarabinmuttakieenafeehayadaaoonafeehabifakihatinkatheeratinwasharab
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
Wa ‘indahum qāṣirātuṭ-ṭarfi atrāb(un).
وعندهم قصرت الطرف اتراب
and with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
waindahumqasiratuttarfiatrabunwaaaindahumqasiratuattarfiatrab
This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
Hāżā mā tū‘adūna liyaumil-ḥisāb(i).
هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
this is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the day of account.
hazamatuadunaliyaumilhisabihathamatooaaadoonaliyawmialhisab
Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
Ina hāżā larizqunā mā lahū min nafād(in).
ان هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
indeed, this is our provision; for it there is no depletion.
inahazalarizqunamalahuminnafadininnahathalarizqunamalahuminnafad
This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
Hāżā, wa inna liṭ-ṭāgīna lasyarra ma'āb(in).
هذا  وان للطغين لشر ماب
this [is so]. but indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
hazawainnalittaginalasyarramaabinhathawainnalittagheenalasharramaab
Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
Jahannam(a), yaṣlaunahā, fabi'sal-mihād(u).
جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد
hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
jahannamayaslaunahafabisalmihadujahannamayaslawnahafabisaalmihad
This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
Hāżā, falyażūqūhu ḥamīmuw wa gassāq(un).
هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
this - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
hazafalyazuquhuhamimuwwagassaqunhathafalyathooqoohuhameemunwaghassaq
And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
Wa ākharu min syaklihī azwāj(un).
وءاخر من شكله ازوج
and other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
waakharuminsyaklihiazwajunwaakharuminshaklihiazwaj
[Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
Hāżā faujum muqtaḥimum ma‘akum, lā marḥabam bihim, innahum ṣālun-nār(i).
هذا فوج مقتحم معكم  لا مرحبا بهم  انهم صالوا النار
[its inhabitants will say], "this is a company bursting in with you. no welcome for them. indeed, they will burn in the fire."
hazafaujummuqtahimummaakumlamarhabambihiminnahumsalunnarihathafawjunmuqtahimunmaaaakumlamarhabanbihiminnahumsalooannar
They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
Qālū bal antum lā marḥabam bikum, antum qaddamtumūhu lanā, fabi'sal-qarār(u).
قالوا بل انتم لا مرحبا بكم  انتم قدمتموه لنا  فبئس القرار
they will say, "nor you! no welcome for you. you, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
qalubalantumlamarhabambikumantumqaddamtumuhulanafabisalqararuqaloobalantumlamarhabanbikumantumqaddamtumoohulanafabisaalqarar
They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
Qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hāżā fazidhu ‘ażāban ḍi‘fan fin-nār(i).
قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
they will say, "our lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the fire."
qalurabbanamanqaddamalanahazafazidhuazabandifanfinnariqaloorabbanamanqaddamalanahathafazidhuaaathabandiaafanfeeannar
And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
Wa qālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā na‘udduhum minal-asyrār(i).
وقالوا ما لنا لا نري رجالا كنا نعدهم من الاشرار
and they will say, "why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
waqalumalanalanararijalankunnanaudduhumminalasyrariwaqaloomalanalanararijalankunnanaaaudduhumminaalashrar
Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
Attakhażnāhum sikhriyyan am zāgat ‘anhumul-abṣār(u).
اتخذنهم سخريا ام زاغت عنهم الابصر
is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
attakhaznahumsikhriyyanamzagatanhumulabsaruattakhathnahumsikhriyyanamzaghataaanhumualabsar
Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
Inna żālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahlin-nār(i).
ان ذلك لحق تخاصم اهل النار
indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the fire.
innazalikalahaqquntakhasumuahlinnariinnathalikalahaqquntakhasumuahliannar
Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
Qul innamā ana munżir(un), wa mā min ilāhin illallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār(u).
قل انما انا منذر  وما من اله الا الله الوحد القهار
say, [o muhammad], "i am only a warner, and there is not any deity except allah, the one, the prevailing,
qulinnamaanamunzirunwamaminilahinillallahulwahidulqahharuqulinnamaanamunthirunwamaminilahinillaallahualwahidualqahhar
Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumal-‘azīzul-gaffār(u).
رب السموت والارض وما بينهما العزيز الغفر
lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the exalted in might, the perpetual forgiver."
rabbussamawatiwalardiwamabainahumalazizulgaffarurabbuassamawatiwalardiwamabaynahumaalaaazeezualghaffar
Say, "It is great news
Qul huwa naba'un ‘aẓīm(un).
قل هو نبؤا عظيم
say, "it is great news
qulhuwanabaunazimunqulhuwanabaonaaatheem
From which you turn away.
Antum ‘anhu mu‘riḍūn(a).
انتم عنه معرضون
from which you turn away.
antumanhumuridunaantumaaanhumuaaridoon
I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
Mā kāna liya min ‘ilmim bil-mala'il-a‘lā iż yakhtaṣimūn(a).
ما كان لي من علم بالملا الاعلي اذ يختصمون
i had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of adam].
makanaliyaminilmimbilmalailalaizyakhtasimunamakanaliyaminaailminbilmalaialaaalaithyakhtasimoon
It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
Iy yūḥā ilayya illā annamā ana nażīrum mubīn(un).
ان يوحي الي الا انما انا نذير مبين
it has not been revealed to me except that i am a clear warner."
iyyuhailayyaillaannamaananazirummubinuninyoohailayyaillaannamaananatheerunmubeen
[So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
Iż qāla rabbuka lil-malā'ikati innī khāliqum basyaram min ṭīn(in).
اذ قال ربك للملئكه اني خلق بشرا من طين
[so mention] when your lord said to the angels, "indeed, i am going to create a human being from clay.
izqalarabbukalilmalaikatiinnikhaliqumbasyarammintininithqalarabbukalilmalaikatiinneekhaliqunbasharanminteen
So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
Fa'iżā sawwaituhū wa nafakhtu fīhi mir rūḥī faqa‘ū lahū sājidīn(a).
فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سجدين
so when i have proportioned him and breathed into him of my [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
faizasawwaituhuwanafakhtufihimirruhifaqaulahusajidinafaithasawwaytuhuwanafakhtufeehiminrooheefaqaaaoolahusajideen
So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
Fasajadal-malā'ikatu kulluhum ajma‘ūn(a).
فسجد الملئكه كلهم اجمعون
so the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
fasajadalmalaikatukulluhumajmaunafasajadaalmalaikatukulluhumajmaaaoon
Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
Illā iblīs(a), istakbara wa kāna minal-kafirīn(a).
الا ابليس استكبر وكان من الكفرين
except iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
illaiblisaistakbarawakanaminalkafirinaillaibleesaistakbarawakanaminaalkafireen
[Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
Qāla yā iblīsu mā mana‘aka an tasjuda  limā khalaqtu biyadayy(a), astakbarta am kunta minal-‘ālīn(a).
قال يابليس ما منعك ان تسجد لما خلقت بيدي  استكبرت ام كنت من العالين
[allah] said, "o iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which i created with my hands? were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
qalayaiblisumamanaakaantasjudalimakhalaqtubiyadayyaastakbartaamkuntaminalalinaqalayaibleesumamanaaaakaantasjudalimakhalaqtubiyadayyaastakbartaamkuntaminaalaaaleen
He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
Qāla ana khairum minhu khalaqtanī min nāriw wa khalaqtahū min ṭīn(in).
قال انا خير منه  خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
he said, "i am better than him. you created me from fire and created him from clay."
qalaanakhairumminhukhalaqtaniminnariwwakhalaqtahumintininqalaanakhayrunminhukhalaqtaneeminnarinwakhalaqtahuminteen
[Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
Qāla fakhruj minhā fa'innaka rajīm(un).
قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم
[allah] said, "then get out of it [i.e., paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
qalafakhrujminhafainnakarajimunqalafakhrujminhafainnakarajeem
And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
Wa inna ‘alaika la‘natī ilā yaumid-dīn(i).
وان عليك لعنتي الي يوم الدين
and indeed, upon you is my curse until the day of recompense."
wainnaalaikalanatiilayaumiddiniwainnaaaalaykalaaanateeilayawmiaddeen
He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
Qāla rabbi fa'anẓirnī ilā yaumi yub‘aṡūn(a).
قال رب فانظرني الي يوم يبعثون
he said, "my lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected."
qalarabbifaanzirniilayaumiyubasunaqalarabbifaanthirneeilayawmiyubaaathoon
[Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
Qāla fa'innaka minal-munẓarīn(a).
قال فانك من المنظرين
[allah] said, "so indeed, you are of those reprieved
qalafainnakaminalmunzarinaqalafainnakaminaalmunthareen
Until the Day of the time well-known."
Ilā yaumil-waqtil-ma‘lūm(i).
الي يوم الوقت المعلوم
until the day of the time well-known."
ilayaumilwaqtilmalumiilayawmialwaqtialmaaaloom
[Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
Qāla fabi‘izzatika la'ugwiyannahum ajma‘īn(a).
قال فبعزتك لاغوينهم اجمعين
[iblees] said, "by your might, i will surely mislead them all.
qalafabiizzatikalaugwiyannahumajmainaqalafabiaaizzatikalaoghwiyannahumajmaaaeen
Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
Illā ‘ibādaka minhumul-mukhlaṣīn(a).
الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
except, among them, your chosen servants."
illaibadakaminhumulmukhlasinaillaaaibadakaminhumualmukhlaseen
[Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
Qāla fal-ḥaqq(u), wal-ḥaqqa aqūl(u).
قال فالحق والحق اقول
[allah] said, "the truth [is my oath], and the truth i say -
qalafalhaqquwalhaqqaaquluqalafalhaqquwalhaqqaaqool
[That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
La'amla'anna jahannama minka wa mimman tabi‘aka minhum ajma‘īn(a).
لاملان جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم اجمعين
[that] i will surely fill hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
laamlaannajahannamaminkawamimmantabiakaminhumajmainalaamlaannajahannamaminkawamimmantabiaaakaminhumajmaaaeen
Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
Qul mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajriw wa mā ana minal-mutakallifīn(a).
قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر وما انا من المتكلفين
say, [o muhammad], "i do not ask you for it [i.e., the qur’an] any payment, and i am not of the pretentious.
qulmaasalukumalaihiminajriwwamaanaminalmutakallifinaqulmaasalukumaaalayhiminajrinwamaanaminaalmutakallifeen
It is but a reminder to the worlds.
In huwa illā żikrul lil-‘ālamīn(a).
ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
it is but a reminder to the worlds.
inhuwaillazikrullilalaminainhuwaillathikrunlilaaalameen
And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
Wa lata‘lamunna naba'ahū ba‘da ḥīn(in).
ولتعلمن نباه بعد حين
and you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
walatalamunnanabaahubadahininwalataaalamunnanabaahubaaadaheen
The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Tanzīlul-kitābi minallāhil-‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).
تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
the revelation of the book [i.e., the qur’an] is from allah, the exalted in might, the wise.
tanzilulkitabiminallahilazizilhakimitanzeelualkitabiminaallahialaaazeezialhakeem
Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
Innā anzalnā ilaikal-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi fa‘budillāha mukhliṣal lahud-dīn(a).
انا انزلنا اليك الكتب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
indeed, we have sent down to you the book, [o muhammad], in truth. so worship allah, [being] sincere to him in religion.
innaanzalnailaikalkitababilhaqqifabudillahamukhlisallahuddinainnaanzalnailaykaalkitababilhaqqifaaabudiallahamukhlisanlahuaddeen

Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

Alā lillāhid-dīnul-khāliṣ(u), wal-lażīnattakhażū min dūnihī auliyā'(a), mā na‘buduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilallāhi zulfā, innallāha yaḥkumu bainahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūn(a), innallāha lā yahdī man huwa kāżibun kaffār(un).
الا لله الدين الخالص  والذين اتخذوا من دونه اولياء ما نعبدهم الا ليقربونا الي الله زلفي ان الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون  ان الله لا يهدي من هو كذب كفار

unquestionably, for allah is the pure religion. and those who take protectors besides him [say], "we only worship them that they may bring us nearer to allah in position." indeed, allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. indeed, allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.


If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
Wa lau arādallāhu ay yattakhiża waladal laṣṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), subḥānah(ū), huwallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār(u).
لو اراد الله ان يتخذ ولدا لاصطفي مما يخلق ما يشاء  سبحنه  هو الله الوحد القهار
if allah had intended to take a son, he could have chosen from what he creates whatever he willed. exalted is he; he is allah, the one, the prevailing.
walauaradallahuayyattakhizawaladallastafamimmayakhluqumayasyausubhanahuhuwallahulwahidulqahharulawaradaallahuanyattakhithawaladanlastafamimmayakhluqumayashaosubhanahuhuwaallahualwahidualqahhar

He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

Khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), yukawwirul-laila ‘alan-nahāri wa yukawwirun nahāra ‘alal-laili wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamar(a), kulluy yajrī li'ajalim musammā(n), alā huwal-‘azīzul-gaffār(u).
خلق السموت والارض بالحق  يكور اليل علي النهار ويكور النهار علي اليل  وسخر الشمس والقمر  كل يجري لاجل مسمي  الا هو العزيز الغفر

he created the heavens and earth in truth. he wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. unquestionably, he is the exalted in might, the perpetual forgiver.



He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

Khalaqakum min nafsiw wāḥidatin ṡumma ja‘ala minhā zaujahā wa anzala lakum minal-an‘āmi ṡamāniyata azwāj(in), yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqam mim ba‘di khalqin fī ẓulumātin ṡalāṡ(in), żālikumullāhu rabbukum lahul-mulk(u), lā ilāha illā huw(a), fa'annā tuṣrafūn(a).
خلقكم من نفس وحده ثم جعل منها زوجها وانزل لكم من الانعم ثمنيه ازوج  يخلقكم في بطون امهتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمت ثلث  ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك  لا اله الا هو  فاني تصرفون

he created you from one soul. then he made from it its mate, and he produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. he creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. that is allah, your lord; to him belongs dominion. there is no deity except him, so how are you averted?



If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

In takfurū fa'innallāha ganiyyun ‘ankum, wa lā yarḍā li‘ibādihil-kufr(a), wa in tasykurū yarḍahu lakum, wa lā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, ṡumma ilā rabbikum marji‘ukum fa yunabbi'ukum bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a), innahū ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ان تكفروا فان الله غني عنكم  ولا يرضي لعباده الكفر  وان تشكروا يرضه لكم  ولا تزر وازره وزر اخري  ثم الي ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون  انه عليم بذات الصدور

if you disbelieve - indeed, allah is free from need of you. and he does not approve for his servants disbelief. and if you are grateful, he approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. then to your lord is your return, and he will inform you about what you used to do. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts.



And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

Wa iżā massal-insāna ḍurrun da‘ā rabbahū munīban ilaihi ṡumma iżā khawwalahū ni‘matan minhu nasiya mā kāna yad‘ū ilaihi min qablu wa ja‘ala lilllāhi andādal liyuḍilla ‘an sabīlih(ī), qul tamatta‘ bikufrika qalīlā(n), innaka min aṣḥābin-nār(i).
واذا مس الانسن ضر دعا ربه منيبا اليه ثم اذا خوله نعمه منه نسي ما كان يدعوا اليه من قبل وجعل لله اندادا ليضل عن سبيله  قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا  انك من اصحب النار

and when adversity touches man, he calls upon his lord, turning to him [alone]; then when he bestows on him a favor from himself, he forgets him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to allah equals to mislead [people] from his way. say, "enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the fire."



Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
Amman huwa qānitun ānā'al-laili sājidaw wa qā'imay yaḥżarul-ākhirata wa yarjū raḥmata rabbih(ī), qul hal yastawil-lażīna ya‘lamūna wal-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a), innamā yatażakkaru ulul-albāb(i).
امن هو قنت ءاناء اليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الاخره ويرجوا رحمه ربه  قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون  انما يتذكر اولوا الالبب

is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his lord, [like one who does not]? say, "are those who know equal to those who do not know?" only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.



Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
Qul yā ‘ibādil-lażīna āmanuttaqū rabbakum, lil-lażīna aḥsanū fī hāżihid-dun-yā ḥasanah(tun), wa arḍullāhi wāsi‘ah(tun), innamā yuwaffaṣ-ṣābirūna ajrahum bigairi ḥisāb(in).
قل يعباد الذين ءامنوا اتقوا ربكم  للذين احسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنه  وارض الله وسعه  انما يوفي الصبرون اجرهم بغير حساب

say, "o my servants who have believed, fear your lord. for those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of allah is spacious. indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

qulyaibadillazinaamanuttaqurabbakumlillazinaahsanufihazihiddunyahasanahtunwaardullahiwasiahtuninnamayuwaffassabirunaajrahumbigairihisabinqulyaaaibadiallatheenaamanooittaqoorabbakumlillatheenaahsanoofeehathihiaddunyahasanatunwaarduallahiwasiaaatuninnamayuwaffaassabiroonaajrahumbighayrihisab
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
Qul innī umirtu an a‘budallāha mukhliṣal lahud-dīn(a).
قل اني امرت ان اعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
say, [o muhammad], "indeed, i have been commanded to worship allah, [being] sincere to him in religion.
qulinniumirtuanabudallahamukhlisallahuddinaqulinneeomirtuanaaabudaallahamukhlisanlahuaddeen
And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
Wa umirtu li'an akūna awwalal-muslimīn(a).
وامرت لان اكون اول المسلمين
and i have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the muslims."
waumirtulianakunaawwalalmusliminawaomirtulianakoonaawwalaalmuslimeen
Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
Qul innī akhāfu in ‘aṣaitu rabbī ‘ażāba yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
say, "indeed i fear, if i should disobey my lord, the punishment of a tremendous day."
qulinniakhafuinasaiturabbiazabayauminaziminqulinneeakhafuinaaasayturabbeeaaathabayawminaaatheem
Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
Qulillāha a‘budu mukhliṣal lahū dīnī.
قل الله اعبد مخلصا له ديني
say, "allah [alone] do i worship, sincere to him in my religion,
qulillahaabudumukhlisallahudiniquliallahaaaabudumukhlisanlahudeenee
So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
Fa‘budū mā syi'tum min dūnih(ī), qul innal-khāsirīnal-lażīna khasirū anfusahum wa ahlīhim yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), alā żālika huwal-khusrānul-mubīn(u).
فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه  قل ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمه  الا ذلك هو الخسران المبين
so worship what you will besides him." say, "indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the day of resurrection. unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

fabudumasyitummindunihiqulinnalkhasirinallazinakhasiruanfusahumwaahlihimyaumalqiyamahtialazalikahuwalkhusranulmubinufaaabudoomashitummindoonihiqulinnaalkhasireenaallatheenakhasirooanfusahumwaahleehimyawmaalqiyamatialathalikahuwaalkhusranualmubeen
They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
Lahum min fauqihim ẓulalum minan-nāri wa min taḥtihim ẓulal(un), żālika yukhawwifullāhu bihī ‘ibādah(ū), yā ‘ibādi fattaqūn(i).
لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل  ذلك يخوف الله به عباده  يعباد فاتقون
they will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. by that allah threatens [i.e., warns] his servants. o my servants, then fear me.

lahumminfauqihimzulalumminannariwamintahtihimzulalunzalikayukhawwifullahubihiibadahuyaibadifattaqunilahumminfawqihimthulalunminaannariwamintahtihimthulalunthalikayukhawwifuallahubihiaaibadahuyaaaibadifattaqoon
But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
Wal-lażīnajtanabuṭ-ṭāgūta ay ya‘budūhā wa anābū ilallāhi lahumul-busyrā, fabasysyir ‘ibād(i).
والذين اجتنبوا الطغوت ان يعبدوها وانابوا الي الله لهم البشري  فبشر عباد
but those who have avoided taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to allah - for them are good tidings. so give good tidings to my servants
wallazinajtanabuttagutaayyabuduhawaanabuilallahilahumulbusyrafabasysyiribadiwallatheenaijtanabooattaghootaanyaaabudoohawaanabooilaallahilahumualbushrafabashshiraaibad
Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allāh has guided, and those are people of understanding.
Allażīna yastami‘ūnal-qaula fa yattabi‘ūna aḥsanah(ū), ulā'ikal-lażīna hadāhumullāhu wa ulā'ika hum ulul-albāb(i).
الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون احسنه  اولئك الذين هديهم الله  واولئك هم اولوا الالبب
who listen to speech and follow the best of it. those are the ones allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
allazinayastamiunalqaulafayattabiunaahsanahuulaikallazinahadahumullahuwaulaikahumululalbabiallatheenayastamiaaoonaalqawlafayattabiaaoonaahsanahuolaikaallatheenahadahumuallahuwaolaikahumolooalalbab
Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
Afaman ḥaqqa ‘alaihi kalimatul-‘ażāb(i), afa'anta tunqiżu man fin-nār(i).
افمن حق عليه كلمه العذاب افانت تنقذ من في النار
then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? then, can you save one who is in the fire?
afamanhaqqaalaihikalimatulazabiafaantatunqizumanfinnariafamanhaqqaaaalayhikalimatualaaathabiafaantatunqithumanfeeannar
But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
Lākinil-lażīnattaqau rabbahum lahum gurafum min fauqihā gurafum mabniyyah(tun), tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār(u), wa‘dallāh(i), lā yukhlifullāhul-mī‘ād(a).
لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنيه تجري من تحتها الانهر  وعد الله  لا يخلف الله الميعاد
but those who have feared their lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [this is] the promise of allah. allah does not fail in [his] promise.

lakinillazinattaqaurabbahumlahumgurafumminfauqihagurafummabniyyahtuntajrimintahtihalanharuwadallahilayukhlifullahulmiadalakiniallatheenaittaqawrabbahumlahumghurafunminfawqihaghurafunmabniyyatuntajreemintahtihaalanharuwaaadaallahilayukhlifuallahualmeeaaad

Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fasalakahū yanābī‘a fil-arḍi ṡumma yaj‘aluhū ḥuṭāmā(n), ina fī żālika lażikrā li'ulil-albāb(i).
الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينبيع في الارض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا الونه ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطما  ان في ذلك لذكري لاولي الالبب

do you not see that allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then he produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then he makes them [scattered] debris. indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.



So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.
Afaman syaraḥallāhu ṣadrahū lil-islāmi fahuwa ‘alā nūrim mir rabbih(ī), fawailul lil-qāsiyati qulūbuhum min żikrillāh(i), ulā'ika fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
افمن شرح الله صدره للاسلم فهو علي نور من ربه  فويل للقسيه قلوبهم من ذكر الله  اولئك في ضلل مبين

so is one whose breast allah has expanded to [accept] islam and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of allah. those are in manifest error.

afamansyarahallahusadrahulilislamifahuwaalanurimmirrabbihifawailullilqasiyatiqulubuhumminzikrillahiulaikafidalalimmubininafamansharahaallahusadrahulilislamifahuwaaaalanoorinminrabbihifawaylunlilqasiyatiquloobuhumminthikriallahiolaikafeedalalinmubeen

Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

Allāhu nazzala aḥsanal-ḥadīṡi kitābam mutasyābiham maṡāniy(a), taqsya‘irru minhu julūdul-lażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum, ṡumma talīnu julūduhum wa qulūbuhum ilā żikrillāh(i), żālika hudallāhi yahdī bihī may yasyā'(u), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
الله نزل احسن الحديث كتبا متشبها مثاني تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم الي ذكر الله  ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشاء  ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد

allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent book wherein is reiteration. the skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of allah. that is the guidance of allah by which he guides whom he wills. and one whom allah sends astray - for him there is no guide.


Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
Afamay yattaqī biwajhihī sū'al-‘ażābi yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), wa qīla liẓ-ẓālimīna żūqū mā kuntum taksibūn(a).
افمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيمه  وقيل للظلمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون
then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the day of resurrection [like one secure from it]? and it will be said to the wrongdoers, "taste what you used to earn."
afamayyattaqibiwajhihisualazabiyaumalqiyamahtiwaqilalizzaliminazuqumakuntumtaksibunaafamanyattaqeebiwajhihisooaalaaathabiyawmaalqiyamatiwaqeelaliththalimeenathooqoomakuntumtaksiboon
Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
Każżabal-lażīna min qablihim fa'atāhumul-‘ażābu mi ḥaiṡu lā yasy‘urūn(a).
كذب الذين من قبلهم فاتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
kazzaballazinaminqablihimfaatahumulazabumihaisulayasyurunakaththabaallatheenaminqablihimfaatahumualaaathabuminhaythulayashaauroon
So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
Fa ażāqahumullāhul-khizya fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa la‘ażābul-ākhirati akbar(u), lau kānū ya‘lamūn(a).
فاذاقهم الله الخزي في الحيوه الدنيا  ولعذاب الاخره اكبر  لو كانوا يعلمون
so allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. but the punishment of the hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
faazaqahumullahulkhizyafilhayatiddunyawalaazabulakhiratiakbarulaukanuyalamunafaathaqahumuallahualkhizyafeealhayatiaddunyawalaaaathabualakhiratiakbarulawkanooyaaalamoon
And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
Wa laqad ḍarabnā lin-nāsi fī hāżal-qur'āni min kulli maṡalil la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
and we have certainly presented for the people in this qur’an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
walaqaddarabnalinnasifihazalquraniminkullimasalillaallahumyatazakkarunawalaqaddarabnalinnasifeehathaalquraniminkullimathalinlaaaallahumyatathakkaroon
[It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
Qur'ānan ‘arabiyyan gaira żī ‘iwajil la‘allahum yattaqūn(a).
قرءانا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون
[it is] an arabic qur’an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
qurananarabiyyangairaziiwajillaallahumyattaqunaqurananaaarabiyyanghayratheeaaiwajinlaaaallahumyattaqoon

Allāh presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.
Ḍaraballāhu maṡalar rajulan fīhi syurakā'u mutasyākisūna wa rajulan salamal lirajulin hal yastawiyāni maṡalā(n), al-ḥamdu lillāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا  الحمد لله  بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون

allah presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? praise be to allah! but most of them do not know.

daraballahumasalarrajulanfihisyurakaumutasyakisunawarajulansalamallirajulinhalyastawiyanimasalanalhamdulillahibalaksaruhumlayalamunadarabaallahumathalanrajulanfeehishurakaomutashakisoonawarajulansalamanlirajulinhalyastawiyanimathalanalhamdulillahibalaktharuhumlayaaalamoon
Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
Innaka mayyituw wa innahum mayyitūn(a).
انك ميت وانهم ميتون
indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
innakamayyituwwainnahummayyitunainnakamayyitunwainnahummayyitoon
Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
Ṡumma innakum yaumal-qiyāmati ‘inda rabbikum takhtaṣimūn(a).
ثم انكم يوم القيمه عند ربكم تختصمون
then indeed you, on the day of resurrection, before your lord, will dispute.
summainnakumyaumalqiyamatiindarabbikumtakhtasimunathummainnakumyawmaalqiyamatiaaindarabbikumtakhtasimoon
So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allāh and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
Faman aẓlamu mimman każaba ‘alallāhi wa każżaba biṣ-ṣidqi iż jā'ah(ū), alaisa fī jahannama maṡwal lil-kāfirīn(a).
فمن اظلم ممن كذب علي الله وكذب بالصدق اذ جاءه  اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
so who is more unjust than one who lies about allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? is there not in hell a residence for the disbelievers?
famanazlamumimmankazabaalallahiwakazzababissidqiizjaahualaisafijahannamamaswallilkafirinafamanathlamumimmankathabaaaalaallahiwakaththababissidqiithjaahualaysafeejahannamamathwanlilkafireen
And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
Wal-lażī jā'a biṣ-ṣidqi wa ṣaddaqa bihī ulā'ika humul-muttaqūn(a).
والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به  اولئك هم المتقون
and the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
wallazijaabissidqiwasaddaqabihiulaikahumulmuttaqunawallatheejaabissidqiwasaddaqabihiolaikahumualmuttaqoon
They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
Lahum mā yasyā'ūna ‘inda rabbihim, żālika jazā'ul-muḥsinīn(a).
لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم  ذلك جزاء المحسنين
they will have whatever they desire with their lord. that is the reward of the doers of good -
lahummayasyaunaindarabbihimzalikajazaulmuhsininalahummayashaoonaaaindarabbihimthalikajazaoalmuhsineen
That Allāh may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
Liyukaffirallāhu ‘anhum aswa'al-lażī ‘amilū wa yajziyahum ajrahum bi'aḥsanil-lażī kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ليكفر الله عنهم اسوا الذي عملوا ويجزيهم اجرهم باحسن الذي كانوا يعملون
that allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
liyukaffirallahuanhumaswaallaziamiluwayajziyahumajrahumbiahsanillazikanuyamalunaliyukaffiraallahuaaanhumaswaaallatheeaaamiloowayajziyahumajrahumbiahsaniallatheekanooyaaamaloon

Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
Alaisallāhu bikāfin ‘abdah(ū), wa yukhawwifūnaka bil-lażīna min dūnih(ī), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
اليس الله بكاف عبده  ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه  ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد

is not allah sufficient for his servant [i.e., prophet muhammad (ﷺ)]? and [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than him. and whoever allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
alaisallahubikafinabdahuwayukhawwifunakabillazinamindunihiwamayyudlilillahufamalahuminhadinalaysaallahubikafinaaabdahuwayukhawwifoonakabillatheenamindoonihiwamanyudliliallahufamalahuminhad
And whoever Allāh guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allāh Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
Wa may yahdillāhu famā lahū min muḍill(in), alaisallāhu bi‘azīzin żintiqām(in).
ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل  اليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام
and whoever allah guides - for him there is no misleader. is not allah exalted in might and owner of retribution?
wamayyahdillahufamalahuminmudillinalaisallahubiazizinzintiqaminwamanyahdiallahufamalahuminmudillinalaysaallahubiaaazeezintheeintiqam

And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allāh? If Allāh intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."

Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunnallāh(u), qul afara'aitum mā tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi in arādaniyallāhu biḍurrin hal hunna kāsyifātu ḍurrihī au arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mumsikātu raḥmatih(ī), qul ḥasbiyallāh(u), ‘alaihi yatawakkalul-mutawakkilūn(a).
ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله  قل افرءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله ان ارادني الله بضر هل هن كشفت ضره او ارادني برحمه هل هن ممسكت رحمته  قل حسبي الله  عليه يتوكل المتوكلون

and if you asked them, "who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "allah." say, "then have you considered what you invoke besides allah? if allah intended me harm, are they removers of his harm; or if he intended me mercy, are they withholders of his mercy?" say, "sufficient for me is allah; upon him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."


Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
Qul yā qaumi‘malū ‘alā makānatikum innī ‘āmil(un), fa saufa ta‘lamūn(a).
قل يقوم اعملوا علي مكانتكم اني عمل  فسوف تعلمون
say, "o my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, i am working; and you are going to know
qulyaqaumimalualamakanatikuminniamilunfasaufatalamunaqulyaqawmiiaamalooaaalamakanatikuminneeaaamilunfasawfataaalamoon
To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
May ya'tīhi ‘ażābuy yukhzīhi wa yaḥillu ‘alaihi ‘ażābum muqīm(un).
من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
to whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
mayyatihiazabuyyukhzihiwayahillualaihiazabummuqimunmanyateehiaaathabunyukhzeehiwayahilluaaalayhiaaathabunmuqeem

Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.
Innā anzalnā ‘alaikal-kitāba lin-nāsi bil-ḥaqq(i), fa manihtadā fa linafsih(ī), wa man ḍalla fa innamā yaḍillu ‘alaihā, wa mā anta ‘alaihim biwakīl(in).
انا انزلنا عليك الكتب للناس بالحق  فمن اهتدي فلنفسه  ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها  وما انت عليهم بوكيل

indeed, we sent down to you the book for the people in truth. so whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. and you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.

innaanzalnaalaikalkitabalinnasibilhaqqifamanihtadafalinafsihiwamandallafainnamayadillualaihawamaantaalaihimbiwakilininnaanzalnaaaalaykaalkitabalinnasibilhaqqifamaniihtadafalinafsihiwamandallafainnamayadilluaaalayhawamaantaaaalayhimbiwakeel

Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
Allāhu yatawaffal-anfusa ḥīna mautihā wal-latī lam tamut fī manāmihā, fayumsikul-latī qaḍā ‘alaihal-mauta wa yursilul-ukhrā ilā ajalim musammā(n), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
الله يتوفي الانفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها  فيمسك التي قضي عليها الموت ويرسل الاخري الي اجل مسمي  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون

allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [he takes] during their sleep. then he keeps those for which he has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.


Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
Amittakhażū min dūnillāhi syufa‘ā'(a), qul awalau kānū lā yamlikūna syai'aw wa lā ya‘qilūn(a).
ام اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء  قل اولو كانوا لا يملكون شيا ولا يعقلون
or have they taken other than allah as intercessors? say, "even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
amittakhazumindunillahisyufaaaqulawalaukanulayamlikunasyaiawwalayaqilunaamiittakhathoomindooniallahishufaaaaaqulawalawkanoolayamlikoonashayanwalayaaaqiloon
Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
Qul lillāhisy-syafā‘atu jamī‘ā(n), lahū mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), ṡumma ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
قل لله الشفعه جميعا  له ملك السموت والارض  ثم اليه ترجعون
say, "to allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. to him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. then to him you will be returned."
qullillahisysyafaatujamianlahumulkussamawatiwalardisummailaihiturjaunaqullillahiashshafaaaatujameeaaanlahumulkuassamawatiwalardithummailayhiturjaaaoon
And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
Wa iżā żukirallāhu waḥdahusyma'azzat qulūbul-lażīna  lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirah(ti), wa iżā żukiral-lażīna min dūnihī iżā hum yastabsyirūn(a).
واذا ذكر الله وحده اشمازت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخره  واذا ذكر الذين من دونه اذا هم يستبشرون
and when allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

waizazukirallahuwahdahusymaazzatqulubullazinalayuminunabilakhirahtiwaizazukirallazinamindunihiizahumyastabsyirunawaithathukiraallahuwahdahuishmaazzatquloobuallatheenalayuminoonabilakhiratiwaithathukiraallatheenamindoonihiithahumyastabshiroon
Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
Qulillāhumma fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍi ‘ālimal-gaibi wasy-syahādati anta taḥkumu baina  ‘ibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
قل اللهم فاطر السموت والارض علم الغيب والشهده انت تحكم بين عبادك في ما كانوا فيه يختلفون
say, "o allah, creator of the heavens and the earth, knower of the unseen and the witnessed, you will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

qulillahummafatirassamawatiwalardialimalgaibiwasysyahadatiantatahkumubainaibadikafimakanufihiyakhtalifunaquliallahummafatiraassamawatiwalardiaaalimaalghaybiwashshahadatiantatahkumubaynaaaibadikafeemakanoofeehiyakhtalifoon

And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.
Wa lau anna lil-lażīna ẓalamū mā fil-arḍi jamī‘aw wa miṡlahū ma‘ahū laftadau bihī min sū'il-‘ażābi yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), wa badā lahum minallāhi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūn(a).
ولو ان للذين ظلموا ما في الارض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيمه  وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون

and if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the day of resurrection. and there will appear to them from allah that which they had not taken into account.

walauannalillazinazalamumafilardijamiawwamislahumaahulaftadaubihiminsuilazabiyaumalqiyamahtiwabadalahumminallahimalamyakunuyahtasibunawalawannalillatheenathalamoomafeealardijameeaaanwamithlahumaaaahulaftadawbihiminsooialaaathabiyawmaalqiyamatiwabadalahumminaallahimalamyakoonooyahtasiboon
And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
Wa badā lahum sayyi'ātu mā kasabū wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
وبدا لهم سيات ما كسبوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
and there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
wabadalahumsayyiatumakasabuwahaqabihimmakanubihiyastahziunawabadalahumsayyiatumakasaboowahaqabihimmakanoobihiyastahzioon

And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
Fa'iżā massal-insāna ḍurrun da‘ānā ṡumma iżā khawwalnāhu ni‘matam minnā, qāla innamā ūtītuhū ‘alā ‘ilm(in), bal hiya fitnatuw wa lākinna akṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
فاذا مس الانسن ضر دعانا ثم اذا خولنه نعمه منا قال انما اوتيته علي علم  بل هي فتنه ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون

and when adversity touches man, he calls upon us; then when we bestow on him a favor from us, he says, "i have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

faizamassalinsanadurrundaanasummaizakhawwalnahunimatamminnaqalainnamautituhualailminbalhiyafitnatuwwalakinnaaksarahumlayalamunafaithamassaalinsanadurrundaaaanathummaithakhawwalnahuniaamatanminnaqalainnamaooteetuhuaaalaaailminbalhiyafitnatunwalakinnaaktharahumlayaaalamoon
Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
Qad qālahal-lażīna min qablihim famā agnā ‘anhum mā kānū yaksibūn(a).
قد قالها الذين من قبلهم فما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
qadqalahallazinaminqablihimfamaagnaanhummakanuyaksibunaqadqalahaallatheenaminqablihimfamaaghnaaaanhummakanooyaksiboon

And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
Fa'aṣābahum sayyi'ātu mā kasabū, wal-lażīna ẓalamū min hā'ulā'i sayuṣībuhum  sayyi'ātu mā kasabū, wa mā hum bimu‘jizīn(a).
فاصابهم سيات ما كسبوا  والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم سيات ما كسبوا وما هم بمعجزين

and the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. and those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
faasabahumsayyiatumakasabuwallazinazalamuminhaulaisayusibuhumsayyiatumakasabuwamahumbimujizinafaasabahumsayyiatumakasaboowallatheenathalamoominhaolaisayuseebuhumsayyiatumakasaboowamahumbimuaajizeen
Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
Awalam ya‘lamū annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
اولم يعلموا ان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يؤمنون
do they not know that allah extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]? indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
awalamyalamuannallahayabsuturrizqalimayyasyauwayaqdiruinnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyuminunaawalamyaaalamooannaallahayabsutuarrizqalimanyashaowayaqdiruinnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyuminoon
Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
Qul yā ‘ibādiyal-lażīna asrafū ‘alā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū mir raḥmatillāh(i), innallāha yagfiruż-żunūba jamī‘ā(n), innahū huwal-gafūrur-raḥīm(u).
قل يعبادي الذين اسرفوا علي انفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمه الله  ان الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا  انه هو الغفور الرحيم
say, "o my servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of allah. indeed, allah forgives all sins. indeed, it is he who is the forgiving, the merciful."

qulyaibadiyallazinaasrafualaanfusihimlataqnatumirrahmatillahiinnallahayagfiruzzunubajamianinnahuhuwalgafururrahimuqulyaaaibadiyaallatheenaasrafooaaalaanfusihimlataqnatoominrahmatiallahiinnaallahayaghfiruaththunoobajameeaaaninnahuhuwaalghafooruarraheem
And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
Wa anībū ilā rabbikum wa aslimū lahū min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-‘ażābu ṡumma lā tunṣarūn(a).
وانيبوا الي ربكم واسلموا له من قبل ان ياتيكم العذاب ثم لا تنصرون
and return [in repentance] to your lord and submit to him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
waanibuilarabbikumwaaslimulahuminqabliayyatiyakumulazabusummalatunsarunawaaneebooilarabbikumwaaslimoolahuminqablianyatiyakumualaaathabuthummalatunsaroon
And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
Wattabi‘ū aḥsana mā unzila ilaikum mir rabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul ‘ażābu bagtataw wa antum lā tasy‘urūn(a).
واتبعوا احسن ما انزل اليكم من ربكم من قبل ان ياتيكم العذاب بغته وانتم لا تشعرون
and follow the best of what was revealed to you from your lord [i.e., the qur’an] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
wattabiuahsanamaunzilailaikummirrabbikumminqabliayyatiyakumulazabubagtatawwaantumlatasyurunawattabiaaooahsanamaonzilailaykumminrabbikumminqablianyatiyakumualaaathabubaghtatanwaantumlatashaauroon
Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."
An taqūla yā ḥasratā ‘alā mā farraṭṭu fī jambillāhi wa in kuntu laminas-sākhirīn(a).
ان تقول نفس يحسرتي علي ما فرطت في جنب الله وان كنت لمن السخرين
lest a soul should say, "oh, [how great is] my regret over what i neglected in regard to allah and that i was among the mockers."
antaqulayahasrataalamafarrattufijambillahiwainkuntulaminassakhirinaantaqoolanafsunyahasrataaaalamafarrattufeejanbiallahiwainkuntulaminaassakhireen
Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
Au taqūla lau annallāha hadānī lakuntu minal-muttaqīn(a).
او تقول لو ان الله هديني لكنت من المتقين
or [lest] it say, "if only allah had guided me, i would have been among the righteous."
autaqulalauannallahahadanilakuntuminalmuttaqinaawtaqoolalawannaallahahadaneelakuntuminaalmuttaqeen
Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
Au taqūla ḥīna taral-‘ażāba lau anna lī karratan fa akūna minal-muḥsinīn(a).
او تقول حين تري العذاب لو ان لي كره فاكون من المحسنين
or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "if only i had another turn so i could be among the doers of good."
autaqulahinataralazabalauannalikarratanfaakunaminalmuhsininaawtaqoolaheenataraalaaathabalawannaleekarratanfaakoonaminaalmuhsineen
But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
Balā qad jā'atka āyātī fa każżabta bihā wastakbarta wa kunta minal-kāfirīn(a).
بلي قد جاءتك ءايتي فكذبت بها واستكبرت وكنت من الكفرين
but yes, there had come to you my verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
balaqadjaatkaayatifakazzabtabihawastakbartawakuntaminalkafirinabalaqadjaatkaayateefakaththabtabihawastakbartawakuntaminaalkafireen
And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
Wa yaumal-qiyāmati taral-lażīna każabū ‘alallāhi wujūhuhum muswaddah(tun), alaisa fī jahannama maṡwal lil-mutakabbirīn(a).
ويوم القيمه تري الذين كذبوا علي الله وجوههم مسوده  اليس في جهنم مثوي للمتكبرين
and on the day of resurrection you will see those who lied about allah [with] their faces blackened. is there not in hell a residence for the arrogant?

wayaumalqiyamatitarallazinakazabualallahiwujuhuhummuswaddahtunalaisafijahannamamaswallilmutakabbirinawayawmaalqiyamatitaraallatheenakathabooaaalaallahiwujoohuhummuswaddatunalaysafeejahannamamathwanlilmutakabbireen
And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
Wa yunajjillāhul-lażīnattaqau bimafāzatihim, lā yamassuhumus-sū'u wa lā hum yaḥzanūn(a).
وينجي الله الذين اتقوا بمفازتهم لا يمسهم السوء ولا هم يحزنون
and allah will save those who feared him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
wayunajjillahullazinattaqaubimafazatihimlayamassuhumussuuwalahumyahzanunawayunajjeeallahuallatheenaittaqawbimafazatihimlayamassuhumuassooowalahumyahzanoon
Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
Allāhu khāliqu kulli syai'(in), wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'iw wakīl(un).
الله خلق كل شيء  وهو علي كل شيء وكيل
allah is the creator of all things, and he is, over all things, disposer of affairs.
allahukhaliqukullisyaiinwahuwaalakullisyaiiwwakilunallahukhaliqukullishayinwahuwaaaalakullishayinwakeel
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.
Lahū maqālīdus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyātillāhi ulā'ika humul-khāsirūn(a).
له مقاليد السموت والارض  والذين كفروا بايت الله اولئك هم الخسرون
to him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. and they who disbelieve in the verses of allah - it is those who are the losers.
lahumaqalidussamawatiwalardiwallazinakafarubiayatillahiulaikahumulkhasirunalahumaqaleeduassamawatiwalardiwallatheenakafaroobiayatiallahiolaikahumualkhasiroon
Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
Qul afagairallāhi ta'murūnnī a‘budu ayyuhal-jāhilūn(a).
قل افغير الله تامروني اعبد ايها الجهلون
say, [o muhammad], "is it other than allah that you order me to worship, o ignorant ones?"
qulafagairallahitamurunniabuduayyuhaljahilunaqulafaghayraallahitamuroonneeaaabuduayyuhaaljahiloon
And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.
Wa laqad ūḥiya ilaika wa ilal-lażīna min qablik(a), la'in asyrakta layaḥbaṭanna ‘amaluka wa latakūnanna minal-khāsirīn(a).
ولقد اوحي اليك والي الذين من قبلك لئن اشركت ليحبطن عملك ولتكونن من الخسرين
and it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.

walaqaduhiyailaikawailallazinaminqablikalainasyraktalayahbatannaamalukawalatakunannaminalkhasirinawalaqadoohiyailaykawailaallatheenaminqablikalainashraktalayahbatannaaaamalukawalatakoonannaminaalkhasireen
Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.
Balillāha fa‘bud wa kum minasy-syākirīn(a).
بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشكرين
rather, worship [only] allah and be among the grateful.
balillahafabudwakumminasysyakirinabaliallahafaaabudwakunminaashshakireen

They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
Wa mā qadarullāha ḥaqqa qadrih(ī), wal-arḍu jamī‘an qabḍatuhū yaumal-qiyāmati was-samāwātu maṭwiyyātum biyamīnih(ī), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
وما قدروا الله حق قدره والارض جميعا قبضته يوم القيمه والسموت مطويت بيمينه  سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون

they have not appraised allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] his grip on the day of resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in his right hand. exalted is he and high above what they associate with him.

wamaqadarullahahaqqaqadrihiwalardujamianqabdatuhuyaumalqiyamatiwassamawatumatwiyyatumbiyaminihisubhanahuwataalaammayusyrikunawamaqadarooallahahaqqaqadrihiwalardujameeaaanqabdatuhuyawmaalqiyamatiwassamawatumatwiyyatunbiyameenihisubhanahuwataaaalaaaammayushrikoon

And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.

Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna kānū min qablihim, kānū hum asyaddu minhum quwwataw wa āṡāran fil-arḍi fa'akhażahumullāhu biżunūbihim, wa mā kāna lahum minallāhi miw wāq(in).
اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين كانوا من قبلهم  كانوا هم اشد منهم قوه وءاثارا في الارض فاخذهم الله بذنوبهم وما كان لهم من الله من واق

have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? they were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but allah seized them for their sins. and they had not from allah any protector.


That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
Żālika bi'annahum kānat ta'tīhim rusuluhum bil-bayyināti fakafarū fa'akhażahumullāh(u), innahū qawiyyun syadīdul-‘iqāb(i).
ذلك بانهم كانت تاتيهم رسلهم بالبينت فكفروا فاخذهم الله  انه قوي شديد العقاب
that was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so allah seized them. indeed, he is powerful and severe in punishment.

zalikabiannahumkanattatihimrusuluhumbilbayyinatifakafarufaakhazahumullahuinnahuqawiyyunsyadiduliqabithalikabiannahumkanattateehimrusuluhumbilbayyinatifakafaroofaakhathahumuallahuinnahuqawiyyunshadeedualaaiqab
And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
Wa laqad arsalnā mūsā bi'āyātinā wa sulṭānim mubīn(in).
ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا وسلطن مبين
and we did certainly send moses with our signs and a clear authority
walaqadarsalnamusabiayatinawasultanimmubininwalaqadarsalnamoosabiayatinawasultaninmubeen
To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
Ilā fir‘auna wa hāmāna wa qārūna faqālū sāḥirun każżāb(un).
الي فرعون وهمن وقرون فقالوا سحر كذاب
to pharaoh, haman and qarun, but they said, "[he is] a magician and a liar."
ilafiraunawahamanawaqarunafaqalusahirunkazzabunilafiraaawnawahamanawaqaroonafaqaloosahirunkaththab
And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
Falammā jā'ahum bil-ḥaqqi min ‘indinā qāluqtulū abnā'al-lażīna āmanū ma‘ahū wastaḥyū nisā'ahum, wa mā kaidul-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl(in).
فلما جاءهم بالحق من عندنا قالوا اقتلوا ابناء الذين ءامنوا معه واستحيوا نساءهم  وما كيد الكفرين الا في ضلل
and when he brought them the truth from us, they said, "kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." but the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

falammajaahumbilhaqqiminindinaqaluqtuluabnaallazinaamanumaahuwastahyunisaahumwamakaidulkafirinaillafidalalinfalammajaahumbilhaqqiminaaindinaqaloooqtulooabnaaallatheenaamanoomaaaahuwastahyoonisaahumwamakaydualkafireenaillafeedalal
And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."
Wa qāla fir‘aunu żarūnī aqtul mūsā walyad‘u rabbah(ū), innī akhāfu ay yubaddila dīnakum au ay yuẓhira fil-arḍil-fasād(a).
وقال فرعون ذروني اقتل موسي وليدع ربه  اني اخاف ان يبدل دينكم او ان يظهر في الارض الفساد
and pharaoh said, "let me kill moses and let him call upon his lord. indeed, i fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."

waqalafiraunuzaruniaqtulmusawalyadurabbahuinniakhafuayyubaddiladinakumauayyuzhirafilardilfasadawaqalafiraaawnutharooneeaqtulmoosawalyadaaurabbahuinneeakhafuanyubaddiladeenakumawanyuthhirafeealardialfasad
But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
Wa qāla mūsā innī ‘użtu birabbī wa rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril lā yu'minu biyaumil-ḥisāb(i).
وقال موسي اني عذت بربي وربكم من كل متكبر لا يؤمن بيوم الحساب
but moses said, "indeed, i have sought refuge in my lord and your lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the day of account."
waqalamusainniuztubirabbiwarabbikumminkullimutakabbirillayuminubiyaumilhisabiwaqalamoosainneeaauthtubirabbeewarabbikumminkullimutakabbirinlayuminubiyawmialhisab

And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.

Wa qāla rajulum mu'min(um), min āli fir‘auna yaktumu īmānahū ataqtulūna rajulan ay yaqūla rabbiyallāhu wa qad jā'akum bil-bayyināti mir rabbikum, wa iy yaku kāżiban fa ‘alaihi każibuh(ū), wa iy yaku ṣādiqay yuṣibkum ba‘ḍul-lażī ya‘idukum, innallāha lā yahdī man huwa musrifun każżāb(un).
وقال رجل مؤمن من ءال فرعون يكتم ايمنه اتقتلون رجلا ان يقول ربي الله وقد جاءكم بالبينت من ربكم  وان يك كذبا فعليه كذبه  وان يك صادقا يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم  ان الله لا يهدي من هو مسرف كذاب

and a believing man from the family of pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'my lord is allah' while he has brought you clear proofs from your lord? and if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. indeed, allah does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.



O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
Yā qaumi lakumul-mulkul-yauma ẓāhirīna fil-arḍ(i), famay yanṣurunā mim ba'sillāhi in jā'anā, qāla fir‘aunu mā urīkum illā mā arā wa mā ahdīkum illā sabīlar-rasyād(i).
يقوم لكم الملك اليوم ظهرين في الارض فمن ينصرنا من باس الله ان جاءنا  قال فرعون ما اريكم الا ما اري وما اهديكم الا سبيل الرشاد

o my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. but who would protect us from the punishment of allah if it came to us?" pharaoh said, "i do not show you except what i see, and i do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."

yaqaumilakumulmulkulyaumazahirinafilardifamayyansurunamimbasillahiinjaanaqalafiraunumaurikumillamaarawamaahdikumillasabilarrasyadiyaqawmilakumualmulkualyawmathahireenafeealardifamanyansurunaminbasiallahiinjaanaqalafiraaawnumaoreekumillamaarawamaahdeekumillasabeelaarrashad
And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
Wa qālal-lażī āmana yā qaumi innī akhāfu ‘alaikum miṡla yaumil-aḥzāb(i).
وقال الذي ءامن يقوم اني اخاف عليكم مثل يوم الاحزاب
and he who believed said, "o my people, indeed i fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
waqalallaziamanayaqaumiinniakhafualaikummislayaumilahzabiwaqalaallatheeamanayaqawmiinneeakhafuaaalaykummithlayawmialahzab
Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.
Miṡla da'bi qaumi nūḥiw wa ‘ādiw wa ṡamūda wal-lażīna mim ba‘dihim, wa mallāhu yurīdu ẓulmal lil-‘ibād(i).
مثل داب قوم نوح وعاد وثمود والذين من بعدهم  وما الله يريد ظلما للعباد
like the custom of the people of noah and of ʿaad and thamud and those after them. and allah wants no injustice for [his] servants.
misladabiqauminuhiwwaadiwwasamudawallazinamimbadihimwamallahuyuriduzulmallilibadimithladabiqawminoohinwaaaadinwathamoodawallatheenaminbaaadihimwamaallahuyureeduthulmanlilaaibad
And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
Wa yā qaumi innī akhāfu ‘alaikum yaumat-tanād(i).
ويقوم اني اخاف عليكم يوم التناد
and o my people, indeed i fear for you the day of calling -
wayaqaumiinniakhafualaikumyaumattanadiwayaqawmiinneeakhafuaaalaykumyawmaattanad
The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.
Yauma tuwallūna mudbirīn(a), mā lakum minallāhi min ‘āṣim(in), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
يوم تولون مدبرين ما لكم من الله من عاصم  ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
the day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from allah any protector. and whoever allah sends astray - there is not for him any guide.
yaumatuwallunamudbirinamalakumminallahiminasiminwamayyudlilillahufamalahuminhadinyawmatuwalloonamudbireenamalakumminaallahiminaaasiminwamanyudliliallahufamalahuminhad

And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

Wa laqad jā'akum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayyināti famā ziltum fī syakkim mimmā jā'akum bih(ī), ḥattā iżā halaka qultum lay yab‘aṡallāhu mim ba‘dihī rasūlā(n), każālika yuḍillullāhu  man huwa musrifum murtāb(un).
ولقد جاءكم يوسف من قبل بالبينت فما زلتم في شك مما جاءكم به  حتي اذا هلك قلتم لن يبعث الله من بعده رسولا  كذلك يضل الله من هو مسرف مرتاب

and joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'never will allah send a messenger after him.' thus does allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."



Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
Allażīna yujādilūna fī āyātillāhi bigairi sulṭānin atāhum, kabura maqtan ‘indallāhi wa ‘indal-lażīna āmanū, każālika yaṭba‘ullāhu ‘alā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbār(in).
الذين يجدلون في ءايت الله بغير سلطن اتيهم  كبر مقتا عند الله وعند الذين ءامنوا  كذلك يطبع الله علي كل قلب متكبر جبار

those who dispute concerning the signs of allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of allah and in the sight of those who have believed. thus does allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.


And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
Wa qāla fir‘aunu yā hāmānubni lī ṣarḥal la‘allī ablugul-asbāb(a).
وقال فرعون يهمن ابن لي صرحا لعلي ابلغ الاسبب
and pharaoh said, "o haman, construct for me a tower that i might reach the ways -
waqalafiraunuyahamanubnilisarhallaalliablugulasbabawaqalafiraaawnuyahamanuibnileesarhanlaaaalleeablughualasbab

The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
Asbābas-samāwāti fa aṭṭali‘a ilā ilāhi mūsā wa innī la'aẓunnuhū kāżibā(n), wa każālika zuyyina lifir‘auna sū'u ‘amalihī wa ṣudda  ‘anis-sabīl(i), wa mā kaidu fir‘auna illā fī tabāb(in).
اسبب السموت فاطلع الي اله موسي واني لاظنه كذبا  وكذلك زين لفرعون سوء عمله وصد عن السبيل  وما كيد فرعون الا في تباب

the ways into the heavens - so that i may look at the deity of moses; but indeed, i think he is a liar." and thus was made attractive to pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. and the plan of pharaoh was not except in ruin.


And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
Wa qālal-lażī āmana yā qaumittabi‘ūni ahdikum sabīlar-rasyād(i).
وقال الذي ءامن يقوم اتبعون اهدكم سبيل الرشاد
and he who believed said, "o my people, follow me; i will guide you to the way of right conduct.
waqalallaziamanayaqaumittabiuniahdikumsabilarrasyadiwaqalaallatheeamanayaqawmiittabiaaooniahdikumsabeelaarrashad
O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
Yā qaumi innamā hāżihil-ḥayātud-dun-yā matā‘(un), wa innal-ākhirata hiya dārul-qarār(i).
يقوم انما هذه الحيوه الدنيا متع وان الاخره هي دار القرار
o my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
yaqaumiinnamahazihilhayatuddunyamataunwainnalakhiratahiyadarulqarariyaqawmiinnamahathihialhayatuaddunyamataaaunwainnaalakhiratahiyadarualqarar

Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
Man ‘amila sayyi'atan falā yujzā illā miṡlahā, wa man ‘amila ṣāliḥam min żakarin au unṡā wa huwa mu'minun fa'ulā'ika yadkhulūnal-jannata yurzaqūna fīhā bigairi ḥisāb(in).
من عمل سيئه فلا يجزي الا مثلها  ومن عمل صلحا من ذكر او انثي وهو مؤمن فاولئك يدخلون الجنه يرزقون فيها بغير حساب

whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter paradise, being given provision therein without account.

manamilasayyiatanfalayujzaillamislahawamanamilasalihamminzakarinauunsawahuwamuminunfaulaikayadkhulunaljannatayurzaqunafihabigairihisabinmanaaamilasayyiatanfalayujzaillamithlahawamanaaamilasalihanminthakarinawonthawahuwamuminunfaolaikayadkhuloonaaljannatayurzaqoonafeehabighayrihisab
And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
Wa yā qaumi mā lī ad‘ūkum ilan-najāti wa tad‘ūnanī ilan-nār(i).
ويقوم ما لي ادعوكم الي النجوه وتدعونني الي النار
and o my people, how is it that i invite you to salvation while you invite me to the fire?
wayaqaumimaliadukumilannajatiwatadunaniilannariwayaqawmimaleeadaaookumilaannajatiwatadaaoonaneeilaannar
You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
Tad‘ūnanī li'akfura billāhi wa usyrika bihī mā laisa lī bihī ‘ilmuw wa ana ad‘ūkum ilal-‘azīzil-gaffār(i).
تدعونني لاكفر بالله واشرك به ما ليس لي به علم وانا ادعوكم الي العزيز الغفر
you invite me to disbelieve in allah and associate with him that of which i have no knowledge, and i invite you to the exalted in might, the perpetual forgiver.
tadunaniliakfurabillahiwausyrikabihimalaisalibihiilmuwwaanaadukumilalazizilgaffaritadaaoonaneeliakfurabillahiwaoshrikabihimalaysaleebihiaailmunwaanaadaaookumilaalaaazeezialghaffar

Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
Lā jarama annamā tad‘ūnanī ilaihi laisa lahū da‘watun fid-dun-yā wa lā fil-ākhirati wa anna maraddanā ilallāhi wa annal-musrifīna hum aṣḥābun-nār(i).
لا جرم انما تدعونني اليه ليس له دعوه في الدنيا ولا في الاخره وان مردنا الي الله وان المسرفين هم اصحب النار

assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the hereafter; and indeed, our return is to allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the fire.

lajaramaannamatadunaniilaihilaisalahudawatunfiddunyawalafilakhiratiwaannamaraddanailallahiwaannalmusrifinahumashabunnarilajaramaannamatadaaoonaneeilayhilaysalahudaaawatunfeeaddunyawalafeealakhiratiwaannamaraddanailaallahiwaannaalmusrifeenahumashabuannar
And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."
Fa satażkurūna mā aqūlu lakum, wa ufawwiḍu amrī ilallāh(i), innallāha baṣīrum bil-‘ibād(i).
فستذكرون ما اقول لكم  وافوض امري الي الله  ان الله بصير بالعباد
and you will remember what i [now] say to you, and i entrust my affair to allah. indeed, allah is seeing of [his] servants."
fasatazkurunamaaqululakumwaufawwiduamriilallahiinnallahabasirumbilibadifasatathkuroonamaaqoolulakumwaofawwiduamreeilaallahiinnaallahabaseerunbilaaibad
So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
Fa waqāhullāhu sayyi'āti mā makarū wa ḥāqa bi'āli fir‘auna sū'al-‘ażāb(i).
فوقيه الله سيات ما مكروا  وحاق بال فرعون سوء العذاب
so allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
fawaqahullahusayyiatimamakaruwahaqabialifiraunasualazabifawaqahuallahusayyiatimamakaroowahaqabialifiraaawnasoooalaaathab
The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
An-nāru yu‘raḍūna ‘alaihā guduwwaw wa ‘asyiyyā(n), wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘ah(tu), adkhilū āla fir‘auna asyaddal-‘ażāb(i).
النار يعرضون عليها غدوا وعشيا  ويوم تقوم الساعه ادخلوا ءال فرعون اشد العذاب
the fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. and the day the hour appears [it will be said], "make the people of pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
annaruyuradunaalaihaguduwwawwaasyiyyanwayaumataqumussaahtuadkhilualafiraunaasyaddalazabiannaruyuaaradoonaaaalayhaghuduwwanwaaaashiyyanwayawmataqoomuassaaaatuadkhilooalafiraaawnaashaddaalaaathab
And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
Wa iż yataḥājjūna fin-nāri fayaqūluḍ-ḍu‘afā'u lil-lażīnastakbarū innā kunnā lakum taba‘an fahal antum mugnūna ‘annā naṣībam minan-nār(i).
واذ يتحاجون في النار فيقول الضعفؤا للذين استكبروا انا كنا لكم تبعا فهل انتم مغنون عنا نصيبا من النار
and [mention] when they will argue within the fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the fire?"

waizyatahajjunafinnarifayaquludduafaulillazinastakbaruinnakunnalakumtabaanfahalantummugnunaannanasibamminannariwaithyatahajjoonafeeannarifayaqooluadduaaafaolillatheenaistakbarooinnakunnalakumtabaaaanfahalantummughnoonaaaannanaseebanminaannar
Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."
Qālal-lażīnastakbarū innā kullun fīhā innallāha qad ḥakama bainal-‘ibād(i).
قال الذين استكبروا انا كل فيها ان الله قد حكم بين العباد
those who had been arrogant will say, "indeed, all [of us] are in it. indeed, allah has judged between the servants."
qalallazinastakbaruinnakullunfihainnallahaqadhakamabainalibadiqalaallatheenaistakbarooinnakullunfeehainnaallahaqadhakamabaynaalaaibad
And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
Wa qālal-lażīna fin-nāri likhazanati jahannamad‘ū rabbakum yukhaffif ‘annā yaumam minal-‘ażāb(i).
وقال الذين في النار لخزنه جهنم ادعوا ربكم يخفف عنا يوما من العذاب
and those in the fire will say to the keepers of hell, "supplicate your lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
waqalallazinafinnarilikhazanatijahannamadurabbakumyukhaffifannayaumamminalazabiwaqalaallatheenafeeannarilikhazanatijahannamaodaaoorabbakumyukhaffifaaannayawmanminaalaaathab

They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."
Qālū awalam taku ta'tīkum rusulukum bil-bayyināt(i), qālū balā, qālū fad‘ū, wa mā du‘ā'ul-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl(in).
قالوا اولم تك تاتيكم رسلكم بالبينت  قالوا بلي  قالوا فادعوا  وما دعؤا الكفرين الا في ضلل

they will say, "did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" they will say, "yes." they will reply, "then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."
qaluawalamtakutatikumrusulukumbilbayyinatiqalubalaqalufaduwamaduaulkafirinaillafidalalinqalooawalamtakutateekumrusulukumbilbayyinatiqaloobalaqaloofadaaoowamaduaaaoalkafireenaillafeedalal
Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
Innā lananṣuru rusulanā wal-lażīna āmanū fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa yauma yaqūmul-asyhād(u).
انا لننصر رسلنا والذين ءامنوا في الحيوه الدنيا ويوم يقوم الاشهد
indeed, we will support our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the day when the witnesses will stand -
innalanansururusulanawallazinaamanufilhayatiddunyawayaumayaqumulasyhaduinnalanansururusulanawallatheenaamanoofeealhayatiaddunyawayawmayaqoomualashhad
The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].
Yauma lā yanfa‘uẓ-ẓālimīna ma‘żiratuhum wa lahumul-la‘natu wa lahum sū'ud-dār(i).
