And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
Wa min āyātihī khalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā baṡṡa fīhimā min dābbah(tin), wa huwa ‘alā jam‘ihim iżā yasyā'u qadīr(un).
ومن ءايته خلق السموت والارض وما بث فيهما من دابه  وهو علي جمعهم اذا يشاء قدير
and of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what he has dispersed throughout them of creatures. and he, for gathering them when he wills, is competent.
waminayatihikhalqussamawatiwalardiwamabassafihimamindabbahtinwahuwaalajamihimizayasyauqadirunwaminayatihikhalquassamawatiwalardiwamabaththafeehimamindabbatinwahuwaaaalajamaaihimithayashaoqadeer
And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
Wa mā aṣābakum mim muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aidīkum wa ya‘fū ‘an kaṡīr(in).
وما اصبكم من مصيبه فبما كسبت ايديكم ويعفوا عن كثير
and whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but he pardons much.
wamaasabakummimmusibatinfabimakasabataidikumwayafuankasirinwamaasabakumminmuseebatinfabimakasabataydeekumwayaaafooaaankatheer
And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
Wa mā antum bimu‘jizīna fil-arḍ(i), wa mā lakum min dūnillāhi miw waliyyiw wa lā naṣīr(in).
وما انتم بمعجزين في الارض  وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
and you will not cause failure [to allah] upon the earth. and you have not besides allah any protector or helper.
wamaantumbimujizinafilardiwamalakummindunillahimiwwaliyyiwwalanasirinwamaantumbimuaajizeenafeealardiwamalakummindooniallahiminwaliyyinwalanaseer
And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
Wa min āyātihil-jawāri fil-baḥri kal-a‘lām(i).
ومن ءايته الجوار في البحر كالاعلم
and of his signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
waminayatihiljawarifilbahrikalalamiwaminayatihialjawarifeealbahrikalaaalam
If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
Iy yasya' yuskinir-rīḥa fa yaẓlalna rawākida ‘alā ẓahrih(ī), inna fī żālika la'āyātil likulli ṣabbārin syakūr(in).
ان يشا يسكن الريح فيظللن رواكد علي ظهره  ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
if he willed, he could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
iyyasyayuskinirrihafayazlalnarawakidaalazahrihiinnafizalikalaayatillikullisabbarinsyakurininyashayuskiniarreehafayathlalnarawakidaaaalathahrihiinnafeethalikalaayatinlikullisabbarinshakoor
Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
Au yūbiqhunna bimā kasabū wa ya‘fu ‘an kaṡīr(in).
او يوبقهن بما كسبوا ويعف عن كثير
or he could destroy them for what they earned; but he pardons much.
auyubiqhunnabimakasabuwayafuankasirinawyoobiqhunnabimakasaboowayaaafuaaankatheer
And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
Wa ya‘lamal-lażīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā, mā lahum mim maḥīṣ(in).
ويعلم الذين يجدلون في ءايتنا ما لهم من محيص
and [that is so] those who dispute concerning our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
wayalamallazinayujadilunafiayatinamalahummimmahisinwayaaalamaallatheenayujadiloonafeeayatinamalahumminmahees
So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
Famā ūtītum min syai'in fa matā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa mā ‘indallāhi khairuw wa abqā lil-lażīna āmanū wa ‘alā rabbihim yatawakkalūn(a).
فما اوتيتم من شيء فمتع الحيوه الدنيا  وما عند الله خير وابقي للذين ءامنوا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
so whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. but what is with allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their lord rely

famautitumminsyaiinfamataulhayatiddunyawamaindallahikhairuwwaabqalillazinaamanuwaalarabbihimyatawakkalunafamaooteetumminshayinfamataaaualhayatiaddunyawamaaaindaallahikhayrunwaabqalillatheenaamanoowaaaalarabbihimyatawakkaloon
And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
Wal-lażīna yajtanibūna kabā'iral-iṡmi wal-fawāḥisya wa iżā mā gaḍibū hum yagfirūn(a).
والذين يجتنبون كبئر الاثم والفوحش واذا ما غضبوا هم يغفرون
and those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
wallazinayajtanibunakabairalismiwalfawahisyawaizamagadibuhumyagfirunawallatheenayajtaniboonakabairaalithmiwalfawahishawaithamaghadiboohumyaghfiroon
And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
Wal-lażīnastajābū lirabbihim wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta wa amruhum syūrā bainahum, wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn(a).
والذين استجابوا لربهم واقاموا الصلوه وامرهم شوري بينهم ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
and those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what we have provided them, they spend,
wallazinastajabulirabbihimwaaqamussalatawaamruhumsyurabainahumwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqunawallatheenaistajaboolirabbihimwaaqamooassalatawaamruhumshoorabaynahumwamimmarazaqnahumyunfiqoon
And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
Wal-lażīna iżā aṣābahumul-bagyu hum yantaṣirūn(a).
والذين اذا اصابهم البغي هم ينتصرون
and those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
wallazinaizaasabahumulbagyuhumyantasirunawallatheenaithaasabahumualbaghyuhumyantasiroon
And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
Wa jazā'u sayyi'atin sayyi'atum miṡluhā, faman ‘afā wa aṣlaḥa fa ajruhū ‘alallāh(i), innahū lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
وجزؤا سيئه سيئه مثلها  فمن عفا واصلح فاجره علي الله  انه لا يحب الظلمين
and the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from allah. indeed, he does not like wrongdoers.
wajazausayyiatinsayyiatummisluhafamanafawaaslahafaajruhualallahiinnahulayuhibbuzzaliminawajazaosayyiatinsayyiatunmithluhafamanaaafawaaslahafaajruhuaaalaallahiinnahulayuhibbuaththalimeen
And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
Wa lamanintaṣara ba‘da ẓulmihī fa ulā'ika mā ‘alaihim min sabīl(in).
ولمن انتصر بعد ظلمه فاولئك ما عليهم من سبيل
and whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
walamanintasarabadazulmihifaulaikamaalaihimminsabilinwalamaniintasarabaaadathulmihifaolaikamaaaalayhimminsabeel
The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
Innamas-sabīlu ‘alal-lażīna yaẓlimūnan-nāsa wa yabgūna fil-arḍi bigairil-ḥaqq(i), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
انما السبيل علي الذين يظلمون الناس ويبغون في الارض بغير الحق  اولئك لهم عذاب اليم
the cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. those will have a painful punishment.
innamassabilualallazinayazlimunannasawayabgunafilardibigairilhaqqiulaikalahumazabunalimuninnamaassabeeluaaalaallatheenayathlimoonaannasawayabghoonafeealardibighayrialhaqqiolaikalahumaaathabunaleem
And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
Wa laman ṣabara wa gafara inna żālika lamin ‘azmil-umūr(i).
ولمن صبر وغفر ان ذلك لمن عزم الامور
and whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
walamansabarawagafarainnazalikalaminazmilumuriwalamansabarawaghafarainnathalikalaminaaazmialomoor
And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
Wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū miw waliyyim mim ba‘dih(ī), wa taraẓ-ẓālimīna lammā ra'awul-‘ażāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddim min sabīl(in).
ومن يضلل الله فما له من ولي من بعده  وتري الظلمين لما راوا العذاب يقولون هل الي مرد من سبيل
and he whom allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond him. and you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

wamayyudlilillahufamalahumiwwaliyyimmimbadihiwatarazzaliminalammaraawulazabayaqulunahalilamaraddimminsabilinwamanyudliliallahufamalahuminwaliyyinminbaaadihiwataraaththalimeenalammaraawooalaaathabayaqooloonahalilamaraddinminsabeel

And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

Wa tarāhum yu‘raḍūna ‘alaihā khāsyi‘īna minaż żulli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyy(in), wa qālal-lażīna āmanū innal-khāsirīnal-lażīna khasirū anfusahum wa ahlīhim yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), alā innaẓ-ẓālimīna fī ‘ażābim muqīm(in).
وتريهم يعرضون عليها خشعين من الذل ينظرون من طرف خفي  وقال الذين ءامنوا ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمه  الا ان الظلمين في عذاب مقيم

and you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. and those who had believed will say, "indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the day of resurrection. unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."


And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
Wa mā kāna lahum min auliyā'a yanṣurūnahum min dūnillāh(i), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min sabīl(in).
وما كان لهم من اولياء ينصرونهم من دون الله  ومن يضلل الله فما له من سبيل
and there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than allah. and whoever allah sends astray - for him there is no way.
wamakanalahumminauliyaayansurunahummindunillahiwamayyudlilillahufamalahuminsabilinwamakanalahumminawliyaayansuroonahummindooniallahiwamanyudliliallahufamalahuminsabeel
Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.
Istajībū lirabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiya yaumul lā maradda lahū minallāh(i), mā lakum mim malja'iy yauma'iżiw wa mā lakum min nakīr(in).
استجيبوا لربكم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله  ما لكم من ملجا يومئذ وما لكم من نكير
respond to your lord before a day comes from allah of which there is no repelling. no refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.

istajibulirabbikumminqabliayyatiyayaumullamaraddalahuminallahimalakummimmaljaiyyaumaiziwwamalakumminnakirinistajeeboolirabbikumminqablianyatiyayawmunlamaraddalahuminaallahimalakumminmaljainyawmaithinwamalakumminnakeer

But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

Fa in a‘raḍū famā arsalnāka ‘alaihim ḥafīẓā(n), in ‘alaika illal-balāg(u), wa innā iżā ażaqnal-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā, wa in tuṣibhum sayyi'atum bimā qaddamat aidīhim fa'innal-insāna kafūr(un).
فان اعرضوا فما ارسلنك عليهم حفيظا  ان عليك الا البلغ  وانا اذا اذقنا الانسن منا رحمه فرح بها  وان تصبهم سيئه بما قدمت ايديهم فان الانسن كفور

but if they turn away - then we have not sent you, [o muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. and indeed, when we let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.


To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
Lillāhi mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), yahabu limay yasyā'u ināṡaw wa yahabu limay yasyā'uż-żukūr(a).
لله ملك السموت والارض  يخلق ما يشاء  يهب لمن يشاء انثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور
to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; he creates what he wills. he gives to whom he wills female [children], and he gives to whom he wills males.
lillahimulkussamawatiwalardiyakhluqumayasyauyahabulimayyasyauinasawwayahabulimayyasyauzzukuralillahimulkuassamawatiwalardiyakhluqumayashaoyahabulimanyashaoinathanwayahabulimanyashaoaththukoor
Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
Au yuzawwijuhum żukrānaw wa ināṡā(n), wa yaj‘alu may yasyā'u ‘aqīmā(n), innahū ‘alīmun qadīr(un).
او يزوجهم ذكرانا وانثا  ويجعل من يشاء عقيما  انه عليم قدير
or he makes them [both] males and females, and he renders whom he wills barren. indeed, he is knowing and competent.
auyuzawwijuhumzukranawwainasanwayajalumayyasyauaqimaninnahualimunqadirunawyuzawwijuhumthukrananwainathanwayajaaalumanyashaoaaaqeemaninnahuaaaleemunqadeer

And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
Wa mā kāna libasyarin ay yukallimahullāhu illā waḥyan au miw warā'i ḥijābin au yursila rasūlan fa yūḥiya bi'iżnihī mā yasyā'(u), innahū ‘aliyyun ḥakīm(un).
وما كان لبشر ان يكلمه الله الا وحيا او من ورائ حجاب او يرسل رسولا فيوحي باذنه ما يشاء  انه علي حكيم

and it is not for any human being that allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that he sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by his permission, what he wills. indeed, he is most high and wise.

wamakanalibasyarinayyukallimahullahuillawahyanaumiwwaraihijabinauyursilarasulanfayuhiyabiiznihimayasyauinnahualiyyunhakimunwamakanalibasharinanyukallimahuallahuillawahyanawminwaraihijabinawyursilarasoolanfayoohiyabiithnihimayashaoinnahuaaaliyyunhakeem

And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
Wa każālika auḥainā ilaika rūḥam min amrinā, mā kunta tadrī mal-kitābu wa lal-īmānu wa lākin ja‘alnāhu nūran nahdī bihī man nasyā'u min ‘ibādinā, wa innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
وكذلك اوحينا اليك روحا من امرنا  ما كنت تدري ما الكتب ولا الايمن ولكن جعلنه نورا نهدي به من نشاء من عبادنا  وانك لتهدي الي صرط مستقيم

and thus we have revealed to you an inspiration of our command [i.e., the qur’an]. you did not know what is the book or [what is] faith, but we have made it a light by which we guide whom we will of our servants. and indeed, [o muhammad], you guide to a straight path -


The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
Ṣirāṭillāhil-lażī lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), alā ilallāhi taṣīrul-umūr(u).
صرط الله الذي له ما في السموت وما في الارض  الا الي الله تصير الامور
the path of allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. unquestionably, to allah do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
siratillahillazilahumafissamawatiwamafilardialailallahitasirulumurusiratiallahiallatheelahumafeeassamawatiwamafeealardialailaallahitaseerualomoor
Ḥā, Meem.
Ḥā mīm.
حم
ha, meem.
hamimhameem
By the clear Book,
Wal-kitābil-mubīn(i).
والكتب المبين
by the clear book,
walkitabilmubiniwalkitabialmubeen
Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
Innā ja‘alnāhu qur'ānan ‘arabiyyal la‘allakum ta‘qilūn(a).
انا جعلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
indeed, we have made it an arabic qur’an that you might understand.
innajaalnahuqurananarabiyyallaallakumtaqilunainnajaaaalnahuqurananaaarabiyyanlaaaallakumtaaaqiloona
And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
Wa innahū fī ummil-kitābi ladainā la‘aliyyun ḥakīm(un).
وانه في ام الكتب لدينا لعلي حكيم
and indeed it is, in the mother of the book with us, exalted and full of wisdom.
wainnahufiummilkitabiladainalaaliyyunhakimunwainnahufeeommialkitabiladaynalaaaaliyyunhakeem
Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
Afa naḍribu ‘ankumuż-żikra ṣafḥan an kuntum qaumam musrifīn(a).
افنضرب عنكم الذكر صفحا ان كنتم قوما مسرفين
then should we turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
afanadribuankumuzzikrasafhanankuntumqaumammusrifinaafanadribuaaankumuaththikrasafhanankuntumqawmanmusrifeen
And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
Wa kam arsalnā min nabiyyin fil-awwalīn(a).
وكم ارسلنا من نبي في الاولين
and how many a prophet we sent among the former peoples,
wakamarsalnaminnabiyyinfilawwalinawakamarsalnaminnabiyyinfeealawwaleen
But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
Wa mā ya'tīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
وما ياتيهم من نبي الا كانوا به يستهزءون
but there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
wamayatihimminnabiyyinillakanubihiyastahziunawamayateehimminnabiyyinillakanoobihiyastahzioon
And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
Fa ahlaknā asyadda minhum baṭsyaw wa maḍā maṡalul-awwalīn(a).
فاهلكنا اشد منهم بطشا ومضي مثل الاولين
and we destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
faahlaknaasyaddaminhumbatsyawwamadamasalulawwalinafaahlaknaashaddaminhumbatshanwamadamathalualawwaleen
And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunnal-‘azīzul-‘alīm(u).
ولئن سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن خلقهن العزيز العليم
and if you should ask them, "who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "they were created by the exalted in might, the knowing,"
walainsaaltahummankhalaqassamawatiwalardalayaqulunnakhalaqahunnalazizulalimuwalainsaaltahummankhalaqaassamawatiwalardalayaqoolunnakhalaqahunnaalaaazeezualaaaleem
[The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
Allażī ja‘ala lakumul-arḍa mahdaw wa ja‘ala lakum fīhā subulal la‘allakum tahtadūn(a).
الذي جعل لكم الارض مهدا وجعل لكم فيها سبلا لعلكم تهتدون
[the one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
allazijaalalakumulardamahdawwajaalalakumfihasubulallaallakumtahtadunaallatheejaaaalalakumualardamahdanwajaaaalalakumfeehasubulanlaaaallakumtahtadoon
And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
Wal-lażī nazzala minas-samā'i mā'am biqadar(in), fa'ansyarnā bihī baldatam maitā(n), każālika tukhrajūn(a).
والذي نزل من السماء ماء بقدر فانشرنا به بلده ميتا  كذلك تخرجون
and who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and we revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
wallazinazzalaminassamaimaambiqadarinfaansyarnabihibaldatammaitankazalikatukhrajunawallatheenazzalaminaassamaimaanbiqadarinfaansharnabihibaldatanmaytankathalikatukhrajoon
And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
Wal-lażī khalaqal-azwāja kullahā wa ja‘ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an‘āmi mā tarkabūn(a).
والذي خلق الازوج كلها وجعل لكم من الفلك والانعم ما تركبون
and who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
wallazikhalaqalazwajakullahawajaalalakumminalfulkiwalanamimatarkabunawallatheekhalaqaalazwajakullahawajaaaalalakumminaalfulkiwalanaaamimatarkaboon

That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
Litastawū ‘alā ẓuhūrihī ṡumma tażkurū ni‘mata rabbikum iżastawaitum ‘alaihi wa taqūlū subḥānal-lażī sakhkhara lanā hāżā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn(a).
لتستوا علي ظهوره ثم تذكروا نعمه ربكم اذا استويتم عليه وتقولوا سبحن الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين

that you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your lord when you have settled upon them and say, "exalted is he who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

litastawualazuhurihisummatazkurunimatarabbikumizastawaitumalaihiwataqulusubhanallazisakhkharalanahazawamakunnalahumuqrininalitastawooaaalathuhoorihithummatathkurooniaamatarabbikumithaistawaytumaaalayhiwataqooloosubhanaallatheesakhkharalanahathawamakunnalahumuqrineen
And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn(a).
وانا الي ربنا لمنقلبون
and indeed we, to our lord, will [surely] return."
wainnailarabbinalamunqalibunawainnailarabbinalamunqaliboon
But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
Wa ja‘alū lahū min ‘ibādihī juz'ā(n), innal-insāna lakafūrum mubīn(un).
وجعلوا له من عباده جزءا  ان الانسن لكفور مبين
but they have attributed to him from his servants a portion. indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
wajaalulahuminibadihijuzaninnalinsanalakafurummubinunwajaaaaloolahuminaaibadihijuzaninnaalinsanalakafoorunmubeen
Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
Amittakhażū mimmā yakhluqu banātiw wa aṣfākum bil-banīn(a).
ام اتخذ مما يخلق بنات واصفيكم بالبنين
or has he taken, out of what he has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
amittakhazumimmayakhluqubanatiwwaasfakumbilbaninaamiittakhathamimmayakhluqubanatinwaasfakumbilbaneen
And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
Wa iżā busysyira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lir-raḥmāni maṡalan ẓalla wajhuhū muswaddaw wa huwa kaẓīm(un).
واذا بشر احدهم بما ضرب للرحمن مثلا ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم
and when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the most merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
waizabusysyiraahaduhumbimadarabalirrahmanimasalanzallawajhuhumuswaddawwahuwakazimunwaithabushshiraahaduhumbimadarabalirrahmanimathalanthallawajhuhumuswaddanwahuwakatheem
So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?
Awamay yunasysya'u fil-ḥilyati wa huwa fil-khiṣāmi gairu mubīn(in).
اومن ينشؤا في الحليه وهو في الخصام غير مبين
so is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to allah]?
awamayyunasysyaufilhilyatiwahuwafilkhisamigairumubininawamanyunashshaofeealhilyatiwahuwafeealkhisamighayrumubeen
And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
Wa ja‘alul-malā'ikatal-lażīna hum ‘ibādur raḥmāni ināṡā(n), asyahidū khalqahum, satuktabu syahādatuhum wa yus'alūn(a).
وجعلوا الملئكه الذين هم عبد الرحمن انثا  اشهدوا خلقهم  ستكتب شهدتهم ويسلون
and they described the angels, who are servants of the most merciful, as females. did they witness their creation? their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

wajaalulmalaikatallazinahumibadurrahmaniinasanasyahidukhalqahumsatuktabusyahadatuhumwayusalunawajaaaalooalmalaikataallatheenahumaaibaduarrahmaniinathanashahidookhalqahumsatuktabushahadatuhumwayusaloon
And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
Wa qālū lau syā'ar-raḥmānu mā ‘abadnāhum, mā lahum biżālika min ‘ilm(in), in hum illā yakhruṣūn(a).
وقالوا لو شاء الرحمن ما عبدنهم  ما لهم بذلك من علم  ان هم الا يخرصون
and they said, "if the most merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." they have of that no knowledge. they are not but misjudging.
waqalulausyaarrahmanumaabadnahummalahumbizalikaminilmininhumillayakhrusunawaqaloolawshaaarrahmanumaaaabadnahummalahumbithalikaminaailmininhumillayakhrusoon
Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
Am ātaināhum kitābam min qablihī fahum bihī mustamsikūn(a).
ام ءاتينهم كتبا من قبله فهم به مستمسكون
or have we given them a book before it [i.e., the qur’an] to which they are adhering?
amatainahumkitabamminqablihifahumbihimustamsikunaamataynahumkitabanminqablihifahumbihimustamsikoon
Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
Bal qālū innā wajadnā ābā'anā ‘alā ummatiw wa innā ‘alā āṡārihim muhtadūn(a).
بل قالوا انا وجدنا ءاباءنا علي امه وانا علي ءاثرهم مهتدون
rather, they say, "indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
balqaluinnawajadnaabaanaalaummatiwwainnaalaasarihimmuhtadunabalqalooinnawajadnaabaanaaaalaommatinwainnaaaalaatharihimmuhtadoon
And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
Wa każālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatim min nażīr(in), illā qāla mutrafūhā, innā wajadnā ābā'anā ‘alā ummatiw wa innā ‘alā āṡārihim muqtadūn(a).
وكذلك ما ارسلنا من قبلك في قريه من نذير الا قال مترفوها انا وجدنا ءاباءنا علي امه وانا علي ءاثرهم مقتدون
and similarly, we did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

wakazalikamaarsalnaminqablikafiqaryatimminnazirinillaqalamutrafuhainnawajadnaabaanaalaummatiwwainnaalaasarihimmuqtadunawakathalikamaarsalnaminqablikafeeqaryatinminnatheerinillaqalamutrafoohainnawajadnaabaanaaaalaommatinwainnaaaalaatharihimmuqtadoon
[Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
Qāla awalau ji'tukum bi'ahdā mimmā wajattum ‘alaihi ābā'akum, qālū innā bimā ursiltum bihī kāfirūn(a).
قل اولو جئتكم باهدي مما وجدتم عليه ءاباءكم  قالوا انا بما ارسلتم به كفرون
[each warner] said, "even if i brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" they said, "indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
qalaawalaujitukumbiahdamimmawajattumalaihiabaakumqaluinnabimaursiltumbihikafirunaqalaawalawjitukumbiahdamimmawajadtumaaalayhiabaakumqalooinnabimaorsiltumbihikafiroon
So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
Fantaqamnā minhum fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mukażżibīn(a).
فانتقمنا منهم  فانظر كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
so we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
fantaqamnaminhumfanzurkaifakanaaqibatulmukazzibinafantaqamnaminhumfanthurkayfakanaaaaqibatualmukaththibeen
And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
Wa iż qāla ibrāhīmu li'abīhi wa qaumihī innanī barā'um mimmā ta‘budūn(a).
واذ قال ابرهيم لابيه وقومه انني براء مما تعبدون
and [mention, o muhammad], when abraham said to his father and his people, "indeed, i am disassociated from that which you worship
waizqalaibrahimuliabihiwaqaumihiinnanibaraummimmatabudunawaithqalaibraheemuliabeehiwaqawmihiinnaneebaraonmimmataaabudoon
Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
Illāl-lażī faṭaranī fa'innahū sayahdīn(i).
الا الذي فطرني فانه سيهدين
except for he who created me; and indeed, he will guide me."
illallazifataranifainnahusayahdiniillaallatheefataraneefainnahusayahdeen
And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
Wa ja‘alahā kalimatam bāqiyatan fī ‘aqibihī la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
وجعلها كلمه باقيه في عقبه لعلهم يرجعون
and he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
wajaalahakalimatambaqiyatanfiaqibihilaallahumyarjiunawajaaaalahakalimatanbaqiyatanfeeaaaqibihilaaaallahumyarjiaaoon
However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
Bal matta‘tu hā'ulā'i wa ābā'ahum ḥattā jā'ahumul-ḥaqqu wa rasūlum mubīn(un).
بل متعت هؤلاء وءاباءهم حتي جاءهم الحق ورسول مبين
however, i gave enjoyment to these [people of makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear messenger.
balmattatuhaulaiwaabaahumhattajaahumulhaqquwarasulummubinunbalmattaaatuhaolaiwaabaahumhattajaahumualhaqquwarasoolunmubeen
But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
Wa lammā jā'ahumul-ḥaqqu qālū hāżā siḥruw wa innā bihī kāfirūn(a).
ولما جاءهم الحق قالوا هذا سحر وانا به كفرون
but when the truth came to them, they said, "this is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
walammajaahumulhaqquqaluhazasihruwwainnabihikafirunawalammajaahumualhaqquqaloohathasihrunwainnabihikafiroon
And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
Wa qālū lau lā nuzzila hāżal-qur'ānu ‘alā rajulim minal-qaryataini ‘aẓīm(in).
وقالوا لولا نزل هذا القرءان علي رجل من القريتين عظيم
and they said, "why was this qur’an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
waqalulaulanuzzilahazalquranualarajulimminalqaryatainiaziminwaqaloolawlanuzzilahathaalquranuaaalarajulinminaalqaryatayniaaatheem

Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

Ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbik(a), naḥnu qasamnā bainahum ma‘īsyatahum fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa rafa‘nā ba‘ḍahum fauqa ba‘ḍin darajātil liyattakhiża ba‘ḍuhum ba‘ḍan sukhriyyā(n), wa raḥmatu rabbika khairum mimmā yajma‘ūn(a).
اهم يقسمون رحمت ربك  نحن قسمنا بينهم معيشتهم في الحيوه الدنيا  ورفعنا بعضهم فوق بعض درجت ليتخذ بعضهم بعضا سخريا  ورحمت ربك خير مما يجمعون

do they distribute the mercy of your lord? it is we who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. but the mercy of your lord is better than whatever they accumulate.



And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
Wa lau lā ay yakūnan-nāsu ummataw wāḥidatal laja‘alnā limay yakfuru bir-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufam min fiḍḍatiw wa ma‘ārija ‘alaihā yaẓharūn(a).
ولولا ان يكون الناس امه وحده لجعلنا لمن يكفر بالرحمن لبيوتهم سقفا من فضه ومعارج عليها يظهرون

and if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], we would have made for those who disbelieve in the most merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.

walaulaayyakunannasuummatawwahidatallajaalnalimayyakfurubirrahmanilibuyutihimsuqufamminfiddatiwwamaarijaalaihayazharunawalawlaanyakoonaannasuommatanwahidatanlajaaaalnalimanyakfurubirrahmanilibuyootihimsuqufanminfiddatinwamaaaarijaaaalayhayathharoon
And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
Wa libuyūtihim abwābaw wa sururan ‘alaihā yattaki'ūn(a).
ولبيوتهم ابوبا وسررا عليها يتكون
and for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
walibuyutihimabwabawwasururanalaihayattakiunawalibuyootihimabwabanwasururanaaalayhayattakioon
And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
Wa zukhrufā(n), wa in kullu żālika lammā matā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wal-ākhiratu ‘inda rabbika lil-muttaqīn(a).
وزخرفا  وان كل ذلك لما متع الحيوه الدنيا  والاخره عند ربك للمتقين
and gold ornament. but all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. and the hereafter with your lord is for the righteous.
wazukhrufanwainkulluzalikalammamataulhayatiddunyawalakhiratuindarabbikalilmuttaqinawazukhrufanwainkulluthalikalammamataaaualhayatiaddunyawalakhiratuaaindarabbikalilmuttaqeen
And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
Wa may ya‘syu ‘an żikrir-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahū syaiṭānan fahuwa lahū qarīn(un).
ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض له شيطنا فهو له قرين
and whoever is blinded from remembrance of the most merciful - we appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
wamayyasyuanzikrirrahmaninuqayyidlahusyaitananfahuwalahuqarinunwamanyaaashuaaanthikriarrahmaninuqayyidlahushaytananfahuwalahuqareen
And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
Wa innahum layaṣuddūnahum ‘anis-sabīli wa yaḥsabūna annahum muhtadūn(a).
وانهم ليصدونهم عن السبيل ويحسبون انهم مهتدون
and indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
wainnahumlayasuddunahumanissabiliwayahsabunaannahummuhtadunawainnahumlayasuddoonahumaaaniassabeeliwayahsaboonaannahummuhtadoon
Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
Ḥattā iżā jā'anā qāla yā laita bainī wa bainaka bu‘dal-masyriqaini fa bi'sal-qarīn(u).
حتي اذا جاءنا قال يليت بيني وبينك بعد المشرقين فبئس القرين
until, when he comes to us [at judgement], he says [to his companion], "how i wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
hattaizajaanaqalayalaitabainiwabainakabudalmasyriqainifabisalqarinuhattaithajaanaqalayalaytabayneewabaynakabuaadaalmashriqaynifabisaalqareen
And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
Wa lay yanfa‘akumul-yauma iẓ ẓalamtum annakum fil-‘ażābi musytarikūn(a).
ولن ينفعكم اليوم اذ ظلمتم انكم في العذاب مشتركون
and never will it benefit you that day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
walayyanfaakumulyaumaizzalamtumannakumfilazabimusytarikunawalanyanfaaaakumualyawmaiththalamtumannakumfeealaaathabimushtarikoon
Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
Afa anta tusmi‘uṣ-ṣumma au tahdil-‘umya  wa man kāna fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
افانت تسمع الصم او تهدي العمي ومن كان في ضلل مبين
then will you make the deaf hear, [o muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
afaantatusmiussummaautahdilumyawamankanafidalalimmubininafaantatusmiaauassummaawtahdeealaaumyawamankanafeedalalinmubeen
And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
Fa immā nażhabanna bika fa innā minhum muntaqimūn(a).
فاما نذهبن بك فانا منهم منتقمون
and whether [or not] we take you away [in death], indeed, we will take retribution upon them.
faimmanazhabannabikafainnaminhummuntaqimunafaimmanathhabannabikafainnaminhummuntaqimoon
Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
Au nuriyannakal-lażī wa‘adnāhum fa'innā ‘alaihim muqtadirūn(a).
او نرينك الذي وعدنهم فانا عليهم مقتدرون
or whether [or not] we show you that which we have promised them, indeed, we are perfect in ability.
aunuriyannakallaziwaadnahumfainnaalaihimmuqtadirunaawnuriyannakaallatheewaaaadnahumfainnaaaalayhimmuqtadiroon
So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
Fastamsik bil-lażī ūḥiya ilaik(a), innaka ‘alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
فاستمسك بالذي اوحي اليك  انك علي صرط مستقيم
so adhere to that which is revealed to you. indeed, you are on a straight path.
fastamsikbillaziuhiyailaikainnakaalasiratimmustaqiminfastamsikbillatheeoohiyailaykainnakaaaalasiratinmustaqeem
And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
Wa innahū lażikrul laka wa liqaumik(a), wa saufa tus'alūn(a).
وانه لذكر لك ولقومك  وسوف تسلون
and indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
wainnahulazikrullakawaliqaumikawasaufatusalunawainnahulathikrunlakawaliqawmikawasawfatusaloon
And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
Was'al man arsalnā min qablika mir rusulinā, aja‘alnā min dūnir-raḥmāni ālihatay yu‘badūn(a).
وسل من ارسلنا من قبلك من رسلنا اجعلنا من دون الرحمن ءالهه يعبدون
and ask those we sent before you of our messengers; have we made besides the most merciful deities to be worshipped?
wasalmanarsalnaminqablikamirrusulinaajaalnamindunirrahmanialihatayyubadunawasalmanarsalnaminqablikaminrusulinaajaaaalnamindooniarrahmanialihatanyuaabadoon
And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
Wa laqad arsalnā mūsā bi'āyātinā ilā fir‘auna wa mala'ihī fa qāla innī rasūlu rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا الي فرعون وملايه فقال اني رسول رب العلمين
and certainly did we send moses with our signs to pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "indeed, i am the messenger of the lord of the worlds."

falammajaahumbiayatinaizahumminhayadhakunafalammajaahumbiayatinaithahumminhayadhakoon

وما نريهم من ءايه الا هي اكبر من اختها  واخذنهم بالعذاب لعلهم يرجعون

وقالوا يايه الساحر ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك اننا لمهتدون

But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

ونادي فرعون في قومه قال يقوم اليس لي ملك مصر وهذه الانهر تجري من تحتي  افلا تبصرون

wanadafiraunufiqaumihiqalayaqaumialaisalimulkumisrawahazihilanharutajrimintahtiafalatubsirunawanadafiraaawnufeeqawmihiqalayaqawmialaysaleemulkumisrawahathihialanharutajreemintahteeafalatubsiroon
Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

ام انا خير من هذا الذي هو مهين ولا يكاد يبين
or am i [not] better than this one [i.e., moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
amanakhairumminhazallazihuwamahinunwalayakaduyubinuamanakhayrunminhathaallatheehuwamaheenunwalayakaduyubeen

فلولا القي عليه اسوره من ذهب او جاء معه الملئكه مقترنين

واختلف اليل والنهار وما انزل الله من السماء من رزق فاحيا به الارض بعد موتها وتصريف الريح ءايت لقوم يعقلون

and [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what allah sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in his] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

wakhtilafillailiwannahariwamaanzalallahuminassamaimirrizqinfaahyabihilardabadamautihawatasrifirriyahiayatulliqaumiyyaqilunawakhtilafiallayliwannahariwamaanzalaallahuminaassamaiminrizqinfaahyabihialardabaaadamawtihawatasreefiarriyahiayatunliqawminyaaaqiloon
These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?
Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ‘alaika bil-ḥaqq(i), fa bi'ayyi ḥadīṡim ba‘dallāhi wa āyātihī yu'minūn(a).
تلك ءايت الله نتلوها عليك بالحق  فباي حديث بعد الله وءايته يؤمنون
these are the verses of allah which we recite to you in truth. then in what statement after allah and his verses will they believe?
tilkaayatullahinatluhaalaikabilhaqqifabiayyihadisimbadallahiwaayatihiyuminunatilkaayatuallahinatloohaaaalaykabilhaqqifabiayyihadeethinbaaadaallahiwaayatihiyuminoon
Woe to every sinful liar
Wailul likulli affākin aṡīm(in).
ويل لكل افاك اثيم
woe to every sinful liar
wailullikulliaffakinasiminwaylunlikulliaffakinatheem
Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
Yasma‘u āyātillāhi tutlā ‘alaihi ṡumma yuṣirru mustakbiran ka'allam yasma‘hā, fa basysyirhu bi‘ażābin alīm(in).
يسمع ءايت الله تتلي عليه ثم يصر مستكبرا كان لم يسمعها  فبشره بعذاب اليم
who hears the verses of allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. so give him tidings of a painful punishment.
yasmauayatillahitutlaalaihisummayusirrumustakbirankaallamyasmahafabasysyirhubiazabinaliminyasmaaauayatiallahitutlaaaalayhithummayusirrumustakbirankaanlamyasmaaahafabashshirhubiaaathabinaleem
And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
Wa iżā ‘alima min āyātinā syai'anittakhażahā huzuwā(n), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābum muhīn(un).
واذا علم من ءايتنا شيا اتخذها هزوا  اولئك لهم عذاب مهين
and when he knows anything of our verses, he takes them in ridicule. those will have a humiliating punishment.
waizaalimaminayatinasyaianittakhazahahuzuwanulaikalahumazabummuhinunwaithaaaalimaminayatinashayanittakhathahahuzuwanolaikalahumaaathabunmuheen
Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
Miw warā'ihim jahannam(u), wa lā yugnī ‘anhum mā kasabū syai'aw wa lā mattakhażū min dūnillāhi auliyā'(a), wa lahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
من ورائهم جهنم  ولا يغني عنهم ما كسبوا شيا ولا ما اتخذوا من دون الله اولياء  ولهم عذاب عظيم
before them is hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides allah as allies. and they will have a great punishment.

miwwaraihimjahannamuwalayugnianhummakasabusyaiawwalamattakhazumindunillahiauliyaawalahumazabunazimunminwaraihimjahannamuwalayughneeaaanhummakasabooshayanwalamaittakhathoomindooniallahiawliyaawalahumaaathabunaaatheem
This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
Hāżā hudā(n), wal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyāti rabbihim lahum ‘ażābum mir rijzin alīm(un).
هذا هدي  والذين كفروا بايت ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز اليم
this [qur’an] is guidance. and those who have disbelieved in the verses of their lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
hazahudanwallazinakafarubiayatirabbihimlahumazabummirrijzinalimunhathahudanwallatheenakafaroobiayatirabbihimlahumaaathabunminrijzinaleem
It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
Allāhul-lażī sakhkhara  lakumul-baḥra litajriyal-fulku fīhi bi'amrihī wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
الله الذي سخر لكم البحر لتجري الفلك فيه بامره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
it is allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by his command and that you may seek of his bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

allahullazisakhkharalakumulbahralitajriyalfulkufihibiamrihiwalitabtaguminfadlihiwalaallakumtasykurunaallahuallatheesakhkharalakumualbahralitajriyaalfulkufeehibiamrihiwalitabtaghoominfadlihiwalaaaallakumtashkuroon
And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
Wa sakhkhara lakum mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍi jamī‘am minh(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
وسخر لكم ما في السموت وما في الارض جميعا منه  ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
and he has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from him. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
wasakhkharalakummafissamawatiwamafilardijamiamminhuinnafizalikalaayatilliqaumiyyatafakkarunawasakhkharalakummafeeassamawatiwamafeealardijameeaaanminhuinnafeethalikalaayatinliqawminyatafakkaroon

Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
Qul lil-lażīna āmanū yagfirū lil-lażīna lā yarjūna ayyāmallāhi liyajziya qaumam bimā kānū yaksibūn(a).
قل للذين ءامنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون ايام الله ليجزي قوما بما كانوا يكسبون

say, [o muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of allah [i.e., of his retribution] so that he may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
qullillazinaamanuyagfirulillazinalayarjunaayyamallahiliyajziyaqaumambimakanuyaksibunaqullillatheenaamanooyaghfiroolillatheenalayarjoonaayyamaallahiliyajziyaqawmanbimakanooyaksiboon
Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
Man ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa linafsih(ī), wa man asā'a fa ‘alaihā, ṡumma ilā rabbikum turja‘ūn(a).
من عمل صلحا فلنفسه  ومن اساء فعليها  ثم الي ربكم ترجعون
whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. then to your lord you will be returned.
manamilasalihanfalinafsihiwamanasaafaalaihasummailarabbikumturjaunamanaaamilasalihanfalinafsihiwamanasaafaaaalayhathummailarabbikumturjaaaoon
And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
Wa laqad ātainā banī isrā'īlal-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwata wa razaqnāhum minaṭ-ṭayyibāti wa faḍḍalnāhum ‘alal-‘ālamīn(a).
ولقد ءاتينا بني اسرءيل الكتب والحكم والنبوه ورزقنهم من الطيبت وفضلنهم علي العلمين
and we did certainly give the children of israel the scripture and judgement and prophethood, and we provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

walaqadatainabaniisrailalkitabawalhukmawannubuwwatawarazaqnahumminattayyibatiwafaddalnahumalalalaminawalaqadataynabaneeisraeelaalkitabawalhukmawannubuwwatawarazaqnahumminaattayyibatiwafaddalnahumaaalaalaaalameen

And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
Wa ātaināhum bayyinātim minal-amr(i), fa makhtalafū illā mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-‘ilmu bagyam bainahum, inna rabbaka yaqḍī bainahum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
وءاتينهم بينت من الامر  فما اختلفوا الا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم  ان ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون

and we gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. and they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.


Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
Ṡumma ja‘alnāka ‘alā syarī‘atim minal-amri fattabi‘hā wa lā tattabi‘ ahwā'al-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ثم جعلنك علي شريعه من الامر فاتبعها ولا تتبع اهواء الذين لا يعلمون
then we put you, [o muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
summajaalnakaalasyariatimminalamrifattabihawalatattabiahwaallazinalayalamunathummajaaaalnakaaaalashareeaaatinminaalamrifattabiaahawalatattabiaaahwaaallatheenalayaaalamoon
Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.
Innahum lay yugnū ‘anka minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa innaẓ-ẓālimīna ba‘ḍuhum auliyā'u ba‘ḍ(in), wallāhu waliyyul-muttaqīn(a).
انهم لن يغنوا عنك من الله شيا  وان الظلمين بعضهم اولياء بعض  والله ولي المتقين
indeed, they will never avail you against allah at all. and indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but allah is the protector of the righteous.
innahumlayyugnuankaminallahisyaianwainnazzaliminabaduhumauliyaubadinwallahuwaliyyulmuttaqinainnahumlanyughnooaaankaminaallahishayanwainnaaththalimeenabaaaduhumawliyaobaaadinwallahuwaliyyualmuttaqeen
This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
Hāżā baṣā'iru lin-nāsi wa hudaw wa raḥmatul liqaumiy yūqinūn(a).
هذا بصئر للناس وهدي ورحمه لقوم يوقنون
this [qur’an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
hazabasairulinnasiwahudawwarahmatulliqaumiyyuqinunahathabasairulinnasiwahudanwarahmatunliqawminyooqinoon

Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
Am ḥasibal-lażīnajtaraḥus -sayyi'āti an naj‘alahum kal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sawā'am maḥyāhum wa mamātuhum, sā'a mā yaḥkumūn(a).
ام حسب الذين اجترحوا السيات ان نجعلهم كالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سواء محياهم ومماتهم  ساء ما يحكمون

or do those who commit evils think we will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].

amhasiballazinajtarahussayyiatiannajalahumkallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatisawaammahyahumwamamatuhumsaamayahkumunaamhasibaallatheenaijtarahooassayyiatiannajaaalahumkallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatisawaanmahyahumwamamatuhumsaamayahkumoon
And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
Wa khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqqi wa litujzā kullu nafsim bimā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
وخلق الله السموت والارض بالحق ولتجزي كل نفس بما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
and allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
wakhalaqallahussamawatiwalardabilhaqqiwalitujzakullunafsimbimakasabatwahumlayuzlamunawakhalaqaallahuassamawatiwalardabilhaqqiwalitujzakullunafsinbimakasabatwahumlayuthlamoon

Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
Afa ra'aita manittakhaża ilāhahū hawāhu wa aḍallahullāhu ‘alā ‘ilmiw wa khatama ‘alā sam‘ihī wa qalbihī wa ja‘ala ‘alā baṣarihī gisyāwah(tan), famay yahdīhi mim ba‘dillāh(i), afalā tażakkarūn(a).
افرءيت من اتخذ الهه هويه واضله الله علي علم وختم علي سمعه وقلبه وجعل علي بصره غشوه فمن يهديه من بعد الله  افلا تذكرون

have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? so who will guide him after allah? then will you not be reminded?


And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
Wa qālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunad-dun-yā namūtu wa naḥyā wa mā yuhlikunā illad-dahr(u), wa mā lahum biżālika min ‘ilmin in hum illā yaẓunnūn(a).
وقالوا ما هي الا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما يهلكنا الا الدهر  وما لهم بذلك من علم  ان هم الا يظنون
and they say, "there is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." and they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

waqalumahiyaillahayatunaddunyanamutuwanahyawamayuhlikunailladdahruwamalahumbizalikaminilmininhumillayazunnunawaqaloomahiyaillahayatunaaddunyanamootuwanahyawamayuhlikunaillaaddahruwamalahumbithalikaminaailmininhumillayathunnoon
And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātim mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālu'tū bi'ābā'inā in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت ما كان حجتهم الا ان قالوا ائتوا بابائنا ان كنتم صدقين
and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
waizatutlaalaihimayatunabayyinatimmakanahujjatahumillaanqalutubiabainainkuntumsadiqinawaithatutlaaaalayhimayatunabayyinatinmakanahujjatahumillaanqalooitoobiabainainkuntumsadiqeen
Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
Qulillāhu yuḥyīkum ṡumma yumītukum ṡumma yajma‘ukum ilā yaumil-qiyāmati lā raiba fīhi wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
قل الله يحييكم ثم يميتكم ثم يجمعكم الي يوم القيمه لا ريب فيه ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
say, "allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then he will assemble you for the day of resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

qulillahuyuhyikumsummayumitukumsummayajmaukumilayaumilqiyamatilaraibafihiwalakinnaaksarannasilayalamunaquliallahuyuhyeekumthummayumeetukumthummayajmaaaukumilayawmialqiyamatilaraybafeehiwalakinnaaktharaannasilayaaalamoon
And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
Wa lillāhi mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yauma'iżiy yakhsarul-mubṭilūn(a).
ولله ملك السموت والارض  ويوم تقوم الساعه يومئذ يخسر المبطلون
and to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. and the day the hour appears - that day the falsifiers will lose.
walillahimulkussamawatiwalardiwayaumataqumussaatuyaumaiziyyakhsarulmubtilunawalillahimulkuassamawatiwalardiwayawmataqoomuassaaaatuyawmaithinyakhsarualmubtiloon
And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
Wa tarā kulla ummatin jāṡiyah(tan), kullu ummatin tud‘ā ilā kitābihā, al-yauma tujzauna mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
وتري كل امه جاثيه  كل امه تدعي الي كتبها اليوم تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
and you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. every nation will be called to its record [and told], "today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
watarakullaummatinjasiyahtankulluummatintudailakitabihaalyaumatujzaunamakuntumtamalunawatarakullaommatinjathiyatankulluommatintudaaailakitabihaalyawmatujzawnamakuntumtaaamaloon
This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
Hāżā kitābunā yanṭiqu ‘alaikum bil-ḥaqq(i), innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
هذا كتبنا ينطق عليكم بالحق  انا كنا نستنسخ ما كنتم تعملون
this, our record, speaks about you in truth. indeed, we were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
hazakitabunayantiqualaikumbilhaqqiinnakunnanastansikhumakuntumtamalunahathakitabunayantiquaaalaykumbilhaqqiinnakunnanastansikhumakuntumtaaamaloon
So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
Fa'ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatih(ī), żālika huwal-fauzul-mubīn(u).
فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فيدخلهم ربهم في رحمته  ذلك هو الفوز المبين
so as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their lord will admit them into his mercy. that is what is the clear attainment.
faammallazinaamanuwaamilussalihatifayudkhiluhumrabbuhumfirahmatihizalikahuwalfauzulmubinufaammaallatheenaamanoowaaaamilooassalihatifayudkhiluhumrabbuhumfeerahmatihithalikahuwaalfawzualmubeen
But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
Wa ammal-lażīna kafarū, falam takun āyātī tutlā ‘alaikum fastakbartum wa kuntum qaumam mujrimīn(a).
واما الذين كفروا افلم تكن ءايتي تتلي عليكم فاستكبرتم وكنتم قوما مجرمين
but as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "were not our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
waammallazinakafarufalamtakunayatitutlaalaikumfastakbartumwakuntumqaumammujriminawaammaallatheenakafarooafalamtakunayateetutlaaaalaykumfastakbartumwakuntumqawmanmujrimeen

And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
Wa iżā qīla inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqquw was-sā‘atu lā raiba fīhā qultum mā nadrī mas-sā‘ah(tu), in naẓunnu illā ẓannaw wa mā naḥnu bimustaiqinīn(a).
واذا قيل ان وعد الله حق والساعه لا ريب فيها قلتم ما ندري ما الساعه ان نظن الا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين

and when it was said, 'indeed, the promise of allah is truth and the hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'we know not what is the hour. we assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"

waizaqilainnawadallahihaqquwwassaatularaibafihaqultummanadrimassaahtuinnazunnuillazannawwamanahnubimustaiqininawaithaqeelainnawaaadaallahihaqqunwassaaaatularaybafeehaqultummanadreemaassaaaatuinnathunnuillathannanwamanahnubimustayqineen
And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
Wa badā lahum sayyi'ātu mā ‘amilū wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
وبدا لهم سيات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
and the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
wabadalahumsayyiatumaamiluwahaqabihimmakanubihiyastahziunawabadalahumsayyiatumaaaamiloowahaqabihimmakanoobihiyastahzioon
And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
Wa qīlal-yauma nansākum kamā nasītum liqā'a yaumikum hāżā, wa ma'wākumun nāru wa mā lakum min nāṣirīn(a).
وقيل اليوم ننسيكم كما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا وماويكم النار وما لكم من نصرين
and it will be said, "today we will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this day of yours, and your refuge is the fire, and for you there are no helpers.
waqilalyaumanansakumkamanasitumliqaayaumikumhazawamawakumunnaruwamalakumminnasirinawaqeelaalyawmanansakumkamanaseetumliqaayawmikumhathawamawakumuannaruwamalakumminnasireen
That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
Żālikum bi'annakumuttakhażtum āyātillāhi huzuwaw wa garratkumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, fal-yauma lā yukhrajūna minhā wa lā hum yusta‘tabūn(a).
ذلكم بانكم اتخذتم ءايت الله هزوا وغرتكم الحيوه الدنيا  فاليوم لا يخرجون منها ولا هم يستعتبون
that is because you took the verses of allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." so that day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [allah].

zalikumbiannakumuttakhaztumayatillahihuzuwawwagarratkumulhayatuddunyafalyaumalayukhrajunaminhawalahumyustatabunathalikumbiannakumuittakhathtumayatiallahihuzuwanwagharratkumualhayatuaddunyafalyawmalayukhrajoonaminhawalahumyustaaataboon
Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
Fa lillāhil-ḥamdu rabbis-samāwāti wa rabbil-arḍi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
فلله الحمد رب السموت ورب الارض رب العلمين
then, to allah belongs [all] praise - lord of the heavens and lord of the earth, lord of the worlds.
falillahilhamdurabbissamawatiwarabbilardirabbilalaminafalillahialhamdurabbiassamawatiwarabbialardirabbialaaalameen
And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Wa lahul-kibriyā'u fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
وله الكبرياء في السموت والارض  وهو العزيز الحكيم
and to him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and he is the exalted in might, the wise.
walahulkibriyaufissamawatiwalardiwahuwalazizulhakimuwalahualkibriyaofeeassamawatiwalardiwahuwaalaaazeezualhakeem
Ḥā, Meem.
Ḥā mīm.
حم
ha, meem.
hamimhameem
The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Tanzīlul-kitābi minallāhil ‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).
تنزيل الكتب من الله العزيز الحكيم
the revelation of the book is from allah, the exalted in might, the wise.
tanzilulkitabiminallahilazizilhakimitanzeelualkitabiminaallahialaaazeezialhakeem
We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
Mā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā illā bil-ḥaqqi wa ajalim musammā(n), wal-lażīna kafarū ‘ammā unżirū mu‘riḍūn(a).
ما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق واجل مسمي  والذين كفروا عما انذروا معرضون
we did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. but those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

makhalaqnassamawatiwalardawamabainahumaillabilhaqqiwaajalimmusammanwallazinakafaruammaunzirumuridunamakhalaqnaassamawatiwalardawamabaynahumaillabilhaqqiwaajalinmusammanwallatheenakafarooaaammaonthiroomuaaridoon

Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
Qul ara'aitum mā tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi arūnī māżā khalaqū minal-arḍi am lahum syirkun fis-samāwāt(i), i'tūnī bikitābim min qabli hāżā au aṡāratim min ‘ilmin in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
قل ارءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله اروني ماذا خلقوا من الارض ام لهم شرك في السموت  ائتوني بكتب من قبل هذا او اثره من علم ان كنتم صدقين

say, [o muhammad], "have you considered that which you invoke besides allah? show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."


And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
Wa man aḍallu mimmay yad‘ū min dūnillāhi mal lā yastajību lahū ilā yaumil-qiyāmati wa hum ‘an du‘ā'ihim gāfilūn(a).
ومن اضل ممن يدعوا من دون الله من لا يستجيب له الي يوم القيمه وهم عن دعائهم غفلون
and who is more astray than he who invokes besides allah those who will not respond to him until the day of resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
wamanadallumimmayyadumindunillahimallayastajibulahuilayaumilqiyamatiwahumanduaihimgafilunawamanadallumimmanyadaaoomindooniallahimanlayastajeebulahuilayawmialqiyamatiwahumaaanduaaaihimghafiloon
And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
Wa iżā ḥusyiran-nāsu kānū lahum a‘dā'aw wa kānū bi‘ibādatihim kāfirīn(a).
واذا حشر الناس كانوا لهم اعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كفرين
and when the people are gathered [that day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
waizahusyirannasukanulahumadaawwakanubiibadatihimkafirinawaithahushiraannasukanoolahumaaadaanwakanoobiaaibadatihimkafireen
And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātin qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-ḥaqqi lammā jā'ahum, hāżā siḥrum mubīn(un).
واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم هذا سحر مبين
and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "this is obvious magic."
waizatutlaalaihimayatunabayyinatinqalallazinakafarulilhaqqilammajaahumhazasihrummubinunwaithatutlaaaalayhimayatunabayyinatinqalaallatheenakafaroolilhaqqilammajaahumhathasihrunmubeen

Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
Am yaqūlūnaftarāh(u), qul iniftaraituh(ū), falā tamlikūna lī minallāhi syai'ā(n), huwa a‘lamu bimā tufīḍūna fīh(i), kafā bihī syahīdam bainī wa bainakum, wa huwal-gafūrur-raḥīm(u).
ام يقولون افتريه  قل ان افتريته فلا تملكون لي من الله شيا  هو اعلم بما تفيضون فيه  كفي به شهيدا بيني وبينكم  وهو الغفور الرحيم

or do they say, "he has invented it"? say, "if i have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from allah at all. he is most knowing of that in which you are involved. sufficient is he as witness between me and you, and he is the forgiving, the merciful."

amyaqulunaftarahuquliniftaraituhufalatamlikunaliminallahisyaianhuwaalamubimatufidunafihikafabihisyahidambainiwabainakumwahuwalgafururrahimuamyaqooloonaiftarahuquliniiftaraytuhufalatamlikoonaleeminaallahishayanhuwaaaalamubimatufeedoonafeehikafabihishaheedanbayneewabaynakumwahuwaalghafooruarraheem
Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
Qul mā kuntu bid‘am minar-rusuli wa mā adrī mā yuf‘alu bī wa lā bikum, in attabi‘u illā mā yūḥā ilayya wa mā ana illā nażīrum mubīn(un).
قل ما كنت بدعا من الرسل وما ادري ما يفعل بي ولا بكم  ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي وما انا الا نذير مبين
say, "i am not something original among the messengers, nor do i know what will be done with me or with you. i only follow that which is revealed to me, and i am not but a clear warner."

qulmakuntubidamminarrusuliwamaadrimayufalubiwalabikuminattabiuillamayuhailayyawamaanaillanazirummubinunqulmakuntubidaaanminaarrusuliwamaadreemayufaaalubeewalabikuminattabiaauillamayoohailayyawamaanaillanatheerunmubeen

Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
Qul ara'aitum in kāna min ‘indillāhi wa kafartum bihī wa syahida syāhidum mim banī isrā'īla ‘alā miṡlihī fa āmana wastakbartum, innallāha lā yahdil-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
قل ارءيتم ان كان من عند الله وكفرتم به وشهد شاهد من بني اسرءيل علي مثله فامن واستكبرتم  ان الله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين

say, "have you considered: if it [i.e., the qur’an] was from allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the children of israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" indeed, allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

qularaaituminkanaminindillahiwakafartumbihiwasyahidasyahidummimbaniisrailaalamislihifaamanawastakbartuminnallahalayahdilqaumazzaliminaqularaaytuminkanaminaaindiallahiwakafartumbihiwashahidashahidunminbaneeisraeelaaaalamithlihifaamanawastakbartuminnaallahalayahdeealqawmaaththalimeen

And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-lażīna āmanū lau kāna khairam mā sabaqūnā ilaih(i), wa iż lam yahtadū bihī fasayaqūlūna hāżā ifkun qadīm(un).
وقال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا لو كان خيرا ما سبقونا اليه  واذ لم يهتدوا به فسيقولون هذا افك قديم

and those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "if it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." and when they are not guided by it, they will say, "this is an ancient falsehood."

waqalallazinakafarulillazinaamanulaukanakhairammasabaqunailaihiwaizlamyahtadubihifasayaqulunahazaifkunqadimunwaqalaallatheenakafaroolillatheenaamanoolawkanakhayranmasabaqoonailayhiwaithlamyahtadoobihifasayaqooloonahathaifkunqadeem
And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
Wa min qablihī kitābu mūsā imāmaw wa raḥmah(tan), wa hāżā kitābum muṣaddiqul lisānan ‘arabiyyal liyunżiral-lażīna ẓalamū, wa busyrā lil-muḥsinīn(a).
ومن قبله كتب موسي اماما ورحمه  وهذا كتب مصدق لسانا عربيا لينذر الذين ظلموا وبشري للمحسنين
and before it was the scripture of moses to lead and as a mercy. and this is a confirming book in an arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

waminqablihikitabumusaimamawwarahmahtanwahazakitabummusaddiqullisananarabiyyalliyunzirallazinazalamuwabusyralilmuhsininawaminqablihikitabumoosaimamanwarahmatanwahathakitabunmusaddiqunlisananaaarabiyyanliyunthiraallatheenathalamoowabushralilmuhsineen
Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
Innal-lażīna qālū rabbunallāhu ṡummastaqāmū falā khaufun ‘alaihim wa lā hum yaḥzanūn(a).
ان الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقموا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
indeed, those who have said, "our lord is allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
innallazinaqalurabbunallahusummastaqamufalakhaufunalaihimwalahumyahzanunainnaallatheenaqaloorabbunaallahuthummaistaqamoofalakhawfunaaalayhimwalahumyahzanoon
Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
Ulā'ika aṣḥābul-jannati khālidīna fīhā, jazā'am bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
اولئك اصحب الجنه خلدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
those are the companions of paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
ulaikaashabuljannatikhalidinafihajazaambimakanuyamalunaolaikaashabualjannatikhalideenafeehajazaanbimakanooyaaamaloon

And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

Wa waṣṣainal-insāna biwālidaihi iḥsānā(n), ḥamalathu ummuhū kurhaw wa waḍa‘athu kurhā(n), wa ḥamluhū wa fiṣāluhū ṡalāṡūna syahrā(n), ḥattā iżā balaga asyuddahū wa balaga arba‘īna sanah(tan), qāla rabbi auzi‘nī an asykura ni‘matakal-latī an‘amta ‘alayya wa ‘alā wālidayya wa an a‘mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī żurriyyatī, innī tubtu ilaika wa innī minal-muslimīn(a).

ووصينا الانسن بولديه احسنا  حملته امه كرها ووضعته كرها  وحمله وفصله ثلثون شهرا  حتي اذا بلغ اشده وبلغ اربعين سنه قال رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي ولدي وان اعمل صلحا ترضيه واصلح لي في ذريتي  اني تبت اليك واني من المسلمين

and we have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [he grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "my lord, enable me to be grateful for your favor which you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which you will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. indeed, i have repented to you, and indeed, i am of the muslims."



Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
Ulā'ikal-lażīna nataqabbalu ‘anhum aḥsana mā ‘amilū wa natajāwazu ‘an sayyi'atihim fī aṣḥābil-jannah(ti), wa‘daṣ-ṣidqil-lażī kānū yū‘adūn(a).
اولئك الذين نتقبل عنهم احسن ما عملوا ونتجاوز عن سياتهم في اصحب الجنه  وعد الصدق الذي كانوا يوعدون

those are the ones from whom we will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of paradise. [that is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.

ulaikallazinanataqabbaluanhumahsanamaamiluwanatajawazuansayyiatihimfiashabiljannahtiwadassidqillazikanuyuadunaolaikaallatheenanataqabbaluaaanhumahsanamaaaamiloowanatajawazuaaansayyiatihimfeeashabialjannatiwaaadaassidqiallatheekanooyooaaadoon

But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -

Wal-lażī qāla liwālidaihi uffil lakumā ata‘idāninī an ukhraja wa qad khalatil qurūnu min qablī, wa humā yastagīṡānillāha wailaka āmin, inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqq(un), fayaqūlu mā hāżā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn(a).
والذي قال لولديه اف لكما اتعدانني ان اخرج وقد خلت القرون من قبلي وهما يستغيثان الله ويلك ءامن ان وعد الله حق فيقول ما هذا الا اسطير الاولين

but one who says to his parents, "uff to you; do you promise me that i will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to allah for help [and to their son], "woe to you! believe! indeed, the promise of allah is truth." but he says, "this is not but legends of the former peoples" -


Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
Ulā'ikal-lażīna ḥaqqa ‘alaihimul-qaulu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins(i), innahum kānū khāsirīn(a).
اولئك الذين حق عليهم القول في امم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والانس  انهم كانوا خسرين
those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. indeed, they [all] were losers.

ulaikallazinahaqqaalaihimulqaulufiumaminqadkhalatminqablihimminaljinniwalinsiinnahumkanukhasirinaolaikaallatheenahaqqaaaalayhimualqawlufeeumaminqadkhalatminqablihimminaaljinniwalinsiinnahumkanookhasireen
And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
Wa likullin darajātum mimmā ‘amilū, wa liyuwaffiyahum a‘mālahum wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ولكل درجت مما عملوا  وليوفيهم اعملهم وهم لا يظلمون
and for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that he may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
walikullindarajatummimmaamiluwaliyuwaffiyahumamalahumwahumlayuzlamunawalikullindarajatunmimmaaaamiloowaliyuwaffiyahumaaamalahumwahumlayuthlamoon

And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

Wa yauma yu‘raḍul-lażīna kafarū ‘alan-nār(i), ażhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumud-dun-yā wastamta‘tum bihā, fal-yauma tujzauna ‘ażābal-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fil-arḍi bigairil-ḥaqqi wa bimā kuntum tafsuqūn(a).
ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا علي النار اذهبتم طيبتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها فاليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تستكبرون في الارض بغير الحق وبما كنتم تفسقون

and the day those who disbelieved are exposed to the fire [it will be said], "you exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."



And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
Ważkur akhā ‘ād(in), iż anżara qaumahū bil-aḥqāfi wa qad khalatin-nużuru mim baini yadaihi wa min khalfihī allā ta‘budū illallāh(a), innī akhāfu ‘alaikum ‘ażāba yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
واذكر اخا عاد اذ انذر قومه بالاحقاف وقد خلت النذر من بين يديه ومن خلفه الا تعبدوا الا الله اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم

and mention, [o muhammad], the brother of ʿaad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "do not worship except allah. indeed, i fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

wazkurakhaadinizanzaraqaumahubilahqafiwaqadkhalatinnuzurumimbainiyadaihiwaminkhalfihiallatabuduillallahainniakhafualaikumazabayauminaziminwathkurakhaaaadinithantharaqawmahubilahqafiwaqadkhalatiannuthuruminbayniyadayhiwaminkhalfihiallataaabudooillaallahainneeakhafuaaalaykumaaathabayawminaaatheem
They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
Qālū aji'tanā lita'fikanā ‘an ālihatinā fa'tinā bimā ta‘idunā in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
قالوا اجئتنا لتافكنا عن ءالهتنا فاتنا بما تعدنا ان كنت من الصدقين
they said, "have you come to delude us away from our gods? then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
qaluajitanalitafikanaanalihatinafatinabimataidunainkuntaminassadiqinaqalooajitanalitafikanaaaanalihatinafatinabimataaaidunainkuntaminaassadiqeen
He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
Qāla innamal ‘ilmu ‘indallāh(i), wa uballigukum mā ursiltu bihī wa lākinnī arākum qauman tajhalūn(a).
قال انما العلم عند الله وابلغكم ما ارسلت به ولكني اريكم قوما تجهلون
he said, "knowledge [of its time] is only with allah, and i convey to you that with which i was sent; but i see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
qalainnamalilmuindallahiwauballigukummaursiltubihiwalakinniarakumqaumantajhalunaqalainnamaalaailmuaaindaallahiwaoballighukummaorsiltubihiwalakinneearakumqawmantajhaloon
And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
Falammā ra'auhu ‘āriḍam mustaqbila audiyatihim, qālū hāżā ‘āriḍum mumṭirunā, bal huwa masta‘jaltum bih(ī), rīḥun fīhā ‘ażābun alīm(un).
فلما راوه عارضا مستقبل اوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا  بل هو ما استعجلتم به  ريح فيها عذاب اليم
and when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "this is a cloud bringing us rain!" rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,

falammaraauhuaridammustaqbilaaudiyatihimqaluhazaaridummumtirunabalhuwamastajaltumbihirihunfihaazabunalimunfalammaraawhuaaaridanmustaqbilaawdiyatihimqaloohathaaaaridunmumtirunabalhuwamaistaaajaltumbihireehunfeehaaaathabunaleem
Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
