waannaminnassalihunawaminnadunazalikakunnataraiqaqidadanwaannaminnaassalihoonawaminnadoonathalikakunnataraiqaqidada
And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
Wa annā ẓanannā allan nu‘jizallāha fil-arḍi wa lan nu‘jizahū harabā(n).
وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
and we have become certain that we will never cause failure to allah upon earth, nor can we escape him by flight.
waannazanannaallannujizallahafilardiwalannujizahuharabanwannathanannaanlannuaajizaallahafeealardiwalannuaajizahuharaba
And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
Wa annā lammā sami‘nal-hudā āmannā bih(ī), famay yu'mim birabbihī falā yakhāfu bakhsaw wa lā rahaqā(n).
وانا لما سمعنا الهدي ءامنا به  فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
and when we heard the guidance [i.e., the qur’an], we believed in it. and whoever believes in his lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
waannalammasaminalhudaamannabihifamayyumimbirabbihifalayakhafubakhsawwalarahaqanwaannalammasamiaanaalhudaamannabihifamanyuminbirabbihifalayakhafubakhsanwalarahaqa
And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
Wa annā minnal-muslimūna wa minnal-qāsiṭūn(a), faman aslama fa ulā'ika taḥarrau rasyadā(n).
وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القسطون  فمن اسلم فاولئك تحروا رشدا
and among us are muslims [in submission to allah], and among us are the unjust. and whoever has become muslim - those have sought out the right course.
waannaminnalmuslimunawaminnalqasitunafamanaslamafaulaikataharraurasyadanwaannaminnaalmuslimoonawaminnaalqasitoonafamanaslamafaolaikataharrawrashada
But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
Wa ammal-qāsiṭūna fa kānū lijahannama ḥaṭabā(n).
واما القسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
but as for the unjust, they will be, for hell, firewood.'
waammalqasitunafakanulijahannamahatabanwaamaalqasitoonafakanoolijahannamahataba
And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
Wa allawistaqāmū ‘alaṭ-ṭarīqati la'asqaināhum mā'an gadaqā(n).
والو استقموا علي الطريقه لاسقينهم ماء غدقا
and [allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, we would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
waallawistaqamualattariqatilaasqainahummaangadaqanwaallawiistaqamooaaalaattareeqatilaasqaynahummaanghadaqa
So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
Linaftinahum fīh(i), wa may yu‘riḍ ‘an żikri rabbihī yasluk-hu ‘ażāban ṣa‘adā(n).
لنفتنهم فيه  ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
so we might test them therein. and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his lord he will put into arduous punishment.
linaftinahumfihiwamayyuridanzikrirabbihiyaslukhuazabansaadanlinaftinahumfeehiwamanyuaaridaaanthikrirabbihiyaslukhuaaathabansaaaada
And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
Wa annal-masājida lillāhi falā tad‘ū ma‘allāhi aḥadā(n).
وان المسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
and [he revealed] that the masjids are for allah, so do not invoke with allah anyone.
waannalmasajidalillahifalatadumaallahiahadanwaannaalmasajidalillahifalatadaaoomaaaaallahiahada
And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
Wa annahū lammā qāma ‘abdullāhi yad‘ūhu kādū yakūnūna ‘alaihi libadā(n).
وانه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
and that when the servant [i.e., prophet] of allah stood up supplicating him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
waannahulammaqamaabdullahiyaduhukaduyakununaalaihilibadanwaannahulammaqamaaaabduallahiyadaaoohukadooyakoonoonaaaalayhilibada
Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
Qul innamā ad‘ū rabbī wa lā usyriku bihī aḥadā(n).
قل انما ادعوا ربي ولا اشرك به احدا
say, [o muhammad], "i only invoke my lord and do not associate with him anyone."
qulinnamaadurabbiwalausyrikubihiahadanqulinnamaadaaoorabbeewalaoshrikubihiahada
Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
Qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarraw wa lā rasyadā(n).
قل اني لا املك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
say, "indeed, i do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
qulinnilaamlikulakumdarrawwalarasyadanqulinneelaamlikulakumdarranwalarashada
Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
Qul innī lay yujīranī minallāhi aḥad(un), wa lan ajida min dūnihī multaḥadā(n).
قل اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولن اجد من دونه ملتحدا
say, "indeed, there will never protect me from allah anyone [if i should disobey], nor will i find in other than him a refuge.
qulinnilayyujiraniminallahiahadunwalanajidamindunihimultahadanqulinneelanyujeeraneeminaallahiahadunwalanajidamindoonihimultahada
But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
Illā balāgam minallāhi wa risālātih(ī), wa may ya‘ṣillāha wa rasūlahū fa inna lahū nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā(n).
الا بلغا من الله ورسلته  ومن يعص الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خلدين فيها ابدا
but [i have for you] only notification from allah, and his messages." and whoever disobeys allah and his messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of hell; they will abide therein forever.

illabalagamminallahiwarisalatihiwamayyasillahawarasulahufainnalahunarajahannamakhalidinafihaabadanillabalaghanminaallahiwarisalatihiwamanyaaasiallahawarasoolahufainnalahunarajahannamakhalideenafeehaabada
[The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
Ḥattā iżā ra'au mā yū‘adūna fasaya‘lamūna man aḍ‘afu nāṣiraw wa aqallu ‘adadā(n).
حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
[the disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
hattaizaraaumayuadunafasayalamunamanadafunasirawwaaqalluadadanhattaitharaawmayooaaadoonafasayaaalamoonamanadaaafunasiranwaaqalluaaadada
Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
Qul in adrī aqarībum mā tū‘adūna am yaj‘alu lahū rabbī amadā(n).
قل ان ادري اقريب ما توعدون ام يجعل له ربي امدا
say, "i do not know if what you are promised is near or if my lord will grant for it a [long] period."
qulinadriaqaribummatuadunaamyajalulahurabbiamadanqulinadreeaqareebunmatooaaadoonaamyajaaalulahurabbeeamada
[He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
‘Ālimul-gaibi falā yuẓhiru ‘alā gaibihī aḥadā(n).
علم الغيب فلا يظهر علي غيبه احدا
[he is] knower of the unseen, and he does not disclose his [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
alimulgaibifalayuzhirualagaibihiahadanaaalimualghaybifalayuthhiruaaalaghaybihiahada
Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
Illā manirtaḍā mir rasūlin fa innahū yasluku mim baini yadaihi wa min khalfihī raṣadā(n).
الا من ارتضي من رسول فانه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
except whom he has approved of messengers, and indeed, he sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
illamanirtadamirrasulinfainnahuyaslukumimbainiyadaihiwaminkhalfihirasadanillamaniirtadaminrasoolinfainnahuyaslukuminbayniyadayhiwaminkhalfihirasada
That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
Liya‘lama an qad ablagū risālāti rabbihim wa aḥāṭa bimā ladaihim wa aḥṣā kulla syai'in ‘adadā(n).
ليعلم ان قد ابلغوا رسلت ربهم واحاط بما لديهم واحصي كل شيء عددا
that he [i.e., muhammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their lord; and he has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
liyalamaanqadablagurisalatirabbihimwaahatabimaladaihimwaahsakullasyaiinadadanliyaaalamaanqadablaghoorisalatirabbihimwaahatabimaladayhimwaahsakullashayinaaadada
O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

o you who wraps himself [in clothing]

قم اليل الا قليلا

qumillailaillaqalilanqumiallaylaillaqaleela

نصفه او انقص منه قليلا
half of it - or subtract from it a little
nisfahuawinqusminhuqalilannisfahuawionqusminhuqaleela
Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
Au zid ‘alaihi wa rattilil-qur'āna tartīlā(n).
او زد عليه ورتل القرءان ترتيلا
or add to it, and recite the qur’an with measured recitation.
auzidalaihiwarattililquranatartilanawzidaaalayhiwarattilialquranatarteela

Innā sanulqī ‘alaika qaulan ṡaqīlā(n).

innasanulqialaikaqaulansaqilaninnasanulqeeaaalaykaqawlanthaqeela
Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
Inna nāsyi'atal-laili hiya asyaddu waṭ'aw wa aqwamu qīlā(n).
ان ناشئه اليل هي اشد وطا واقوم قيلا
indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
innanasyiatallailihiyaasyadduwatawwaaqwamuqilaninnanashiataallaylihiyaashadduwatanwaaqwamuqeela

Inna laka fin-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlā(n).
ان لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
innalakafinnaharisabhantawilaninnalakafeeannaharisabhantaweela
And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
Ważkurisma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabtīlā(n).
واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل اليه تبتيلا
and remember the name of your lord and devote yourself to him with [complete] devotion.
wazkurismarabbikawatabattalilaihitabtilanwathkuriismarabbikawatabattalilayhitabteela
[He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
Rabbul-masyriqi wal-magribi lā ilāha illā huwa fattakhiżhu wakīlā(n).
رب المشرق والمغرب لا اله الا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
[he is] the lord of the east and the west; there is no deity except him, so take him as disposer of [your] affairs.
rabbulmasyriqiwalmagribilailahaillahuwafattakhizhuwakilanrabbualmashriqiwalmaghribilailahaillahuwafattakhithhuwakeela
And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
Waṣbir ‘alā mā yaqūlūna wahjurhum hajran jamīlā(n).
واصبر علي ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا
and be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
wasbiralamayaqulunawahjurhumhajranjamilanwasbiraaalamayaqooloonawahjurhumhajranjameela

and leave me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

Inna ladainā ankālaw wa jaḥīmā(n).
ان لدينا انكالا وجحيما
indeed, with us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
innaladainaankalawwajahimaninnaladaynaankalanwajaheema
And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

and food that chokes and a painful punishment -
wataamanzagussatiwwaazabanalimanwataaaamanthaghussatinwaaaathabanaleema
On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

يوم ترجف الارض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
on the day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
yaumatarjufularduwaljibaluwakanatiljibalukasibammahilanyawmatarjufualarduwaljibaluwakanatialjibalukatheebanmaheela
Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
Innā arsalnā ilaikum rasūlā(n), syāhidan ‘alaikum kamā arsalnā ilā fir‘auna rasūlā(n).
انا ارسلنا اليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما ارسلنا الي فرعون رسولا
indeed, we have sent to you a messenger as a witness upon you just as we sent to pharaoh a messenger.
innaarsalnailaikumrasulansyahidanalaikumkamaarsalnailafiraunarasulaninnaarsalnailaykumrasoolanshahidanaaalaykumkamaarsalnailafiraaawnarasoola

Fa ‘aṣā fir‘aunar-rasūla fa akhażnāhu akhżaw wabīlā(n).
فعصي فرعون الرسول فاخذنه اخذا وبيلا
but pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so we seized him with a ruinous seizure.
faasafiraunarrasulafaakhaznahuakhzawwabilanfaaaasafiraaawnuarrasoolafaakhathnahuakhthanwabeela
Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
Fakaifa tattaqūna in kafartum yaumay yaj‘alul-wildāna syībā(n).
فكيف تتقون ان كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدن شيبا
then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a day that will make the children white-haired?
fakaifatattaqunainkafartumyaumayyajalulwildanasyibanfakayfatattaqoonainkafartumyawmanyajaaalualwildanasheeba
The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
As-samā'u munfaṭirum bih(ī), kāna wa‘duhū maf‘ūlā(n).
السماء منفطر به  كان وعده مفعولا
the heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is his promise fulfilled.
assamaumunfatirumbihikanawaduhumafulanassamaomunfatirunbihikanawaaaduhumafaaoola
Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
Inna hāżihī tażkirah(tun), faman syā'attakhaża ilā rabbihī sabīlā(n).
ان هذه تذكره  فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his lord a way.
innahazihitazkirahtunfamansyaattakhazailarabbihisabilaninnahathihitathkiratunfamanshaaittakhathailarabbihisabeela

Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

Inna rabbaka ya‘lamu annaka taqūmu adnā min ṡuluṡayil-laili wa niṣfahū wa ṡuluṡahū wa ṭā'ifatum minal-lażīna ma‘ak(a), wallāhu yuqaddirul-laila wan-nahār(a), ‘alima allan tuḥṣūhu fa tāba ‘alaikum faqra'ū mā tayassara minal-qur'ān(i), ‘alima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā, wa ākharūna yaḍribūna fil-arḍi yabtagūna min faḍlillāh(i), wa ākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīlillāh(i), faqra'ū mā tayassara minh(u), wa aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa ātuz-zakāta wa aqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanā(n), wa mā tuqaddimū li'anfusikum min khairin tajidūhu ‘indallāh(i), huwa khairaw wa a‘ẓama ajrā(n), wastagfirullāh(a), innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).

ان ربك يعلم انك تقوم ادني من ثلثي اليل ونصفه وثلثه وطائفه من الذين معك  والله يقدر اليل والنهار  علم ان لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم  فاقرءوا ما تيسر من القرءان  علم ان سيكون منكم مرضي  وءاخرون يضربون في الارض يبتغون من فضل الله  وءاخرون يقتلون في سبيل الله  فاقرءوا ما تيسر منه  واقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا  وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا واعظم اجرا  واستغفروا الله  ان الله غفور رحيم

indeed, your lord knows, [o muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. and allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. he has known that you [muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the qur’an. he has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of allah and others fighting for the cause of allah. so recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan allah a goodly loan. and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with allah. it is better and greater in reward. and seek forgiveness of allah. indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful.
